Laporan · Log simulasi · Source bernomor baris

Unduh paket bukti dan testbench (.zip)

SHA-256 paket bukti: 34da844288503428034b6ffbdfaf8acdbdd8c27709be8c997d7b2d9dd8abe943

Audit Rev 3.0 — 31 Oktober 2026, baseline 11:39 KST

Kesimpulan: FEC memiliki bukti regresi yang kuat. Keseluruhan modem belum lulus verifikasi end-to-end dan belum dapat dinyatakan bebas bug atau aman untuk hardware. Masalah paling relevan terhadap demo adalah batas paket menuju backend, pengikatan seed IDLE dengan nomor frame, serta timer ARQ. Struktur CDC juga belum sesuai dengan catatan rilis.

Audit ID: SDA-20261031-1139-A. Fokus tetap paket Ethernet 2.000 byte yang disegmentasi menjadi 1.900 + 100 byte, IDLE, MGMT, dan pengujian ketangguhan multi-paket. Ukuran paket besar dalam regresi bukan penambahan requirement demo. Timestamp statis dan active-disparity inversion OFF tetap dicatat sebagai batas cakupan. LPC encoder/decoder tetap aktif.

1. Baseline dan metode

[FAKTA SUMBER] Arsip yang diperiksa adalah Keseluruhan Codingan SDAOISL10Gto10G 31 Oct 2026 (11.39 am).zip, SHA-256:

aa48d62d1b9582c415b8ed19064af3f1477e01288598fb68b08d4f27f7006c46

Arsip memuat 150 file. Tepat lima RTL berubah dibanding baseline 30 Oktober 18:47. Kelima file tersebut identik byte-per-byte dengan lima lampiran Rev 3.0 yang dikirim sebelumnya. Source DUT tidak dimodifikasi untuk audit. Seluruh file diinventarisasi dan dependensi diindeks; review terperinci diarahkan pada perubahan, FEC, ARQ, serta integrasi jalur paket.

[HASIL SIMULASI] Pengujian menggunakan Icarus Verilog 12.0 dan Python. Semua 28 testbench bawaan dicoba: 17 berhasil dikompilasi dan selesai, 11 terhalang dependensi IP vendor atau modul legacy. Beberapa TB yang selesai hanya bersifat demonstrasi sehingga exit code nol tidak otomatis berarti seluruh kontennya telah diperiksa.

[BELUM DIVERIFIKASI] Vivado/xsim, synthesis, implementation, timing closure, laporan CDC vendor, bitstream, dan FPGA fisik tidak dijalankan. Elaborasi top dengan -i hanya memeriksa struktur yang tersedia, karena opsi itu mengabaikan modul tidak dikenal. Ini bukan simulasi modem lengkap.

2. Temuan yang perlu ditindaklanjuti

D01 — Catatan rilis tidak sesuai isi ZIP

[FAKTA SUMBER] Beberapa perbaikan yang dijanjikan belum terdapat dalam artefak yang diaudit.

Klaim Source aktual Status
Akumulator frame_frac_acc Tidak ada; periode tetap 804 siklus B13 terbuka
auto_tick_credit Tidak ada Kasus hitungan ganda masih muncul
slot_del_pending dalam allocator Tidak ada Proteksi reuse belum terbukti
rst_warmup_done Tidak ada Jangan disebut sudah diterapkan
Sinkronisasi balik Gray read pointer melalui src_sync_clk Tidak ada B14 belum selesai untuk hardware
Continuation tidak konsisten membuang seluruh sisa frame Kode melewati panjang yang dinyatakan lalu dapat mencari header lagi Deskripsi rilis lebih kuat daripada implementasi

[INTERPRETASI] Belum diketahui apakah arsip yang salah dikirim atau perubahan belum tersimpan. Developer perlu menyelaraskan source, diff, hash, dan catatan rilis terlebih dahulu. Ketiadaan bitmap pending-delete belum menjadi bukti adanya collision reuse baru: kasus collision lama justru sudah lulus. Pisahkan klaim yang belum terbukti dari bug yang benar-benar direproduksi.

D02 — Dua atau lebih paket dapat tergabung di backend Ethernet

[HASIL SIMULASI] packed_backend.sv memasukkan dua paket 64 byte dalam satu frame FSO yang valid. Reassembly mengenali dua paket, tetapi backend menghasilkan satu terminator /T/ dengan snapshot panjang MAC 136 byte, bukan dua paket 64 byte. Kasus ini memakai ready konstan tinggi.

Pada queued_backend.sv, lima paket 2.000, 2.000, 64, 128, dan 1.516 byte dikuras setelah tertahan. Reassembly mengeluarkan 1.437 kata dan lima TLAST tanpa mismatch, tetapi backend menghasilkan satu /T/ dengan panjang 5.740 byte.

[FAKTA SUMBER] FSM reassembly dapat langsung berpindah dari DR_DATA ke DR_PRE0 jika paket berikutnya sudah tersedia. Valid tidak turun di batas paket. Backend tidak menerima TLAST dan formatter mengandalkan turunnya valid untuk mendeteksi akhir paket.

[HASIL HITUNGAN] 64 + 8 byte preamble paket berikutnya + 64 = 136 byte. Untuk lima paket, 5.708 byte data + empat preamble internal × 8 = 5.740 byte. Ini sesuai dengan observasi simulasi.

[INTERPRETASI / PERBAIKAN] Gunakan batas paket eksplisit melalui last dan buffering/ready di backend, atau tambahkan jeda antar-paket yang benar-benar memenuhi kebutuhan formatter saat ini. Satu siklus valid rendah belum cukup untuk dianggap sebagai solusi, karena formatter juga melewati IPG_WAIT dan tidak mempunyai input ready. Pertahankan ketahanan stall reassembly yang sudah lulus.

Acceptance: dua paket 64 byte menghasilkan dua /T/ dan panjang masing-masing benar; lima paket menghasilkan lima /T/, urutan dan seluruh byte tetap benar, baik dengan maupun tanpa stall. Ini prioritas tinggi untuk demo multi-paket.

D03 — Seed IDLE dapat tidak cocok dengan TXFN setelah DATA

[HASIL SIMULASI] framer_data_then_idle.sv menjalankan framer aktual dengan satu segmen DATA, kemudian IDLE. Retry dinonaktifkan hanya untuk mengisolasi scheduling. Pada IDLE pertama setelah DATA, log menunjukkan:

IDLE_BIND txfn=1 seed=1 word0=80000040
SEED_MISMATCHES 1

TXFN 1 seharusnya terkait seed 2, dengan Word 0 40000020. Generator telah mengunci seed 1 melalui prefetch ketika DATA masih berjalan. Ini terjadi tanpa stall. Pengujian IDLE-only yang mulai dari TXFN 0 tidak memperlihatkan masalah tersebut.

[INTERPRETASI / PERBAIKAN] Penetapan TXFN/header harus terikat pada start atau commit frame payload. Jangan menawarkan Word 0 sebelum identitas frame final. Namun, kata yang sudah ditawarkan dengan valid tinggi harus tetap stabil sampai diterima. Mengubah data tepat ketika ready naik akan menghidupkan kembali bug B15.

Acceptance: DATA→IDLE, MGMT→IDLE, late-selection, stall pada kata pertama, dan frame beruntun harus menjaga kesesuaian TXFN/seed serta kontrak valid/ready. Bukti ini berada pada integrasi framer/payload, belum merupakan pengukuran on-wire GTH.

D04 / B13 — Timer belum fraksional dan masih dapat menghitung ganda

[FAKTA SUMBER] CLK_FREQ_HZ dideklarasikan tetapi tidak digunakan untuk menentukan periode. FRAME_DURATION_CYCLES tetap 804.

[HASIL SIMULASI] Setelah tick pertama, histogram 128 interval menunjukkan:

Parameter frekuensi Expected menurut rilis Actual
322.265.625 Hz 51 × 803 + 77 × 804 = 102.861 siklus 128 × 804 = 102.912 siklus
312.500.000 Hz 96 × 779 + 32 × 780 = 99.744 siklus 128 × 804 = 102.912 siklus

TB mengukur jumlah siklus menggunakan clock simulasi 5 ns. Konversi ke frekuensi operasional berikut adalah hasil hitungan, bukan pengukuran hardware.

[HASIL HITUNGAN] Pada 322,265625 MHz, 804 siklus = 2.494,836 ns, lebih panjang 1,236 ns daripada 2.493,6 ns. Pada 312,5 MHz, 804 siklus = 2.572,8 ns, lebih panjang 79,2 ns. Pendekatan konstan boleh dibahas sebagai toleransi prototipe, tetapi tidak boleh disebut rata-rata eksak atau otomatis mengikuti clock.

[HASIL SIMULASI] Dalam timer_adjacent_valid_future.sv, tick otonom menaikkan count menjadi 1. Event non-DATA valid dengan TXFN 4 pada siklus berikutnya menaikkan count menjadi 2. Reset fase saja tidak menghapus waktu yang sudah dihitung.

[INTERPRETASI / PERBAIKAN] Implementasikan akumulator sesuai frekuensi dan satu definisi elapsed time. Buktikan bahwa tick otonom dan event frame tidak menghitung periode yang sama dua kali. Penghapusan reset timer oleh penulisan RAM pada revisi ini sudah ada dan perlu dipertahankan.

D05 / B14 — CDC lulus simulasi ideal, struktur hardware belum selesai

[FAKTA SUMBER] Full aktual dihitung dengan:

wire src_arq_full = ((src_arq_wr_bin - dst_arq_rd_bin) >= 5'd16);
always @(posedge arq_valid_clean or negedge rst_n)

Pointer baca biner digunakan langsung lintas domain. Gray write pointer disinkronkan ke tujuan, tetapi Gray read pointer tidak disinkronkan kembali. Jalur peer mempunyai persoalan struktur serupa.

[HASIL SIMULASI] Burst 8 dan 16 event diterima berurutan. Burst 17 menerima 16 dengan overflow 1; burst 32 menerima 16 dengan overflow 16. Empat batch 16 event dengan drain/refill menghasilkan urutan 1–64 tanpa overflow. Tes lama yang hanya menunggu 100 ns memotong capture kedelapan; dengan 500 ns, delapan event terbaca. Itu masalah durasi harness, bukan kehilangan event kedelapan di RTL.

[INTERPRETASI / PERBAIKAN] Gunakan clock sumber kontinu dengan write enable, sinkronisasi balik Gray read pointer, full/empty yang konsisten, reset per domain, dan constraints CDC. Kelulusan simulasi digital ideal tidak membuktikan keamanan metastabilitas. Overflow counter hanya mencatat event yang ditolak, tidak memulihkannya.

D06 / B22 — ARQ MGMT belum diterapkan seperti DATA

[HASIL SIMULASI] Matriks RX menunjukkan DATA CRC benar menghasilkan ACK, CRC salah menghasilkan NAK, dan header salah tidak menghasilkan local ACK. Peer ACK diteruskan terpisah. MGMT dengan CRC benar menghasilkan non-data sequence advancement tetapi tidak menghasilkan local ACK; CRC MGMT salah juga tidak menghasilkan NAK.

[FAKTA SUMBER] TX MGMT tidak disimpan dan dilacak seperti DATA. Materi SDA OISL proyek §2.6.3.3.3 mencakup DATA dan MGMT dalam ARQ, sedangkan IDLE dikecualikan.

[INTERPRETASI] Untuk demo yang memang hanya membuktikan ARQ DATA, nyatakan batas ini secara eksplisit. Jangan mengklaim kepatuhan ARQ lengkap. Menambahkan MGMT ARQ memerlukan penyimpanan, retransmisi, dan feedback yang konsisten, bukan sekadar mengubah conditional pada RX.

3. FEC: hasil yang sudah memiliki bukti kuat

[HASIL SIMULASI] Regresi dijalankan kembali menggunakan source arsip ini.

Pengujian Hasil Batas penting
GF multiply, polinomial 0x187 65.536 pasangan, 0 mismatch Exhaustive operasi 8 bit
GF inverse 255 input nonzero, 0 failure Termasuk inverse 1
RS encoder 16→32 dan 239→255, 0 mismatch Oracle GF independen
RS decoder dasar 14 kasus, 0 mismatch Model BRAM dua siklus
RS extended 372 kasus k=16 + 595 kasus k=239, semuanya lulus Total 967 kasus terpilih
RS streaming 30 frame per konfigurasi, interval 499 dan 498 siklus Empat run, total 120 frame; 0 mismatch
Decoder delapan lane dengan injeksi penuh 64 byte header dan 956 word payload kembali benar Empat frame, 8 error per codeword
LPC inversion OFF 1.638.400 kasus, 0 failure 65.536 input × 25 pola tanpa/single-bit error
Scrambler/LPC chain 1.036 input/output, 0 mismatch Rantai terpilih
Demux 32 header + 255 payload, 0 mismatch Pemetaan konten stimulus
CRC32 dengan stall 210 kata, 0 mismatch Termasuk kata CRC

Koreksi penting untuk laporan decoder: mask asli E175_0023_4600_8792 mempunyai dua lane nol. Karena itu TB asli menginjeksi 48 simbol payload per frame, bukan 64. Auditor menjalankan varian E175_1123_4622_8792 yang mengaktifkan seluruh delapan lane, serta delapan error header. Empat frame mengandung total 256 simbol payload rusak dan 32 simbol header rusak; seluruh output yang diperiksa kembali benar. DUT tidak diubah.

Bukti ini mendukung klaim 8 simbol error per codeword pada seluruh delapan lane untuk stimulus yang diuji, bukan 64 error pada sembarang distribusi. Lebih dari 8 simbol per codeword berada di luar jaminan koreksi RS tersebut. Timing vendor, semua pola error yang mungkin, active-disparity ON, dan BER hardware belum terbukti.

Tidak ada temuan dari pengujian ini yang mengharuskan penulisan ulang RS atau LPC. Pertahankan regresinya ketika control plane diperbaiki.

Reorder 1,3,2 1.431 kata, 3 TLAST, 0 mismatch termasuk stall Lulus kasus terpilih
Recovery tanpa IDLE 954 kata, 2 TLAST, 0 mismatch setelah timeout Lulus; akurasi timer D04 terbuka
B15 Held Word 0 tidak berubah pada tepi penerimaan Lulus; binding seed D03 terpisah
B21 Satu paket 2.000 byte dihitung sebagai satu paket dan 2.000 byte Lulus unit

TB ARQ bawaan juga menyelesaikan DATA→ACK, DATA→NAK→RETX→ACK, timeout sampai lima retry lalu drop, dan scheduling MGMT. Jumlah enam retransmisi dalam log merupakan satu akibat NAK ditambah lima akibat timeout, bukan enam retry untuk satu frame.

Roundtrip frontend→payload→reassembly pada 12 ukuran, termasuk 2.000 byte, lulus pemeriksaan terarah. Untuk 2.000 byte diperoleh 502 kata termasuk preamble, satu TLAST, dan nol byte error. Kelulusan ukuran 65 byte sampai reassembly tidak membuktikan egress byte-accurate: batas egress kelipatan empat byte tetap berlaku.

5. Durasi, byte, dan batas kepatuhan

[HASIL HITUNGAN] Frame 3.117 byte = 24.936 bit pada 10 Gb/s memiliki durasi 2.493,6 ns. Header RS 16→32 byte kemudian LPC menjadi 48 byte. Payload 8×239→8×255 byte kemudian LPC menjadi 3.060 byte. Ditambah preamble 9 byte, totalnya 3.117 byte.

Informasi 1.908 byte berbeda dari 1.900 byte Ethernet pada segmen awal dan 1.912 byte setelah CRC. Rasio informasi 1.908/3.117 menghasilkan sekitar 6,12127 Gb/s. Jika satu paket 2.000 byte memakai dua frame penuh, laju paket tersebut sekitar 3,20821 Gb/s sebelum interleaving lainnya. Backpressure internal tidak otomatis menghentikan trafik dari Ethernet fisik.

Pada 200 MHz, durasi frame ideal adalah 498,72 siklus. Kombinasi interval 498 dan 499 siklus dapat memberi rata-rata tersebut. Tidak tepat menetapkan 2.490 ns sebagai durasi normatif hanya karena clock memiliki kuantisasi 5 ns.

[BELUM DIVERIFIKASI] FCS yang diterima NIC, pengiriman ke aplikasi host, full GTH chain, timing hardware, DC balance fisik, dan native SDA waveform. TB backend memakai FCS dummy. Tunnel 64B/66B dan LPC inversion OFF harus dinyatakan sebagai konfigurasi laboratorium, bukan sertifikasi optical PHY.

6. Urutan revisi dan syarat penutupan

  1. Developer: pastikan ZIP benar-benar berisi perubahan yang dinyatakan. Bekukan hash dan diff untuk audit berikutnya.
  2. Developer + auditor: perbaiki D02 lalu buktikan jumlah /T/, panjang setiap paket, urutan, dan byte dengan/ tanpa stall.
  3. Developer + auditor: perbaiki D03 dengan kontrak start frame yang menjaga TXFN/seed sekaligus stabilitas valid/ready.
  4. Developer + auditor: tutup B13 melalui histogram periode dan test event/tick berdekatan; tulis toleransi bila memilih pendekatan konstan.
  5. Developer + tim FPGA: tutup B14 melalui desain CDC yang benar, regresi reset/full/refill, serta laporan implementasi vendor.
  6. Williams/tim: nyatakan apakah laporan hanya mencakup ARQ DATA atau MGMT ARQ juga menjadi syarat penerimaan. Scope prototipe tidak boleh ditulis sebagai kepatuhan penuh.
  7. Jalankan kembali regresi FEC dan paket setelah revisi. Semua penutupan harus menyertakan hash source, stimulus, expected/actual, dan log.

Laporan ETRI dapat disusun sekarang sebagai laporan kemajuan verifikasi FEC dan ARQ DATA, dengan daftar temuan terbuka. Belum tepat menyebut modem keseluruhan lulus, seluruh Rev 3.0 telah diterapkan, atau FPGA siap berdasarkan Icarus saja.

7. Membaca dan mengulang bukti

Lampiran memuat log mentah, source bernomor baris, manifest, diff, TB auditor, dan model BRAM. Tombol unduh di awal laporan menyediakan paket bukti. reproduce_selected.py adalah runner portabel untuk kasus integrasi utama; script lama disimpan sebagai rekam eksperimen dan beberapa masih memakai path lingkungan audit asli.

Exit code nol simulator bukan otomatis PASS. Runner melaporkan apakah observasi baseline berhasil direproduksi, termasuk kegagalan DUT yang memang diharapkan pada baseline ini. Hist timer tidak menunggu expiry 255 frame; skor drain di akhir log histogram bukan indikator kegagalan reorder. Oracle late-selection lama mengharapkan seed baru pada frame yang sudah ditawarkan; ketidakcocokan itu tidak dipakai sebagai bukti D03. Temuan D03 berasal dari integrasi DATA→IDLE aktual.

/*
===========================================================================
Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
Module Name  : tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.v
               (eth_mac_packing_tx + xgmii_tx_formatter) at 312.5 MHz.

               Revision History:
               - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic stimulus testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.
               - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:09 KST) :
                 1. Preserved original module/instance names and port structure.
                 2. Upgraded input stimulus to feed an authentic 502-word 
                    (2008-Byte) Ethernet frame (2 words [8B] Preamble 
                    0x55555555_555555D5 + 500 words [2000B] Jumbo Ethernet 
                    Packet ending in FCS 0xDEADBEEF).
                 3. Added zero-lag waveform counters for input (in_word_cnt 
                    1..502, in_byte_cnt 4..2008) and XGMII output 
                    (xgmii_word_cnt 1..503, xgmii_byte_cnt 4..2012).
===========================================================================
*/

module tb_eth_tx_back_end_top();
    reg clk;
    reg rst_n;
    reg [31:0] data_in;
    reg        en;
    
    wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
    wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
    wire        txp_unused, txn_unused;

    // Zero-lag Input & Output Counters for Waveform Verification
    reg  [15:0] in_word_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] in_byte_cnt;
    reg  [15:0] raw_xgmii_idx;
    wire        xgmii_active   = (xgmii_txd != 32'h0707_0707);
    wire [15:0] xgmii_word_cnt = xgmii_active ? (raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) : 16'd0; // 1..503
    wire [15:0] xgmii_byte_cnt = xgmii_active ? ((raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) * 16'd

constrs_1/new/SDAOISL10Gto10G.xdc
    1  #==============================================================================
    2  # Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    3  # Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    4  # File Name    : SDAOISL10Gto10G.xdc
    5  # Target Board : ALINX AXKU062 (AMD Xilinx Kintex UltraScale xcku060-ffva1156-2-i)
    6  # Description  : Physical Pin, GTH Quad X1Y2 Co-Location, CDC Timing, and 
    7  #                3 Stage-Dedicated ChipScope ILA Cores (TX, GTH, RX)
    8  #
    9  # Revision History:
   10  #   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Physical constraints and 3 stage-dedicated ILA cores.
   11  #   - Rev 2.7 (2026-10-30 02:53 KST) : [Audit Fix N15 - Exact Differential Clock Pins]
   12  #     1. Aligned 200 MHz differential system oscillator pins with ALINX AXKU062 
   13  #        User Manual Section 2.3 (Page 16): sys_clk_p = Pin AK17, sys_clk_n = Pin AK16
   14  #        (Bank 45, DIFF_HSTL_I_18) with explicit 5.000 ns period create_clock.
   15  #     2. Added explicit GTH reference clock N-side pin assignment (fso_refclk_n = Pin T5).
   16  #==============================================================================
   17  
   18  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   19  # 1. BITSTREAM & SPI FLASH CONFIGURATION PROPERTIES
   20  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   21  set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.SPI_BUSWIDTH 8 [current_design]
   22  set_property CONFIG_MODE SPIx8 [current_design]
   23  set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.CONFIGRATE 50 [current_design]
   24  set_property BITSTREAM.GENERAL.COMPRESS TRUE [current_design]
   25  set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.UNUSEDPIN PULLUP [current_design]
   26  
   27  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   28  # 2. SYSTEM DIFFERENTIAL CLOCK (200 MHz Oscillator -> Pin AK17 / AK16, Bank 45)
   29  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   30  set_property PACKAGE_PIN AK17 [get_ports sys_clk_p]
   31  set_property PACKAGE_PIN AK16 [get_ports sys_clk_n]
   32  set_property IOSTANDARD DIFF_HSTL_I_18 [get_ports sys_clk_p]
   33  set_property IOSTANDARD DIFF_HSTL_I_18 [get_ports sys_clk_n]
   34  create_clock -name clk_sys_200m -period 5.000 [get_ports sys_clk_p]
   35  
   36  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   37  # 3. GTH REFERENCE CLOCK & QUAD X1Y2 CO-LOCATION (156.25 MHz -> Pin T6 / T5)
   38  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   39  set_property PACKAGE_PIN T6 [get_ports fso_refclk_p]
   40  set_property PACKAGE_PIN T5 [get_ports fso_refclk_n]
   41  create_clock -name clk_fso_refclk_p -period 6.400 [get_ports fso_refclk_p]
   42  
   43  set_property LOC GTHE3_COMMON_X1Y2 [get_cells {u_fso_gth_core/u_gth_fso_64b66b/inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3_top.gth_fso_64b66b_gtwizard_gthe3_inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3.gen_common.gen_common_container[3].gen_enabled_common.gthe3_common_wrapper_inst/common_inst/gthe3_common_gen.GTHE3_COMMON_PRIM_INST}]
   44  set_property LOC GTHE3_CHANNEL_X1Y8 [get_cells {u_fso_gth_core/u_gth_fso_64b66b/inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3_top.gth_fso_64b66b_gtwizard_gthe3_inst/gen_gtwizard_gthe3.gen_channel_container[3].gen_enabled_channel.gthe3_channel_wrapper_inst/channel_inst/gthe3_channel_gen.gen_gthe3_channel_inst[0].GTHE3_CHANNEL_PRIM_INST}]
   45  
   46  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   47  # 4. SFP+ OPTICAL MODULE CONTROL & BOARD COOLING FAN PINS (LVCMOS18)
   48  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   49  set_property PACKAGE_PIN AN11 [get_ports {tx_disable[0]}]
   50  set_property PACKAGE_PIN AM11 [get_ports {tx_disable[1]}]
   51  set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18 [get_ports {tx_disable[0]}]
   52  set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18 [get_ports {tx_disable[1]}]
   53  
   54  set_property PACKAGE_PIN AK11 [get_ports fan]
   55  set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18 [get_ports fan]
   56  
   57  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   58  # 5. ASYNCHRONOUS CLOCK DOMAIN CROSSING (CDC) & GTH CLOCK GROUPS
   59  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   60  set_clock_groups -asynchronous \
   61      -group [get_clocks -include_generated_clocks -of_objects [get_pins clk_wiz_0_inst/inst/mmcme3_adv_inst/CLKOUT0]] \
   62      -group [get_clocks -include_generated_clocks -of_objects [get_pins clk_wiz_0_inst/inst/mmcme3_adv_inst/CLKOUT1]] \
   63      -group [get_clocks -include_generated_clocks -of_objects [get_pins u_fso_gth_core/u_bufg_gt_tx/O]] \
   64      -group [get_clocks -include_generated_clocks -of_objects [get_pins u_fso_gth_core/u_bufg_gt_rx/O]]
   65  
   66  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   67  # 6. FALSE PATH & DRC RELAXATION FOR SIMULATION-ONLY TOP-LEVEL PROBING PORTS
   68  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
   69  set_false_path -to [get_ports {tx_fso_data_out[*] tx_fso_valid_out}]
   70  set_false_path -to [get_ports {rx_fso_data_out[*] rx_fso_valid_out}]
   71  set_false_path -to [get_ports {rx_dec_hdr_tdata[*] rx_dec_hdr_tvalid}]
   72  set_false_path -to [get_ports {rx_dec_pld_tdata[*] rx_dec_pld_tvalid}]
   73  set_false_path -to [get_ports {pc2_xgmii_txd[*] pc2_xgmii_txc[*]}]
   74  set_false_path -to [get_ports {rx_preamble_locked rx_block_locked gth_link_up eth_data_error_flag}]
   75  
   76  set_property SEVERITY {Warning} [get_drc_checks NSTD-1]
   77  set_property SEVERITY {Warning} [get_drc_checks UCIO-1]
   78  
   79  # =============================================================================
   80  # 7. STAGE-BASED INTEGRATED LOGIC ANALYZER (ILA) CONFIGURATION
   81  # =============================================================================
   82

   84  # ILA 1 (u_ila_0): TX STAGE MONITOR (Inside u_gth64b66b_tx, Clock: tx0_clk)
   85  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

   94  set_property C_TRIGOUT_EN false [get_debug_cores u_ila_0]
   95  
   96  set_property port_width 1 [get_debug_ports u_ila_0/clk]
   97  connect_debug_port u_ila_0/clk [get_nets [list tx0_clk]]

setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl
    1  # ==============================================================================
    2  # Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    3  # Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    4  # File Name    : setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl
    5  # Description  : Unified Auto-Grouping Waveform Script for All 25 Testbenches
    6  #                in the SDA OISL 10G-to-10G Optical Communication Project.
    7  #                - Keeps standard default Vivado waveform colors.
    8  #                - Automatically sets Radix (unsigned for counters/indices,
    9  #                  ascii for string tags, hex for data/header/CRC buses).
   10  #
   11  # Revision History:
   12  #   - Rev 1.0 (2026-10-27) : Initial 25-testbench auto-grouping Tcl dispatcher.
   13  #   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : Synchronized all 25 testbench waveform
   14  #     groups to include unified frame_id, frame_type_str ("DAT1", "DAT2", 
   15  #     "IDLE", "MGMT"), in_clk_cnt, in_byte_cnt, out_clk_cnt, out_byte_cnt, 
   16  #     and scoreboard telemetry counters.
   17  #
   18  # Usage        : In Vivado Tcl Console (while any simulation is open), run:
   19  #                  source setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl
   20  # ==============================================================================
   21  
   22  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   23  # HELPER PROCEDURE: Safely adds a list of signals into a collapsible Wave Group
   24  #                   with automatic Radix formatting and default Vivado colors.
   25  # ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   26  proc add_grp_sigs {grp_title top_scope sig_list} {
   27      set grp_obj [add_wave_group $grp_title]
   28      foreach s $sig_list {
   29          set full_path "/${top_scope}/${s}"
   30          set obj [get_objects -quiet $full_path]
   31          if {[llength $obj] > 0} {
   32              set w [add_wave -into $grp_obj $obj]
   33              set s_low [string tolower $s]
   34              # Auto-select Radix based on signal name convention (colors untouched)
   35              if {[string match "*_str*" $s_low] || [string match "*ascii*" $s_low]} {
   36                  set_property radix ascii $w
   37              } elseif {[string match "time_*" $s_low] || [string match "oisl_*" $s_low] || [string match "measured_*" $s_low]} {
   38                  # Real/floating-point metric signals keep default real format
   39              } elseif {[string match "*_cnt*" $s_low] || [string match "*_idx*" $s_low] || \
   40                        [string match "*_index*" $s_low] || [string match "*_bytes*" $s_low] || \
   41                        [string match "*_words*" $s_low] || [string match "*frame_id*" $s_low] || \
   42                        [string match "*_size*" $s_low] || [string match "*_disp*" $s_low] || \
   43                        [string match "*repaired*" $s_low] || [string match "*_pass_*" $s_low] || \
   44                        [string match "*_ok_*" $s_low] || [string match "*_err_*" $s_low] || \
   45                        [string match "*tracker*" $s_low] || [string match "*scenario_id*" $s_low] || \
   46                        [string match "*_sequence*" $s_low] || [string match "*_tod_*" $s_low] || \
   47                        [string match "*_sec*" $s_low] || [string match "*_picosec*" $s_low] || \
   48                        [string match "*_acc*" $s_low]} {
   49                  set_property radix unsigned $w
   50              } else {
   51                  catch {set_property radix hex $w}
   52              }
   53          }
   54      }
   55  }
   56  
   57  # ==============================================================================
   58  # 1. tb_fso_header_top (4 Frames: DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT)
   59  # ==============================================================================
   60  proc wave_tb_fso_header_top {} {
   61      set t "tb_fso_header_top"
   62      add_grp_sigs "1_Clocks_and_Frame_ID" $t {clk rst_n frame_id frame_type_str scenario_id trigger_header_gen system_busy}
   63      add_grp_sigs "2_Table_2_9_Header_Inputs" $t {txfn_in rxfn_in ack_in ack_valid_in frame_type_in tx_ts_in tod_seconds_in ts_applies_in fcch_opcode_in fcch_pl_in}
   64      add_grp_sigs "3_Serialized_16B_Header_and_CRC16_Out" $t {final_header_valid final_header_byte byte_tracker out_clk_cnt out_byte_cnt total_hdr_bytes error_cnt}
   65  }
   66  
   67  # ==============================================================================
   68  # 2. tb_fso_payload (2000B Jumbo: DAT1, DAT2 Continuation & ARQ Retx)
   69  # ==============================================================================
   70  proc wave_tb_fso_payload {} {
   71      set t "tb_fso_payload"
   72      add_grp_sigs "1_PC_Packet_Gen_2000B" $t {clk rst_n trigger target_frame_size frame_id frame_type_str gen_tvalid gen_tdata gen_tkeep gen_tlast gen_tready}
   73      add_grp_sigs "2_FrontEnd_1900B_Segmenter" $t {seg_tvalid seg_tdata seg_tlast seg_tready seg_valid_bytes in_clk_cnt in_byte_cnt}
   74      add_grp_sigs "3_FSO_Payload_1912B_Table_2_18" $t {fifo_data_tvalid fifo_data_tdata fifo_data_tlast fifo_data_tready payload_cycle_cnt out_clk_cnt out_byte_cnt frame1_word_cnt frame2_word_cnt f1_pld_hdr f1_pkt_hdr f1_crc32 f2_pld_hdr f2_word1_data f2_word25_fcs f2_crc32}
   75      add_grp_sigs "4_ARQ_DDR4_Sniffer_and_Retx" $t {ddr4_write_req ddr4_read_req ddr4_delete_req ddr4_addr retx_data_tvalid retx_data_tdata retx_data_tlast retx_word_cnt retx_last_word_crc32}
   76  }
   77  
   78  # ==============================================================================
   79  # 3. tb_idle_MGMT (25-bit PRBS IDLE & 5000 km MGMT Telemetry)
   80  # ==============================================================================
   81  proc wave_tb_idle_MGMT {} {
   82      set t "tb_idle_MGMT"
   83      add_grp_sigs "1_Clocks_MUX_and_PNT_Inputs" $t {clk rst_n frame_id frame_type_str payload_mux_sel txfn_in mgmt_trigger_1hz rx_phy_ts_sec rx_phy_ts_picosec tx_phy_ts_sec tx_phy_ts_picosec range_meters range_ts_sec range_ts_picosec ts_valid}
   84      add_grp_sigs "2_Path00_IDLE_25b_PRBS_1912B" $t {idle_tvalid idle_tdata idle_tlast idle_tready idle_crc_cnt idle_first_word_txfn0 idle_first_word_txfn1}
   85      add_grp_sigs "3_Path10_MGMT_Table_2_14_1912B" $t {mgmt_tvalid mgmt_tdata mgmt_tlast mgmt_tready mgmt_crc_cnt}
   86      add_grp_sigs "4_Arbitrated_FSO_MUX_Out" $t {m_axis_fso_tvalid m_axis_fso_tdata m_axis_fso_tlast m_axis_fso_tready out_clk_cnt out_byte_cnt}
   87  }
   88  
   89  # ==============================================================================
   90  # 4. tb_FEC_RS (RS(32,16) + 8xRS(255,239) over GF 0x187 + FEC_MUX)
   91  # ==============================================================================
   92  proc wave_tb_FEC_RS {} {
   93      set t "tb_FEC_RS"
   94      add_grp_sigs "1_Clocks_and_Frame_FSM" $t {clk rst_n tb_state frame_id mux_frame_type_str cycle_cnt}
   95      add_grp_sigs "2_Unencoded_Header_16B_and_Payload_1912B" $t {en_head header_in in_header_byte_idx in_header_word_idx en_load payload_in in_payload_word_idx in_payload_byte_idx}
   96      add_grp_sigs "3_RS_32_16_and_8xRS_255_239_Out" $t {rs_head_dv rs_head_out rs_head_out_byte_idx rs_head_out_word_idx rs_load_dv rs_load_out rs_load_out_word_idx rs_load_out_byte_idx}
   97      add_grp_sigs "4_FEC_MUX_259W_and_GF0x187_Syndrome" $t {mux_dv mux_data_out mux_out_word_idx mux_out_byte_idx hdr_synd_done hdr_syndrome_vec pld_synd_done pld_syndrome_vec hdr_synd_pass_cnt pld_synd_pass_cnt}
   98  }
   99  
  100  # ==============================================================================
  101  # 5. tb_Scrambler_LPC (25-bit PRBS Seed 0x0000007 + LPC(24,16) Disparity)
  102  # ==============================================================================
  103  proc wave_tb_Scrambler_LPC {} {
  104      set t "tb_Scrambler_LPC"
  105      add_grp_sigs "1_Clocks_and_Frame_FSM" $t {clk rst_n tb_state frame_id frame_type_str cycle_cnt}
  106      add_grp_sigs "2_FEC_MUX_Input_2072B" $t {mux_dv mux_data in_mux_word_idx in_mux_byte_idx}
  107      add_grp_sigs "3_Scrambler_25b_Seed_0x0000007" $t {scr_dv scr_data scr_state_25b scr_prbs_mask_64b out_scr_word_idx out_scr_byte_idx}
  108      add_grp_sigs "4_LPC_24_16_3108B_and_Disparity" $t {lpc_dv lpc_data out_lpc_word_idx out_lpc_byte_idx lpc3_running_disp lpc2_running_disp lpc1_running_disp lpc0_running_disp}
  109      add_grp_sigs "5_Loopback_SelfCheck_Out" $t {rx_lpc_dec_dv rx_lpc_dec_data rx_desc_dv rx_desc_data loopback_ok_cnt loopback_err_cnt}
  110  }

  112  # ==============================================================================

  386      tb_demux_preamble_128
  387      tb_lpc_dec_descrambler
  388      tb_FEC_Demux
  389      tb_rs_decoder_rx
  390      tb_cdc4_logic_gth
  391      tb_fso_deframer_payload
  392      tb_fso_ethernet_deframer
  393      tb_reassembly_and_backend
  394      tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
  395  }
  396  
  397  set detected_tb ""
  398  foreach cand_tb $all_supported_tbs {
  399      if {[llength [get_objects -quiet "/${cand_tb}/*"]] > 0} {
  400          set detected_tb $cand_tb
  401          break
  402      }
  403  }
  404  
  405  if {$detected_tb eq ""} {
  406      catch {set detected_tb [get_property top [current_fileset -simset]]}
  407  }
  408  
  409  if {$detected_tb ne "" && [info procs "wave_${detected_tb}"] ne ""} {
  410      puts "=================================================================="
  411      puts " \[AUTO-WAVEFORM\] Detected Active Testbench: $detected_tb"
  412      puts " \[AUTO-WAVEFORM\] Clearing ungrouped waves and building groups..."
  413      puts "=================================================================="
  414      catch {remove_wave [get_waves *]}
  415      eval "wave_${detected_tb}"
  416      catch {wv.zoom.full}
  417      puts " \[AUTO-WAVEFORM\] Waveform Groups for $detected_tb Ready!"
  418  } else {
  419      puts " \[WARN\] Could not auto-detect active testbench. You can manually call:"
  420      puts "        wave_<tb_name>  (e.g., wave_tb_SDAOISL10Gto10G_top)"
  421  }

sources_1/new/FEC_Demux.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : FEC_Demux
    7  Description  : Receiver Baseband FEC Demultiplexer (2072B -> 32B RS Header + 
    8                 2040B RS Payload).
    9                 - Receives 259 contiguous 64-bit descrambled words (2072 Bytes) 
   10                   per frame from descrambler.v at 200.0 MHz.
   11                 - Buffers the first 4 words (32 Bytes) into hdr_shift_buf and 
   12                   serializes them 1 Byte per cycle (32 cycles) to rs_decoder #(33).
   13                 - Routes the remaining 255 words (2040 Bytes) directly to the 
   14                   64-bit Payload bus (255 cycles) for rs_decoder_64.
   15                                 1. RS Header Stream : 32 cycles @ 8-bit  (32 Bytes: 16B Data + 16B Parity)
   16                                 2. RS Payload Stream: 255 cycles @ 64-bit (2040 Bytes: 1912B Data + 128B Parity)
   17  
   18                 Revision Notes:
   19                 - Added non-intrusive simulation trackers (hdr_out_byte_cnt 1..32,
   20                   pld_out_word_cnt 1..255), clocked pld_sim_q writer on negedge clk, 
   21                   and maintained continuous 4-frame unpacking (8160 bytes across 
   22                   exact 2493.600 ns frame windows) so demux_frame_id counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4.
   23                 - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Waveform Telemetry Counter Restoration]
   24                   Added internal telemetry counters (out_hdr_byte_cnt [1..32], 
   25                   out_pld_word_cnt [1..255], and out_pld_byte_cnt [8..2040]) 
   26                   referenced by tb_FEC_Demux.v and setup_all_25_waveforms.tcl.
   27                 - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R03 - Restored 256-Bit Header Serializer & 255-Word Payload Datapath]
   28                   Restored the exact 256-bit 'hdr_shift_buf' serializer and 
   29                   'in_word_cnt' (0..258) state machine from the verified baseline 
   30                   so all 32 Header bytes serialize MSB-first with 0 mismatches and 
   31                   strictly 255 Payload words (2040 Bytes) are emitted per frame 
   32                   without admitting invalid tail words when en == 0.
   33  ===========================================================================
   34  */
   35  
   36  module FEC_Demux (
   37      input  wire        clk,
   38      input  wire        rst_n,
   39      input  wire        en,          // 259 continuous cycles from descrambler
   40      input  wire [63:0] data_in,     // 64-bit descrambled word
   41  
   42      // Output to RS(32,16) Header Decoder (8-bit, 32 cycles = 32 Bytes)
   43      output reg         header_dv,
   44      output reg  [7:0]  header,
   45  
   46      // Output to 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder (64-bit, 255 cycles = 2040 Bytes)
   47      output reg         payload_dv,
   48      output reg  [63:0] payload
   49  );
   50  
   51      reg [8:0]   in_word_cnt;
   52      reg [255:0] hdr_shift_buf;
   53      reg [5:0]   hdr_byte_idx;
   54      reg         hdr_serializing;
   55  
   56      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   57          if (!rst_n) begin
   58              in_word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
   59              hdr_shift_buf   <= 256'd0;
   60              hdr_byte_idx    <= 6'd0;
   61              hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   62              header_dv       <= 1'b0;
   63              header          <= 8'd0;
   64              payload_dv      <= 1'b0;
   65              payload         <= 64'd0;
   66          end else begin
   67              header_dv  <= 1'b0;
   68              header     <= 8'd0;
   69              payload_dv <= 1'b0;
   70              payload    <= 64'd0;
   71  
   72              // 1. Route first 4 words (32 Bytes) to Header buffer, remaining 255 words (2040 Bytes) to Payload
   73              if (en) begin
   74                  if (in_word_cnt < 9'd4) begin
   75                      case (in_word_cnt[1:0])
   76                          2'd0: hdr_shift_buf[255:192] <= data_in;
   77                          2'd1: hdr_shift_buf[191:128] <= data_in;
   78                          2'd2: hdr_shift_buf[127:64]  <= data_in;
   79                          2'd3: begin
   80                              hdr_shift_buf[63:0] <= data_in;
   81                              hdr_serializing     <= 1'b1;
   82                              hdr_byte_idx        <= 6'd0;
   83                          end
   84                      endcase
   85                      in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   86                  end else begin
   87                      payload_dv <= 1'b1;
   88                      payload    <= data_in;
   89                      if (in_word_cnt == 9'd258)
   90                          in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   91                      else
   92                          in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   93                  end
   94              end else begin
   95                  in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   96              end
   97  
   98              // 2. Serialize 32-Byte RS Header at 1 Byte per clock cycle (MSB-first)
   99              if (hdr_serializing) begin
  100                  header_dv     <= 1'b1;
  101                  header        <= hdr_shift_buf[255:248];
  102                  hdr_shift_buf <= {hdr_shift_buf[247:0], 8'd0};
  103  
  104                  if (hdr_byte_idx == 6'd31) begin
  105                      hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
  106                      hdr_byte_idx    <= 6'd0;
  107                  end else begin
  108                      hdr_byte_idx <= hdr_byte_idx + 6'd1;
  109                  end
  110              end
  111          end
  112      end
  113  
  114      // =======================================================
  115      // 3. TELEMETRY & WAVEFORM TRACKERS: HEADER (1..32B) & PAYLOAD (1..2040B)
  116      // =======================================================
  117      reg  [5:0]  hdr_out_byte_cnt; // Counts 1..32 during header_dv
  118      reg  [8:0]  pld_out_word_cnt; // Counts 1..255 during payload_dv
  119      wire [5:0]  out_hdr_byte_cnt = hdr_out_byte_cnt;
  120      wire [8:0]  out_pld_word_cnt = pld_out_word_cnt;
  121      wire [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt = {pld_out_word_cnt, 3'b000};
  122  
  123      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  124          if (!rst_n) begin
  125              hdr_out_byte_cnt <= 6'd0;
  126              pld_out_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  127          end else begin
  128              if (hdr_serializing)
  129                  hdr_out_byte_cnt <= hdr_byte_idx + 6'd1;
  130              else
  131                  hdr_out_byte_cnt <= 6'd0;
  132  
  133              if (en && (in_word_cnt >= 9'd4))
  134                  pld_out_word_cnt <= (in_word_cnt - 9'd3);
  135              else
  136                  pld_out_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  137          end
  138      end
  139  
  140      // synthesis translate_off
  141      reg [7:0]  pld_sim_q [0:16383];
  142      integer    pld_wr_ptr;
  143      integer    pld_rd_ptr;
  144      reg        pld_unpack_active;
  145  
  146      reg [7:0]  pld_byte_stream;
  147      reg [11:0] pld_byte_cnt;     // Counts strictly 1 to 2040 per frame
  148      reg [31:0] demux_frame_id;   // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  149      reg [15:0] pld_total_bytes;  // Counts 1 to 8160 (4 x 2040 Bytes)
  150  
  151      initial begin
  152          pld_wr_ptr        = 0;
  153          pld_rd_ptr        = 0;
  154          pld_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  155          pld_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  156          pld_byte_cnt      = 12'd0;
  157          demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  158          pld_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  159      end
  160  
  161      // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (2.5 ns before posedge clk)
  162      always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  163          if (!rst_n) begin
  164              pld_wr_ptr = 0;
  165          end else if (payload_dv) begin
  166              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 0] = payload[63:56];
  167              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 1] = payload[55:48];
  168              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 2] = payload[47:40];
  169              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 3] = payload[39:32];
  170              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 4] = payload[31:24];
  171              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 5] = payload[23:16];
  172              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 6] = payload[15:8];
  173              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 7] = payload[7:0];
  174              pld_wr_ptr                = pld_wr_ptr + 8;
  175          end
  176      end
  177  
  178      // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (2040 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  179      real next_pld_edge_ns;
  180      always @(posedge clk) begin
  181          if (rst_n && en && (in_word_cnt == 9'd4) && !pld_unpack_active) begin
  182              pld_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  183              #0.001;
  184              next_pld_edge_ns  = $realtime;
  185              while (pld_total_bytes < 16'd8160) begin
  186                  if (pld_rd_ptr == 0)
  187                      pld_byte_stream = payload[63:56];
  188                  else
  189                      pld_byte_stream = pld_sim_q[pld_rd_ptr];
  190  
  191                  pld_rd_ptr      = pld_rd_ptr + 1;
  192                  pld_total_bytes = pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  193  
  194                  if (demux_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  195                      demux_frame_id = 32'd1;
  196                      pld_byte_cnt   = 12'd1;
  197                  end else if (pld_byte_cnt == 12'd2040) begin
  198                      demux_frame_id = demux_frame_id + 32'd1;
  199                      pld_byte_cnt   = 12'd1;
  200                  end else begin
  201                      pld_byte_cnt   = pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  202                  end
  203  
  204                  next_pld_edge_ns = next_pld_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 2040.0);
  205                  #((next_pld_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_pld_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  206              end
  207              pld_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  208              pld_byte_cnt      = 12'd0;
  209              demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  210              pld_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  211          end
  212      end
  213      // synthesis translate_on
  214  
  215  endmodule
sources_1/new/FEC_MUX.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Description  : FEC Multiplexer (Replaces combiner.v).
    5                 Zero-Gap Continuous Streaming (259 Cycles)
    6                 without using BRAM or large counter delays.
    7                 
    8                 Mechanism:
    9                 1. Absorbs 32-Bytes of RS Header silently into a Shift Register.
   10                 2. When Payload arrives, it is delayed by exactly 4 clock cycles.
   11                 3. During those 4 cycles, the 32-Byte Header is blasted out 
   12                    at 64-bits per cycle.
   13                 4. On cycle 5, the Payload emerges and perfectly splices 
   14                    behind the Header. Total Output = 4 + 255 = 259 Cycles.
   15   FIX: 
   16                 Implemented edge-detection routing (rs_load_dv && !pipe).
   17                 This guarantees that the 32-Byte Header is blasted out in 
   18                 EXACTLY 4 cycles, seamlessly followed by the 255-Word Payload.
   19                 Total Output = 259 Continuous Cycles (Zero-Gap).
   20  ===========================================================================
   21  */
   22  
   23  module FEC_MUX (
   24      input               clk,
   25      input               rst_n,
   26      
   27      // Interface from RS Header
   28      input               rs_head_dv,
   29      input   [7:0]       rs_head,
   30      
   31      // Interface from RS Payload
   32      input               rs_load_dv,
   33      input   [63:0]      rs_load,
   34      
   35      // Continuous Output to Scrambler
   36      output              flag,
   37      output  [63:0]      data_out
   38  );
   39  
   40      // =======================================================
   41      // 1. HEADER ABSORPTION (32-Bytes = 256 bits)
   42      // =======================================================
   43      reg [255:0] hdr_buf;
   44      
   45      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   46          if (!rst_n) 
   47              hdr_buf <= 256'd0;
   48          else if (rs_head_dv) 
   49              hdr_buf <= {hdr_buf[247:0], rs_head};
   50      end
   51  
   52      // =======================================================
   53      // 2. PAYLOAD 4-CYCLE DELAY PIPELINE
   54      // =======================================================
   55      reg [63:0] load_pipe [0:3];
   56      reg [3:0]  load_dv_pipe;
   57  
   58      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   59          if (!rst_n) begin
   60              load_pipe[0] <= 64'd0; load_pipe[1] <= 64'd0;
   61              load_pipe[2] <= 64'd0; load_pipe[3] <= 64'd0;
   62              load_dv_pipe <= 4'd0;
   63          end else begin
   64              // Shift Payload Data
   65              load_pipe[0] <= rs_load;
   66              load_pipe[1] <= load_pipe[0];
   67              load_pipe[2] <= load_pipe[1];
   68              load_pipe[3] <= load_pipe[2];
   69              
   70              // Shift Data Valid Flag
   71              load_dv_pipe <= {load_dv_pipe[2:0], rs_load_dv};
   72          end
   73      end
   74  
   75      // =======================================================
   76      // 3. STRICT COMBINATIONAL ROUTING
   77      // =======================================================
   78      assign data_out = (rs_load_dv      && !load_dv_pipe[0]) ? hdr_buf[255:192] :
   79                        (load_dv_pipe[0] && !load_dv_pipe[1]) ? hdr_buf[191:128] :
   80                        (load_dv_pipe[1] && !load_dv_pipe[2]) ? hdr_buf[127:64]  :
   81                        (load_dv_pipe[2] && !load_dv_pipe[3]) ? hdr_buf[63:0]    :
   82                        (load_dv_pipe[3])                     ? load_pipe[3]     : 64'd0;
   83  
   84      assign flag = rs_load_dv | load_dv_pipe[0] | load_dv_pipe[1] | load_dv_pipe[2] | load_dv_pipe[3];
   85  
   86  endmodule
sources_1/new/FEC_separator.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : FEC_separator (Previously separator.v)
    7  Description  : FEC Auto-Aligning Demultiplexer (Exact Inverse of FEC_MUX.v).
    8                 Receives the 259-cycle continuous 64-bit stream (2072 Bytes) 
    9                 from descrambler.v and separates it into:
   10                 1. RS Header Stream : 32 cycles @ 8-bit  (32 Bytes: 16B Data + 16B Parity)
   11                 2. RS Payload Stream: 255 cycles @ 64-bit (2040 Bytes: 1912B Data + 128B Parity)
   12  ===========================================================================
   13  */
   14  
   15  module FEC_separator (
   16      input  wire        clk,
   17      input  wire        rst_n,
   18      input  wire        en,          // From descrambler_dv (259 continuous cycles)
   19      input  wire [63:0] data_in,     // From descrambler data_out[63:0]
   20  
   21      // Output to RS(32,16) Header Decoder (8-bit, 32 cycles)
   22      output reg         header_dv,
   23      output reg  [7:0]  header,
   24  
   25      // Output to 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder (64-bit, 255 cycles)
   26      output reg         payload_dv,
   27      output reg  [63:0] payload
   28  );
   29  
   30      reg [8:0]   in_word_cnt;
   31      reg [255:0] hdr_shift_buf;
   32      reg [5:0]   hdr_byte_cnt;
   33      reg         hdr_serializing;
   34  
   35      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   36          if (!rst_n) begin
   37              in_word_cnt     <= 9'd0;
   38              hdr_shift_buf   <= 256'd0;
   39              hdr_byte_cnt    <= 6'd0;
   40              hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   41              header_dv       <= 1'b0;
   42              header          <= 8'd0;
   43              payload_dv      <= 1'b0;
   44              payload         <= 64'd0;
   45          end else begin
   46              // Default de-assertions
   47              header_dv  <= 1'b0;
   48              header     <= 8'd0;
   49              payload_dv <= 1'b0;
   50              payload    <= 64'd0;
   51  
   52              // ---------------------------------------------------
   53              // 1. INCOMING 259-CYCLE 64-BIT STREAM ROUTING
   54              // ---------------------------------------------------
   55              if (en) begin
   56                  if (in_word_cnt < 9'd4) begin
   57                      // Cycles 0..3: Capture 4 x 64-bit words (256 bits = 32 Bytes) of RS Header
   58                      case (in_word_cnt[1:0])
   59                          2'd0: hdr_shift_buf[255:192] <= data_in;
   60                          2'd1: hdr_shift_buf[191:128] <= data_in;
   61                          2'd2: hdr_shift_buf[127:64]  <= data_in;
   62                          2'd3: begin
   63                              hdr_shift_buf[63:0] <= data_in;
   64                              hdr_serializing     <= 1'b1;
   65                              hdr_byte_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   66                          end
   67                      endcase
   68                      in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   69                  end else begin
   70                      // Cycles 4..258: Forward 255 x 64-bit words (2040 Bytes) to RS Payload Decoder
   71                      payload_dv <= 1'b1;
   72                      payload    <= data_in;
   73                      if (in_word_cnt == 9'd258)
   74                          in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   75                      else
   76                          in_word_cnt <= in_word_cnt + 9'd1;
   77                  end
   78              end else begin
   79                  in_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   80              end
   81  
   82              // ---------------------------------------------------
   83              // 2. SERIALIZE 256-BIT HEADER BUFFER (32 CYCLES @ 8-BIT)
   84              // Emits MSB-first (hdr_shift_buf[255:248] .. [7:0])
   85              // ---------------------------------------------------
   86              if (hdr_serializing) begin
   87                  header_dv     <= 1'b1;
   88                  header        <= hdr_shift_buf[255:248];
   89                  hdr_shift_buf <= {hdr_shift_buf[247:0], 8'd0};
   90  
   91                  if (hdr_byte_cnt == 6'd31) begin
   92                      hdr_serializing <= 1'b0;
   93                      hdr_byte_cnt    <= 6'd0;
   94                  end else begin
   95                      hdr_byte_cnt <= hdr_byte_cnt + 6'd1;
   96                  end
   97              end
   98          end
   99      end
  100  
  101  endmodule
sources_1/new/SDAOISL10Gto10G_top.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : SDAOISL10Gto10G_top
    7  Description  : Complete End-to-End SDA OISL 10G-to-10G Grand Top Module.
    8                 Integrates:
    9                 1. Ingress Packet Generator / Ethernet RX Front-End (PC 1)
   10                 2. SDA Encoder (Framer, ARQ TX, CDC 1, FEC Core TX, CDC 2, Error Inject)
   11                 3. Modular GTH 64B/66B Optical Transceiver (TX, Core Wrapper, RX)
   12                 4. SDA Decoder (CDC 3, FEC Core RX, CDC 4, Deframer, ARQ RX, Reassembly)
   13                 5. Egress Ethernet TX Back-End to PC 2 (eth_tx_back_end_top)
   14  
   15                 Revision Notes:
   16                 1. Preserved all original architecture connections and port names.
   17                 2. Moved all ILA telemetry registers inside their respective 
   18                    hierarchical sub-modules (u_gth64b66b_tx, u_gth64b66b_rx, 
   19                    and back_end_inst) so SDAOISL10Gto10G_top is 100% purely 
   20                    structural with ZERO loose yellow flip-flop boxes in the 
   21                    Vivado RTL Schematic (identical layout to image_1335e3.png).
   22                 3. [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST]: Connected 'seg_valid_bytes'
   23                    [10:0] wire between front_end_inst and sda_encoder_inst.
   24                 4. [Rev 2.4 - 2026-10-29 13:07 KST - Deep Audit Fix F06]:
   25                    Connected 'clk_wiz_locked' from clk_wiz_0_inst to drive 'rst_n'
   26                    cleanly after MMCM lock (instead of tying rst_n to constant 1'b1),
   27                    and synchronized the closed-loop ARQ feedback signals from 
   28                    rx0_clk to tx0_clk inside sda_encoder_inst.
   29                 5. [Rev 2.7 - 2026-10-30 02:53 KST - Audit Fix N05 & Normative FCCH Default]:
   30                    - Connected dedicated 'peer_fb_rxfn', 'peer_fb_ack', and 
   31                      'peer_fb_ack_valid' wires between sda_decoder_inst and 
   32                      sda_encoder_inst alongside 'arq_fb_*' (local RX CRC feedback), 
   33                      and exposed top-level parameter 'LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT' (1 = 
   34                      single-board optical loopback, 0 = two-terminal separate link).
   35                    - Updated default static FCCH inputs to normative 'No Message' 
   36                      values per SDA OISL Table 2-12 & Section 2.6.3.3.5 
   37                      (fcch_opcode = 4'hF, fcch_pl = 16'hFFFF).
   38                 6. [Rev 2.8 - 2026-10-30 11:45 KST - Audit Fix A18]:
   39                    Widened 'seg_valid_bytes' interconnect wire to 14 bits ([13:0]) 
   40                    to match front_end_inst and sda_encoder_inst with zero port-width 
   41                    padding/pruning warnings during top-level elaboration.
   42  ===========================================================================
   43  */
   44  
   45  module SDAOISL10Gto10G_top #(
   46      // 1 = Simulation / Internal Packet Gen Mode
   47      // 0 = External SFP+ 10G Ethernet PHY Mode (PC 1 -> FPGA -> PC 2)
   48      parameter SIM_MODE            = 1,
   49      // 1 = Single-FPGA Optical Loopback (uses local RX CRC feedback for TX tracker)
   50      // 0 = Two-Terminal Full-Duplex Link (uses peer Header ACK for TX tracker)
   51      parameter LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 1
   52  )(
   53      input  wire        sys_clk_p,
   54      input  wire        sys_clk_n,
   55      
   56      output wire [1:0]  tx_disable,
   57      input  wire        mgtrefclk_n,
   58      input  wire        mgtrefclk_p,    
   59      input  wire        fso_refclk_n,
   60      input  wire        fso_refclk_p,
   61      input  wire [3:0]  RXN_IN,
   62      input  wire [3:0]  RXP_IN,
   63      output wire [3:0]  TXN_OUT,
   64      output wire [3:0]  TXP_OUT,
   65      output wire        fan,
   66      
   67      // Probing & Status Outputs
   68      output wire [31:0] tx_fso_data_out,
   69      output wire        tx_fso_valid_out,
   70      output wire [31:0] rx_fso_data_out,
   71      output wire        rx_fso_valid_out,
   72      output wire [7:0]  rx_dec_hdr_tdata,
   73      output wire        rx_dec_hdr_tvalid,
   74      output wire [31:0] rx_dec_pld_tdata,
   75      output wire        rx_dec_pld_tvalid,
   76      output wire [31:0] pc2_xgmii_txd,
   77      output wire [3:0]  pc2_xgmii_txc,
   78      output wire        rx_preamble_locked,
   79      output wire        rx_block_locked,
   80      output wire        gth_link_up,
   81      output wire        eth_data_error_flag
   82  );
   83  
   84      assign tx_disable = 2'b00;
   85      assign fan        = 1'b0;
   86  
   87      wire sys_clk;
   88      wire clk_100M;
   89      wire clk_logic;
   90      wire clk_wiz_locked;
   91      wire tx0_clk;
   92      wire rx0_clk;
   93  
   94      // [Rev 2.4 - Audit Fix F06] Derive active-low system reset from MMCM locked status
   95      wire rst_n     = clk_wiz_locked; 
   96      wire eth_reset = ~rst_n;
   97  
   98      IBUFGDS sys_clk_inst (
   99          .I  (sys_clk_p),
  100          .IB (sys_clk_n),
  101          .O  (sys_clk)
  102      );
  103  
  104      clk_wiz_0 clk_wiz_0_inst (
  105          .clk_in1  (sys_clk),
  106          .reset    (1'b0),
  107          .locked   (clk_wiz_locked),
  108          .clk_out1 (clk_100M),
  109          .clk_out2 (clk_logic)
  110      );
  111  
  112      // =======================================================
  113      // 1. INGRESS TRAFFIC SOURCE (SIMULATION vs HARDWARE)
  114      // =======================================================
  115      wire [31:0] xgmii_txd_in;
  116      wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc_in;
  117  
  118      generate
  119          if (SIM_MODE == 1) begin : gen_sim_mode
  120              wire        trigger_en;
  121              wire [31:0] gen_axis_tdata;
  122              wire [3:0]  gen_axis_tkeep;
  123              wire        gen_axis_tvalid;
  124              wire        gen_axis_tlast;
  125              wire        gen_axis_tready;
  126  
  127              autorun autorun_inst (
  128                  .clk   (tx0_clk),
  129                  .rst_n (rst_n),
  130                  .flag  (trigger_en) 
  131              );
  132  
  133              eth_axis_packet_gen packet_gen_inst (
  134                  .clk              (tx0_clk),
  135                  .rst_n            (rst_n),
  136                  .trigger          (trigger_en),
  137                  .frame_size_bytes (16'd2000), 
  138                  .m_axis_tdata     (gen_axis_tdata),
  139                  .m_axis_tkeep     (gen_axis_tkeep),
  140                  .m_axis_tvalid    (gen_axis_tvalid),
  141                  .m_axis_tlast     (gen_axis_tlast),
  142                  .m_axis_tready    (gen_axis_tready)
  143              );
  144  
  145              xgmii_tx_encoder xgmii_encoder_inst (
  146                  .clk              (tx0_clk),
  147                  .rst_n            (rst_n),
  148                  .s_axis_tdata     (gen_axis_tdata),
  149                  .s_axis_tkeep     (gen_axis_tkeep),
  150                  .s_axis_tvalid    (gen_axis_tvalid),
  151                  .s_axis_tlast     (gen_axis_tlast),
  152                  .s_axis_tready    (gen_axis_tready),
  153                  .xgmii_txd        (xgmii_txd_in),
  154                  .xgmii_txc        (xgmii_txc_in)
  155              );
  156          end else begin : gen_hw_mode
  157              assign xgmii_txd_in = 32'd0;
  158              assign xgmii_txc_in = 4'd0;
  159          end
  160      endgenerate
  161  
  162      // =======================================================
  163      // 2. ETHERNET RX FRONT-END (SFP+ Channel 0 RX from PC 1)
  164      // =======================================================
  165      wire [31:0] seg_axis_tdata;
  166      wire        seg_axis_tvalid;
  167      wire        seg_axis_tlast;
  168      wire        seg_axis_tready;
  169      wire [13:0] seg_valid_bytes; // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A18] Full 14-bit packet/segment byte count
  170  
  171      eth_rx_front_end_top #(
  172          .RUN_MODE (SIM_MODE)
  173      ) front_end_inst (
  174          .clk             (tx0_clk),
  175          .rst_n           (rst_n),
  176          .xgmii_rxd       (xgmii_txd_in),  
  177          .xgmii_rxc       (xgmii_txc_in),
  178          .fso_data_out    (seg_axis_tdata),     
  179          .fso_valid       (seg_axis_tvalid),
  180          .fso_last        (seg_axis_tlast),
  181          .fso_ready       (seg_axis_tready),
  182          .seg_valid_bytes (seg_valid_bytes),
  183          .refclk_p        (mgtrefclk_p),
  184          .refclk_n        (mgtrefclk_n),
  185          .reset           (eth_reset),
  186          .dclk            (clk_100M),
  187          .rxp             (RXP_IN[0]),    
  188          .rxn             (RXN_IN[0])
  189      );
  190  
  191      // =======================================================
  192      // 3. SDA ENCODER (Connected to Dual-Channel Closed-Loop ARQ Feedback)
  193      // =======================================================
  194      wire [15:0] arq_fb_rxfn;
  195      wire        arq_fb_ack;
  196      wire        arq_fb_ack_valid;
  197  
  198      // [Rev 2.7 - Fix N05] Dedicated Peer Header ACK Wires
  199      wire [15:0] peer_fb_rxfn;
  200      wire        peer_fb_ack;
  201      wire        peer_fb_ack_valid;
  202  
  203      sda_encoder #(
  204          .SIM_MODE            (SIM_MODE),
  205          .LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT (LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT)
  206      ) sda_encoder_inst (
  207          .clk_logic           (clk_logic), 
  208          .clk_gth             (tx0_clk),   
  209          .rst_n               (rst_n),
  210          .s_axis_eth_tdata    (seg_axis_tdata),
  211          .s_axis_eth_tvalid   (seg_axis_tvalid),
  212          .s_axis_eth_tlast    (seg_axis_tlast),
  213          .s_axis_eth_tready   (seg_axis_tready),
  214          .seg_valid_bytes     (seg_valid_bytes),
  215          .mgmt_trigger_1hz    (1'b0),
  216          .rx_phy_ts_sec       (6'd15),
  217          .rx_phy_ts_picosec   (40'd16678204759),
  218          .tx_phy_ts_sec       (6'd15),
  219          .tx_phy_ts_picosec   (40'd0),
  220          .range_meters        (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000),
  221          .range_ts_sec        (32'd1476000000),
  222          .range_ts_picosec    (40'd0),
  223          .ts_valid            (1'b1),
  224          .tod_seconds_in      (6'd15), 
  225          .fcch_opcode         (4'hF),      // [Rev 2.7] Normative Table 2-12 'No Message' (4'b1111)
  226          .fcch_pl             (16'hFFFF),  // [Rev 2.7] Normative Sec. 2.6.3.3.5 All-Ones (16'hFFFF)
  227          .rx_rxfn_in          (arq_fb_rxfn),      
  228          .rx_ack_in           (arq_fb_ack),       
  229          .rx_ack_valid_in     (arq_fb_ack_valid),
  230          .peer_rxfn_in        (peer_fb_rxfn),
  231          .peer_ack_in         (peer_fb_ack),
  232          .peer_ack_valid_in   (peer_fb_ack_valid),
  233          .tx_fso_data_out     (tx_fso_data_out),
  234          .tx_fso_valid_out    (tx_fso_valid_out),
  235          .eth_data_error_flag (eth_data_error_flag)
  236      );
  237  
  238      // =======================================================
  239      // 4. GTH 64B/66B OPTICAL TRANSCEIVER (SFP+ Channel 1)
  240      // =======================================================
  241      wire        gth_tx_ready;
  242      wire        gth_rx_ready;
  243      wire        tx_gearbox_stall;
  244      wire [31:0] gt_txdata_int;
  245      wire [5:0]  gt_txheader_int;
  246      wire [6:0]  gt_txsequence_int;
  247  
  248      wire [31:0] gt_rxdata_int;
  249      wire [1:0]  gt_rxdatavalid_int;
  250      wire [5:0]  gt_rxheader_int;
  251      wire [1:0]  gt_rxheadervalid_int;
  252      wire [1:0]  gt_rxstartofseq_int;
  253      wire        gt_rxgearboxslip_int;
  254  
  255      wire        fso_txp_ch1, fso_txn_ch1;
  256      wire        eth_txp_ch0, eth_txn_ch0;
  257  
  258      gth64b66b_tx u_gth64b66b_tx (
  259          .clk_312_5         (tx0_clk),
  260          .clk_gth           (tx0_clk),
  261          .rst_n             (rst_n),
  262          .gth_tx_ready      (gth_tx_ready),
  263          .up_data_in        (tx_fso_data_out),
  264          .up_valid_in       (tx_fso_valid_out),
  265          .tx_stall_out      (tx_gearbox_stall),
  266          .gt_txdata_out     (gt_txdata_int),
  267          .gt_txheader_out   (gt_txheader_int),
  268          .gt_txsequence_out (gt_txsequence_int)
  269      );
  270  
  271      fso_gth_core_wrapper u_fso_gth_core (
  272          .clk_100_freerun      (clk_100M),
  273          .sys_rst_n            (rst_n),
  274          .gt_refclk_p          (fso_refclk_p),
  275          .gt_refclk_n          (fso_refclk_n),
  276          .txp_out              (fso_txp_ch1),
  277          .txn_out              (fso_txn_ch1),
  278          .rxp_in               (RXP_IN[1]),
  279          .rxn_in               (RXN_IN[1]),
  280          .tx0_clk              (tx0_clk),
  281          .rx0_clk              (rx0_clk),
  282          .gth_tx_ready         (gth_tx_ready),
  283          .gth_rx_ready         (gth_rx_ready),
  284          .gth_link_up          (gth_link_up),
  285          .gt_txdata_in         (gt_txdata_int),
  286          .gt_txheader_in       (gt_txheader_int),
  287          .gt_txsequence_in     (gt_txsequence_int),
  288          .gt_rxdata_out        (gt_rxdata_int),
  289          .gt_rxdatavalid_out   (gt_rxdatavalid_int),
  290          .gt_rxheader_out      (gt_rxheader_int),
  291          .gt_rxheadervalid_out (gt_rxheadervalid_int),
  292          .gt_rxstartofseq_out  (gt_rxstartofseq_int),
  293          .gt_rxgearboxslip_in  (gt_rxgearboxslip_int)
  294      );
  295  
  296      gth64b66b_rx u_gth64b66b_rx (
  297          .clk_gth              (rx0_clk),
  298          .clk_312_5            (rx0_clk),
  299          .rst_n                (rst_n),
  300          .gth_rx_ready         (gth_rx_ready),
  301          .gt_rxdata_in         (gt_rxdata_int),
  302          .gt_rxdatavalid_in    (gt_rxdatavalid_int),
  303          .gt_rxheader_in       (gt_rxheader_int),
  304          .gt_rxheadervalid_in  (gt_rxheadervalid_int),
  305          .gt_rxgearboxslip_out (gt_rxgearboxslip_int),
  306          .rx_block_locked      (rx_block_locked),
  307          .down_data            (rx_fso_data_out),
  308          .down_dv              (rx_fso_valid_out)
  309      );
  310  
  311      // =======================================================
  312      // 5. SDA DECODER (CDC 3 -> core_rx -> CDC 4 -> Deframer -> Reassembly)
  313      // =======================================================
  314      wire [31:0] reassembled_eth_tdata;
  315      wire        reassembled_eth_tvalid;
  316      wire        reassembled_eth_tlast;
  317  
  318      sda_decoder #(
  319          .LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT (LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT)
  320      ) sda_decoder_inst (
  321          .clk_gth            (rx0_clk),
  322          .clk_logic          (clk_logic),
  323          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  324          .rx_fso_valid_in    (rx_fso_valid_out),
  325          .rx_fso_data_in     (rx_fso_data_out),
  326          .m_axis_eth_tdata   (reassembled_eth_tdata),
  327          .m_axis_eth_tvalid  (reassembled_eth_tvalid),
  328          .m_axis_eth_tlast   (reassembled_eth_tlast),

  330          .arq_fb_ack         (arq_fb_ack),
  331          .arq_fb_ack_valid   (arq_fb_ack_valid),
  332          .peer_fb_rxfn       (peer_fb_rxfn),
  333          .peer_fb_ack        (peer_fb_ack),
  334          .peer_fb_ack_valid  (peer_fb_ack_valid),
  335          .m_axis_hdr_tvalid  (rx_dec_hdr_tvalid),
  336          .m_axis_hdr_tdata   (rx_dec_hdr_tdata),
  337          .m_axis_fso_tvalid  (rx_dec_pld_tvalid),
  338          .m_axis_fso_tdata   (rx_dec_pld_tdata),
  339          .rx_preamble_locked (rx_preamble_locked),
  340          .hdr_crc_ok         (),
  341          .pld_crc_ok         ()
  342      );
  343  
  344      // =======================================================
  345      // 6. ETHERNET TX BACK-END (SFP+ Channel 0 TX to PC 2)
  346      // =======================================================
  347      eth_tx_back_end_top #(
  348          .RUN_MODE (SIM_MODE)
  349      ) back_end_inst (
  350          .clk       (rx0_clk),
  351          .rst_n     (rst_n),
  352          .data_in   (reassembled_eth_tdata),
  353          .en        (reassembled_eth_tvalid),
  354          .xgmii_txd (pc2_xgmii_txd),
  355          .xgmii_txc (pc2_xgmii_txc),
  356          .refclk_p  (mgtrefclk_p),
  357          .refclk_n  (mgtrefclk_n),
  358          .reset     (eth_reset),
  359          .dclk      (clk_100M),
  360          .txp       (eth_txp_ch0),
  361          .txn       (eth_txn_ch0)
  362      );
  363  
  364      assign TXP_OUT = {2'b00, fso_txp_ch1, eth_txp_ch0};
  365      assign TXN_OUT = {2'b00, fso_txn_ch1, eth_txn_ch0};
