sources_1/new/arq_ddr4_wrapper.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : arq_ddr4_wrapper
    7  Description  : Circular Frame-Indexed ARQ Retransmission Memory Wrapper.
    8                 Sniffs and stores outgoing 1912-Byte FSO DATA frames (478 words 
    9                 x 32-bit, including the 4-Byte FSO CRC-32) indexed by TXFN, and 
   10                 re-emits them upon retransmission requests from arq_tx_controller.
   11  
   12                 Revision Notes:
   13                 1. Changed 's_axis_tready' to an input port so it monitors the 
   14                    upstream FIFO handshake in fso_payload.v without creating a 
   15                    multi-driven net against fifo_data.s_axis_tready.
   16                 2. Separated 'ram_storage' array read/write operations into a 
   17                    dedicated synchronous 'always @(posedge clk)' block for 
   18                    clean Block RAM (BRAM) inference.
   19                 3. [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST - Target B3.2 Audit Fix]:
   20                    Updated terminal word index (LAST_WORD_IDX) from 9'd476 
   21                    (477 words = 1908 Bytes) to 9'd477 (478 words = 1912 Bytes) 
   22                    in both the Write and Read state machines. Because 
   23                    fso_payload.v sniffs the stream AFTER fso_crc_32.v (which 
   24                    appends the 4-Byte CRC-32 as the 478th word per SDA OISL 
   25                    Figure 2-7 & Figure 2-17), storing and reading all 478 words 
   26                    ensures the 4-Byte CRC-32 trailer is preserved intact during 
   27                    ARQ retransmissions.
   28                 4. [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 15:19 KST - Audit Fix R10 & R04]:
   29                    - [Fix R10]: Added BRAM read clock-enable gating ('rd_ce') coupled 
   30                      strictly to AXI-Stream output acceptance (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready)
   31                      so that arbitrary downstream backpressure stalls (arq_ram_stalls.sv) 
   32                      preserve all 478 words, 0 mismatches, and exact m_axis_tlast alignment.
   33                    - [Fix R04]: Provided both 'writing_state' and 'is_writing' alias 
   34                      for full testbench backward compatibility.
   35                 5. [Rev 2.8 - 2026-10-30 11:45 KST - Audit Fix A07 - 16-Slot Associative CAM Mapping]:
   36                    Added a 16-entry associative tag table ('slot_txfn_tag[0:15]' and 
   37                    'slot_tag_valid[0:15]') that maps the full 16-bit 'ddr4_addr' (TXFN) 
   38                    to a free physical BRAM slot on 'ddr4_write_req', looks up the matching 
   39                    physical slot on 'ddr4_read_req', and frees the slot on 'ddr4_delete_req'.
   40                 6. [Rev 2.9 - 2026-10-30 18:25 KST - Audit Fix B11 - Non-Colliding Read/Write/Delete Tag Guard]:
   41                    Guarded 'ddr4_delete_req' tag clearing with '(!ddr4_write_req && !ddr4_read_req)'
   42                    so that a simultaneous read or write operation never corrupts the active 
   43                    slot tag, working in tandem with arq_tx_controller's 1-cycle deferred 
   44                    delete queue (arq_ack_retx_shared_address.sv).
   45  ===========================================================================
   46  */
   47  
   48  module arq_ddr4_wrapper #(
   49      parameter DATA_WIDTH    = 32,
   50      parameter MAX_FRAMES    = 16,
   51      parameter LAST_WORD_IDX = 9'd477 // 0..477 = 478 words = 1912 Bytes (includes 4B CRC-32)
   52  )(
   53      input  wire                  clk,
   54      input  wire                  rst_n,
   55  
   56      // Control Signals from arq_tx_controller
   57      input  wire                  ddr4_write_req,
   58      input  wire                  ddr4_read_req,
   59      input  wire                  ddr4_delete_req,
   60      input  wire [15:0]           ddr4_addr,
   61  
   62      // Passive Sniffer Input (Connected to CRC-32 Output Stream)
   63      input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] s_axis_tdata,
   64      input  wire                  s_axis_tvalid,
   65      input  wire                  s_axis_tlast,
   66      input  wire                  s_axis_tready,
   67  
   68      // Retransmit AXI-Stream Output to fso_payload_mux (Path 11)
   69      output reg  [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata,
   70      output reg                   m_axis_tvalid,
   71      output reg                   m_axis_tlast,
   72      input  wire                  m_axis_tready
   73  );
   74  
   75      // 16 Slots x 512 Words x 32-bit = 8192 Words (32 KB Internal Block RAM)
   76      (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] ram_storage [0:8191];
   77  
   78      /*
   79      ===========================================================================
   80      [NOTE FOR HARDWARE DDR4 MIG EXPANSION ON ALINX AXKU062 (BANK 44/45/46)]
   81      When scaling window capacity to 13,377..16,320 frames (~25.6 MB TX Buffer):
   82        - TX Buffer Physical Base Address : 32'h0000_0000
   83        - Direct 2KB Slot Byte Address    : {5'd0, ddr4_addr[15:0], 11'd0}
   84      ===========================================================================
   85      */
   86  
   87      // [Rev 2.8 / Rev 2.9 - Fix A07 & B11] 16-Slot Associative CAM Table
   88      reg [15:0] slot_tag_valid;
   89      reg [15:0] slot_txfn_tag [0:15];
   90  
   91      reg        wr_hit_found;
   92      reg [3:0]  wr_hit_slot;
   93      reg        wr_free_found;
   94      reg [3:0]  wr_free_slot;
   95      reg        rd_hit_found;
   96      reg [3:0]  rd_hit_slot;
   97      integer    k;
   98  
   99      always @(*) begin
  100          wr_hit_found  = 1'b0;
  101          wr_hit_slot   = ddr4_addr[3:0];
  102          wr_free_found = 1'b0;
  103          wr_free_slot  = ddr4_addr[3:0];
  104          rd_hit_found  = 1'b0;
  105          rd_hit_slot   = ddr4_addr[3:0];
  106  
  107          for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  108              if (slot_tag_valid[k] && (slot_txfn_tag[k] == ddr4_addr)) begin
  109                  if (!wr_hit_found) begin
  110                      wr_hit_found = 1'b1;
  111                      wr_hit_slot  = k[3:0];
  112                  end
  113                  if (!rd_hit_found) begin
  114                      rd_hit_found = 1'b1;
  115                      rd_hit_slot  = k[3:0];
  116                  end
  117              end
  118              if (!slot_tag_valid[k] && !wr_free_found) begin
  119                  wr_free_found = 1'b1;
  120                  wr_free_slot  = k[3:0];
  121              end
  122          end
  123      end
  124  
  125      // Prefer direct 4-bit slot if free; otherwise use matching or first free CAM slot
  126      wire [3:0] alloc_wr_slot = wr_hit_found ? wr_hit_slot :
  127                                 (!slot_tag_valid[ddr4_addr[3:0]]) ? ddr4_addr[3:0] :
  128                                 wr_free_found ? wr_free_slot : ddr4_addr[3:0];
  129  
  130      wire [3:0] lookup_rd_slot = rd_hit_found ? rd_hit_slot : ddr4_addr[3:0];
  131  
  132      reg [3:0] write_slot_ptr;
  133      reg [8:0] write_word_ptr;
  134      reg       writing_state;
  135      wire      is_writing = writing_state;
  136  
  137      reg [3:0] read_slot_ptr;
  138      reg [8:0] read_word_ptr;
  139      reg       reading_state;
  140  
  141      wire        stream_handshake = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
  142      wire        ram_wr_en        = writing_state && stream_handshake;
  143      wire [12:0] wr_ram_addr      = {write_slot_ptr, write_word_ptr};
  144  
  145      // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R10] Advance BRAM read only on initial read request or accepted output beat
  146      wire        start_read_now   = ddr4_read_req && !reading_state;
  147      wire        advance_read_now = reading_state && m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready && !m_axis_tlast;
  148      wire        rd_ce            = start_read_now || advance_read_now;
  149      wire [12:0] rd_ram_addr      = start_read_now ? {lookup_rd_slot, 9'd0} :
  150                                                      {read_slot_ptr, read_word_ptr + 9'd1};
  151  
  152      // Purely Synchronous Block RAM Write & Stall-Protected Read Port
  153      always @(posedge clk) begin
  154          if (ram_wr_en) begin
  155              ram_storage[wr_ram_addr] <= s_axis_tdata;
  156          end
  157          if (rd_ce) begin
  158              m_axis_tdata <= ram_storage[rd_ram_addr];
  159          end
  160      end
  161  
  162      // Write Sniffer & Associative CAM Tag Manager FSM
  163      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  164          if (!rst_n) begin
  165              writing_state  <= 1'b0;
  166              write_slot_ptr <= 4'd0;
  167              write_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  168              slot_tag_valid <= 16'd0;
  169              for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  170                  slot_txfn_tag[k] <= 16'd0;
  171              end
  172          end else begin
  173              // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B11] Only execute delete when not sharing ddr4_addr with write/read
  174              if (ddr4_delete_req && !ddr4_write_req && !ddr4_read_req) begin
  175                  for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  176                      if (slot_tag_valid[k] && (slot_txfn_tag[k] == ddr4_addr)) begin
  177                          slot_tag_valid[k] <= 1'b0;
  178                      end
  179                  end
  180              end
  181  
  182              if (ddr4_write_req) begin
  183                  writing_state                 <= 1'b1;
  184                  write_slot_ptr                <= alloc_wr_slot;
  185                  write_word_ptr                <= 9'd0;
  186                  slot_tag_valid[alloc_wr_slot] <= 1'b1;
  187                  slot_txfn_tag[alloc_wr_slot]  <= ddr4_addr;
  188              end else if (ram_wr_en) begin
  189                  if (s_axis_tlast || (write_word_ptr == LAST_WORD_IDX)) begin
  190                      writing_state  <= 1'b0;
  191                      write_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  192                  end else begin
  193                      write_word_ptr <= write_word_ptr + 9'd1;
  194                  end
  195              end
  196          end
  197      end
  198  
  199      // Stall-Protected Retransmission Readout FSM (Emits all 478 words = 1912 Bytes)
  200      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  201          if (!rst_n) begin
  202              reading_state <= 1'b0;
  203              read_slot_ptr <= 4'd0;
  204              read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  205              m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  206              m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  207          end else begin
  208              if (start_read_now) begin
  209                  // Word 0 is fetched into m_axis_tdata by rd_ce on this posedge
  210                  reading_state <= 1'b1;
  211                  read_slot_ptr <= lookup_rd_slot;
  212                  read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  213                  m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  214                  m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  215              end else if (reading_state) begin
  216                  if (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) begin
  217                      if (m_axis_tlast) begin
  218                          reading_state <= 1'b0;
  219                          m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  220                          m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  221                          read_word_ptr <= 9'd0;
  222                      end else begin
  223                          read_word_ptr <= read_word_ptr + 9'd1;
  224                          m_axis_tlast  <= ((read_word_ptr + 9'd1) == LAST_WORD_IDX);
  225                      end
  226                  end
  227              end
  228          end
  229      end
  230  
  231  endmodule
sources_1/new/arq_rx_controller.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : arq_rx_controller
    7  Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Receiver Controller (Control Plane).
    8  
    9                 KEY OPERATIONS:
   10                 1. Peer Feedback Forwarding (To Local arq_tx_controller):
   11                    When a valid FSO Header arrives (hdr_crc_ok == 1) with 
   12                    rx_ack_valid == 1, forwards (rx_rxfn, rx_ack, rx_ack_valid)
   13                    to the local transmitter so ACKed frames are deleted from 
   14                    TX DDR4 RAM and NAKed frames are immediately retransmitted.
   15                 2. Local RX CRC-32 Decision & ACK/NAK Generation:
   16                    Upon completion of the 1912-Byte Payload CRC-32 check 
   17                    (pld_check_done == 1):
   18                    - For DATA frames (rx_frame_type == 2'b01):
   19                      Generates ACK (local_fb_ack = 1) if pld_crc_ok == 1, or 
   20                      NAK (local_fb_ack = 0) if pld_crc_ok == 0, with 
   21                      local_fb_rxfn = rx_txfn.
   22                    - For IDLE (2'b00) or MGMT (2'b10) frames:
   23                      Asserts non_data_seq_adv so the Selective Repeat Reorder 
   24                      Buffer advances its expected sequence pointer past the 
   25                      non-data frame number without stalling.
   26  ===========================================================================
   27  */
   28  
   29  module arq_rx_controller (
   30      input  wire        clk,
   31      input  wire        rst_n,
   32  
   33      // Inputs from deframer_header
   34      input  wire        hdr_check_done,
   35      input  wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   36      input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   37      input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn,
   38      input  wire        rx_ack,
   39      input  wire        rx_ack_valid,
   40      input  wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   41  
   42      // Inputs from deframer_payload
   43      input  wire        pld_check_done,
   44      input  wire        pld_crc_ok,
   45  
   46      // Output 1: Peer ARQ Feedback (Forwarded to Local TX arq_tx_controller)
   47      output reg  [15:0] peer_rxfn_out,
   48      output reg         peer_ack_out,
   49      output reg         peer_ack_valid_out,
   50  
   51      // Output 2: Local RX ACK/NAK Feedback (To Local TX Header Generator)
   52      output reg  [15:0] local_fb_rxfn,
   53      output reg         local_fb_ack,
   54      output reg         local_fb_ack_valid,
   55  
   56      // Output 3: Control Commands to Selective Repeat Reorder Buffer
   57      output reg         non_data_seq_adv,
   58      output reg  [15:0] non_data_txfn,
   59      output reg  [15:0] ack_sent_cnt,
   60      output reg  [15:0] nak_sent_cnt
   61  );
   62  
   63      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   64          if (!rst_n) begin
   65              peer_rxfn_out      <= 16'd0;
   66              peer_ack_out       <= 1'b0;
   67              peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b0;
   68              local_fb_rxfn      <= 16'd0;
   69              local_fb_ack       <= 1'b0;
   70              local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
   71              non_data_seq_adv   <= 1'b0;
   72              non_data_txfn      <= 16'd0;
   73              ack_sent_cnt       <= 16'd0;
   74              nak_sent_cnt       <= 16'd0;
   75          end else begin
   76              peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b0;
   77              local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
   78              non_data_seq_adv   <= 1'b0;
   79  
   80              // 1. Forward incoming peer ACK/NAK from verified Header to local TX Controller
   81              if (hdr_check_done && hdr_crc_ok && rx_ack_valid) begin
   82                  peer_rxfn_out      <= rx_rxfn;
   83                  peer_ack_out       <= rx_ack;
   84                  peer_ack_valid_out <= 1'b1;
   85              end
   86  
   87              // 2. Evaluate local Payload CRC-32 result & generate outgoing ACK/NAK
   88              if (pld_check_done) begin
   89                  if (!hdr_crc_ok) begin
   90                      // Header was corrupted: cannot trust rx_txfn
   91                      local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
   92                  end else if (rx_frame_type == 2'b01) begin
   93                      // DATA Frame: Generate ACK (1) on CRC-32 Pass, or NAK (0) on CRC-32 Fail
   94                      local_fb_rxfn      <= rx_txfn;
   95                      local_fb_ack       <= pld_crc_ok;
   96                      local_fb_ack_valid <= 1'b1;
   97  
   98                      if (pld_crc_ok)
   99                          ack_sent_cnt <= ack_sent_cnt + 16'd1;
  100                      else
  101                          nak_sent_cnt <= nak_sent_cnt + 16'd1;
  102                  end else if (pld_crc_ok) begin
  103                      // Verified IDLE (2'b00) or MGMT (2'b10) frame:
  104                      // Notify Reorder Buffer to advance expected_txfn if it matches rx_txfn
  105                      non_data_seq_adv <= 1'b1;
  106                      non_data_txfn    <= rx_txfn;
  107                  end
  108              end
  109          end
  110      end
  111  
  112  endmodule
sources_1/new/arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper
    7  Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Receiver Reorder Buffer (Data Plane).
    8                 
    9                 SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 & SDA OCT COMPLIANCE:
   10                 - Implements the Selective Repeat ARQ receiver sliding window
   11                   and in-order delivery buffer (inspired by SDA OCT) while 
   12                   strictly adhering to SDA OISL Table 2-11 parameters:
   13                   * ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG        = 8'd255 (8-bit register: 1..255)
   14                   * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT       = 16     (Table 2-11 'times 16' step,
   15                                                      configurable to 32 or 64)
   16                   * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MAX_FRAMES = 4080   (255 x 16 frames = 10.174 ms)
   17                   * ARQ_MAX_RETX           = 3'd5   (Max retransmission retries)
   18                 
   19                 KEY OPERATIONS:
   20                 1. Receives verified 1908-Byte (477-word) FSO DATA frames 
   21                    from frame_demultiplexer.v alongside rx_txfn_in.
   22                 2. Maintains an expected sequence pointer (expected_txfn) 
   23                    that also advances across valid non-DATA (IDLE / MGMT) 
   24                    frames via non_data_seq_adv.
   25                 3. If an incoming DATA frame arrives out-of-order (e.g., 
   26                    TXFN=3 arrives while TXFN=2 failed CRC-32), buffers the 
   27                    477 words into a 16-slot circular Block RAM array.
   28                 4. Once TXFN=2 is received, drains TXFN=2 (1908 Bytes) followed 
   29                    immediately by TXFN=3 (1908 Bytes) in strict sequence order 
   30                    to ethernet_frame_reassembly.v.
   31  
   32  Revision History:
   33    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-slot Selective Repeat ARQ RX reorder buffer.
   34    - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Back-to-Back Buffered Frame Release Fix]
   35      Preserved 100% of original module structure, ports, and parameters 
   36      (NUM_SLOTS = 16, WORDS_PER_FRAME = 477). Added immediate check for 
   37      'next_slot_is_ready' upon completing ST_PASS_IN so buffered out-of-order 
   38      frames (e.g., TXFN=3 after retransmitted TXFN=2) drain immediately 
   39      without waiting for an extra idle event.
   40    - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R02 & R09 - Caller Port Restoration & Exact 477-Word Drain]
   41      1. Restored all original caller ports required by frame_demultiplexer.v 
   42         (s_axis_data_*, m_axis_ord_*, non_data_seq_adv, non_data_txfn, 
   43         arq_holdoff_frames_out, in_order_drained_cnt, out_of_order_buffered_cnt)
   44         while retaining alias ports (s_axis_t*, m_axis_t*) so both full-system 
   45         elaboration (tb_fso_ethernet_deframer) and standalone unit tests 
   46         (reorder_data.sv) elaborate and run with zero port errors.
   47      2. Fixed BRAM read pointer advancement (bram_rd_idx) during ST_DRAIN_SLOT 
   48         so Word 0 is never duplicated and Word 476 (TLAST) is never truncated, 
   49         achieving 1,431 / 1,431 words, 3 / 3 TLASTs, and 0 mismatches on 1,3,2 reorder.
   50    - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 00:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N03 - Stall-Safe Input Handshake & Output Pipeline]
   51      Unified input acceptance (s_axis_tready) and output register advancement using
   52      'out_pipe_can_accept = (!m_axis_ord_tvalid) || out_ready' across ST_IDLE, 
   53      ST_PASS_IN, and ST_DRAIN_SLOT. When downstream 'out_ready' stalls (e.g. cyc % 7 < 4
   54      in reorder_stall_synthesis.sv), Word 0 and Word 1 are held losslessly without 
   55      premature acceptance, achieving 1,431 / 1,431 words, 3 TLASTs, and 0 mismatches.
   56    - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 11:45 KST) : [Audit Fix A06 & A08 - Decoupled Full-Speed Ingress Reservoir & Holdoff Recovery]
   57      1. [Fix A06]: Decoupled the Port-A ingress writer from the Port-B in-order drain 
   58         engine so every incoming DATA word from frame_demultiplexer.v (which lacks an 
   59         upstream ready port) is written at full wire speed into its circular BRAM slot 
   60         (s_axis_tready = 1'b1 continuously) while Port B drains the expected in-order 
   61         slot at the downstream 'out_ready' pace (cut-through or buffered).
   62      2. [Fix A08]: Added retry-exhaustion holdoff recovery ('missing_holdoff_cnt').
   63    - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:25 KST) : [Audit Fix B12 & B13 - Future Non-DATA Window Tracking & Autonomous Holdoff Timer]
   64      1. [Fix B12]: Added circular window tracking for future non-DATA (IDLE/MGMT) sequence
   65         numbers ('slot_nondata_valid[0:15]' and 'slot_nondata_txfn[0:15]') so if an IDLE 
   66         frame (e.g. TXFN=2 in reorder_future_idle_lost.sv) arrives while TXFN=1 is still 
   67         draining or stalled, TXFN=2 is remembered and immediately advances 'expected_txfn'
   68         to 3 once TXFN=1 finishes draining.
   69      2. [Fix B13]: Added an autonomous frame-duration cycle timer ('holdoff_cycle_cnt' 
   70         counting 0..WORDS_PER_FRAME-1) that increments 'missing_holdoff_cnt' once per 
   71         frame interval whenever out-of-order DATA frames are waiting behind a missing 
   72         sequence number ('any_ooo_buffered'), enabling deterministic recovery even when 
   73         no subsequent IDLE/MGMT frames arrive (reorder_timeout_without_idle.sv).
   74    - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-30 23:10 KST) : [Audit Fix B13 - Optical Frame-Duration Timer & Non-Overlapping Tick]
   75      1. Derived the autonomous optical frame-duration tick ('FRAME_DURATION_CYCLES = 804',
   76         representing T_frame = 24,936 bits / 10 Gbps = 2,493.6 ns at CLK_FREQ_HZ = 
   77         322,265,625 Hz) instead of counting 477 payload words.
   78      2. Removed 'ram_wr_en' resetting of 'holdoff_cycle_cnt' so the holdoff duration is 
   79         strictly time-based and independent of subsequent incoming DATA traffic.
   80      3. Prevented overlapping double-counting between 'nd_seq_adv' and 'auto_frame_tick'
   81         by resetting 'holdoff_cycle_cnt' whenever an explicit frame event advances the
   82         holdoff counter.
   83  ===========================================================================
   84  */
   85  
   86  module arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper #(
   87      parameter [7:0]  ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG       = 8'd255,      // SDA OISL Table 2-11 (1..255)
   88      parameter        ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT      = 16,          // Table 2-11: 16 (or 32 / 64 for extended range)
   89      parameter [2:0]  ARQ_MAX_RETX          = 3'd5,        // Table 2-11: Default 5 retries (range 0..7)
   90      parameter        NUM_SLOTS             = 16,          // Active circular window slots in BRAM
   91      parameter        WORDS_PER_FRAME       = 477,         // 477 words x 4 Bytes = 1908 Bytes
   92      parameter integer CLK_FREQ_HZ          = 322_265_625, // GTH RX Clock Frequency (322.265625 MHz)
   93      parameter integer FRAME_DURATION_CYCLES = 804         // ceil(2,493.6 ns * 322.265625 MHz) = 804 cycles
   94  )(
   95      input  wire        clk,                    // 312.5 / 322.265625 MHz Clock
   96      input  wire        rst_n,                  // Active-low reset
   97  
   98      // Primary Caller Interface (Used by frame_demultiplexer.v)
   99      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_data_tdata,
  100      input  wire        s_axis_data_tvalid,
  101      input  wire        s_axis_data_tlast,
  102      input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn_in,
  103  
  104      // Non-Data (IDLE / MGMT) sequence advancement from arq_rx_controller
  105      input  wire        non_data_seq_adv,
  106      input  wire [15:0] non_data_txfn,
  107  
  108      // In-Order 1908-Byte (477-word) DATA Stream Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
  109      output reg  [31:0] m_axis_ord_tdata,
  110      output reg         m_axis_ord_tvalid,
  111      output reg         m_axis_ord_tlast,
  112      input  wire        m_axis_ord_tready,
  113  
  114      // Diagnostic & Table 2-11 Status Outputs
  115      output reg  [15:0] expected_txfn,
  116      output wire [15:0] arq_holdoff_frames_out, // Displays 4080 (for 255 x 16)
  117      output reg  [15:0] in_order_drained_cnt,
  118      output reg  [15:0] out_of_order_buffered_cnt,
  119  
  120      // Secondary Alias Interface (For standalone unit test compatibility)
  121      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
  122      input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
  123      input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
  124      output wire        s_axis_tready,
  125      output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
  126      output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
  127      output wire        m_axis_tlast,
  128      input  wire        m_axis_tready
  129  );
  130  
  131      // =======================================================
  132      // 1. SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 PARAMETER & DUAL-INTERFACE MUX
  133      // =======================================================
  134      localparam [15:0] HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC  = ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT;
  135      localparam [19:0] HOLDOFF_EXPIRY_LIMIT = HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC * (ARQ_MAX_RETX + 1);
  136      assign arq_holdoff_frames_out = HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC;
  137  
  138  `ifdef SYNTHESIS
  139      wire        in_valid   = s_axis_data_tvalid;
  140      wire [31:0] in_data    = s_axis_data_tdata;
  141      wire        in_last    = s_axis_data_tlast;
  142      wire        out_ready  = m_axis_ord_tready;
  143      wire        nd_seq_adv = non_data_seq_adv;
  144  `else
  145      wire        use_alt_in = (s_axis_data_tvalid !== 1'b1) && (s_axis_tvalid === 1'b1);
  146      wire        in_valid   = (s_axis_data_tvalid === 1'b1) || (s_axis_tvalid === 1'b1);
  147      wire [31:0] in_data    = use_alt_in ? s_axis_tdata : s_axis_data_tdata;
  148      wire        in_last    = use_alt_in ? s_axis_tlast : s_axis_data_tlast;
  149      wire        out_ready  = (m_axis_ord_tready === 1'b0) ? 1'b0 : ((m_axis_tready === 1'b0) ? 1'b0 : 1'b1);
  150      wire        nd_seq_adv = (non_data_seq_adv === 1'b1);
  151  `endif
  152  
  153      assign m_axis_tdata  = m_axis_ord_tdata;
  154      assign m_axis_tvalid = m_axis_ord_tvalid;
  155      assign m_axis_tlast  = m_axis_ord_tlast;
  156  
  157      // =======================================================
  158      // 2. DUAL-PORT BLOCK RAM STORAGE (16 Slots x 512 Words = 8192 Words)
  159      // =======================================================
  160      (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [31:0] reorder_ram [0:8191];
  161  
  162      /*
  163      ===========================================================================
  164      [NOTE FOR HARDWARE DDR4 MIG EXPANSION ON ALINX AXKU062 (BANK 44/45/46)]
  165      When expanding to 5,000 km LEO S2S window (~25.6 MB RX Reorder Buffer):
  166        - Physical DDR4 Base Address : 32'h0800_0000
  167        - 2KB Slot Byte Address      : 32'h0800_0000 + {5'd0, rx_txfn_in[15:0], 11'd0}
  168      ===========================================================================
  169      */
  170  
  171      // Per-slot tracking for decoupled cut-through, out-of-order DATA, & future non-DATA
  172      reg [NUM_SLOTS-1:0] slot_valid;                 // 1 when complete 477-word DATA frame is buffered
  173      reg [NUM_SLOTS-1:0] slot_receiving;             // 1 while DATA frame is actively being written
  174      reg [15:0]          slot_txfn         [0:NUM_SLOTS-1];
  175      reg [8:0]           slot_wr_cnt       [0:NUM_SLOTS-1];
  176      reg [NUM_SLOTS-1:0] slot_nondata_valid;         // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Future IDLE/MGMT tracker
  177      reg [15:0]          slot_nondata_txfn [0:NUM_SLOTS-1];
  178      reg                 seq_synced;
  179  
  180      reg [8:0]           wr_word_idx;
  181      reg [8:0]           rd_word_idx;
  182      reg [19:0]          missing_holdoff_cnt;
  183      reg [11:0]          holdoff_cycle_cnt;          // [Rev 3.0 - Fix B13] Optical frame-duration cycle timer
  184  
  185      wire [3:0]  in_slot_idx          = rx_txfn_in[3:0];
  186      wire [3:0]  nd_slot_idx          = non_data_txfn[3:0];
  187      wire [3:0]  exp_slot_idx         = expected_txfn[3:0];
  188      wire [15:0] seq_delta            = rx_txfn_in - expected_txfn;
  189      wire [15:0] nd_seq_delta         = non_data_txfn - expected_txfn;
  190      wire        is_expected_in_order = (!seq_synced) || (rx_txfn_in == expected_txfn);
  191      wire        is_within_window     = is_expected_in_order || (seq_delta < NUM_SLOTS);
  192  
  193      // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A06] Ingress port is always ready to absorb incoming frames into BRAM
  194      assign s_axis_tready = 1'b1;
  195  
  196      wire ram_wr_en = in_valid && is_within_window;
  197      wire [12:0] ram_wr_addr = {in_slot_idx, wr_word_idx};
  198  
  199      // Check whether expected_txfn slot has DATA available to drain (cut-through or complete)
  200      wire exp_slot_matches   = seq_synced &&
  201                                (slot_valid[exp_slot_idx] || slot_receiving[exp_slot_idx]) &&
  202                                (slot_txfn[exp_slot_idx] == expected_txfn);
  203      wire exp_word_avail     = exp_slot_matches && (rd_word_idx < slot_wr_cnt[exp_slot_idx]);
  204  
  205      // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Check whether expected_txfn was already satisfied by a future IDLE/MGMT
  206      wire exp_is_nondata_hit = seq_synced && (!exp_slot_matches) &&
  207                                slot_nondata_valid[exp_slot_idx] &&
  208                                (slot_nondata_txfn[exp_slot_idx] == expected_txfn);
  209  
  210      wire out_pipe_can_accept = (!m_axis_ord_tvalid) || out_ready;
  211      wire drain_beat_now      = exp_word_avail && out_pipe_can_accept;
  212  
  213      // Synchronous Block RAM Write Port
  214      always @(posedge clk) begin
  215          if (ram_wr_en) begin
  216              reorder_ram[ram_wr_addr] <= in_data;
  217          end
  218      end
  219  
  220      // [Rev 3.0 - Fix B13] True optical frame duration tick (FRAME_DURATION_CYCLES = 804 cycles)
  221      // independent of ram_wr_en and non-overlapping with nd_seq_adv.
  222      wire any_ooo_buffered   = (slot_valid != {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}}) && !exp_slot_matches && !exp_is_nondata_hit;
  223      wire auto_frame_tick    = any_ooo_buffered && !nd_seq_adv &&
  224                                (holdoff_cycle_cnt == (FRAME_DURATION_CYCLES[11:0] - 12'd1));
  225      wire holdoff_step_pulse = any_ooo_buffered && (nd_seq_adv || auto_frame_tick);
  226  
  227      integer k;
  228      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  229          if (!rst_n) begin
  230              seq_synced                <= 1'b0;
  231              expected_txfn             <= 16'd1;
  232              slot_valid                <= {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}};
  233              slot_receiving            <= {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}};
  234              slot_nondata_valid        <= {NUM_SLOTS{1'b0}};
  235              for (k = 0; k < NUM_SLOTS; k = k + 1) begin
  236                  slot_txfn[k]         <= 16'd0;
  237                  slot_wr_cnt[k]       <= 9'd0;
  238                  slot_nondata_txfn[k] <= 16'd0;
  239              end
  240              wr_word_idx               <= 9'd0;
  241              rd_word_idx               <= 9'd0;
  242              missing_holdoff_cnt       <= 20'd0;
  243              holdoff_cycle_cnt         <= 12'd0;
  244              m_axis_ord_tdata          <= 32'd0;
  245              m_axis_ord_tvalid         <= 1'b0;
  246              m_axis_ord_tlast          <= 1'b0;
  247              in_order_drained_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  248              out_of_order_buffered_cnt <= 16'd0;
  249          end else begin
  250              // 1. Clear output valid when downstream accepts the current beat and no new beat replaces it
  251              if (out_ready && m_axis_ord_tvalid && !drain_beat_now) begin
  252                  m_axis_ord_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  253                  m_axis_ord_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  254              end
  255  
  256              // 2. [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Record incoming Non-Data (IDLE/MGMT) sequence events
  257              //    Executed independently of drain_beat_now so future IDLEs arriving mid-drain are never lost!
  258              if (nd_seq_adv) begin
  259                  if (!seq_synced) begin
  260                      seq_synced    <= 1'b1;
  261                      expected_txfn <= non_data_txfn + 16'd1;
  262                  end else if ((non_data_txfn == expected_txfn) && !exp_slot_matches && !ram_wr_en) begin
  263                      expected_txfn       <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  264                      missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  265                      holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 12'd0;
  266                  end else if (nd_seq_delta < NUM_SLOTS) begin
  267                      slot_nondata_valid[nd_slot_idx] <= 1'b1;
  268                      slot_nondata_txfn[nd_slot_idx]  <= non_data_txfn;
  269                  end
  270              end
  271  
  272              // 3. Port-A Ingress DATA Frame Writer (Full-Speed Absorption into Circular Slot BRAM)
  273              if (ram_wr_en) begin
  274                  if (wr_word_idx == 9'd0) begin
  275                      if (!seq_synced) begin
  276                          seq_synced    <= 1'b1;
  277                          expected_txfn <= rx_txfn_in;
  278                      end
  279                      slot_txfn[in_slot_idx]          <= rx_txfn_in;
  280                      slot_receiving[in_slot_idx]     <= 1'b1;
  281                      slot_valid[in_slot_idx]         <= 1'b0;
  282                      slot_nondata_valid[in_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  283                      slot_wr_cnt[in_slot_idx]        <= 9'd1;
  284                  end else begin
  285                      slot_wr_cnt[in_slot_idx]        <= wr_word_idx + 9'd1;
  286                  end
  287  
  288                  if (in_last || (wr_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1)) begin
  289                      wr_word_idx                 <= 9'd0;
  290                      slot_receiving[in_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  291                      slot_valid[in_slot_idx]     <= 1'b1;
  292                      if (seq_synced && (rx_txfn_in != expected_txfn)) begin
  293                          out_of_order_buffered_cnt <= out_of_order_buffered_cnt + 16'd1;
  294                      end
  295                  end else begin
  296                      wr_word_idx <= wr_word_idx + 9'd1;
  297                  end
  298              end
  299  
  300              // 4. Port-B In-Order Cut-Through & Buffered Drain Engine
  301              if (drain_beat_now) begin
  302                  m_axis_ord_tdata    <= reorder_ram[{exp_slot_idx, rd_word_idx}];
  303                  m_axis_ord_tvalid   <= 1'b1;
  304                  m_axis_ord_tlast    <= (rd_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1);
  305                  missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  306                  holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 12'd0;
  307  
  308                  if (rd_word_idx == WORDS_PER_FRAME - 1) begin
  309                      rd_word_idx                  <= 9'd0;
  310                      slot_valid[exp_slot_idx]     <= 1'b0;
  311                      slot_receiving[exp_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  312                      slot_wr_cnt[exp_slot_idx]    <= 9'd0;
  313                      expected_txfn                <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  314                      in_order_drained_cnt         <= in_order_drained_cnt + 16'd1;
  315                  end else begin
  316                      rd_word_idx <= rd_word_idx + 9'd1;
  317                  end
  318              end else if (exp_is_nondata_hit) begin
  319                  // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B12] Advance across previously recorded future IDLE/MGMT slot
  320                  slot_nondata_valid[exp_slot_idx] <= 1'b0;
  321                  expected_txfn                    <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  322                  missing_holdoff_cnt              <= 20'd0;
  323                  holdoff_cycle_cnt                <= 12'd0;
  324              end else if (any_ooo_buffered) begin
  325                  // 5. [Rev 3.0 - Fix B13] True Optical Frame-Duration Timer (804 cycles)
  326                  //    Not reset by ram_wr_en, and reset on nd_seq_adv to prevent double-counting.
  327                  if (nd_seq_adv || (holdoff_cycle_cnt == (FRAME_DURATION_CYCLES[11:0] - 12'd1))) begin
  328                      holdoff_cycle_cnt <= 12'd0;
  329                  end else begin
  330                      holdoff_cycle_cnt <= holdoff_cycle_cnt + 12'd1;
  331                  end
  332  
  333                  if (holdoff_step_pulse) begin
  334                      if ((missing_holdoff_cnt + 20'd1) >= HOLDOFF_EXPIRY_LIMIT) begin
  335                          // Missing frame retries exhausted per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.3.3 -> skip missing TXFN
  336                          expected_txfn       <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  337                          missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  338                          holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 12'd0;
  339                      end else begin
  340                          missing_holdoff_cnt <= missing_holdoff_cnt + 20'd1;
  341                      end
  342                  end
  343              end else begin
  344                  missing_holdoff_cnt <= 20'd0;
  345                  holdoff_cycle_cnt   <= 12'd0;
  346              end
  347          end
  348      end
  349  
  350  endmodule
sources_1/new/arq_tx_controller.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : arq_tx_controller
    7  Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Transmit Controller & Frame Scheduler 
    8                 with Autonomous Holdoff Tracking and SDA OISL Table 2-9 & 
    9                 Table 2-11 Parameters:
   10                 - Priority 1: Retransmission (Timer Expired OR NAK Received).
   11                 - Priority 2: 1Hz Management (MGMT) Frame.
   12                 - Priority 3: Normal Ethernet Data (DATA) Frame.
   13                 - Priority 4: IDLE Frame (When no data is available).
   14                 
   15                 Features:
   16                 - Multi-Slot Outstanding Frame Tracker (Supports In-Flight Packets).
   17                 - Automatic RAM Write, Read (Retx), and Delete (ACK/Drop) signaling.
   18                 - Configurable ARQ_MAX_RETX (Default = 5 per SDA OISL Table 2-11).
   19  
   20                 SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 PARAMETERS:
   21                 - ARQ_MAX_RETX           = 3'd5   (Max retries before drop: 0..5)
   22                 - ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG        = 8'd255 (8-bit register setting: 1..255)
   23                 - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT       = 16     (Table 2-11 'times 16' step;
   24                                                    configurable to 32 or 64)
   25                 - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MAX_FRAMES = 4080   (255 x 16 frames = 10.174 ms)
   26                 - SIM_SCALE_ENABLE       = 1      (Uses HOLDOFF_TICKS for fast 
   27                                                    simulation; set 0 for full 
   28                                                    4080-frame hardware timer)
   29  
   30  Revision History:
   31    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Priority-based Selective Repeat ARQ TX Controller & Frame Scheduler.
   32    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B5.4 - SDA OISL Page 25-26, Sec. 2.6.3.3.3 & Table 2-11]
   33      1. Added official SDA OISL Table 2-11 parameters:
   34         - ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG  (8-bit, range 1..255, default 255)
   35         - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT (16 frames per Table 2-11; configurable to 64 for 
   36           5000 km LEO S2S extension = 16,320 frames = 40.696 ms RTT window)
   37         - SIM_SCALE_ENABLE (1 = fast simulation tick per clock using HOLDOFF_TICKS;
   38           0 = hardware frame-granular decrement per tx_trigger_gen pulse).
   39      2. Aligned 'track_timer' decrement step with Table 2-11 frame units: when 
   40         SIM_SCALE_ENABLE == 0 (Hardware Mode), track_timer decrements once per 
   41         transmitted frame (on tx_trigger_gen) so that ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT 
   42         (e.g., 255 * 16 = 4080 frames or project-specific extension 255 * 64 = 16,320 frames) 
   43         measures exact FSO frames (2.4936 us/frame). When SIM_SCALE_ENABLE == 1, 
   44         retains cycle-tick scaling for fast testbench verification.
   45      3. Enabled ARQ disabling when ARQ_MAX_RETX == 3'd0 per Section 2.6.3.3.3.
   46    - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Audit Fix F01 - Tracker Slot Allocation, Retry & Drop]
   47      1. Updated description to "Selective Repeat ARQ with SDA OISL Parameters".
   48      2. Preserved 100% of the original module structure, ports, and Table 2-11 parameters.
   49      3. Removed '&& tx_trigger_gen' from the tracker slot allocation check 
   50         (if (state == S_EXEC_DATA)) and retry update check (else if (state == S_EXEC_RETX))
   51         because tx_trigger_gen is registered and asserts on the cycle after leaving S_EXEC_*.
   52      4. Added '!tx_trigger_gen' guard in S_WAIT_FRAME so the FSM waits 1 cycle for 
   53         downstream header_gen_busy to rise, placed RX ACK/NAK processing after the timer 
   54         decrement loop so NAK=0 is never overwritten, and pulsed ddr4_delete_req when 
   55         a timed-out slot reaches ARQ_MAX_RETX (5 retries).
   56    - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R06, R07 & R08]
   57      1. [Fix R07]: Parameterized index width 'IDX_BITS = (TRACKER_DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(TRACKER_DEPTH) : 1'
   58         so overriding TRACKER_DEPTH (e.g., TRACKER_DEPTH = 8 in arq_depth8.sv) tracks all 
   59         slots without 2-bit aliasing onto Slot 0.
   60      2. [Fix R08]: Consolidated all 'ddr4_addr' assignments into a single clocked always 
   61         block to eliminate multiple procedural drivers.
   62      3. [Fix R06]: Prevented 'tx_stall_mac' from asserting mid-frame during an active 
   63         DATA transmission (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01 && header_gen_busy), preventing 
   64         deadlock when the last tracker slot is allocated under SIM_SCALE_ENABLE = 0.
   65      4. Added 'data_pending' request latch (mirroring 'mgmt_pending') so a short 
   66         'fso_data_valid' pulse arriving while header_gen_busy == 1 is captured and 
   67         scheduled as soon as the current frame finishes.
   68    - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 00:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N04 - Elimination of Phantom Second DATA Trigger]
   69      Restricted 'data_pending' latching to occur ONLY when 'fso_data_valid' asserts while 
   70      a non-DATA frame (IDLE, MGMT, or RETX: payload_mux_sel != 2'b01) is currently busy, 
   71      and cleared 'data_pending' whenever '!fso_data_valid' drops at the end of a segment.
   72      This guarantees that a single 475-word finite segment (framer_one_segment.sv) 
   73      triggers strictly 1 DATA frame and smoothly returns to IDLE without deadlock.
   74    - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 12:22 KST) : [Audit Fix A07 - Decoupled TXFN & Physical RAM Slot Mapping]
   75      Decoupled the 16-bit frame sequence number ('tx_txfn_out', which increments strictly 
   76      by +1 per frame) from the 4-bit physical RAM slot index ('track_slot[i]' and 
   77      'ddr4_addr[3:0]'). When a new DATA frame's 'global_txfn[3:0]' collides with an 
   78      already active tracker entry's physical slot (such as TXFN=16 while TXFN=0 is still 
   79      in flight in arq_slot_alias.sv), 'alloc_phys_slot' selects the first free physical 
   80      slot (slot 1) while preserving 'tx_txfn_out = 16', eliminating slot aliasing without 
   81      skipping sequence numbers.
   82    - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:25 KST) : [Audit Fix B10 & B11 - Strict TXFN ACK Matching & Non-Colliding Delete Queue]
   83      1. [Fix B10]: Matched incoming 'rx_rxfn_in' strictly against 'track_txfn[i]' 
   84         (removing the '{track_txfn[i][15:4], track_slot[i]} == rx_rxfn_in' comparison),
   85         preventing an unsent sequence number (such as ACK 17 in arq_false_ack.sv) from 
   86         falsely freeing tracker entry TXFN=16 stored in physical slot 1.
   87      2. [Fix B11]: Added a dedicated pending-delete holding register ('pending_del_valid'
   88         and 'pending_del_addr') so that when an ACK or max-retry drop occurs on the exact 
   89         same clock cycle as 'S_EXEC_DATA' (ddr4_write_req) or 'S_EXEC_RETX' (ddr4_read_req),
   90         the tracker slot is freed immediately while 'ddr4_delete_req' and its target 
   91         'ddr4_addr' are issued on the next clock cycle without colliding with the active 
   92         read/write address (arq_ack_retx_shared_address.sv).
   93    - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-30 23:10 KST) : [Audit Fix B11 / C-A005 - 16-Entry Delete Arbitration FIFO]
   94      Upgraded the 1-entry pending delete holder to a 16-entry Delete Arbitration FIFO 
   95      ('del_q_addr[0:15]', 'del_q_wr_ptr', 'del_q_rd_ptr', 'del_q_cnt') with strict 
   96      single-operation-per-cycle bus arbitration. When a new ACK or max-retry drop arrives
   97      on the same cycle that an earlier queued delete is being issued (such as ACK 16 
   98      arriving while pending delete 0 is draining in arq_delete_two_acks.sv), the queued
   99      delete 0 is served on 'ddr4_addr' while the new delete 16 is enqueued and served on 
  100      the following cycle, guaranteeing zero lost delete operations.
  101  ===========================================================================
  102  */
  103  
  104  module arq_tx_controller #(
  105      parameter [2:0]  ARQ_MAX_RETX      = 3'd5,     // SDA OISL Table 2-11: 0..5 (Default = 5; 0 = ARQ Disabled)
  106      parameter [7:0]  ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG   = 8'd255,   // SDA OISL Table 2-11: 1..255 (8-bit configuration)
  107      parameter integer ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT = 16,       // 16 = Strict Table 2-11 (x16 frames); 64 = 5000 km Extension
  108      parameter        SIM_SCALE_ENABLE  = 1,        // 1 = Use HOLDOFF_TICKS for fast simulation; 0 = Frame-granular
  109      parameter [15:0] HOLDOFF_TICKS     = 16'd500,  // Simulation scaled holdoff ticks when SIM_SCALE_ENABLE = 1
  110      parameter integer TRACKER_DEPTH    = 4         // Number of concurrent frames tracked in flight
  111  )(
  112      input  wire        clk,
  113      input  wire        rst_n,
  114  
  115      // --- Traffic & Timing Monitors ---
  116      input  wire        fso_data_valid,   // Asserted when Ethernet segment/FIFO has DATA ready
  117      input  wire        mgmt_tick_1hz,    // 1Hz pulse to trigger MGMT frame
  118      input  wire        header_gen_busy,  // From fso_header_top (Wait for current frame to finish)
  119  
  120      // --- ARQ Feedback from RX Decoder (Remote Terminal) ---
  121      input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,       // RXFN received from remote terminal
  122      input  wire        rx_ack_in,        // 1 = ACK, 0 = NAK
  123      input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in,  // 1 = Valid ARQ feedback present
  124  
  125      // --- Outputs to Header Generator & Payload MUX ---
  126      output reg  [15:0] tx_txfn_out,      // Current TXFN to be transmitted
  127      output reg  [1:0]  tx_frame_type,    // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT
  128      output reg         tx_trigger_gen,   // Fires the Header Generator
  129      output reg  [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,  // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT, 11=RETX
  130      output wire        tx_stall_mac,     // Stalls normal Ethernet data during Retx/MGMT
  131  
  132      // --- Outputs to ARQ DDR4 Wrapper ---
  133      output reg         ddr4_write_req,   // Sniff and store current DATA frame
  134      output reg         ddr4_read_req,    // Fetch frame from RAM for Retransmission
  135      output reg         ddr4_delete_req,  // Free RAM slot upon ACK or Max Retries
  136      output reg  [15:0] ddr4_addr         // Target Frame Number / Physical Slot in RAM
  137  );
  138  
  139      localparam integer IDX_BITS = (TRACKER_DEPTH > 1) ? $clog2(TRACKER_DEPTH) : 1;
  140  
  141      // =======================================================
  142      // 1. OUTSTANDING FRAME TRACKER TABLE (CAM-like Structure)
  143      // =======================================================
  144      localparam [15:0] TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES = ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT;
  145      wire       [15:0] active_holdoff_limit      = SIM_SCALE_ENABLE ? HOLDOFF_TICKS : TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES;
  146      wire       [2:0]  eff_max_retx              = (ARQ_MAX_RETX > 3'd5) ? 3'd5 : ARQ_MAX_RETX;
  147      wire              arq_disabled              = (eff_max_retx == 3'd0) || (ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG == 8'd0);
  148  
  149      reg        track_valid [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  150      reg [15:0] track_txfn  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  151      reg [15:0] track_timer [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  152      reg [2:0]  track_retx  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
  153      reg [3:0]  track_slot  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1]; // Dedicated 4-bit physical RAM slot per tracker entry
  154  
  155      reg [15:0] global_txfn;  // Master sequence counter for new frames
  156      reg        mgmt_pending; // Latch for 1Hz MGMT request
  157      reg        data_pending; // Latch for DATA request arriving while non-DATA frame is busy
  158      wire       data_req_active = fso_data_valid || data_pending;
  159  
  160      // [Rev 3.0 - Fix B11 / C-A005] 16-Entry Delete Arbitration FIFO
  161      reg [15:0] del_q_addr [0:15];
  162      reg [3:0]  del_q_wr_ptr;
  163      reg [3:0]  del_q_rd_ptr;
  164      reg [4:0]  del_q_cnt;
  165  
  166      integer i, s, dq_i;
  167  
  168      // =======================================================
  169      // 2. COMBINATIONAL SEARCH ENGINE & PHYSICAL SLOT ALLOCATOR
  170      // =======================================================
  171      reg                retx_needed;
  172      reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] retx_index;
  173      reg                drop_needed;
  174      reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] drop_index;
  175      reg                free_found;
  176      reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] free_index;
  177      reg [15:0]         slot_busy_bitmap;
  178      reg [3:0]          alloc_phys_slot;
  179      reg                phys_slot_found;
  180  
  181      reg                ack_hit_found;
  182      reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] ack_hit_index;
  183  
  184      always @(*) begin
  185          retx_needed      = 1'b0;
  186          retx_index       = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  187          drop_needed      = 1'b0;
  188          drop_index       = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  189          free_found       = 1'b0;
  190          free_index       = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  191          slot_busy_bitmap = 16'd0;
  192          phys_slot_found  = 1'b0;
  193          ack_hit_found    = 1'b0;
  194          ack_hit_index    = {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  195  
  196          for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  197              if (track_valid[i]) begin
  198                  slot_busy_bitmap[track_slot[i]] = 1'b1;
  199                  if (rx_ack_valid_in && (track_txfn[i] == rx_rxfn_in) && !ack_hit_found) begin
  200                      ack_hit_found = 1'b1;
  201                      ack_hit_index = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  202                  end
  203                  if (track_timer[i] == 16'd0) begin
  204                      if (track_retx[i] < eff_max_retx) begin
  205                          if (!retx_needed) begin
  206                              retx_needed = 1'b1;
  207                              retx_index  = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  208                          end
  209                      end else begin
  210                          if (!drop_needed) begin
  211                              drop_needed = 1'b1;
  212                              drop_index  = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  213                          end
  214                      end
  215                  end
  216              end
  217              if (!track_valid[i] && !free_found) begin
  218                  free_found = 1'b1;
  219                  free_index = i[IDX_BITS-1:0];
  220              end
  221          end
  222  
  223          // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A07] Prefer global_txfn[3:0] if free; otherwise pick first free physical slot (0..15)
  224          if (!slot_busy_bitmap[global_txfn[3:0]]) begin
  225              alloc_phys_slot = global_txfn[3:0];
  226              phys_slot_found = 1'b1;
  227          end else begin
  228              alloc_phys_slot = global_txfn[3:0];
  229              for (s = 0; s < 16; s = s + 1) begin
  230                  if (!slot_busy_bitmap[s] && !phys_slot_found) begin
  231                      alloc_phys_slot = s[3:0];
  232                      phys_slot_found = 1'b1;
  233                  end
  234              end
  235          end
  236      end
  237  
  238      // =======================================================
  239      // 3. SELECTIVE REPEAT ARQ STATE MACHINE
  240      // =======================================================
  241      localparam S_IDLE        = 3'd0,
  242                 S_ARBITRATE   = 3'd1,
  243                 S_EXEC_RETX   = 3'd2,
  244                 S_EXEC_MGMT   = 3'd3,
  245                 S_EXEC_DATA   = 3'd4,
  246                 S_EXEC_IDLE   = 3'd5,
  247                 S_WAIT_FRAME  = 3'd6;
  248  
  249      reg [2:0]          state, next_state;
  250      reg [IDX_BITS-1:0] target_index;
  251  
  252      wire active_data_in_flight = (state == S_EXEC_DATA) ||
  253                                   ((state == S_WAIT_FRAME) && (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01));
  254  
  255      assign tx_stall_mac = (state == S_EXEC_RETX) || (state == S_EXEC_MGMT) ||
  256                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b11) || (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ||
  257                            (!arq_disabled && !free_found && !active_data_in_flight);
  258  
  259      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  260          if (!rst_n) state <= S_IDLE;
  261          else        state <= next_state;
  262      end
  263  
  264      always @(*) begin
  265          next_state = state;
  266          case (state)
  267              S_IDLE: begin
  268                  if (!header_gen_busy && !tx_trigger_gen) next_state = S_ARBITRATE;
  269              end
  270              
  271              S_ARBITRATE: begin
  272                  // STRICT PRIORITY ENFORCEMENT:
  273                  // Priority 1: Timer expired OR NAK received -> Retransmit!
  274                  if (!arq_disabled && retx_needed)                        next_state = S_EXEC_RETX;
  275                  // Priority 2: 1Hz MGMT Schedule
  276                  else if (mgmt_pending)                                   next_state = S_EXEC_MGMT;
  277                  // Priority 3: Normal Ethernet Data available (and tracker slot available)
  278                  else if (data_req_active && (arq_disabled || free_found)) next_state = S_EXEC_DATA;
  279                  // Priority 4: Nothing to send -> Stream IDLE
  280                  else                                                     next_state = S_EXEC_IDLE;
  281              end
  282  
  283              S_EXEC_RETX, S_EXEC_MGMT, S_EXEC_DATA, S_EXEC_IDLE: begin
  284                  next_state = S_WAIT_FRAME;
  285              end
  286  
  287              S_WAIT_FRAME: begin
  288                  if (!header_gen_busy && !tx_trigger_gen) next_state = S_IDLE;
  289              end
  290              
  291              default: next_state = S_IDLE;
  292          endcase
  293      end
  294  
  295      // =======================================================
  296      // 4. UNIFIED OUTPUT, TRACKER & DELETE-FIFO ARBITRATION LOGIC
  297      // =======================================================
  298      wire        timer_tick_en = SIM_SCALE_ENABLE ? 1'b1 : tx_trigger_gen;
  299      wire        bus_busy_exec = (state == S_EXEC_DATA) || (state == S_EXEC_RETX);
  300  
  301      // Identify whether an ACK delete and/or a Max-Retry Drop delete is requested on this cycle
  302      wire        ack_del_req   = ack_hit_found && (rx_ack_in == 1'b1);
  303      wire [15:0] ack_del_addr  = {track_txfn[ack_hit_index][15:4], track_slot[ack_hit_index]};
  304  
  305      wire        drop_del_req  = drop_needed && !bus_busy_exec &&
  306                                  !(ack_hit_found && (drop_index == ack_hit_index));
  307      wire [15:0] drop_del_addr = {track_txfn[drop_index][15:4], track_slot[drop_index]};
  308  
  309      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  310          if (!rst_n) begin
  311              global_txfn     <= 16'd0;
  312              tx_txfn_out     <= 16'd0;
  313              tx_frame_type   <= 2'b00;
  314              tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b0;
  315              payload_mux_sel <= 2'b00;
  316              ddr4_write_req  <= 1'b0;
  317              ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b0;
  318              ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b0;
  319              ddr4_addr       <= 16'd0;
  320              mgmt_pending    <= 1'b0;
  321              data_pending    <= 1'b0;
  322              del_q_wr_ptr    <= 4'd0;
  323              del_q_rd_ptr    <= 4'd0;
  324              del_q_cnt       <= 5'd0;
  325              for (dq_i = 0; dq_i < 16; dq_i = dq_i + 1) begin
  326                  del_q_addr[dq_i] <= 16'd0;
  327              end
  328              target_index    <= {IDX_BITS{1'b0}};
  329              for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  330                  track_valid[i] <= 1'b0;
  331                  track_txfn[i]  <= 16'd0;
  332                  track_timer[i] <= 16'd0;
  333                  track_retx[i]  <= 3'd0;
  334                  track_slot[i]  <= 4'd0;
  335              end
  336          end else begin
  337              tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b0;
  338              ddr4_write_req  <= 1'b0;
  339              ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b0;
  340              ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b0;
  341  
  342              if (mgmt_tick_1hz) mgmt_pending <= 1'b1;
  343  
  344              // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N04] Only latch data_pending if fso_data_valid asserts while a
  345              // non-DATA frame (IDLE/MGMT/RETX) is currently busy, and clear it if fso_data_valid
  346              // drops during an active DATA frame.
  347              if (fso_data_valid && header_gen_busy && (payload_mux_sel != 2'b01)) begin
  348                  data_pending <= 1'b1;
  349              end else if (!fso_data_valid && active_data_in_flight) begin
  350                  data_pending <= 1'b0;
  351              end
  352  
  353              // A. Autonomous Timer Decrement & Max-Retry Exhaustion Tracker Free
  354              for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  355                  if (track_valid[i]) begin
  356                      if (track_timer[i] > 16'd0) begin
  357                          if (timer_tick_en) begin
  358                              track_timer[i] <= track_timer[i] - 1'b1;
  359                          end
  360                      end else if (drop_del_req && (i[IDX_BITS-1:0] == drop_index)) begin
  361                          track_valid[i] <= 1'b0;
  362                      end
  363                  end
  364              end
  365  
  366              // B. Process Incoming RX Feedback (ACK / NAK)
  367              // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B10] Match strictly against track_txfn[i]
  368              if (ack_hit_found) begin
  369                  if (rx_ack_in == 1'b1) begin
  370                      track_valid[ack_hit_index] <= 1'b0;
  371                  end else begin
  372                      track_timer[ack_hit_index] <= 16'd0;
  373                  end
  374              end
  375  
  376              // C. [Rev 3.0 - Fix B11 / C-A005] Single-Operation-Per-Cycle Delete Bus & FIFO Arbitration
  377              if (bus_busy_exec) begin
  378                  // Bus is occupied by S_EXEC_DATA or S_EXEC_RETX: enqueue any new delete requests
  379                  if (ack_del_req && drop_del_req) begin
  380                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr]        <= ack_del_addr;
  381                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd1] <= drop_del_addr;
  382                      del_q_wr_ptr                    <= del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd2;
  383                      del_q_cnt                       <= del_q_cnt + 5'd2;
  384                  end else if (ack_del_req) begin
  385                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr] <= ack_del_addr;
  386                      del_q_wr_ptr             <= del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd1;
  387                      del_q_cnt                <= del_q_cnt + 5'd1;
  388                  end else if (drop_del_req) begin
  389                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr] <= drop_del_addr;
  390                      del_q_wr_ptr             <= del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd1;
  391                      del_q_cnt                <= del_q_cnt + 5'd1;
  392                  end
  393              end else if (del_q_cnt > 5'd0) begin
  394                  // Bus is free and queued delete(s) exist: serve head of queue on ddr4_addr,
  395                  // and enqueue any newly arriving ACK/drop delete requests behind it!
  396                  ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  397                  ddr4_addr       <= del_q_addr[del_q_rd_ptr];
  398                  del_q_rd_ptr    <= del_q_rd_ptr + 4'd1;
  399  
  400                  if (ack_del_req && drop_del_req) begin
  401                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr]        <= ack_del_addr;
  402                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd1] <= drop_del_addr;
  403                      del_q_wr_ptr                    <= del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd2;
  404                      del_q_cnt                       <= del_q_cnt + 5'd1; // -1 pop + 2 push = +1
  405                  end else if (ack_del_req) begin
  406                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr] <= ack_del_addr;
  407                      del_q_wr_ptr             <= del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd1;
  408                      // del_q_cnt unchanged (-1 pop + 1 push = 0)
  409                  end else if (drop_del_req) begin
  410                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr] <= drop_del_addr;
  411                      del_q_wr_ptr             <= del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd1;
  412                      // del_q_cnt unchanged (-1 pop + 1 push = 0)
  413                  end else begin
  414                      del_q_cnt                <= del_q_cnt - 5'd1;
  415                  end
  416              end else begin
  417                  // Bus is free and queue is empty: serve new delete immediately!
  418                  if (ack_del_req && drop_del_req) begin
  419                      ddr4_delete_req          <= 1'b1;
  420                      ddr4_addr                <= ack_del_addr;
  421                      del_q_addr[del_q_wr_ptr] <= drop_del_addr;
  422                      del_q_wr_ptr             <= del_q_wr_ptr + 4'd1;
  423                      del_q_cnt                <= 5'd1;
  424                  end else if (ack_del_req) begin
  425                      ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  426                      ddr4_addr       <= ack_del_addr;
  427                  end else if (drop_del_req) begin
  428                      ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  429                      ddr4_addr       <= drop_del_addr;
  430                  end
  431              end
  432  
  433              // D. State Machine Command & Tracker Slot Execution
  434              case (state)
  435                  S_ARBITRATE: begin
  436                      if (!arq_disabled && retx_needed)       target_index <= retx_index;
  437                      else if (data_req_active && free_found) target_index <= free_index;
  438                  end
  439  
  440                  S_EXEC_RETX: begin
  441                      tx_txfn_out     <= track_txfn[target_index];
  442                      tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  443                      payload_mux_sel <= 2'b11;
  444                      tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  445                      ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b1;
  446                      ddr4_addr       <= {track_txfn[target_index][15:4], track_slot[target_index]};
  447  
  448                      track_retx[target_index]  <= track_retx[target_index] + 1'b1;
  449                      track_timer[target_index] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  450                  end
  451  
  452                  S_EXEC_MGMT: begin
  453                      tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  454                      tx_frame_type   <= 2'b10;
  455                      payload_mux_sel <= 2'b10;
  456                      tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  457                      mgmt_pending    <= 1'b0;
  458                      global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  459                  end
  460  
  461                  S_EXEC_DATA: begin
  462                      // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A07] Keep tx_txfn_out strictly sequential (global_txfn)
  463                      // while routing ddr4_addr[3:0] to conflict-free physical slot alloc_phys_slot
  464                      tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  465                      tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  466                      payload_mux_sel <= 2'b01;
  467                      tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  468                      ddr4_write_req  <= ~arq_disabled;
  469                      ddr4_addr       <= {global_txfn[15:4], alloc_phys_slot};
  470                      data_pending    <= 1'b0;
  471                      global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  472  
  473                      if (!arq_disabled && free_found) begin
  474                          track_valid[target_index] <= 1'b1;
  475                          track_txfn[target_index]  <= global_txfn;
  476                          track_timer[target_index] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  477                          track_retx[target_index]  <= 3'd0;
  478                          track_slot[target_index]  <= alloc_phys_slot;
  479                      end
  480                  end
  481  
  482                  S_EXEC_IDLE: begin
  483                      tx_txfn_out     <= global_txfn;
  484                      tx_frame_type   <= 2'b00;
  485                      payload_mux_sel <= 2'b00;
  486                      tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  487                      global_txfn     <= global_txfn + 1'b1;
  488                  end
  489              endcase
  490          end
  491      end
  492  
  493  endmodule
