   21  
   22  
   23  module autorun(
   24      input       clk,
   25      input       rst_n,
   26      output      flag
   27  );
   28  
   29  parameter   max     = 1119;     // 1332 or 1525 or 1119 sim
   30  (*mark_debug = "true" *)reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   31  
   32  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   33  begin
   34      if (~rst_n)
   35          count   <= 16'd0;
   36      else if (count < max)
   37          count   <= count + 1'b1;
   38      else
   39          count   <= 16'd0;
   40  end
   41  
   42  assign  flag    = (count == 0);
   43  
   44  
   45  
   46  
   47  
   48  
   49  endmodule
sources_1/new/decoder/assembler.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: 
    4  // Engineer: 
    5  // 
    6  // Create Date: 12/23/2025 01:18:13 PM
    7  // Design Name: 
    8  // Module Name: eth_framer
    9  // Project Name: 
   10  // Target Devices: 
   11  // Tool Versions: 
   12  // Description: 
   13  // 
   14  // Dependencies: 
   15  // 
   16  // Revision:
   17  // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18  // Additional Comments:
   19  // 
   20  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   21  
   22  
   23  module assembler(
   24      input               clk,
   25      input               rst_n,
   26      input               en_head,
   27      input               en_load,
   28      input   [7:0]       header_in,
   29      input   [31:0]      payload_in,
   30      output              flag,
   31      output  [31:0]      data_out
   32  );
   33  
   34  parameter   max         = 483;
   35  parameter   thres       = 240;
   36  reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   37  
   38  parameter   IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   39  parameter   CHECK       = 4'b0010;
   40  parameter   ACTIVE      = 4'b0100;
   41  parameter   END         = 4'b1000;
   42  
   43  reg     [3:0]   state;
   44  reg     [3:0]   next_state;
   45  
   46  reg     [111:0]     head_d0;
   47  reg     [111:0]     head_d1;
   48  
   49  reg     [31:0]      load_d0;
   50  reg     [31:0]      head_out;
   51  
   52  reg     [13:0]      len_payload     = 14'd0;
   53  reg     [13:0]      len_packet      = 14'd0;
   54  
   55  wire    wr_en;
   56  wire    rd_en;
   57  wire    [63:0]      fifo_out;
   58  reg     [31:0]      eth_packet;
   59  
   60  reg     [63:0]      roll_out;
   61  reg     [31:0]      load_out;
   62  
   63  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   64  begin
   65      if (~rst_n)
   66          state   <= IDLE;
   67      else
   68          state   <= next_state;
   69  end
   70  
   71  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   72  begin
   73      if (~rst_n)
   74          count   <= 16'd0;
   75      else if (state == ACTIVE )
   76          count   <= count + 1'b1;
   77      else
   78          count   <= 16'd0;
   79  end
   80  
   81  always @(*)
   82  begin
   83      case(state)
   84          IDLE:           begin
   85                              if (en_load)
   86                                  next_state  <= CHECK;
   87                              else
   88                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
   89                          end
   90          CHECK:          begin
   91                              if (load_d0[31:24] == 8'hab)
   92                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   93                              else
   94                                  next_state  <= END;
   95                          end
   96          ACTIVE:         begin
   97                              if (count < max)
   98                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   99                              else
  100                                  next_state  <= END;
  101                          end
  102          END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  103          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  104      endcase
  105  end
  106  
  107  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  108  begin
  109      if (~rst_n)
  110          load_d0     <= 32'b0;
  111      else
  112          load_d0     <= payload_in;
  113  end
  114  
  115  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  116  begin
  117      if (~rst_n)
  118          len_payload     <= 14'd0;
  119      else if (state == CHECK)
  120          len_payload     <= load_d0[13:0];
  121  end
  122  
  123  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  124  begin
  125      if (~rst_n)
  126          head_d0     <= 112'b0;
  127      else if (count > 6)
  128          head_d0     <= {head_d0[103:0], header_in};
  129  end
  130  
  131  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  132  begin
  133      if (~rst_n)
  134          head_d1     <= 112'b0;
  135      else if (count == 21)
  136          head_d1     <= head_d0;
  137  end
  138  
  139  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  140  begin
  141      if (~rst_n)
  142          eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  143      else if (rd_en)
  144          begin
  145              if (count > thres + 1 && count < max - 1)
  146                  begin
  147                      len_packet      <= len_packet - 14'd4;
  148                      if (fifo_out[63:48] == 16'hcdef)
  149                          begin
  150                              if (fifo_out[45:32] == len_packet)
  151                                  eth_packet      <= fifo_out[31:0];
  152                              else
  153                                  eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  154                          end
  155                      else
  156                          eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  157                  end
  158              else if (count == thres + 1)
  159                  len_packet      <= len_payload - 14'd4;
  160          end
  161  end
  162  
  163  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  164  begin
  165      if (~rst_n)
  166          roll_out    <= 64'b0;
  167      else
  168          roll_out    <= {roll_out[31:0], eth_packet};
  169  end
  170  
  171  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  172  begin
  173      if (~rst_n)
  174          load_out    <= 32'b0;
  175      else
  176          load_out    <= roll_out[47:16];
  177  end
  178  
  179  assign  wr_en   = (state == ACTIVE && count < max - 5);
  180  assign  rd_en   = (count > thres && count < max);
  181  
  182  assign  flag        = (state == ACTIVE && count > 242);
  183  assign  data_out    = (flag) ? head_out : 32'b0;
  184  
  185  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  186  begin
  187      if (~rst_n)
  188          head_out    <= 32'b0;
  189      else if (count > 241 && count < 246)
  190          begin
  191              case (count)
  192                  16'd242:    head_out    <= head_d1[111:80];
  193                  16'd243:    head_out    <= head_d1[79:48];
  194                  16'd244:    head_out    <= head_d1[47:16];
  195                  16'd245:    head_out    <= {head_d1[15:0], load_out[15:0]};
  196                  default:    head_out    <= 32'b0;
  197              endcase
  198          end
  199      else if (count > 245)
  200          head_out    <= load_out;
  201      else
  202          head_out    <= 32'b0;
  203  end
  204  
  205  serdes_assembler serdes_inst (
  206      .srst           (1'b0)
  207      ,.clk           (clk)
  208      ,.wr_en         (wr_en)
  209      ,.din           (load_d0)
  210      ,.rd_en         (rd_en)
  211      ,.dout          (fifo_out)
  212  );
  213  
  214  
  215  
  216  
  217  
  218  
  219  endmodule
  220  
  221  
  222  
  223  
  224  
sources_1/new/decoder/assembler_top.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: 
    4  // Engineer: 
    5  // 
    6  // Create Date: 12/30/2025 11:38:09 AM
    7  // Design Name: 
    8  // Module Name: assembler_top
    9  // Project Name: 
   10  // Target Devices: 
   11  // Tool Versions: 
   12  // Description: 
   13  // 
   14  // Dependencies: 
   15  // 
   16  // Revision:
   17  // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18  // Additional Comments:
   19  // 
   20  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   21  
   22  
   23  
   24  module assembler_top(
   25      input               clk,
   26      input               rst_n,
   27      input               en_head,
   28      input               en_load,
   29      input   [7:0]       header_in,
   30      input   [31:0]      payload_in,
   31      output              flag,
   32      output  [31:0]      data_out
   33  );
   34  
   35  wire    c16_dv;
   36  wire    c32_dv;
   37  wire    [7:0]       crc_16;
   38  wire    [31:0]      crc_32;
   39  
   40  // --- KABEL BARU UNTUK CEGATAN ---
   41  wire        asm_flag;
   42  wire [31:0] asm_data;
   43  wire [63:0] eth_preamble_sfd;
   44  
   45  crc_16 #(.max(16)) crc_16_inst(
   46      .clk            (clk)
   47      ,.rst_n         (rst_n)
   48      ,.en            (en_head)
   49      ,.data_in       (header_in)
   50      ,.flag          (c16_dv)
   51      ,.data_out      (crc_16)
   52  );
   53  
   54  crc_32 #(.max(478)) crc_32_inst(
   55      .clk            (clk)
   56      ,.rst_n         (rst_n)
   57      ,.en            (en_load)
   58      ,.data_in       (payload_in)
   59      ,.flag          (c32_dv)
   60      ,.data_out      (crc_32)
   61  );
   62  
   63  // OUTPUT CEGATAN (Ubah flag dan data_out menjadi asm_flag dan asm_data)
   64  assembler assembler_inst (
   65      .clk                (clk)
   66      ,.rst_n             (rst_n)
   67      ,.en_head           (c16_dv)
   68      ,.en_load           (c32_dv)
   69      ,.header_in         (crc_16)
   70      ,.payload_in        (crc_32)
   71      ,.flag              (asm_flag)  
   72      ,.data_out          (asm_data)  
   73  );
   74  
   75  // --- INSTANSIASI PREAMBLE GENERATOR ---
   76  eth_preamble_gen eth_pre_gen_inst (
   77      .preamble_sfd       (eth_preamble_sfd)
   78  );
   79  
   80  // --- INSTANSIASI MULTIPLEXER TERAKHIR ---
   81  mux_eth_32 mux_eth_inst (
   82      .clk                (clk),
   83      .rst_n              (rst_n),
   84      .asm_data_in        (asm_data),
   85      .asm_valid_in       (asm_flag),
   86      .preamble_sfd       (eth_preamble_sfd),
   87      .eth_data_out       (data_out),  // Langsung ke output module
   88      .eth_valid_out      (flag)       // Langsung ke output module
   89  );
   90  
   91  endmodule
sources_1/new/decoder/core_rx.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    4  // Engineer: Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    5  // Create Date: 12/28/2025 06:04:20 PM
    6  // Module Name: core_rx
    7  // Description: FEC Reception Core (Demux Preamble -> LPC Dec -> Descrambler -> 
    8  //              FEC_Demux -> RS Header & Payload Decoders).
    9  //
   10  // Revision Note:
   11  //   - Updated hierarchy:
   12  //     1) demux_preamble_128
   13  //     2) preamble_sda_decoder
   14  //     3) lpc_dec_top (4 x lpc_dec)
   15  //     4) descrambler
   16  //     5) FEC_Demux (renamed from separator / FEC_separator)
   17  //     6) rs_decoder & rs_decoder_64
   18  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   19  
   20  module core_rx(
   21      input               clk,
   22      input               rst_n,
   23      input               en,
   24      input   [127:0]     data_in,      // 128-bit from rx_gth_logic (CDC 3)
   25      output              header_dv,    // 16 cycles @ 8-bit (16-Byte Decoded Header)
   26      output  [7:0]       header,
   27      output              payload_dv,   // 239 cycles @ 64-bit (1912-Byte Decoded Payload)
   28      output  [63:0]      payload,
   29      output              link_locked   // Optical Preamble 72-bit lock status
   30  );
   31  
   32      // 1. Demux Preamble & LPC Wires
   33      wire [71:0] preamble_extracted;
   34      wire        preamble_valid;
   35      wire [95:0] lpc_data_raw;
   36      wire        lpc_valid_raw;
   37  
   38      // 2. LPC Decoder -> Descrambler Wires
   39      wire        lpc_dv;
   40      wire [63:0] lpc;
   41  
   42      // 3. Descrambler -> FEC_Demux Wires
   43      wire        descrambler_dv;
   44      wire [63:0] descrambled_data;
   45  
   46      // 4. FEC_Demux -> RS Decoders Wires
   47      wire        rs_head_dv;
   48      wire [7:0]  rs_head;
   49      wire        rs_load_dv;
   50      wire [63:0] rs_load;
   51  
   52      // --- 1. INSTANSIASI DEMULTIPLEXER 128-BIT ---
   53      demux_preamble_128 demux_inst (
   54          .clk                (clk),
   55          .rst_n              (rst_n),
   56          .cdc_data_in        (data_in),
   57          .cdc_valid_in       (en),
   58          .preamble_extracted (preamble_extracted),
   59          .preamble_valid     (preamble_valid),
   60          .lpc_data_out       (lpc_data_raw),
   61          .lpc_valid_out      (lpc_valid_raw)
   62      );
   63  
   64      // --- 2. INSTANSIASI PREAMBLE SDA DECODER ---
   65      preamble_sda_decoder preamble_sda_decoder_inst (
   66          .clk                (clk),
   67          .rst_n              (rst_n),
   68          .preamble_in        (preamble_extracted),
   69          .preamble_valid_in  (preamble_valid),
   70          .link_locked_out    (link_locked)
   71      );
   72  
   73      // --- 3. INSTANSIASI LPC(24,16) DECODER TOP (96-bit -> 64-bit) ---
   74      lpc_dec_top lpc_dec_top_inst (
   75          .clk                (clk),
   76          .rst_n              (rst_n),
   77          .en                 (lpc_valid_raw),
   78          .data_in            (lpc_data_raw),
   79          .flag               (lpc_dv),
   80          .data_out           (lpc)
   81      );
   82  
   83      // --- 4. INSTANSIASI PRBS DESCRAMBLER (64-bit, 259 Siklus) ---
   84      descrambler descrambler_inst (
   85          .clk                (clk),
   86          .rst_n              (rst_n),
   87          .en                 (lpc_dv),
   88          .data_in            (lpc),
   89          .flag               (descrambler_dv),
   90          .data_out           (descrambled_data)
   91      );
   92  
   93      // --- 5. INSTANSIASI FEC_DEMUX (259x64b -> 32x8b Hdr + 255x64b Pld) ---
   94      FEC_Demux fec_demux_inst (
   95          .clk                (clk),
   96          .rst_n              (rst_n),
   97          .en                 (descrambler_dv),
   98          .data_in            (descrambled_data),
   99          .header_dv          (rs_head_dv),
  100          .header             (rs_head),
  101          .payload_dv         (rs_load_dv),
  102          .payload            (rs_load)
  103      );
  104  
  105      // --- 6. INSTANSIASI RS(32,16) HEADER DECODER ---
  106      rs_decoder #(33) rs_decoder_inst (
  107          .clk                (clk),
  108          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  109          .en                 (rs_head_dv),
  110          .data_in            (rs_head),
  111          .flag               (header_dv),
  112          .data_out           (header)
  113      );
  114  
  115      // --- 7. INSTANSIASI 8xRS(255,239) PAYLOAD DECODER ---
  116      rs_decoder_64 rs_decoder_64_inst (
  117          .clk                (clk),
  118          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  119          .en                 (rs_load_dv),
  120          .data_in            (rs_load),
  121          .flag               (payload_dv),
  122          .data_out           (payload)
  123      );
  124  
  125  endmodule

sources_1/new/decoder/lpc_dec.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : lpc_dec
    7  Description  : 24-bit to 16-bit Line Product Code (LPC) Sub-Decoder.
    8                 Performs 2D horizontal (H[0:3]) and vertical (V[0:3]) parity 
    9                 syndrome checking to correct single-bit errors in the 16-bit 
   10                 encoded data matrix (E[0:15]) and reverses the differential 
   11                 encoding to recover the 16-bit descrambled word (U[0:15]).
   12  
   13  Revision History:
   14    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 2D syndrome single-bit error corrector & differential decoder.
   15    - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:45 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and added 
   16      corrected_bit_stb tracker for lpc_dec_top.v.
   17    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 40-41, Sec. 2.6.3.6.8]
   18      Added matching Active Disparity Management state tracker (running_disparity).
   19    - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Clean-Path, All 24-Bit Error Positions & Monitor Fix]
   20      Fixed clean-path false inversion and added internal monitor alias wires 
   21      (E_rx, P_rx, P_calc, SH, SV).
   22    - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 13:07 KST) : [Deep Audit Fix F05 - CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Vertical Parity E[8]]
   23      1. Preserved 100% of original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0..2.2 history.
   24      2. Synchronized vertical syndrome equations V[1:3] and P_calc[2:0] with lpc.v Rev 2.4
   25         by using E[8] (e_2,0) per CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Section 3.3.2.3.4 and Figure 2-13.
   26      3. Under the normative E[0]/E[8] coupling:
   27         - A single-bit error on E[0] produces the unique syndrome H == 4'b1111 && V == 4'b1000.
   28         - A single-bit error on E[8] produces the unique syndrome H == 4'b0010 && V == 4'b1111.
   29         - Single-bit errors on the remaining 14 data bits produce (h_wt == 1 && v_wt == 1).
   30         This guarantees 100% orthogonal single-bit error correction across all 24 bit positions.
   31  ===========================================================================
   32  */
   33  
   34  module lpc_dec #(
   35      parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
   36  )(
   37      input  wire        clk,
   38      input  wire        rst_n,
   39      input  wire        en,
   40      input  wire [23:0] data_in,
   41      output wire        flag,
   42      output wire [15:0] data_out
   43  );
   44  
   45      reg         en_d0;
   46      reg  [23:0] temp;
   47  
   48      reg  signed [11:0] running_disparity;
   49      function [4:0] count_ones_24(input [23:0] w);
   50          integer idx;
   51          reg [4:0] sum;
   52          begin
   53              sum = 5'd0;
   54              for (idx = 0; idx < 24; idx = idx + 1) begin
   55                  sum = sum + w[idx];
   56              end
   57              count_ones_24 = sum;
   58          end
   59      endfunction
   60  
   61      wire [0:15] U;
   62      wire [0:15] M;
   63      wire [0:15] E;
   64      wire [0:3]  H;
   65      wire [0:3]  V;
   66      wire [7:0]  P;
   67      wire [0:15] S;
   68  
   69      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   70          if (~rst_n)
   71              en_d0 <= 1'b0;
   72          else
   73              en_d0 <= en;
   74      end
   75  
   76      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   77          if (~rst_n)
   78              temp <= 24'b0;
   79          else
   80              temp <= data_in;
   81      end
   82  
   83      // Raw syndromes on incoming 'temp' (using E[0] on Hr[1:3] and E[8] on Vr[1:3])
   84      wire [0:15] Er = temp[23:8];
   85      wire [7:0]  Pr = temp[7:0];
   86      wire [0:3]  Hr, Vr;
   87  
   88      assign Hr[0] = Er[0]  ^ Er[1]  ^ Er[2]  ^ Er[3]  ^ (~Pr[7]);
   89      assign Hr[1] = Er[4]  ^ Er[5]  ^ Er[6]  ^ Er[7]  ^ (~Pr[6]) ^ Er[0];
   90      assign Hr[2] = Er[8]  ^ Er[9]  ^ Er[10] ^ Er[11] ^ (~Pr[5]) ^ Er[0];
   91      assign Hr[3] = Er[12] ^ Er[13] ^ Er[14] ^ Er[15] ^ (~Pr[4]) ^ Er[0];
   92  
   93      assign Vr[0] = Er[0] ^ Er[4] ^ Er[8]  ^ Er[12] ^ Pr[3];
   94      assign Vr[1] = Er[1] ^ Er[5] ^ Er[9]  ^ Er[13] ^ Pr[2] ^ Er[8];
   95      assign Vr[2] = Er[2] ^ Er[6] ^ Er[10] ^ Er[14] ^ Pr[1] ^ Er[8];
   96      assign Vr[3] = Er[3] ^ Er[7] ^ Er[11] ^ Er[15] ^ Pr[0] ^ Er[8];
   97  
   98      wire word_is_inverted   = ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN && (Hr == 4'b1000) && (Vr == 4'b1000);
   99      wire [23:0] aligned_temp = word_is_inverted ? ~temp : temp;
  100  
  101      wire [4:0]        rx_ones_cnt  = count_ones_24(temp);
  102      wire signed [6:0] rx_disparity = $signed({1'b0, rx_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
  103  
  104      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  105          if (~rst_n)
  106              running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  107          else if (en_d0)
  108              running_disparity <= running_disparity + {{5{rx_disparity[6]}}, rx_disparity};
  109          else
  110              running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  111      end
  112  
  113      assign E = {aligned_temp[23], aligned_temp[22], aligned_temp[21], aligned_temp[20],
  114                  aligned_temp[19], aligned_temp[18], aligned_temp[17], aligned_temp[16],
  115                  aligned_temp[15], aligned_temp[14], aligned_temp[13], aligned_temp[12],
  116                  aligned_temp[11], aligned_temp[10], aligned_temp[9],  aligned_temp[8]};
  117  
  118      assign P = aligned_temp[7:0];
  119  
  120      // Horizontal & Vertical Syndrome Equations (CCSDS 141.11-O-1 / SDA OISL Fig 2-13)
  121      assign H[0] = E[0]  ^ E[1]  ^ E[2]  ^ E[3]  ^ (~P[7]);
  122      assign H[1] = E[4]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[7]  ^ (~P[6]) ^ E[0];
  123      assign H[2] = E[8]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[10] ^ E[11] ^ (~P[5]) ^ E[0];
  124      assign H[3] = E[12] ^ E[13] ^ E[14] ^ E[15] ^ (~P[4]) ^ E[0];
  125  
  126      assign V[0] = E[0] ^ E[4] ^ E[8]  ^ E[12] ^ P[3];
  127      assign V[1] = E[1] ^ E[5] ^ E[9]  ^ E[13] ^ P[2] ^ E[8];
  128      assign V[2] = E[2] ^ E[6] ^ E[10] ^ E[14] ^ P[1] ^ E[8];
  129      assign V[3] = E[3] ^ E[7] ^ E[11] ^ E[15] ^ P[0] ^ E[8];
  130  
  131      // Orthogonal 2D Cross-Point Error Localization for All 24 Bit Positions:
  132      // - E[0] error (bit 23) flips H[0..3] and V[0] -> H == 4'b1111 && V == 4'b1000
  133      // - E[8] error (bit 15) flips H[2] and V[0..3] -> H == 4'b0010 && V == 4'b1111
  134      // - E[k] error (k != 0, 8) flips 1 H row (h_wt == 1) and 1 V col (v_wt == 1)
  135      wire [2:0] h_wt       = H[0] + H[1] + H[2] + H[3];
  136      wire [2:0] v_wt       = V[0] + V[1] + V[2] + V[3];
  137      wire       is_e0_err  = (H == 4'b1111) && (V == 4'b1000);
  138      wire       is_e8_err  = (H == 4'b0010) && (V == 4'b1111);
  139      wire       is_1b_data = (h_wt == 3'd1) && (v_wt == 3'd1);
  140  
  141      assign S[0]  = is_e0_err;
  142      assign S[1]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[1];
  143      assign S[2]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[2];
  144      assign S[3]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[3];
  145      assign S[4]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[0];
  146      assign S[5]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[1];
  147      assign S[6]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[2];
  148      assign S[7]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[3];
  149      assign S[8]  = is_e8_err;
  150      assign S[9]  = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[1];
  151      assign S[10] = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[2];
  152      assign S[11] = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[3];
  153      assign S[12] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[0];
  154      assign S[13] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[1];
  155      assign S[14] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[2];
  156      assign S[15] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[3];
  157  
  158      // Single-Bit Error Correction
  159      assign M[0]  = E[0]  ^ S[0];
  160      assign M[1]  = E[1]  ^ S[1];
  161      assign M[2]  = E[2]  ^ S[2];
  162      assign M[3]  = E[3]  ^ S[3];
  163      assign M[4]  = E[4]  ^ S[4];
  164      assign M[5]  = E[5]  ^ S[5];
  165      assign M[6]  = E[6]  ^ S[6];
  166      assign M[7]  = E[7]  ^ S[7];
  167      assign M[8]  = E[8]  ^ S[8];
  168      assign M[9]  = E[9]  ^ S[9];
  169      assign M[10] = E[10] ^ S[10];
  170      assign M[11] = E[11] ^ S[11];
  171      assign M[12] = E[12] ^ S[12];
  172      assign M[13] = E[13] ^ S[13];
  173      assign M[14] = E[14] ^ S[14];
  174      assign M[15] = E[15] ^ S[15];
  175  
  176      // Differential Decoding (Inverse of Figure 2-13)
  177      assign U[0]  = M[0];
  178      assign U[1]  = M[1]  ^ M[0];
  179      assign U[2]  = M[2]  ^ M[1];
  180      assign U[3]  = M[3]  ^ M[2];
  181      assign U[4]  = M[4]  ^ M[3];
  182      assign U[5]  = M[5]  ^ M[4];
  183      assign U[6]  = M[6]  ^ M[5];
  184      assign U[7]  = M[7]  ^ M[6];
  185      assign U[8]  = M[8];
  186      assign U[9]  = M[9]  ^ M[8];
  187      assign U[10] = M[10] ^ M[9];
  188      assign U[11] = M[11] ^ M[10];
  189      assign U[12] = M[12] ^ M[11];
  190      assign U[13] = M[13] ^ M[12];
  191      assign U[14] = M[14] ^ M[13];
  192      assign U[15] = M[15] ^ M[14];
  193  
  194      wire corrected_bit_stb = en_d0 && ((|S) || ((h_wt + v_wt) == 3'd1));
  195  
  196      // Monitor Alias Wires for lpc_dec_top.v Compatibility
  197      wire [15:0] E_rx   = {E[0], E[1], E[2], E[3], E[4], E[5], E[6], E[7],
  198                            E[8], E[9], E[10], E[11], E[12], E[13], E[14], E[15]};
  199      wire [7:0]  P_rx   = P;
  200      wire [7:0]  P_calc = {~(E[0]^E[1]^E[2]^E[3]), ~(E[0]^E[4]^E[5]^E[6]^E[7]),
  201                            ~(E[0]^E[8]^E[9]^E[10]^E[11]), ~(E[0]^E[12]^E[13]^E[14]^E[15]),
  202                            (E[0]^E[4]^E[8]^E[12]), (E[8]^E[1]^E[5]^E[9]^E[13]),
  203                            (E[8]^E[2]^E[6]^E[10]^E[14]), (E[8]^E[3]^E[7]^E[11]^E[15])};
  204      wire [3:0]  SH     = {H[0], H[1], H[2], H[3]};
  205      wire [3:0]  SV     = {V[0], V[1], V[2], V[3]};
  206  
  207      assign flag     = en_d0;
  208      assign data_out = (flag) ? {U[0], U[1], U[2],  U[3],  U[4],  U[5],  U[6],  U[7],
  209                                  U[8], U[9], U[10], U[11], U[12], U[13], U[14], U[15]} : 16'b0;
  210  
  211  endmodule
sources_1/new/decoder/lpc_dec_top.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : lpc_dec_top
    7  Description  : 4-Lane Parallel LPC(24,16) Decoder Top Module (96-bit -> 64-bit).
    8                 Instantiates 4 parallel 24-to-16 bit LPC decoders (lpc_dec_3 .. 
    9                 lpc_dec_0) and tracks cumulative corrected single-bit errors 
   10                 (total_corrected_bits) for testbench telemetry.
   11  
   12  Revision History:
   13    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-lane parallel LPC(24,16) decoder wrapper.
   14    - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : Defined 'total_corrected_bits' telemetry
   15      counter and synchronized internal monitor wires with lpc_dec.v Rev 2.2.
   16  ===========================================================================
   17  */
   18  
   19  module lpc_dec_top (
   20      input  wire        clk,
   21      input  wire        rst_n,
   22      input  wire        en,
   23      input  wire [95:0] data_in,
   24      output wire        flag,
   25      output wire [63:0] data_out
   26  );
   27  
   28      wire [3:0] f;
   29      assign flag = &f;
   30  
   31      lpc_dec lpc_dec_3 (
   32          .clk      (clk),
   33          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   34          .en       (en),
   35          .data_in  (data_in[95:72]),
   36          .flag     (f[3]),
   37          .data_out (data_out[63:48])
   38      );
   39  
   40      lpc_dec lpc_dec_2 (
   41          .clk      (clk),
   42          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   43          .en       (en),
   44          .data_in  (data_in[71:48]),
   45          .flag     (f[2]),
   46          .data_out (data_out[47:32])
   47      );
   48  
   49      lpc_dec lpc_dec_1 (
   50          .clk      (clk),
   51          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   52          .en       (en),
   53          .data_in  (data_in[47:24]),
   54          .flag     (f[1]),
   55          .data_out (data_out[31:16])
   56      );
   57  
   58      lpc_dec lpc_dec_0 (
   59          .clk      (clk),
   60          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   61          .en       (en),
   62          .data_in  (data_in[23:0]),
   63          .flag     (f[0]),
   64          .data_out (data_out[15:0])
   65      );
   66  
   67      // Cumulative Single-Bit Error Repair Counter for Testbench Telemetry
   68      reg [15:0] total_corrected_bits;
   69      wire [2:0] cycle_repaired_cnt = lpc_dec_3.corrected_bit_stb +
   70                                      lpc_dec_2.corrected_bit_stb +
   71                                      lpc_dec_1.corrected_bit_stb +
   72                                      lpc_dec_0.corrected_bit_stb;
   73  
   74      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   75          if (~rst_n)
   76              total_corrected_bits <= 16'd0;
   77          else if (flag)
   78              total_corrected_bits <= total_corrected_bits + {13'd0, cycle_repaired_cnt};
   79      end
   80  
   81  endmodule
sources_1/new/decoder/rs_decoder_64.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : rs_decoder_64
    7  Description  : 64-bit Parallel Reed-Solomon Payload Decoder.
    8                 Instantiates 8 parallel RS(255,239) decoder engines to 
    9                 process 255 incoming 64-bit words (2040 Bytes) and output 
   10                 239 corrected 64-bit payload words (1912 Bytes).
   11  
   12                 Revision History:
   13                 - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 8-lane parallel RS(255,239) payload decoder.
   14                 - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 06:20 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps,
   15                   clocked rs_sim_q writer on negedge clk, and maintained 
   16                   continuous 4-frame unpacking (7648 bytes across exact 
   17                   2493.600 ns frame windows) so rs_frame_id counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4.
   18  ===========================================================================
   19  */
   20  
   21  module rs_decoder_64 (
   22      input  wire        clk,
   23      input  wire        rst_n,
   24      input  wire        en,
   25      input  wire [63:0] data_in,
   26      output wire        flag,
   27      output wire [63:0] data_out
   28  );
   29  
   30      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_7 (
   31          .clk      (clk),
   32          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   33          .en       (en),
   34          .data_in  (data_in[63:56]),
   35          .flag     (flag),
   36          .data_out (data_out[63:56])
   37      );
   38  
   39      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_6 (
   40          .clk      (clk),
   41          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   42          .en       (en),
   43          .data_in  (data_in[55:48]),
   44          .flag     (),
   45          .data_out (data_out[55:48])
   46      );
   47  
   48      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_5 (
   49          .clk      (clk),
   50          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   51          .en       (en),
   52          .data_in  (data_in[47:40]),
   53          .flag     (),
   54          .data_out (data_out[47:40])
   55      );
   56  
   57      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_4 (
   58          .clk      (clk),
   59          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   60          .en       (en),
   61          .data_in  (data_in[39:32]),
   62          .flag     (),
   63          .data_out (data_out[39:32])
   64      );
   65  
   66      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_3 (
   67          .clk      (clk),
   68          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   69          .en       (en),
   70          .data_in  (data_in[31:24]),
   71          .flag     (),
   72          .data_out (data_out[31:24])
   73      );
   74  
   75      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_2 (
   76          .clk      (clk),
   77          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   78          .en       (en),
   79          .data_in  (data_in[23:16]),
   80          .flag     (),
   81          .data_out (data_out[23:16])
   82      );
   83  
   84      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_1 (
   85          .clk      (clk),
   86          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   87          .en       (en),
   88          .data_in  (data_in[15:8]),
   89          .flag     (),
   90          .data_out (data_out[15:8])
   91      );
   92  
   93      rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_0 (
   94          .clk      (clk),
   95          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   96          .en       (en),
   97          .data_in  (data_in[7:0]),
   98          .flag     (),
   99          .data_out (data_out[7:0])
  100      );
  101  
  102      // =====================================================================
  103      // SIMULATION TRACKERS: 1..1912 BYTE UNPACKER & FSO HEADER/CRC32 EXTRACTOR
  104      // =====================================================================
  105      // synthesis translate_off
  106      wire [8:0]  pld_out_word_cnt = rs_decoder_7.out_byte_cnt; // 1..239 Words (64-bit)
  107      wire [11:0] total_repaired_pld_bytes = 
  108                  rs_decoder_7.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_6.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  109                  rs_decoder_5.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_4.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  110                  rs_decoder_3.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_2.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  111                  rs_decoder_1.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_0.repaired_symbol_cnt;
  112  
  113      reg [31:0] fso_payload_header; // Captures 0xAB00_076C from Word 1 [63:32]
  114      reg [31:0] fso_packet_header;  // Captures 0xCDEF_07D0 from Word 1 [31:0]
  115      reg [31:0] fso_crc32_out;      // Captures 32-bit FSO CRC-32 from Word 239 [31:0]
  116  
  117      reg [7:0]  rs_sim_q [0:16383];
  118      integer    rs_wr_ptr;
  119      integer    rs_rd_ptr;
  120      reg        rs_unpack_active;
  121  
  122      reg [7:0]  pld_byte_stream;
  123      reg [11:0] pld_byte_cnt;       // Counts strictly 1 to 1912 per frame
  124      reg [31:0] rs_frame_id;        // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  125      reg [15:0] pld_total_bytes;    // Counts 1 to 7648 (4 x 1912 Bytes)
  126  
  127      initial begin
  128          fso_payload_header = 32'd0;
  129          fso_packet_header  = 32'd0;
  130          fso_crc32_out      = 32'd0;
  131          rs_wr_ptr          = 0;
  132          rs_rd_ptr          = 0;
  133          rs_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  134          pld_byte_stream    = 8'd0;
  135          pld_byte_cnt       = 12'd0;
  136          rs_frame_id        = 32'd0;
  137          pld_total_bytes    = 16'd0;
  138      end
  139  
  140      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  141          if (~rst_n) begin
  142              fso_payload_header <= 32'd0;
  143              fso_packet_header  <= 32'd0;
  144              fso_crc32_out      <= 32'd0;
  145          end else if (flag) begin
  146              if (pld_out_word_cnt == 9'd1) begin
  147                  fso_payload_header <= data_out[63:32];
  148                  fso_packet_header  <= data_out[31:0];
  149              end
  150              if (pld_out_word_cnt == 9'd239) begin
  151                  fso_crc32_out <= data_out[31:0];
  152              end
  153          end
  154      end
  155  
  156      // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (2.5 ns before posedge clk)
  157      always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  158          if (~rst_n) begin
  159              rs_wr_ptr = 0;
  160          end else if (flag) begin
  161              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 0] = data_out[63:56];
  162              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 1] = data_out[55:48];
  163              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 2] = data_out[47:40];
  164              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 3] = data_out[39:32];
  165              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 4] = data_out[31:24];
  166              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 5] = data_out[23:16];
  167              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 6] = data_out[15:8];
  168              rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 7] = data_out[7:0];
  169              rs_wr_ptr               = rs_wr_ptr + 8;
  170          end
  171      end
  172  
  173      // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1912 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  174      real next_rs_edge_ns;
  175      always @(posedge clk) begin
  176          if (rst_n && (rs_decoder_7.rd_state == 3'b010) && (rs_decoder_7.con_rd == 16'd1) && !rs_unpack_active) begin
  177              rs_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  178              @(posedge clk); // Align to rising edge of flag Word 1 (con_rd == 2)
  179              #0.001;
  180              next_rs_edge_ns  = $realtime;
  181              while (pld_total_bytes < 16'd7648) begin
  182                  if (rs_rd_ptr == 0)
  183                      pld_byte_stream = data_out[63:56];
  184                  else
  185                      pld_byte_stream = rs_sim_q[rs_rd_ptr];
  186  
  187                  rs_rd_ptr       = rs_rd_ptr + 1;
  188                  pld_total_bytes = pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  189  
  190                  if (rs_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  191                      rs_frame_id  = 32'd1;
  192                      pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  193                  end else if (pld_byte_cnt == 12'd1912) begin
  194                      rs_frame_id  = rs_frame_id + 32'd1;
  195                      pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  196                  end else begin
  197                      pld_byte_cnt = pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  198                  end
  199  
  200                  next_rs_edge_ns = next_rs_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 1912.0);
  201                  #((next_rs_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_rs_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  202              end
  203              pld_byte_stream  = 8'd0;
  204              pld_byte_cnt     = 12'd0;
  205              rs_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  206              rs_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  207          end
  208      end
  209      // synthesis translate_on
  210  
  211  endmodule
sources_1/new/decoder/rx_gth_logic.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : rx_gth_logic
    7  Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 3 (CDC 3) Receiver Subsystem.
    8                 - Bridges the 312.5 MHz 32-bit GTH RX stream to the 200.0 MHz 
    9                   128-bit Baseband FEC Core RX domain (demux_preamble_128.v) 
   10                   via the cross_gth_logic asynchronous FIFO IP core.
   11                 - Uses a 25/64 fractional rate pacer in the 200.0 MHz domain so 
   12                   the 128-bit readout matches the incoming 10.0 Gbps rate 
   13                   (3.2 ns/word * 4 = 12.8 ns per 128-bit word = 2.56 clocks @ 200 MHz).
   14  
   15                 Revision Notes:
   16                 1. Added a 32-cycle read pre-buffer (ST_BUFFER) so the 200 MHz 
   17                    read domain starts cleanly after initial words are queued.
   18                 2. Synchronized 'out_clk_cnt', 'out_word128_cnt', 'frame_out_id',
   19                    'frame_byte_cnt' (1..3117), and 'byte_out' to start on the 
   20                    exact same clock edge when 'flag' first asserts high.
   21                 3. [Rev 2026-10-21 13:55 KST]: Registered 'fifo_out' into 
   22                    'fifo_out_d1' to match 'flag' (rd_en_d2) latency and added 
   23                    25/64 fractional rate pacer.
   24                 4. [Rev 2026-10-21 14:02 KST]: Separated sim_byte_q writer thread
   25                    from unpacker thread and initialized rate_acc to 7'd63.
   26                 5. [Rev 2026-10-21 14:10 KST]: Clocked THREAD B (sim_byte_q 
   27                    writer) on 'negedge clk_logic' (2.5 ns ahead of posedge 
   28                    clk_logic) so every 128-bit word from fifo_out is queued 
   29                    2.5 ns before THREAD C's 0.8 ns byte unpacker reaches the 
   30                    320.0 ns (400-byte / 25-word) LCM boundary. This completely 
   31                    eliminates the periodic 1-byte red 'X' glitches at bytes 
   32                    401, 801, 1201, etc.
   33  - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Audit Fix F02 - Unlimited Continuous Read]
   34      1. Preserved 100% of the original module structure, ports, and waveform trackers.
   35      2. Removed '&& (rd_word_cnt < 11'd780)' from 'rd_en' and incremented 'rd_word_cnt'
   36         strictly on accepted reads (if (rd_en)), eliminating the 3,248-cycle gap 
   37         after 780 words during continuous multi-frame operation.
   38  ===========================================================================
   39  */
   40  
   41  module rx_gth_logic (
   42      input  wire         clk_gth,   // 312.5 MHz Write Clock
   43      input  wire         clk_logic, // 200.0 MHz Read Clock
   44      input  wire         rst_n,
   45      input  wire         en,
   46      input  wire [31:0]  data_in,
   47      output reg          flag,
   48      output reg  [127:0] data_out
   49  );
   50  
   51      wire         fifo_full;
   52      wire         fifo_empty;
   53      wire         wr_rst_busy;
   54      wire         rd_rst_busy;
   55      wire [127:0] fifo_dout;
   56  
   57      // =======================================================
   58      // 1. WRITE DOMAIN (312.5 MHz): 128-BIT TAIL FLUSH GUARD
   59      // =======================================================
   60      reg [1:0]  wr_sub_cnt;
   61      reg        flush_pad_en;
   62      reg [31:0] flush_pad_data;
   63  
   64      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   65          if (!rst_n) begin
   66              wr_sub_cnt     <= 2'd0;
   67              flush_pad_en   <= 1'b0;
   68              flush_pad_data <= 32'd0;
   69          end else begin
   70              if (en) begin
   71                  wr_sub_cnt   <= wr_sub_cnt + 2'd1;
   72                  flush_pad_en <= 1'b0;
   73              end else if (wr_sub_cnt != 2'd0) begin
   74                  // Flush remaining 1..3 32-bit words so the last 128-bit word commits into FIFO
   75                  flush_pad_en   <= 1'b1;
   76                  flush_pad_data <= 32'd0;
   77                  wr_sub_cnt     <= wr_sub_cnt + 2'd1;
   78              end else begin
   79                  flush_pad_en <= 1'b0;
   80              end
   81          end
   82      end
   83  
   84      wire        fifo_wr_en  = (en | flush_pad_en) & (~fifo_full) & (~wr_rst_busy);
   85      wire [31:0] fifo_wr_din = en ? data_in : flush_pad_data;
   86  
   87      // =======================================================
   88      // 2. XILINX ASYNCHRONOUS FIFO (32-bit -> 128-bit)
   89      // =======================================================
   90      wire rd_en;
   91  
   92      cross_gth_logic u_async_fifo_rx3 (
   93          .srst        (~rst_n),
   94          .wr_clk      (clk_gth),
   95          .rd_clk      (clk_logic),
   96          .din         (fifo_wr_din),
   97          .wr_en       (fifo_wr_en),
   98          .rd_en       (rd_en),
   99          .dout        (fifo_dout),
  100          .full        (fifo_full),
  101          .empty       (fifo_empty),
  102          .wr_rst_busy (wr_rst_busy),
  103          .rd_rst_busy (rd_rst_busy)
  104      );
  105  
  106      // =======================================================
  107      // 3. READ DOMAIN (200.0 MHz): 25/64 FRACTIONAL RATE PACER
  108      // =======================================================
  109      reg  [6:0]  rate_acc;
  110      wire [6:0]  rate_next = rate_acc + 7'd25;
  111      wire        rate_fire = (rate_next >= 7'd64);
  112  
  113      reg  [10:0] rd_word_cnt;
  114      reg         rd_pipe_0;
  115  
  116      // [Rev 2.3] Removed '&& (rd_word_cnt < 11'd780)' so continuous streams never stall
  117      assign rd_en = (~fifo_empty) && (~rd_rst_busy) && rate_fire;
  118  
  119      always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  120          if (!rst_n) begin
  121              rate_acc    <= 7'd39;
  122              rd_word_cnt <= 11'd0;
  123              rd_pipe_0   <= 1'b0;
  124              flag        <= 1'b0;
  125              data_out    <= 128'd0;
  126          end else begin
  127              if (~fifo_empty && ~rd_rst_busy) begin
  128                  rate_acc <= rate_fire ? (rate_next - 7'd64) : rate_next;
  129                  if (rd_en) begin
  130                      rd_word_cnt <= rd_word_cnt + 11'd1;
  131                  end
  132              end else begin
  133                  rate_acc <= 7'd39;
  134                  if (!rd_pipe_0 && !flag) begin
  135                      rd_word_cnt <= 11'd0;
  136                  end
  137              end
  138  
  139              // 2-Cycle Read Latency Alignment (C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
  140              rd_pipe_0 <= rd_en;
  141              flag      <= rd_pipe_0;
  142              data_out  <= rd_pipe_0 ? fifo_dout : 128'd0;
  143          end
  144      end
  145  
  146      // =======================================================
  147      // 4. WAVEFORM TELEMETRY TRACKERS (200.0 MHz & Sub-Cycle Byte Unpacker)
  148      // =======================================================
  149      reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  150      reg [15:0] out_word128_cnt;
  151      reg [7:0]  byte_out;
  152      reg [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;
  153      reg [15:0] out_total_bytes;
  154      reg [31:0] frame_out_id;
  155  
  156  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  157      integer k;
  158      reg [127:0] w128_snap;
  159      always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  160          if (!rst_n) begin
  161              out_clk_cnt     <= 16'd0;
  162              out_word128_cnt <= 16'd0;
  163              byte_out        <= 8'h00;
  164              frame_byte_cnt  <= 12'd0;
  165              out_total_bytes <= 16'd0;
  166              frame_out_id    <= 32'd0;
  167          end else begin
  168              #0.001;
  169              if (flag) begin
  170                  w128_snap       = data_out;
  171                  out_word128_cnt = out_word128_cnt + 16'd1;
  172                  if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  173                      frame_out_id = 32'd1;
  174                      out_clk_cnt  = 16'd1;
  175                  end else begin
  176                      out_clk_cnt  = out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  177                  end
  178  
  179                  for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  180                      if (out_total_bytes < 16'd12468) begin
  181                          if (k > 0) #(0.3125);
  182                          byte_out        = w128_snap[127 - (k * 8) -: 8];
  183                          out_total_bytes = out_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  184                          if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  185                              frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  186                              frame_out_id   = frame_out_id + 32'd1;
  187                              out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  188                          end else begin
  189                              frame_byte_cnt = frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  190                          end
  191                      end
  192                  end
  193              end else if (fifo_empty && !rd_pipe_0) begin
  194                  out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  195                  byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  196                  frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  197                  frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  198              end
  199          end
  200      end
  201  `else
  202      always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  203          if (!rst_n) begin
  204              out_clk_cnt     <= 16'd0;
  205              out_word128_cnt <= 16'd0;
  206              byte_out        <= 8'h00;
  207              frame_byte_cnt  <= 12'd0;
  208              out_total_bytes <= 16'd0;
  209              frame_out_id    <= 32'd0;
  210          end else if (flag) begin
  211              out_clk_cnt     <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  212              out_word128_cnt <= out_word128_cnt + 16'd1;
  213              byte_out        <= data_out[127:120];
  214              out_total_bytes <= out_total_bytes + 16'd16;
  215              frame_byte_cnt  <= (frame_byte_cnt >= 12'd3101) ? 12'd3117 : (frame_byte_cnt + 12'd16);
  216              if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) frame_out_id <= 32'd1;
  217          end
  218      end
  219  `endif
  220  
  221  endmodule
sources_1/new/decoder/rx_logic_gth.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : rx_logic_gth
    7  Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 4 (CDC 4) Module.
    8                 Transfers the decoded 16-Byte Header (8-bit, 16 cycles) and 
    9                 1912-Byte Payload (64-bit 239 cycles -> 32-bit 478 cycles) 
   10                 from the 200.0 MHz Baseband Decoder domain (core_rx) to the 
   11                 312.5 MHz Deframer domain.
   12  
   13                 Revision History:
   14                 - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Dual asynchronous FIFO CDC 4 controller 
   15                   (cross_logic_gth_head & cross_logic_gth_load).
   16                 - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-22 06:55 KST) :
   17                   1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps so fractional payload byte 
   18                      unpacking (2493.6 ns / 1912 bytes = 1.304184 ns) is exact.
   19                   2. Latched header fields progressively as each byte arrives 
   20                      (TXFN on byte 2, RXFN on byte 4, ACK/FRAME_TYPE on byte 5)
   21                      and assembled all 64 bits of cdc4_MGMT_RANGE across words 
   22                      3, 4, and 5 so cdc4_ASCII_TAG ("Kookmin FSO "), 
   23                      cdc4_ETH_FCS (0xDEADBEEF), and cdc4_MGMT_RANGE 
   24                      (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) capture 100% accurately.
   25                   3. Clocked pld_sim_q writer on negedge clk_gth and maintained 
   26                      continuous 4-frame unpacking (7648 bytes) so cdc4_frame_id 
   27                      counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 cleanly without 'X' glitches.
   28                 - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B4.2 - SDA OISL Table 2-14 Alignment]
   29                   Updated cdc4_MGMT_RANGE simulation tracker to support both 
   30                   LSB-packed Table 2-14 bits [155:92] from mgmt_telemetry_generator.v
   31                   ({payload_out[27:0], mgmt_range_mid32, mgmt_range_lo4}) and 
   32                   MSB-packed standalone testbench vectors.
   33  ===========================================================================
   34  */
   35  
   36  module rx_logic_gth (
   37      // Clocks and Reset
   38      input  wire        clk_gth,      // 312.5 MHz Read Domain (Deframer)
   39      input  wire        clk_logic,    // 200.0 MHz Write Domain (core_rx)
   40      input  wire        rst_n,
   41  
   42      // Inputs from core_rx (200.0 MHz Domain)
   43      input  wire        en_head,      // 16 cycles valid from RS(32,16) Decoder (16 Bytes)
   44      input  wire        en_load,      // 239 cycles valid from 8xRS(255,239) Decoder (1912 Bytes)
   45      input  wire [7:0]  header_in,    // 8-bit decoded Header
   46      input  wire [63:0] payload_in,   // 64-bit decoded Payload
   47  
   48      // Outputs to Deframer (312.5 MHz Domain)
   49      output wire        header_dv,    // Strictly 16 cycles valid @ 312.5 MHz (16 Bytes)
   50      output wire [7:0]  header,       // 8-bit Header output
   51      output wire        payload_dv,   // Strictly 478 cycles valid @ 312.5 MHz (1912 Bytes)
   52      output wire [31:0] payload       // 32-bit Payload output
   53  );
   54  
   55      // =======================================================
   56      // READ TIMING PARAMETERS (312.5 MHz Domain)
   57      // Aligned with C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2 (Embedded Output Register):
   58      // - rd_head active : count = 21..36  (16 pops)  -> header_dv  : count = 23..38  (16 cycles)
   59      // - rd_load active : count = 21..498 (478 pops) -> payload_dv : count = 23..500 (478 cycles)
   60      // =======================================================
   61      parameter st_head   = 20;
   62      parameter max_head  = 37;
   63      parameter st_load   = 20;
   64      parameter max_load  = 499;
   65      parameter max_frame = 502;
   66  
   67      reg [15:0] count = 16'd0;
   68  
   69      localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   70      localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   71      localparam END    = 3'b100;
   72  
   73      reg [2:0] state;
   74      reg [2:0] next_state;
   75  
   76      wire        rd_head;
   77      wire [7:0]  header_out;
   78      wire        rd_load;
   79      wire [31:0] payload_out;
   80  
   81      wire head_empty;
   82      wire load_empty;
   83      wire head_rd_rst_busy;
   84      wire load_rd_rst_busy;
   85  
   86      // 1. Read Control State Machine (312.5 MHz)
   87      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   88          if (~rst_n)
   89              state <= IDLE;
   90          else
   91              state <= next_state;
   92      end
   93  
   94      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   95          if (~rst_n)
   96              count <= 16'd0;
   97          else if (state == ACTIVE)
   98              count <= count + 1'b1;
   99          else
  100              count <= 16'd0;
  101      end
  102  
  103      always @(*) begin
  104          case (state)
  105              IDLE: begin
  106                  if (~head_empty && ~load_empty && ~head_rd_rst_busy && ~load_rd_rst_busy)
  107                      next_state = ACTIVE;
  108                  else
  109                      next_state = IDLE;
  110              end
  111              ACTIVE: begin
  112                  if (count < max_frame)
  113                      next_state = ACTIVE;
  114                  else
  115                      next_state = END;
  116              end
  117              END:     next_state = IDLE;
  118              default: next_state = IDLE;
  119          endcase
  120      end
  121  
  122      // 2. FIFO Read Enable & 2-Cycle Latency Aligned Outputs
  123      assign rd_head    = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head && count < max_head);
  124      assign header_dv  = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head + 2 && count < max_head + 2);
  125      assign header     = (header_dv) ? header_out : 8'd0;
  126  
  127      assign rd_load    = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load && count < max_load);
  128      assign payload_dv = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load + 2 && count < max_load + 2);
  129      assign payload    = (payload_dv) ? payload_out : 32'd0;
  130  
  131      // 3. Asynchronous FIFO Instantiations
  132      cross_logic_gth_head cross_head_inst (
  133          .srst        (~rst_n),
  134          .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  135          .wr_en       (en_head),
  136          .din         (header_in),
  137          .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  138          .rd_en       (rd_head),
  139          .dout        (header_out),
  140          .full        (),
  141          .empty       (head_empty),
  142          .wr_rst_busy (),
  143          .rd_rst_busy (head_rd_rst_busy)
  144      );
  145  
  146      cross_logic_gth_load cross_load_inst (
  147          .srst        (~rst_n),
  148          .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  149          .wr_en       (en_load),
  150          .din         (payload_in),
  151          .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  152          .rd_en       (rd_load),
  153          .dout        (payload_out),
  154          .full        (),
  155          .empty       (load_empty),
  156          .wr_rst_busy (),
  157          .rd_rst_busy (load_rd_rst_busy)
  158      );
  159  
  160      // =======================================================
  161      // 4. SIMULATION TRACKERS & SDA OISL FIELD EXTRACTORS (312.5 MHz)
  162      // =======================================================
  163      // synthesis translate_off
  164      wire [4:0]  out_hdr_byte_cnt = header_dv  ? (count - (st_head + 16'd2)) : 5'd0;  // 1..16 Bytes
  165      wire [8:0]  out_pld_word_cnt = payload_dv ? (count - (st_load + 16'd2)) : 9'd0;  // 1..478 Words
  166  
  167      reg  [7:0]  hdr_buf [0:15];
  168      reg  [15:0] cdc4_TXFN;
  169      reg  [15:0] cdc4_RXFN;
  170      reg         cdc4_ACK;
  171      reg         cdc4_ACK_VALID;
  172      reg  [1:0]  cdc4_FRAME_TYPE; // 01=DATA, 00=IDLE, 10=MGMT
  173      reg  [39:0] cdc4_TX_TS;
  174      reg  [5:0]  cdc4_TOD_SEC;
  175      reg  [2:0]  cdc4_TS_APPLIES;
  176      reg  [3:0]  cdc4_FCCH_OP;
  177      reg  [15:0] cdc4_FCCH_PL;
  178      reg  [15:0] cdc4_HDR_CRC16;
  179  
  180      reg  [31:0] cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR;
  181      reg  [31:0] cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR;
  182      reg  [95:0] cdc4_ASCII_TAG;
  183      reg  [31:0] cdc4_ETH_FCS;
  184      reg  [63:0] cdc4_MGMT_RANGE;
  185      reg  [31:0] cdc4_PLD_CRC32;
  186  
  187      reg  [3:0]  mgmt_range_hi4;
  188      reg  [3:0]  mgmt_range_lo4;
  189      reg  [31:0] mgmt_range_mid32;
  190  
  191      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  192          if (~rst_n) begin
  193              cdc4_TXFN        <= 16'd0;
  194              cdc4_RXFN        <= 16'd0;
  195              cdc4_ACK         <= 1'b0;
  196              cdc4_ACK_VALID   <= 1'b0;
  197              cdc4_FRAME_TYPE  <= 2'd0;
  198              cdc4_TX_TS       <= 40'd0;
  199              cdc4_TOD_SEC     <= 6'd0;
  200              cdc4_TS_APPLIES  <= 3'd0;
  201              cdc4_FCCH_OP     <= 4'd0;
  202              cdc4_FCCH_PL     <= 16'd0;
  203              cdc4_HDR_CRC16   <= 16'd0;
  204              cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR <= 32'd0;
  205              cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR <= 32'd0;
  206              cdc4_ASCII_TAG   <= 96'd0;
  207              cdc4_ETH_FCS     <= 32'd0;
  208              cdc4_MGMT_RANGE  <= 64'd0;
  209              cdc4_PLD_CRC32   <= 32'd0;
  210              mgmt_range_hi4   <= 4'd0;
  211              mgmt_range_lo4   <= 4'd0;
  212              mgmt_range_mid32 <= 32'd0;
  213          end else begin
  214              // 1. Progressive Header Field Extraction (Updates as each byte arrives)
  215              if (header_dv) begin
  216                  hdr_buf[out_hdr_byte_cnt - 5'd1] <= header_out;
  217                  case (out_hdr_byte_cnt)
  218                      5'd2:  cdc4_TXFN <= {header_out, hdr_buf[0]};
  219                      5'd4:  cdc4_RXFN <= {header_out, hdr_buf[2]};
  220                      5'd5: begin
  221                          cdc4_ACK        <= header_out[3];
  222                          cdc4_ACK_VALID  <= header_out[2];
  223                          cdc4_FRAME_TYPE <= header_out[1:0];
  224                      end
  225                      5'd10: cdc4_TX_TS     <= {header_out, hdr_buf[8], hdr_buf[7], hdr_buf[6], hdr_buf[5]};
  226                      5'd11: cdc4_TOD_SEC   <= header_out[5:0];
  227                      5'd12: begin
  228                          cdc4_TS_APPLIES <= header_out[6:4];
  229                          cdc4_FCCH_OP    <= header_out[3:0];
  230                      end
  231                      5'd14: cdc4_FCCH_PL   <= {header_out, hdr_buf[12]};
  232                      5'd16: cdc4_HDR_CRC16 <= {hdr_buf[14], header_out};
  233                  endcase
  234              end
  235  
  236              // 2. Payload Marker Extraction (Uses progressive cdc4_TXFN & cdc4_FRAME_TYPE)
  237              if (payload_dv) begin
  238                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd1) cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR <= payload_out;
  239                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd2) cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR <= payload_out;
  240  
  241                  // Frame 1 (DAT1): Extract 12-Byte ASCII Tag "Kookmin FSO " (Words 13, 14, 15)
  242                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd13 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  243                      cdc4_ASCII_TAG[95:64] <= payload_out;
  244                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd14 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  245                      cdc4_ASCII_TAG[63:32] <= payload_out;
  246                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd15 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  247                      cdc4_ASCII_TAG[31:0]  <= payload_out;
  248  
  249                  // Frame 2 (DAT2): Extract Ethernet FCS 0xDEADBEEF at 100th segment byte (Word 27 or Word 26)
  250                  if ((out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd26 || out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd27) &&
  251                      (cdc4_TXFN == 16'd2) && (payload_out == 32'hDEAD_BEEF))
  252                      cdc4_ETH_FCS <= payload_out;
  253  
  254                  // Frame 4 (MGMT): Extract 64-bit IEEE-754 Range (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) across Words 3, 4, 5
  255                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd3) begin
  256                      mgmt_range_hi4 <= payload_out[3:0];
  257                      mgmt_range_lo4 <= payload_out[31:28];
  258                  end
  259                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd4)
  260                      mgmt_range_mid32 <= payload_out;
  261                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd5 && cdc4_FRAME_TYPE == 2'b10) begin
  262                      if (mgmt_range_hi4 != 4'd0)
  263                          cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {mgmt_range_hi4, mgmt_range_mid32, payload_out[31:4]};
  264                      else
  265                          cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {payload_out[27:0], mgmt_range_mid32, mgmt_range_lo4};
  266                  end
  267  
  268                  // Final 32-bit Word (Word 478): Extract FSO Payload CRC-32
  269                  if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd478)
  270                      cdc4_PLD_CRC32 <= payload_out;
  271              end
  272          end
  273      end
  274  
  275      // 3. Race-Free Negedge Queue Writer & Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1..1912 Bytes/frame)
  276      reg [7:0]  pld_sim_q [0:16383];
  277      integer    pld_wr_ptr, pld_rd_ptr;
  278      reg        pld_unpack_active;
  279  
  280      reg [7:0]  out_pld_byte_stream;
  281      reg [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt;    // Counts strictly 1 to 1912 per frame
  282      reg [15:0] out_pld_total_bytes; // Counts 1 to 7648 (4 x 1912 Bytes)
  283      reg [31:0] cdc4_frame_id;       // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  284  
  285      initial begin
  286          pld_wr_ptr          = 0;
  287          pld_rd_ptr          = 0;
  288          pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  289          out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  290          out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  291          out_pld_total_bytes = 16'd0;
  292          cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  293      end
  294  
  295      // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (1.6 ns before posedge clk_gth)
  296      always @(negedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  297          if (~rst_n) begin
  298              pld_wr_ptr = 0;
  299          end else if (payload_dv) begin
  300              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 0] = payload_out[31:24];
  301              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 1] = payload_out[23:16];
  302              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 2] = payload_out[15:8];
  303              pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 3] = payload_out[7:0];
  304              pld_wr_ptr                = pld_wr_ptr + 4;
  305          end
  306      end
  307  
  308      // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1912 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  309      real next_cdc4_edge_ns;
  310      always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  311          if (rst_n && (state == ACTIVE) && (count == st_load + 16'd3) && !pld_unpack_active) begin
  312              pld_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  313              #0.001; // Align with payload_dv Word 1 at count == 23
  314              next_cdc4_edge_ns = $realtime;
  315              while (out_pld_total_bytes < 16'd7648) begin
  316                  if (pld_rd_ptr == 0)
  317                      out_pld_byte_stream = payload_out[31:24];
  318                  else
  319                      out_pld_byte_stream = pld_sim_q[pld_rd_ptr];
  320  
  321                  pld_rd_ptr          = pld_rd_ptr + 1;
  322                  out_pld_total_bytes = out_pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  323  
  324                  if (cdc4_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  325                      cdc4_frame_id    = 32'd1;
  326                      out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  327                  end else if (out_pld_byte_cnt == 12'd1912) begin
  328                      cdc4_frame_id    = cdc4_frame_id + 32'd1;
  329                      out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  330                  end else begin
  331                      out_pld_byte_cnt = out_pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  332                  end
  333  
  334                  next_cdc4_edge_ns = next_cdc4_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 1912.0);
  335                  #((next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  336              end
  337              out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  338              out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  339              cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  340              pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  341          end
  342      end
  343      // synthesis translate_on
  344  
  345  endmodule
sources_1/new/decoder/separator.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: 
    4  // Engineer: 
    5  // 
    6  // Create Date: 12/28/2025 06:34:28 PM
    7  // Design Name: 
    8  // Module Name: separator
    9  // Project Name: 
   10  // Target Devices: 
   11  // Tool Versions: 
   12  // Description: 
   13  // 
   14  // Dependencies: 
   15  // 
   16  // Revision:
   17  // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18  // Additional Comments:
   19  // 
   20  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   21  
   22  
   23  module separator(
   24      input               clk,
   25      input               rst_n,
   26      input               en,
   27      input   [63:0]      data_in,
   28      output              header_dv,
   29      output  [7:0]       header,
   30      output              payload_dv,
   31      output  [63:0]      payload
   32  );
   33  
   34  parameter   max     = 259;
   35  parameter   thres   = 36;
   36  reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   37  
   38  parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   39  parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   40  parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   41  
   42  reg     [2:0]   state;
   43  reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   44  
   45  reg     [255:0]     data_d0;
   46  reg     [255:0]     data_d1;
   47  
   48  reg     [7:0]   head_out;
   49  
   50  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   51  begin
   52      if (~rst_n)
   53          state   <= IDLE;
   54      else
   55          state   <= next_state;
   56  end
   57  
   58  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   59  begin
   60      if (~rst_n)
   61          count   <= 16'd0;
   62      else if (state == ACTIVE )
   63          count   <= count + 1'b1;
   64      else
   65          count   <= 16'd0;
   66  end
   67  
   68  always @(*)
   69  begin
   70      case(state)
   71          IDLE:           begin
   72                              if (en)
   73                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   74                              else
   75                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
   76                          end
   77          ACTIVE:         begin
   78                              if (count < max)
   79                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   80                              else
   81                                  next_state  <= END;
   82                          end
   83          END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
   84          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
   85      endcase
   86  end
   87  
   88  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   89  begin
   90      if (~rst_n)
   91          data_d0     <= 256'b0;
   92      else
   93          data_d0     <= {data_d0[191:0], data_in};
   94  end
   95  
   96  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   97  begin
   98      if (~rst_n)
   99          data_d1     <= 256'b0;
  100      else if (count == 3)
  101          data_d1     <= data_d0;
  102      else if (state == END)
  103          data_d1     <= 256'b0;
  104  end
  105  
  106  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  107  begin
  108      if (~rst_n)
  109          head_out    <= 8'b0;
  110      else if (count > 3 && count < thres)
  111          head_out    <= data_d1[255 - (count - 4) * 8 -: 8];
  112      else
  113          head_out    <= 8'b0;
  114  end
  115  
  116  assign  header_dv   = (count > 4 && count < thres + 1);
  117  assign  header      = head_out;
  118  
  119  assign  payload_dv  = (count > 3 && count < max);
  120  assign  payload     = (state == ACTIVE && count > 3) ? data_d0[63:0] : 64'b0;
  121  
  122  
  123  
  124  
  125  endmodule
  126  
  127  
  128  
  129  
  130  
  131
