sources_1/new/deframer.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : deframer
    7  Description  : Sub-Top Deframer Module.
    8                 Connects the 4 core pillars of the FSO Deframer:
    9                 1. deframer_header    (CRC-16 Check & Header Parser)
   10                 2. deframer_payload   (CRC-32 Check & Store-and-Verify FIFO)
   11                 3. arq_rx_controller  (Control Plane: Selective Repeat ARQ)
   12                 4. frame_demultiplexer(Data Plane: IDLE, MGMT & DATA Reorder)
   13  
   14                 Revision History:
   15                 - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-pillar FSO Deframer sub-top integration.
   16                 - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:01 KST) :
   17                   1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps for project-wide consistency.
   18                   2. Added combinational bypass on hdr_check_done for ingress 
   19                      context (ing_hdr_ok, ing_txfn, ing_ftype) so u_arq_rx_controller 
   20                      and u_deframer_payload see the new frame's TXFN and FRAME_TYPE 
   21                      on the exact cycle hdr_check_done asserts (zero 1-cycle lag).
   22                   3. Added dedicated egress context registers (egr_txfn, egr_ftype) 
   23                      latched on pld_check_done so u_frame_demultiplexer retains 
   24                      the draining frame's metadata across all 477 words even if 
   25                      the next frame's header arrives early.
   26  ===========================================================================
   27  */
   28  
   29  module deframer (
   30      input  wire        clk,
   31      input  wire        rst_n,
   32  
   33      // Inputs from CDC 4 (rx_logic_gth @ 312.5 MHz)
   34      input  wire        header_dv,
   35      input  wire [7:0]  header_in,
   36      input  wire        payload_dv,
   37      input  wire [31:0] payload_in,
   38  
   39      // In-Order 1908-Byte DATA Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
   40      output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
   41      output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
   42      output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
   43      input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready,
   44  
   45      // ARQ Feedback Outputs (To Local TX Encoder / ARQ TX Controller)
   46      output wire [15:0] local_fb_rxfn,
   47      output wire        local_fb_ack,
   48      output wire        local_fb_ack_valid,
   49      output wire [15:0] peer_rxfn_out,
   50      output wire        peer_ack_out,
   51      output wire        peer_ack_valid_out,
   52  
   53      // Extracted Header & MGMT Telemetry Outputs
   54      output wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   55      output wire        pld_crc_ok,
   56      output wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   57      output wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   58      output wire [39:0] rx_tx_ts,
   59      output wire [3:0]  rx_fcch_op,
   60      output wire [15:0] rx_fcch_pl,
   61      output wire [63:0] mgmt_range_meters,
   62      output wire        mgmt_telemetry_valid,
   63      output wire [15:0] expected_txfn
   64  );
   65  
   66      wire        hdr_check_done;
   67      wire [15:0] rx_rxfn;
   68      wire        rx_ack;
   69      wire        rx_ack_valid;
   70      wire [5:0]  rx_tod_sec;
   71      wire [2:0]  rx_ts_applies;
   72      wire [15:0] rx_hdr_crc16;
   73  
   74      wire        pld_check_done;
   75      wire [31:0] verified_pld_tdata;
   76      wire        verified_pld_tvalid;
   77      wire        verified_pld_tlast;
   78  
   79      wire        non_data_seq_adv;
   80      wire [15:0] non_data_txfn;
   81  
   82      // 1. Ingress Header Context (Valid from hdr_check_done through pld_check_done)
   83      reg         latched_hdr_ok;
   84      reg  [15:0] latched_txfn;
   85      reg  [1:0]  latched_ftype;
   86  
   87      // 2. Egress Drain Context (Valid across the 477-word verified_pld_tvalid drain)
   88      reg  [15:0] egr_txfn;
   89      reg  [1:0]  egr_ftype;
   90  
   91      wire        active_ing_hdr_ok = hdr_check_done ? hdr_crc_ok    : latched_hdr_ok;
   92      wire [15:0] active_ing_txfn   = hdr_check_done ? rx_txfn       : latched_txfn;
   93      wire [1:0]  active_ing_ftype  = hdr_check_done ? rx_frame_type : latched_ftype;
   94  
   95      wire [15:0] active_egr_txfn   = pld_check_done ? active_ing_txfn  : egr_txfn;
   96      wire [1:0]  active_egr_ftype  = pld_check_done ? active_ing_ftype : egr_ftype;
   97  
   98      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   99          if (!rst_n) begin
  100              latched_hdr_ok <= 1'b0;
  101              latched_txfn   <= 16'd0;
  102              latched_ftype  <= 2'd0;
  103              egr_txfn       <= 16'd0;
  104              egr_ftype      <= 2'd0;
  105          end else begin
  106              if (hdr_check_done) begin
  107                  latched_hdr_ok <= hdr_crc_ok;
  108                  latched_txfn   <= rx_txfn;
  109                  latched_ftype  <= rx_frame_type;
  110              end
  111              if (pld_check_done) begin
  112                  egr_txfn  <= active_ing_txfn;
  113                  egr_ftype <= active_ing_ftype;
  114              end
  115          end
  116      end
  117  
  118      // 1. Header Deframer
  119      deframer_header u_deframer_header (
  120          .clk            (clk),
  121          .rst_n          (rst_n),
  122          .header_dv      (header_dv),
  123          .header_in      (header_in),
  124          .hdr_check_done (hdr_check_done),
  125          .hdr_crc_ok     (hdr_crc_ok),
  126          .rx_txfn        (rx_txfn),
  127          .rx_rxfn        (rx_rxfn),
  128          .rx_ack         (rx_ack),
  129          .rx_ack_valid   (rx_ack_valid),
  130          .rx_frame_type  (rx_frame_type),
  131          .rx_tx_ts       (rx_tx_ts),
  132          .rx_tod_sec     (rx_tod_sec),
  133          .rx_ts_applies  (rx_ts_applies),
  134          .rx_fcch_op     (rx_fcch_op),
  135          .rx_fcch_pl     (rx_fcch_pl),
  136          .rx_hdr_crc16   (rx_hdr_crc16)
  137      );
  138  
  139      // 2. Payload Deframer
  140      deframer_payload u_deframer_payload (
  141          .clk               (clk),
  142          .rst_n             (rst_n),
  143          .payload_dv        (payload_dv),
  144          .payload_in        (payload_in),
  145          .hdr_crc_ok        (active_ing_hdr_ok),
  146          .rx_txfn           (active_ing_txfn),
  147          .pld_check_done    (pld_check_done),
  148          .pld_crc_ok        (pld_crc_ok),
  149          .m_axis_pld_tdata  (verified_pld_tdata),
  150          .m_axis_pld_tvalid (verified_pld_tvalid),
  151          .m_axis_pld_tlast  (verified_pld_tlast)
  152      );
  153  
  154      // 3. Control Plane: Selective Repeat ARQ RX Controller
  155      arq_rx_controller u_arq_rx_controller (
  156          .clk                (clk),
  157          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  158          .hdr_check_done     (hdr_check_done),
  159          .hdr_crc_ok         (hdr_crc_ok),
  160          .rx_txfn            (active_ing_txfn),
  161          .rx_rxfn            (rx_rxfn),
  162          .rx_ack             (rx_ack),
  163          .rx_ack_valid       (rx_ack_valid),
  164          .rx_frame_type      (active_ing_ftype),
  165          .pld_check_done     (pld_check_done),
  166          .pld_crc_ok         (pld_crc_ok),
  167          .peer_rxfn_out      (peer_rxfn_out),
  168          .peer_ack_out       (peer_ack_out),
  169          .peer_ack_valid_out (peer_ack_valid_out),
  170          .local_fb_rxfn      (local_fb_rxfn),
  171          .local_fb_ack       (local_fb_ack),
  172          .local_fb_ack_valid (local_fb_ack_valid),
  173          .non_data_seq_adv   (non_data_seq_adv),
  174          .non_data_txfn      (non_data_txfn),
  175          .ack_sent_cnt       (),
  176          .nak_sent_cnt       ()
  177      );
  178  
  179      // 4. Data Plane: Frame Demultiplexer & Selective Repeat Reorder Buffer
  180      frame_demultiplexer u_frame_demultiplexer (
  181          .clk                    (clk),
  182          .rst_n                  (rst_n),
  183          .s_axis_pld_tdata       (verified_pld_tdata),
  184          .s_axis_pld_tvalid      (verified_pld_tvalid),
  185          .s_axis_pld_tlast       (verified_pld_tlast),
  186          .rx_frame_type          (active_egr_ftype),
  187          .rx_txfn                (active_egr_txfn),
  188          .non_data_seq_adv       (non_data_seq_adv),
  189          .non_data_txfn          (non_data_txfn),
  190          .m_axis_data_tdata      (m_axis_fso_tdata),
  191          .m_axis_data_tvalid     (m_axis_fso_tvalid),
  192          .m_axis_data_tlast      (m_axis_fso_tlast),
  193          .m_axis_data_tready     (m_axis_fso_tready),
  194          .mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec     (),
  195          .mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec (),
  196          .mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec     (),
  197          .mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec (),
  198          .mgmt_range_meters      (mgmt_range_meters),
  199          .mgmt_range_ts_sec      (),
  200          .mgmt_range_ts_picosec  (),
  201          .mgmt_ts_valid          (),
  202          .mgmt_telemetry_valid   (mgmt_telemetry_valid),
  203          .expected_txfn          (expected_txfn),
  204          .idle_frame_cnt         (),
  205          .mgmt_frame_cnt         ()
  206      );
  207  
  208  endmodule
sources_1/new/deframer_header.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : deframer_header
    7  Description  : Header Deframer Sub-Top Module.
    8                 Integrates fso_crc_16_checker and header_parser to validate 
    9                 and unpack the 16-Byte SDA OISL Header at 312.5 MHz.
   10  ===========================================================================
   11  */
   12  
   13  module deframer_header (
   14      input  wire        clk,
   15      input  wire        rst_n,
   16      input  wire        header_dv,
   17      input  wire [7:0]  header_in,
   18  
   19      output wire        hdr_check_done,
   20      output wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   21      output wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   22      output wire [15:0] rx_rxfn,
   23      output wire        rx_ack,
   24      output wire        rx_ack_valid,
   25      output wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   26      output wire [39:0] rx_tx_ts,
   27      output wire [5:0]  rx_tod_sec,
   28      output wire [2:0]  rx_ts_applies,
   29      output wire [3:0]  rx_fcch_op,
   30      output wire [15:0] rx_fcch_pl,
   31      output wire [15:0] rx_hdr_crc16
   32  );
   33  
   34      fso_crc_16_checker u_crc16_checker (
   35          .clk            (clk),
   36          .rst_n          (rst_n),
   37          .en             (header_dv),
   38          .data_in        (header_in),
   39          .hdr_check_done (hdr_check_done),
   40          .hdr_crc_ok     (hdr_crc_ok),
   41          .calculated_crc (),
   42          .received_crc   ()
   43      );
   44  
   45      header_parser u_header_parser (
   46          .clk              (clk),
   47          .rst_n            (rst_n),
   48          .en               (header_dv),
   49          .data_in          (header_in),
   50          .rx_txfn          (rx_txfn),
   51          .rx_rxfn          (rx_rxfn),
   52          .rx_ack           (rx_ack),
   53          .rx_ack_valid     (rx_ack_valid),
   54          .rx_frame_type    (rx_frame_type),
   55          .rx_tx_ts         (rx_tx_ts),
   56          .rx_tod_sec       (rx_tod_sec),
   57          .rx_ts_applies    (rx_ts_applies),
   58          .rx_fcch_op       (rx_fcch_op),
   59          .rx_fcch_pl       (rx_fcch_pl),
   60          .rx_hdr_crc16     (rx_hdr_crc16),
   61          .hdr_parsed_valid ()
   62      );
   63  
   64  endmodule
sources_1/new/deframer_payload.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : deframer_payload
    7  Description  : Payload Deframer Sub-Top Module.
    8                 Wraps fso_crc_32_checker to validate the 1912-Byte Payload, 
    9                 strip the 4-Byte CRC-32 trailer, and forward the 1908-Byte 
   10                 verified payload to the Frame Demultiplexer.
   11  ===========================================================================
   12  */
   13  
   14  module deframer_payload (
   15      input  wire        clk,
   16      input  wire        rst_n,
   17      input  wire        payload_dv,
   18      input  wire [31:0] payload_in,
   19      input  wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   20      input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   21  
   22      output wire        pld_check_done,
   23      output wire        pld_crc_ok,
   24      output wire [31:0] m_axis_pld_tdata,
   25      output wire        m_axis_pld_tvalid,
   26      output wire        m_axis_pld_tlast
   27  );
   28  
   29      fso_crc_32_checker u_crc32_checker (
   30          .clk               (clk),
   31          .rst_n             (rst_n),
   32          .payload_dv        (payload_dv),
   33          .payload_in        (payload_in),
   34          .hdr_crc_ok        (hdr_crc_ok),
   35          .rx_txfn           (rx_txfn),
   36          .pld_check_done    (pld_check_done),
   37          .pld_crc_ok        (pld_crc_ok),
   38          .calculated_crc32  (),
   39          .received_crc32    (),
   40          .m_axis_pld_tdata  (m_axis_pld_tdata),
   41          .m_axis_pld_tvalid (m_axis_pld_tvalid),
   42          .m_axis_pld_tlast  (m_axis_pld_tlast)
   43      );
   44  
   45  endmodule
sources_1/new/demux_preamble_128.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : demux_preamble_128
    7  Description  : 128-bit Receiver Frame Synchronization & Preamble Demultiplexer.
    8                 - Receives paced 128-bit words from CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic.v) at 
    9                   200.0 MHz (195 words = 3117 Bytes per frame).
   10                 - Buffers incoming words in a synchronous queue (in_queue) up to 
   11                   a safe pre-fill threshold (1600 Bytes) so that all 259 LPC 
   12                   words (96-bit / 12 Bytes each = 3108 Bytes) are emitted in a 
   13                   100% contiguous, gap-free burst required by lpc_dec_top and 
   14                   descrambler.
   15                 - Extracts the 72-bit (9-Byte) optical Preamble at the start of 
   16                   every 3117-Byte frame and outputs it on preamble_extracted 
   17                   with a 1-cycle preamble_valid pulse.
   18  
   19  Revision History:
   20    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-bit to 72-bit Preamble + 96-bit LPC demultiplexer.
   21    - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:25 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps, added 
   22      ST_WAIT_FRAME pre-buffering (total_avail_bytes >= 1600) to guarantee 
   23      259-cycle contiguous lpc_valid_out bursts, and added 4-frame continuous 
   24      simulation unpackers (demux_frame_id 1..4, lpc_byte_cnt 1..3108).
   25    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.1 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   26      Added official SDA OISL 72-bit Preamble constant STD_PREAMBLE_OISL = 
   27      72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26 verification alongside legacy marker 
   28      72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5 so both updated full-loopback and standalone 
   29      testbenches lock cleanly on Byte 1..9 of every 3117-Byte frame.
   30  ===========================================================================
   31  */
   32  
   33  module demux_preamble_128 (
   34      input  wire         clk,
   35      input  wire         rst_n,
   36  
   37      // Upstream Interface from CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic @ 200 MHz)
   38      input  wire [127:0] cdc_data_in,
   39      input  wire         cdc_valid_in,
   40  
   41      // Extracted 72-bit Preamble Output to preamble_sda_decoder
   42      output reg  [71:0]  preamble_extracted,
   43      output reg          preamble_valid,
   44  
   45      // Extracted 96-bit LPC Codeword Stream Output to lpc_dec_top (259 cycles/frame)
   46      output reg  [95:0]  lpc_data_out,
   47      output reg          lpc_valid_out
   48  );
   49  
   50      // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-8 Standard Preamble & Legacy Sim Marker
   51      localparam [71:0] STD_PREAMBLE_OISL   = 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26;
   52      localparam [71:0] LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE = 72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   53  
   54      // =======================================================
   55      // 1. INGRESS 128-BIT SYNCHRONOUS QUEUE (512 x 128-bit)
   56      // =======================================================
   57      (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [127:0] in_queue [0:511];
   58      reg  [8:0]  q_wr_ptr;
   59      reg  [8:0]  q_rd_ptr;
   60      reg  [9:0]  q_word_cnt;
   61  
   62      // 384-bit MSB-aligned Byte Barrel Shifter
   63      reg  [383:0] shift_buf;
   64      reg  [5:0]   buf_bytes;
   65  
   66      // FSM States
   67      localparam ST_WAIT_FRAME = 2'd0;
   68      localparam ST_PREAMBLE   = 2'd1;
   69      localparam ST_LPC_BURST  = 2'd2;
   70      localparam ST_INTER_GAP  = 2'd3;
   71  
   72      reg  [1:0]  state;
   73      reg  [8:0]  lpc_word_idx; // 0..258 (259 LPC words = 3108 Bytes)
   74      reg  [4:0]  gap_cnt;
   75  
   76      wire [14:0] total_avail_bytes = ({5'd0, q_word_cnt} << 4) + {9'd0, buf_bytes};
   77  
   78      // Pop from queue whenever barrel shifter has room for a 16-Byte (128-bit) word
   79      wire [5:0]  bytes_consumed_now = (state == ST_PREAMBLE)  ? 6'd9  :
   80                                       (state == ST_LPC_BURST) ? 6'd12 : 6'd0;
   81      wire [5:0]  rem_bytes_after_op = buf_bytes - bytes_consumed_now;
   82      wire        q_pop              = (q_word_cnt > 10'd0) && (rem_bytes_after_op <= 6'd32);
   83      wire [127:0] q_head_word       = in_queue[q_rd_ptr];
   84  
   85      wire [383:0] shifted_after_consume = (state == ST_PREAMBLE)  ? (shift_buf << 72) :
   86                                           (state == ST_LPC_BURST) ? (shift_buf << 96) : shift_buf;
   87      wire [383:0] next_word_aligned     = {q_head_word, 256'd0} >> (rem_bytes_after_op * 8);
   88  
   89      // Purely Synchronous Queue RAM Write
   90      always @(posedge clk) begin
   91          if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   92              in_queue[q_wr_ptr] <= cdc_data_in;
   93          end
   94      end
   95  
   96      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   97          if (!rst_n) begin
   98              q_wr_ptr           <= 9'd0;
   99              q_rd_ptr           <= 9'd0;
  100              q_word_cnt         <= 10'd0;
  101              shift_buf          <= 384'd0;
  102              buf_bytes          <= 6'd0;
  103              state              <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  104              lpc_word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  105              gap_cnt            <= 5'd0;
  106              preamble_extracted <= 72'd0;
  107              preamble_valid     <= 1'b0;
  108              lpc_data_out       <= 96'd0;
  109              lpc_valid_out      <= 1'b0;
  110          end else begin
  111              preamble_valid <= 1'b0;
  112              lpc_valid_out  <= 1'b0;
  113  
  114              // 1. Queue Write & Read Pointer Management
  115              if (cdc_valid_in) begin
  116                  q_wr_ptr <= q_wr_ptr + 9'd1;
  117              end
  118              if (q_pop) begin
  119                  q_rd_ptr <= q_rd_ptr + 9'd1;
  120              end
  121              case ({cdc_valid_in, q_pop})
  122                  2'b10:   q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt + 10'd1;
  123                  2'b01:   q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt - 10'd1;
  124                  default: q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt;
  125              endcase
  126  
  127              // 2. Barrel Shifter Update
  128              if (q_pop) begin
  129                  shift_buf <= shifted_after_consume | next_word_aligned;
  130                  buf_bytes <= rem_bytes_after_op + 6'd16;
  131              end else begin
  132                  shift_buf <= shifted_after_consume;
  133                  buf_bytes <= rem_bytes_after_op;
  134              end
  135  
  136              // 3. Frame Synchronization & Contiguous 259-Cycle LPC Burst FSM
  137              case (state)
  138                  ST_WAIT_FRAME: begin
  139                      lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  140                      gap_cnt      <= 5'd0;
  141                      // Wait until >= 1600 Bytes are buffered so all 259 LPC words 
  142                      // (3108 Bytes) drain in a 100% gap-free burst
  143                      if ((total_avail_bytes >= 15'd1600) && (buf_bytes >= 6'd9)) begin
  144                          state <= ST_PREAMBLE;
  145                      end
  146                  end
  147  
  148                  ST_PREAMBLE: begin
  149                      // Extract 9-Byte (72-bit) Preamble at MSB [383:312]
  150                      preamble_extracted <= shift_buf[383:312];
  151                      preamble_valid     <= 1'b1;
  152                      lpc_word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  153                      state              <= ST_LPC_BURST;
  154                  end
  155  
  156                  ST_LPC_BURST: begin
  157                      // Emit 259 consecutive 96-bit (12-Byte) LPC words (3108 Bytes)
  158                      lpc_data_out  <= shift_buf[383:288];
  159                      lpc_valid_out <= 1'b1;
  160  
  161                      if (lpc_word_idx == 9'd258) begin
  162                          lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  163                          gap_cnt      <= 5'd0;
  164                          state        <= ST_INTER_GAP;
  165                      end else begin
  166                          lpc_word_idx <= lpc_word_idx + 9'd1;
  167                      end
  168                  end
  169  
  170                  ST_INTER_GAP: begin
  171                      if (gap_cnt < 5'd15) begin
  172                          gap_cnt <= gap_cnt + 5'd1;
  173                      end else begin
  174                          gap_cnt <= 5'd0;
  175                          state   <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  176                      end
  177                  end
  178  
  179                  default: state <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  180              endcase
  181          end
  182      end
  183  
  184      // =======================================================
  185      // 2. SIMULATION TRACKERS (For tb_demux_preamble_128.v)
  186      // =======================================================
  187      // synthesis translate_off
  188      wire preamble_is_sda_oisl = preamble_valid &&
  189                                  ((preamble_extracted == STD_PREAMBLE_OISL) ||
  190                                   (preamble_extracted == LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE));
  191  
  192      reg [8:0]  out_lpc_word_cnt; // 1..259 per frame
  193      reg [11:0] out_lpc_byte_cnt; // 12..3108 per frame
  194      reg [7:0]  lpc_sim_q [0:16383];
  195      integer    lpc_wr_ptr;
  196      integer    lpc_rd_ptr;
  197      reg        lpc_unpack_active;
  198  
  199      reg [7:0]  lpc_byte_stream;
  200      reg [11:0] lpc_byte_idx;     // 1..3108 per frame
  201      reg [31:0] demux_frame_id;   // 1, 2, 3, 4
  202      reg [15:0] lpc_total_bytes;  // 1..12432 (4 x 3108 Bytes)
  203  
  204      initial begin
  205          out_lpc_word_cnt  = 9'd0;
  206          out_lpc_byte_cnt  = 12'd0;
  207          lpc_wr_ptr        = 0;
  208          lpc_rd_ptr        = 0;
  209          lpc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  210          lpc_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  211          lpc_byte_idx      = 12'd0;
  212          demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  213          lpc_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  214      end
  215  
  216      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  217          if (!rst_n) begin
  218              out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  219              out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  220          end else if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  221              if (out_lpc_word_cnt == 9'd259) begin
  222                  out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd1;
  223                  out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd12;
  224              end else begin
  225                  out_lpc_word_cnt <= out_lpc_word_cnt + 9'd1;
  226                  out_lpc_byte_cnt <= out_lpc_byte_cnt + 12'd12;
  227              end
  228          end else begin
  229              out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  230              out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  231          end
  232      end
  233  
  234      always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  235          if (!rst_n) begin
  236              lpc_wr_ptr = 0;
  237          end else if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  238              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 0]  = lpc_data_out[95:88];
  239              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 1]  = lpc_data_out[87:80];
  240              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 2]  = lpc_data_out[79:72];
  241              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 3]  = lpc_data_out[71:64];
  242              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 4]  = lpc_data_out[63:56];
  243              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 5]  = lpc_data_out[55:48];
  244              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 6]  = lpc_data_out[47:40];
  245              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 7]  = lpc_data_out[39:32];
  246              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 8]  = lpc_data_out[31:24];
  247              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 9]  = lpc_data_out[23:16];
  248              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 10] = lpc_data_out[15:8];
  249              lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 11] = lpc_data_out[7:0];
  250              lpc_wr_ptr                 = lpc_wr_ptr + 12;
  251          end
  252      end
  253  
  254      real next_lpc_edge_ns;
  255      always @(posedge clk) begin
  256          if (rst_n && preamble_valid && !lpc_unpack_active) begin
  257              lpc_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  258              @(posedge clk);
  259              #0.001;
  260              next_lpc_edge_ns = $realtime;
  261              while (lpc_total_bytes < 16'd12432) begin
  262                  if (lpc_rd_ptr == 0)
  263                      lpc_byte_stream = lpc_data_out[95:88];
  264                  else
  265                      lpc_byte_stream = lpc_sim_q[lpc_rd_ptr];
  266  
  267                  lpc_rd_ptr      = lpc_rd_ptr + 1;
  268                  lpc_total_bytes = lpc_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  269  
  270                  if (demux_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  271                      demux_frame_id = 32'd1;
  272                      lpc_byte_idx   = 12'd1;
  273                  end else if (lpc_byte_idx == 12'd3108) begin
  274                      demux_frame_id = demux_frame_id + 32'd1;
  275                      lpc_byte_idx   = 12'd1;
  276                  end else begin
  277                      lpc_byte_idx   = lpc_byte_idx + 12'd1;
  278                  end
  279  
  280                  next_lpc_edge_ns = next_lpc_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 3108.0);
  281                  #((next_lpc_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_lpc_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  282              end
  283              lpc_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  284              lpc_byte_idx      = 12'd0;
  285              demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  286              lpc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  287          end
  288      end
  289      // synthesis translate_on
  290  
  291  endmodule
sources_1/new/demux_preamble_hotswap.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  
    3  module demux_preamble_hotswap (
    4      input  wire         clk,
    5      input  wire         rst_n,
    6      input  wire [127:0] cdc_data_in,
    7      input  wire         cdc_valid_in,
    8      output reg  [71:0]  preamble_extracted,
    9      output reg          preamble_valid,
   10      output reg  [95:0]  lpc_data_out,
   11      output reg          lpc_valid_out
   12  );
   13  
   14      localparam [71:0] TARGET_PREAMBLE = 72'hD55555555555555555;
   15      
   16      reg [255:0] rx_buffer;
   17      reg [7:0]   bytes_in_buffer;
   18      reg         preamble_found;
   19  
   20      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   21          if (!rst_n) begin
   22              rx_buffer          <= 256'd0;
   23              bytes_in_buffer    <= 8'd0;
   24              preamble_found     <= 1'b0;
   25              preamble_valid     <= 1'b0;
   26              lpc_valid_out      <= 1'b0;
   27              // PERBAIKAN 1: Inisialisasi Wajib
   28              preamble_extracted <= 72'd0; 
   29              lpc_data_out       <= 96'd0; 
   30          end else begin
   31              preamble_valid <= 1'b0;
   32              lpc_valid_out  <= 1'b0;
   33  
   34              // PERBAIKAN 2: FSM Isolasi State
   35              if (!preamble_found) begin
   36                  // STATE 1: Mencari Preamble
   37                  if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   38                      if (cdc_data_in[71:0] == TARGET_PREAMBLE) begin
   39                          preamble_extracted <= cdc_data_in[71:0];
   40                          preamble_valid     <= 1'b1;
   41                          preamble_found     <= 1'b1;
   42                          
   43                          // Simpan sisa 7 Byte data ke buffer untuk LPC
   44                          rx_buffer[55:0] <= cdc_data_in[127:72];
   45                          bytes_in_buffer <= 8'd7; 
   46                      end
   47                  end
   48              end else begin
   49                  // STATE 2: Menampung dan Mengekstrak LPC
   50                  if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   51                      rx_buffer <= rx_buffer | ({128'd0, cdc_data_in} << (bytes_in_buffer * 8));
   52                      bytes_in_buffer <= bytes_in_buffer + 16;
   53                  end
   54                  
   55                  if (bytes_in_buffer >= 12) begin
   56                      lpc_data_out  <= rx_buffer[95:0];
   57                      lpc_valid_out <= 1'b1;
   58                      
   59                      rx_buffer       <= rx_buffer >> 96;
   60                      bytes_in_buffer <= bytes_in_buffer - 12;
   61                  end
   62              end
   63          end
   64      end
   65  endmodule
sources_1/new/descrambler.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : descrambler
    7  Description  : 64-bit Parallel Additive PRBS Descrambler.
    8                 Processes 259 contiguous 64-bit words per frame (4 Header 
    9                 words = 32B + 255 Payload words = 2040B; Total = 2072 Bytes).
   10                 Resets the internal LFSR state to 'init' at the end of every
   11                 259-word frame to maintain frame-synchronous descrambling.
   12  
   13                 CRITICAL BUG FIXES (4 LFSR Matrix Typos Fixed to Match scrambler.v):
   14                 1. B[27] : Fixed 1st XOR term from 'B[26][63] ^ B[26][61]' to 'B[26][64] ^ B[26][61]'.
   15                 2. B[58] : Fixed 22nd XOR term from 'B[57][44] ^ B[57][40]' to 'B[57][43] ^ B[57][40]'.
   16                 3. B[60] : Fixed slice prefix from 'B[58][4:0]' to 'B[59][4:0]'.
   17                 4. B[61] : Fixed 41st XOR term from 'B[60][25] ^ B[60][21]' to 'B[60][24] ^ B[60][21]'.
   18  
   19  Revision History:
   20    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 64-bit parallel descrambler with 4 matrix fixes.
   21    - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:45 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and preserved 
   22      simulation byte unpackers (out_byte_cnt 1..2072, desc_frame_id 1..4).
   23    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 4 - SDA OISL Page 39-40, Table 2-17 & Fig. 2-12]
   24      Updated PRBS generator to the 25-bit shift register X[24:0] initialized with
   25      SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007 at the start of every frame header and unrolled 64 bits
   26      per cycle (step_prbs25_64) to match scrambler.v Rev 2.00 bit-for-bit.
   27  ===========================================================================
   28  */
   29  
   30  module descrambler (
   31      input  wire        clk,
   32      input  wire        rst_n,
   33      input  wire        en,
   34      input  wire [63:0] data_in,
   35      output wire        flag,
   36      output wire [63:0] data_out
   37  );
   38  
   39      parameter max  = 258;
   40      reg [15:0] count = 16'd0;
   41  
   42      parameter IDLE   = 3'b001;
   43      parameter ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   44      parameter END    = 3'b100;
   45  
   46      reg [2:0] state;
   47      reg [2:0] next_state;
   48  
   49      parameter init = 64'h87654321abcd9536;
   50      // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:09 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-17 25-bit seed:
   51      parameter [24:0] SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007;
   52  
   53      reg  [63:0] data_in_d0;
   54      reg  [63:0] scr_out;
   55      wire [63:0] S;
   56  
   57      reg  [24:0] Q = SEED_INIT;
   58      wire [24:0] D;
   59  
   60      function [88:0] step_prbs25_64(input [24:0] q_in);
   61          reg [24:0] sr;
   62          reg [63:0] s_vec;
   63          reg        fb;
   64          integer    k;
   65          begin
   66              sr = q_in;
   67              for (k = 0; k < 64; k = k + 1) begin
   68                  s_vec[63 - k] = sr[0];
   69                  fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];
   70                  sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]};
   71              end
   72              step_prbs25_64 = {sr, s_vec};
   73          end
   74      endfunction
   75  
   76      wire [88:0] prbs25_step_out = step_prbs25_64(Q);
   77      assign D = prbs25_step_out[88:64];
   78      assign S = prbs25_step_out[63:0];
   79  
   80      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   81          if (~rst_n)
   82              state <= IDLE;
   83          else
   84              state <= next_state;
   85      end
   86  
   87      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   88          if (~rst_n)
   89              count <= 16'd0;
   90          else if (state == ACTIVE)
   91              count <= count + 1'b1;
   92          else
   93              count <= 16'd0;
   94      end
   95  
   96      always @(*) begin
   97          case (state)
   98              IDLE: begin
   99                  if (en)
  100                      next_state = ACTIVE;
  101                  else
  102                      next_state = IDLE;
  103              end
  104              ACTIVE: begin
  105                  if (count < max)
  106                      next_state = ACTIVE;
  107                  else
  108                      next_state = END;
  109              end
  110              END:     next_state = IDLE;
  111              default: next_state = IDLE;
  112          endcase
  113      end
  114  
  115      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  116          if (~rst_n)
  117              data_in_d0 <= 64'b0;
  118          else
  119              data_in_d0 <= data_in;
  120      end
  121  
  122      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  123          if (~rst_n)
  124              Q <= SEED_INIT;
  125          else if (state == ACTIVE)
  126              Q <= D;
  127          else
  128              Q <= SEED_INIT;
  129      end
  130  
  131      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  132          if (~rst_n)
  133              scr_out <= 64'd0;
  134          else if (state == ACTIVE)
  135              scr_out <= data_in_d0 ^ S;
  136          else
  137              scr_out <= 64'd0;
  138      end
  139  
  140      assign flag     = (count != 0);
  141      assign data_out = (flag) ? scr_out : 64'b0;
  142  
  143      // =====================================================================
  144      // SIMULATION TRACKERS: 259-WORD COUNTER & 2072-BYTE STREAM UNPACKER
  145      // =====================================================================
  146      // synthesis translate_off
  147      wire [8:0]  out_word64_cnt  = flag ? count[8:0] : 9'd0;
  148      wire [11:0] out_byte_cnt    = flag ? (count[11:0] * 12'd8) : 12'd0;
  149      wire        is_hdr_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd1 && count <= 16'd4);
  150      wire        is_pld_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd5 && count <= 16'd259);
  151  
  152      reg  [7:0]  desc_sim_q [0:16383];
  153      integer     desc_wr_ptr;
  154      integer     desc_rd_ptr;
  155      reg         desc_unpack_active;
  156  
  157      reg  [7:0]  byte_stream_out;
  158      reg  [11:0] frame_byte_idx;
  159      reg  [31:0] desc_frame_id;
  160      reg  [15:0] desc_total_bytes;
  161  
  162      initial begin
  163          desc_wr_ptr        = 0;
  164          desc_rd_ptr        = 0;
  165          desc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  166          byte_stream_out    = 8'd0;
  167          frame_byte_idx     = 12'd0;
  168          desc_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  169          desc_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  170      end
  171  
  172      always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  173          if (~rst_n) begin
  174              desc_wr_ptr = 0;
  175          end else if (flag) begin
  176              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 0] = data_out[63:56];
  177              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 1] = data_out[55:48];
  178              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 2] = data_out[47:40];
  179              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 3] = data_out[39:32];
  180              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 4] = data_out[31:24];
  181              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 5] = data_out[23:16];
  182              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 6] = data_out[15:8];
  183              desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 7] = data_out[7:0];
  184              desc_wr_ptr                 = desc_wr_ptr + 8;
  185          end
  186      end
  187  
  188      real next_desc_edge_ns;
  189      always @(posedge clk) begin
  190          if (rst_n && (state == ACTIVE) && (count == 16'd0) && !desc_unpack_active) begin
  191              desc_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  192              @(posedge clk);
  193              #0.001;
  194              next_desc_edge_ns = $realtime;
  195              while (desc_total_bytes < 16'd8288) begin
  196                  if (desc_rd_ptr == 0)
  197                      byte_stream_out = data_out[63:56];
  198                  else
  199                      byte_stream_out = desc_sim_q[desc_rd_ptr];
  200  
  201                  desc_rd_ptr      = desc_rd_ptr + 1;
  202                  desc_total_bytes = desc_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  203  
  204                  if (desc_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  205                      desc_frame_id  = 32'd1;
  206                      frame_byte_idx = 12'd1;
  207                  end else if (frame_byte_idx == 12'd2072) begin
  208                      desc_frame_id  = desc_frame_id + 32'd1;
  209                      frame_byte_idx = 12'd1;
  210                  end else begin
  211                      frame_byte_idx = frame_byte_idx + 12'd1;
  212                  end
  213  
  214                  next_desc_edge_ns = next_desc_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 2072.0);
  215                  #((next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  216              end
  217              byte_stream_out    = 8'd0;
  218              frame_byte_idx     = 12'd0;
  219              desc_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  220              desc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  221          end
  222      end
  223      // synthesis translate_on
  224  
  225  endmodule
sources_1/new/encoder/combiner.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: 
    4  // Engineer: 
    5  // 
    6  // Create Date: 12/25/2025 09:43:52 PM
    7  // Design Name: 
    8  // Module Name: combiner
    9  // Project Name: 
   10  // Target Devices: 
   11  // Tool Versions: 
   12  // Description: 
   13  // 
   14  // Dependencies: 
   15  // 
   16  // Revision:
   17  // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18  // Additional Comments:
   19  // 
   20  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   21  
   22  
   23  module combiner(
   24      input               clk,
   25      input               rst_n,
   26      input               en,
   27      input   [7:0]       header_in,
   28      input   [63:0]      payload_in,
   29      output              flag,
   30      output  [63:0]      data_out
   31  );
   32  
   33  parameter   thres       = 6;
   34  parameter   max_wr      = 149;
   35  parameter   max_rd      = thres + 254;
   36  
   37  reg     [15:0]  con_wr      = 16'd0;
   38  reg     [15:0]  con_rd      = 16'd0;
   39  
   40  parameter   IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   41  parameter   WRITE       = 4'b0010;
   42  parameter   READ        = 4'b0100;
   43  parameter   END         = 4'b1000;
   44  
   45  reg     [3:0]   state;
   46  reg     [3:0]   next_state;
   47  
   48  wire    rd_en;
   49  wire    [63:0]      fifo_out;
   50  reg     [63:0]      combine_out;
   51  
   52  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   53  begin
   54      if (~rst_n)
   55          state   <= IDLE;
   56      else
   57          state   <= next_state;
   58  end
   59  
   60  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   61  begin
   62      if (~rst_n)
   63          con_wr      <= 16'd0;
   64      else if (state == WRITE)
   65          con_wr      <= con_wr + 1'b1;
   66      else
   67          con_wr      <= 16'd0;
   68  end
   69  
   70  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   71  begin
   72      if (~rst_n)
   73          con_rd      <= 16'd0;
   74      else if (state == READ)
   75          con_rd      <= con_rd + 1'b1;
   76      else
   77          con_rd      <= 16'd0;
   78  end
   79  
   80  always @(*)
   81  begin
   82      case(state)
   83          IDLE:           begin
   84                              if (en)
   85                                  next_state  <= WRITE;
   86                              else
   87                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
   88                          end
   89          WRITE:          begin
   90                              if (con_wr < max_wr)
   91                                  next_state  <= WRITE;
   92                              else
   93                                  next_state  <= READ;
   94                          end
   95          READ:           begin
   96                              if (con_rd < max_rd)
   97                                  next_state  <= READ;
   98                              else
   99                                  next_state  <= END;
  100                          end
  101          END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  102          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  103      endcase
  104  end
  105  
  106  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  107  begin
  108      if (~rst_n)
  109          combine_out     <= 63'b0;
  110      else if (con_rd > 0 && con_rd < thres - 1)
  111          combine_out     <= fifo_out;
  112      else if (state == READ && con_rd > thres - 2)
  113          combine_out     <= payload_in;
  114      else
  115          combine_out     <= 63'b0;
  116  end
  117  
  118  assign  rd_en   = (state == READ && con_rd < thres);
  119  
  120  assign  flag        = (state == READ && con_rd > 1);
  121  assign  data_out    = (flag) ? combine_out : 64'b0;
  122  
  123  delay_combiner delay_inst (
  124      .srst           (1'b0)
  125      ,.clk           (clk)
  126      ,.wr_en         (en)
  127      ,.din           (header_in)
  128      ,.rd_en         (rd_en)
  129      ,.dout          (fifo_out)
  130  );
  131  
  132  
  133  
  134  
  135  endmodule
  136  
  137  
  138  
  139  
  140

sources_1/new/encoder/core_tx.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Description  : FEC Transmission Core (RS Encoder -> Scrambler -> LPC).
    5                 CRITICAL REVISION:
    6                 - Restored RS Encoder parameters to #(31) and #(254). 
    7                   Since internal counters are 0-indexed, this geometrically 
    8                   guarantees exactly 32 cycles for Header and 255 for Payload.
    9                 - Utilizes FEC_MUX for 259-cycle true Zero-Gap streaming.
   10  ===========================================================================
   11  */
   12  module core_tx(
   13      input               clk,
   14      input               rst_n,
   15      input               en_head,
   16      input               en_load,
   17      input   [7:0]       header,
   18      input   [63:0]      payload,
   19      output              flag,
   20      output  [95:0]      data_out
   21  );
   22  
   23      wire        encoder_dv;
   24      wire [7:0]  rs_head;
   25      
   26      wire        rs_load_dv; 
   27      wire [63:0] rs_load;
   28  
   29      wire        mux_dv;
   30      wire [63:0] mux_data;
   31      
   32      wire        scrambler_dv;
   33      wire [63:0] scrambler;
   34  
   35      // 1. RS Encoder for Header (max=31 yields exactly 32 Cycles)
   36      rs_encoder #(31) rs_enc_header_inst (
   37          .clk        (clk),
   38          .rst_n      (rst_n),
   39          .en         (en_head),
   40          .data_in    (header),
   41          .flag       (encoder_dv),
   42          .data_out   (rs_head)
   43      );
   44  
   45      // 2. RS Encoder for Payload (max=254 yields exactly 255 Cycles)
   46      rs_encoder_64 #(254) rs_encoder_64_inst (
   47          .clk        (clk),
   48          .rst_n      (rst_n),
   49          .en         (en_load),
   50          .data_in    (payload),
   51          .flag       (rs_load_dv), 
   52          .data_out   (rs_load)
   53      );
   54  
   55      // 3. FEC Auto-Aligning Multiplexer (259 Continuous Cycles)
   56      FEC_MUX u_fec_mux (
   57          .clk        (clk),
   58          .rst_n      (rst_n),
   59          .rs_head_dv (encoder_dv),
   60          .rs_head    (rs_head),
   61          .rs_load_dv (rs_load_dv),
   62          .rs_load    (rs_load),
   63          .flag       (mux_dv),
   64          .data_out   (mux_data)
   65      );
   66  
   67      // 4. PRBS Scrambler
   68      scrambler scrambler_inst (
   69          .clk        (clk),
   70          .rst_n      (rst_n),
   71          .en         (mux_dv),
   72          .data_in    (mux_data),
   73          .flag       (scrambler_dv),
   74          .data_out   (scrambler)
   75      );
   76  
   77      // 5. Low-Density Parity Check (LPC) Compression
   78      lpc_top lpc_top_inst (
   79          .clk        (clk),
   80          .rst_n      (rst_n),
   81          .en         (scrambler_dv),
   82          .data_in    (scrambler),
   83          .flag       (flag),
   84          .data_out   (data_out)
   85      );
   86  
   87  endmodule

   21  
   22  
   23  module crc_16 # (parameter max = 15) (
   24      input           clk,
   25      input           rst_n,
   26      input           en,
   27      input   [7:0]   data_in,
   28      output          flag,
   29      output  [7:0]   data_out
   30  );
   31  
   32  reg     [7:0]   count   = 8'd0;
   33  
   34  localparam  IDLE        = 3'b001;
   35  localparam  ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   36  localparam  END         = 3'b100;
   37  
   38  reg     [2:0]   state;
   39  reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   40  
   41  reg     [7:0]   temp;
   42  reg     [7:0]   crc_out;
   43  
   44  wire    [15:0]  D;
   45  reg     [15:0]  Q   = 16'b0;
   46  reg     [15:0]  R   = 16'b0;
   47  
   48  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   49  begin
   50      if (~rst_n)
   51          state   <= IDLE;
   52      else
   53          state   <= next_state;
   54  end
   55  
   56  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   57  begin
   58      if (~rst_n)
   59          count   <= 8'd0;
   60      else if (state == ACTIVE)
   61          count   <= count + 1'b1;
   62      else
   63          count   <= 8'd0;
   64  end
   65  
   66  always @(*)
   67  begin
   68      case(state)
   69          IDLE:           begin
   70                              if (en)
   71                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   72                              else
   73                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
   74                          end
   75          ACTIVE:         begin
   76                              if (count < max)
   77                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   78                              else
   79                                  next_state  <= END;
   80                          end
   81          END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
   82          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
   83      endcase
   84  end
   85  
   86  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   87  begin
   88      if (~rst_n)
   89          temp    <= 8'd0;
   90      else
   91          temp    <= data_in;
   92  end
   93  
   94  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   95  begin
   96      if(~rst_n)
   97          begin
   98              Q   <= 16'b0;
   99              R   <= 16'b0;
  100          end
  101      else if (state == ACTIVE)
  102          begin
  103              if (count < max)
  104                  begin
  105                      Q   <= D;
  106                      if (count == max - 2)
  107                          R   <= D;
  108                  end
  109              else
  110                  begin
  111                      Q   <= 16'b0;
  112                      R   <= 16'b0;
  113                  end
  114          end
  115  end
  116  
  117  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  118  begin
  119      if(~rst_n)
  120          crc_out     <= 16'b0;
  121      else if (state == ACTIVE)
  122          begin
  123              if (count < max - 1)
  124                  crc_out     <= temp;
  125              else if (count == max - 1)
  126                  crc_out     <= R[15:8];
  127              else if (count == max)
  128                  crc_out     <= R[7:0];
  129          end
  130  end
  131  
  132  assign  D[0]    = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4];
  133  assign  D[1]    = Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5];
  134  assign  D[2]    = Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6];
  135  assign  D[3]    = Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
  136  assign  D[4]    = Q[12] ^ temp[4];
  137  assign  D[5]    = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[5];
  138  assign  D[6]    = Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5] ^ temp[6];
  139  assign  D[7]    = Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[7];
  140  assign  D[8]    = Q[0] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
  141  assign  D[9]    = Q[1] ^ Q[12] ^ temp[4];
  142  assign  D[10]   = Q[2] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[5];
  143  assign  D[11]   = Q[3] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[6];
  144  assign  D[12]   = Q[4] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[7];
  145  assign  D[13]   = Q[5] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5];
  146  assign  D[14]   = Q[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6];
  147  assign  D[15]   = Q[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
  148  
  149  assign  flag        = (count != 0);
  150  assign  data_out    = (flag) ? crc_out : 16'b0;
  151  
  152  
  153  
  154  
  155  
  156  
  157  endmodule
  158  
  159

   22  module crc_32 # (parameter max = 477) (
   23      input               clk,
   24      input               rst_n,
   25      input               en,
   26      input   [31:0]      data_in,

   28      output  [31:0]      data_out,

   30  );
   31  
   32  reg     [15:0]   count  = 16'd0;
   33  
   34  localparam  IDLE        = 3'b001;
   35  localparam  ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   36  localparam  END         = 3'b100;
   37

   39  reg     [2:0]   next_state;

   43  
   44  wire    [31:0]  D;
   45  reg     [31:0]  Q   = 16'b0;
   46  reg     [31:0]  R   = 16'b0;
   47  
   48  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   49  begin
   50      if (~rst_n)
   51          state   <= IDLE;
   52      else
   53          state   <= next_state;
   54  end
   55  
   56  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   57  begin
   58      if (~rst_n)
   59          count   <= 16'd0;
   60      else if (state == ACTIVE)
   61          count   <= count + 1'b1;
   62      else
   63          count   <= 16'd0;
   64  end
   65  
   66  always @(*)
   67  begin
   68      case(state)
   69          IDLE:           begin
   70                              if (en)
   71                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   72                              else
   73                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
   74                          end
   75          ACTIVE:         begin
   76                              if (count < max)
   77                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   78                              else
   79                                  next_state  <= END;
   80                          end
   81          END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
   82          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
   83      endcase
   84  end
   85  
   86  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   87  begin
   88      if (~rst_n)
   89          temp    <= 32'd0;
   90      else
   91          temp    <= data_in;
   92  end
   93  
   94  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   95  begin
   96      if(~rst_n)
   97          Q   <= 32'b0;
   98      else if (state == ACTIVE)
   99          Q   <= D;
  100      else
  101          Q   <= 32'b0;
  102  end
  103  
  104  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  105  begin
  106      if(~rst_n)
  107          crc_out     <= 32'b0;
  108      else if (state == ACTIVE)
  109          begin
  110              if (count < max - 1)
  111                  crc_out     <= temp;
  112              else if (count == max - 1)
  113                  crc_out     <= D; 
  114          end
  115  end
  116  
  117  assign  D[0] = Q[0] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[16] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[26] ^ Q[28] ^ Q[29] ^ Q[30] ^ Q[31] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[9] ^ temp[10] ^ temp[12] ^ temp[16] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[26] ^ temp[28] ^ temp[29] ^ temp[30] ^ temp[31];

  119  assign  D[2] = Q[0] ^ Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[16] ^ Q[17] ^ Q[18] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[26] ^ Q[30] ^ Q[31] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[7] ^ temp[8] ^ temp[9] ^ temp[13] ^ temp[14] ^ temp[16] ^ temp[17] ^ temp[18] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[26] ^ temp[30] ^ temp[31];
  120  assign  D[3] = Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15] ^ Q[17] ^ Q[18] ^ Q[19] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[27] ^ Q[31] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7] ^ temp[8] ^ temp[9] ^ temp[10] ^ temp[14] ^ temp[15] ^ temp[17] ^ temp[18] ^ temp[19] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[27] ^ temp[31];
  121  assign  D[4] = Q[0] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15] ^ Q[18] ^ Q[19] ^ Q[20] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[29] ^ Q[30] ^ Q[31] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[8] ^ temp[11] ^ temp[12] ^ temp[15] ^ temp[18] ^ temp[19] ^ temp[20] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[29] ^ temp[30] ^ temp[31];

  143  assign  D[26] = Q[0] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[18] ^ Q[19] ^ Q[20] ^ Q[22] ^ Q[23] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[26] ^ Q[28] ^ Q[31] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[10] ^ temp[18] ^ temp[19] ^ temp[20] ^ temp[22] ^ temp[23] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[26] ^ temp[28] ^ temp[31];
  144  assign  D[27] = Q[1] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[19] ^ Q[20] ^ Q[21] ^ Q[23] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[26] ^ Q[27] ^ Q[29] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[5] ^ temp[7] ^ temp[11] ^ temp[19] ^ temp[20] ^ temp[21] ^ temp[23] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[26] ^ temp[27] ^ temp[29];
  145  assign  D[28] = Q[2] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[20] ^ Q[21] ^ Q[22] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[26] ^ Q[27] ^ Q[28] ^ Q[30] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[5] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[8] ^ temp[12] ^ temp[20] ^ temp[21] ^ temp[22] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[26] ^ temp[27] ^ temp[28] ^ temp[30];
  146  assign  D[29] = Q[3] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ Q[21] ^ Q[22] ^ Q[23] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[26] ^ Q[27] ^ Q[28] ^ Q[29] ^ Q[31] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[7] ^ temp[9] ^ temp[13] ^ temp[21] ^ temp[22] ^ temp[23] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[26] ^ temp[27] ^ temp[28] ^ temp[29] ^ temp[31];
  147  assign  D[30] = Q[4] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[22] ^ Q[23] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[26] ^ Q[27] ^ Q[28] ^ Q[29] ^ Q[30] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[7] ^ temp[8] ^ temp[10] ^ temp[14] ^ temp[22] ^ temp[23] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[26] ^ temp[27] ^ temp[28] ^ temp[29] ^ temp[30];
  148  assign  D[31] = Q[5] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ Q[23] ^ Q[24] ^ Q[25] ^ Q[27] ^ Q[28] ^ Q[29] ^ Q[30] ^ Q[31] ^ temp[5] ^ temp[8] ^ temp[9] ^ temp[11] ^ temp[15] ^ temp[23] ^ temp[24] ^ temp[25] ^ temp[27] ^ temp[28] ^ temp[29] ^ temp[30] ^ temp[31];
  149  
  150  assign  flag        = (count != 0);
  151  assign  data_out    = (flag) ? crc_out : 32'b0;
  152  assign  count_out   = count; 
  153  
  154  
  155  
  156  
  157  
  158  endmodule

   24  module encoder_top(

   26      input               clk_logic,
   27      input               rst_n,
   28      input               en,
   29      input   [31:0]      data_in,
   30      output              flag,
   31      output  [31:0]      data_out
   32  );
   33  
   34  wire    c16_dv;
   35  wire    [7:0]       crc_16;
   36  wire    c32_dv;
   37  wire    [31:0]      crc_32;
   38  
   39  wire    header_dv;
   40  wire    [7:0]       header;
   41  wire    payload_dv;
   42  wire    [63:0]      payload;
   43  
   44  wire    core_dv;
   45  wire    [95:0]      core_data;
   46  
   47  // KABEL BARU UNTUK MUX DAN PREAMBLE
   48  wire    [71:0]      preamble_wire;
   49  wire    mux_dv;
   50  wire    [127:0]     mux_data;
   51  
   52  framer_top framer_top_inst (
   53      .clk                (clk_gth)

   57      ,.header_dv         (c16_dv)
   58      ,.header            (crc_16)
   59      ,.payload_dv        (c32_dv)
   60      ,.payload           (crc_32)
   61  );
   62  
   63  x_gth_logic x_gth_logic_inst (
   64      .clk_gth            (clk_gth)

   67      ,.en_head           (c16_dv)
   68      ,.en_load           (c32_dv)
   69      ,.header_in         (crc_16)
   70      ,.payload_in        (crc_32)
   71      ,.header_dv         (header_dv)

   73      ,.payload_dv        (payload_dv)

   75  );
   76  
   77  core_tx core_tx_inst (
   78      .clk                (clk_logic)
   79      ,.rst_n             (rst_n)
   80      ,.en_head           (header_dv)
   81      ,.en_load           (payload_dv)
   82      ,.header            (header)

   84      ,.flag              (core_dv)

   88  // INSTANTIATION MODUL PREAMBLE (BARU)
   89  preamble_gen preamble_inst (
   90      .preamble_out   (preamble_wire)
   91  );

   93  // INSTANTIATION MUX GEARBOX (BARU)
   94  mux_gearbox_128 mux_inst (
   95      .clk            (clk_logic)
   96      ,.rst_n         (rst_n)
   97      ,.preamble_data (preamble_wire) // Mengambil dari preamble_gen
   98      ,.lpc_data      (core_data)     // Mengambil dari core_tx
   99      ,.lpc_valid     (core_dv)

  101      ,.cdc_valid     (mux_dv)
  102  );

  105      .clk_gth        (clk_gth)

  108      ,.en            (mux_dv)       // UBAH: Di-trigger oleh MUX
  109      ,.data_in       (mux_data)     // UBAH: Lebar bus masuk 128-bit
  110      ,.flag          (flag)
  111      ,.data_out      (data_out)

    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: 
    4  // Engineer: 
    5  // 
    6  // Create Date: 12/09/2025 04:18:56 PM
    7  // Design Name: 
    8  // Module Name: fso_framer
    9  // Project Name: 
   10  // Target Devices: 
   11  // Tool Versions: 
   12  // Description: 
   13  // 
   14  // Dependencies: 
   15  // 
   16  // Revision:
   17  // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18  // Additional Comments:
   19  // 
   20  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   21  
   22  
   23  
   24  module framer(
   25      input                   clk,
   26      input                   rst_n,
   27      input                   en,
   28      input   [31:0]          data_in,
   29      output                  header_dv,
   30      output  [7:0]           header,
   31      output                  payload_dv,
   32      output  [31:0]          payload,
   33      output  [15:0]          count_out 
   34  );
   35  
   36  parameter   max         = 477;
   37  parameter   thres       = 246;
   38  (* mark_debug = "true", keep = "true" *) reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   39  
   40  parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   41  parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   42  parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   43  
   44  reg     [2:0]   state;
   45  reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   46  
   47  reg     [255:0]     temp;
   48  reg     [111:0]     mac_header;
   49  reg     [7:0]       mac_out;
   50  
   51  reg     [9:0]       seq_payload     = 10'd0;
   52  reg     [13:0]      len_payload     = 14'd0;
   53  reg     [31:0]      head_payload;
   54  
   55  reg     [13:0]      len_packet      = 14'd0;
   56  wire    [31:0]      head_packet;
   57  wire    [63:0]      fso_packet;
   58  
   59  wire    wr_en;
   60  wire    rd_en;
   61  
   62  reg     [63:0]      serdes_in;
   63  wire    [31:0]      serdes_out;
   64  
   65  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   66  begin
   67      if (~rst_n)
   68          state   <= IDLE;
   69      else
   70          state   <= next_state;
   71  end
   72  
   73  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   74  begin
   75      if (~rst_n)
   76          count   <= 16'd0;
   77      else if (state == ACTIVE )
   78          count   <= count + 1'b1;
   79      else
   80          count   <= 16'd0;
   81  end
   82  
   83  always @(*)
   84  begin
   85      case(state)
   86          IDLE:           begin
   87                              if (en)
   88                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   89                              else
   90                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
   91                          end
   92          ACTIVE:         begin
   93                              if (count < max - 1)
   94                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   95                              else
   96                                  next_state  <= END;
   97                          end
   98          // --- MODIFIKASI KONTINYU SESUAI STANDAR SDA-OISL ---
   99          // Langsung mengecek 'en' dari state END agar tidak ada jeda / pause kosong
  100          END:            begin
  101                              if (en)
  102                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  103                              else
  104                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
  105                          end
  106          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  107      endcase
  108  end
  109  
  110  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  111  begin
  112      if (~rst_n)
  113          begin
  114              temp    <= 256'b0;
  115              head_payload    <= 32'b0;
  116          end
  117      else
  118          begin
  119              temp    <= {temp[223:0], data_in};
  120              head_payload    <= {8'hab, seq_payload, len_payload};
  121          end
  122  end
  123  
  124  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  125  begin
  126      if (~rst_n)
  127          mac_header      <= 112'b0;
  128      else if (count == 3)
  129          mac_header      <= temp[127:16];
  130  end
  131  
  132  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  133  begin
  134      if (~rst_n)
  135          mac_out     <= 8'b0;
  136      else if (count > 3 && count < 18)
  137          mac_out     <= mac_header[111 - (count - 4) * 8 -: 8];
  138      else
  139          mac_out     <= 8'b0;
  140  end
  141  
  142  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  143  begin
  144      if (~rst_n)
  145          len_payload     <= 14'd0;
  146      else if (count == 4)
  147          len_payload     <= temp[29:16];
  148  end
  149  
  150  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  151  begin
  152      if (~rst_n)
  153          len_packet      <= 14'd0;
  154      else if (count == 5)
  155          len_packet      <= len_payload;
  156      else if (len_packet > 0 && count > 5)
  157          len_packet      <= len_packet - 14'd4;
  158      else
  159          len_packet      <= 14'd0;
  160  end
  161  
  162  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  163  begin
  164      if (~rst_n)
  165          serdes_in   <= 64'b0;
  166      else if (count == 6)
  167          serdes_in   <= {32'b0, head_payload};
  168      else if (count > 6)
  169          serdes_in   <= fso_packet;
  170      else
  171          serdes_in   <= 64'b0;
  172  end
  173  
  174  assign  header_dv       = (count > 4 && count < 19);
  175  assign  header          = mac_out;
  176  
  177  assign  head_packet     = {16'hcdef, 2'b0, len_packet};
  178  assign  fso_packet      = {head_packet, temp[143:112]};
  179  
  180  assign  wr_en           = (count > 6 && count < thres);
  181  assign  rd_en           = (count > 8);
  182  
  183  assign  payload_dv      = (state == ACTIVE && count > 10);
  184  assign  payload         = (payload_dv) ? serdes_out : 32'b0;
  185  
  186  serdes_framer serdes_inst (
  187      .srst           (1'b0)
  188      ,.clk           (clk)
  189      ,.wr_en         (wr_en)
  190      ,.din           (serdes_in)
  191      ,.rd_en         (rd_en)
  192      ,.dout          (serdes_out)
  193  );
  194  
  195  assign  count_out       = count;
  196  
  197  endmodule
  198  
  199  
  200  
  201  
  202  
  203  
  204  
  205  
  206  
  207

   21  
   22  
   23  module framer_top(
   24      input                 clk,             
   25      input                 rst_n,           
   26      input                 en,              
   27      input        [31:0]   data_in,         
   28      output                header_dv,       
   29      output                payload_dv,      
   30      output       [7:0]    header,          
   31      output       [31:0]   payload,         
   32      (* mark_debug = "true", keep = "true" *) output wire  [15:0]   count,
   33      (* mark_debug = "true", keep = "true" *) output reg            stage_indicator 
   34  );
   35  
   36  wire        c16_dv; 
   37  wire  [7:0] crc_16; 
   38  wire        c32_dv; 
   39  wire  [31:0] crc_32; 
   40  
   41  // Logika stage_indicator untuk memantau tahapan proses
   42  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin 
   43      if (~rst_n) begin 
   44          stage_indicator <= 1'b0;          
   45      end else begin 
   46          if (c32_dv) begin 
   47              stage_indicator <= 1'b1; 
   48          end else if (c16_dv) begin 
   49              stage_indicator <= 1'b0;       
   50          end
   51      end
   52  end
   53  
   54  framer framer_inst ( 
   55      .clk            (clk)         
   56      ,.rst_n         (rst_n)       
   57      ,.en            (en)          
   58      ,.data_in       (data_in)     
   59      ,.header_dv     (c16_dv)      
   60      ,.header        (crc_16)      
   61      ,.payload_dv    (c32_dv)      
   62      ,.payload       (crc_32)      
   63      ,.count_out     (count)       // [DIUBAH] Mengambil count asli dari dalam framer
   64  );
   65  
   66  crc_16 #(.max(15)) crc_16_inst( 
   67      .clk            (clk)         
   68      ,.rst_n         (rst_n)       
   69      ,.en            (c16_dv)      
   70      ,.data_in       (crc_16)      
   71      ,.flag          (header_dv)   
   72      ,.data_out      (header)      
   73  );
   74  
   75  crc_32 #(.max(477)) crc_32_inst( 
   76      .clk            (clk)         
   77      ,.rst_n         (rst_n)       
   78      ,.en            (c32_dv)      
   79      ,.data_in       (crc_32)      
   80      ,.flag          (payload_dv)  
   81      ,.data_out      (payload)     
   82  );
   83  
   84  endmodule

sources_1/new/encoder/lpc.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Description  : Low-Density Parity Check (LPC) Sub-module.
    5                 CRITICAL FIX (Data-Parity Misalignment):
    6                 - Removed the clocked registers for P[7:0].
    7                 - Converted the lengthy IF-ELSE parity generation into 
    8                   pure combinational XOR/XNOR gates.
    9                 - This guarantees that Data (E) and Parity (P) emerge on 
   10                   the exact same clock cycle without shifting/mixing.
   11  
   12  Revision History:
   13    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Combinational differential encoder (E[0:15]) and 2D parity (P[7:0]).
   14    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 40-41, Sec. 2.6.3.6.8,
   15      Figure 2-13 & Figure 2-14]:
   16      Added Running Disparity accumulation state (running_disparity) and verified
   17      24-bit codeword bit ordering per Figure 2-14.
   18    - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Clean-Path & Full 24-Position 1-Bit Error Fix]
   19      Set default ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0 so the 24-bit punctured codeword preserves full
   20      Hamming distance across all 24 bit positions.
   21    - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 13:07 KST) : [Deep Audit Fix F05 - CCSDS 141.11-O-1 Vertical Parity E[8]]
   22      1. Preserved 100% of original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0/2.0/2.2 history.
   23      2. Aligned vertical parity equations P[2:0] (pv_1, pv_2, pv_3) with CCSDS 141.11-O-1
   24         Section 3.3.2.3.4 and SDA OISL Figure 2-13 by XORing V[1:3] with E[8] (e_2,0, the
   25         reference bit of the lower 8-bit differential chain E[8..15]), while horizontal
   26         parities P[6:4] (ph_1, ph_2, ph_3) are XNORed with E[0] (e_0,0, the reference bit
   27         of the upper 8-bit differential chain E[0..7]).
   28  ===========================================================================
   29  */
   30  module lpc #(
   31      parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
   32  )(
   33      input               clk,
   34      input               rst_n,
   35      input               en,
   36      input   [15:0]      data_in,
   37      output              flag,
   38      output  [23:0]      data_out
   39  );
   40  
   41      reg         en_d0;
   42      reg  [15:0] temp;
   43  
   44      wire [0:15] U;
   45      wire [0:15] E;
   46      wire [0:3]  H;
   47      wire [0:3]  V;
   48      wire [7:0]  P; // CRITICAL: Converted to combinational wire
   49  
   50      // 1-Cycle Pipeline Delay for Input
   51      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   52          if (~rst_n) begin
   53              en_d0 <= 1'b0;
   54              temp  <= 16'b0;
   55          end else begin
   56              en_d0 <= en;
   57              temp  <= data_in;
   58          end
   59      end
   60  
   61      // Combinational Math for Encryption 'E' (Figure 2-13 Differential Encoding)
   62      assign U    = {temp[15], temp[14], temp[13], temp[12], temp[11], temp[10], temp[9], temp[8], 
   63                     temp[7],  temp[6],  temp[5],  temp[4],  temp[3],  temp[2],  temp[1], temp[0]};
   64  
   65      assign E[0]  = U[0];
   66      assign E[1]  = U[1]  ^ E[0];
   67      assign E[2]  = U[2]  ^ E[1];
   68      assign E[3]  = U[3]  ^ E[2];
   69      assign E[4]  = U[4]  ^ E[3];
   70      assign E[5]  = U[5]  ^ E[4];
   71      assign E[6]  = U[6]  ^ E[5];
   72      assign E[7]  = U[7]  ^ E[6];
   73      assign E[8]  = U[8];
   74      assign E[9]  = U[9]  ^ E[8];
   75      assign E[10] = U[10] ^ E[9];
   76      assign E[11] = U[11] ^ E[10];
   77      assign E[12] = U[12] ^ E[11];
   78      assign E[13] = U[13] ^ E[12];
   79      assign E[14] = U[14] ^ E[13];
   80      assign E[15] = U[15] ^ E[14];
   81  
   82      assign H[0]  = E[0]  ^ E[1]  ^ E[2]  ^ E[3];
   83      assign H[1]  = E[4]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[7];
   84      assign H[2]  = E[8]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[10] ^ E[11];
   85      assign H[3]  = E[12] ^ E[13] ^ E[14] ^ E[15];
   86      
   87      assign V[0]  = E[0]  ^ E[4]  ^ E[8]  ^ E[12];
   88      assign V[1]  = E[1]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[13];
   89      assign V[2]  = E[2]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[10] ^ E[14];
   90      assign V[3]  = E[3]  ^ E[7]  ^ E[11] ^ E[15];
   91  
   92      // CRITICAL: Combinational Math for Parity 'P' (Eliminates 1-Cycle Delay Bug)
   93      // P[7:4] = {ph_0, ph_1, ph_2, ph_3} coupled with E[0] (e_0,0)
   94      // P[3:0] = {pv_0, pv_1, pv_2, pv_3} coupled with E[8] (e_2,0) per CCSDS 141.11-O-1 & Fig 2-13
   95      assign P[7] = ~H[0];
   96      assign P[6] = ~(E[0] ^ H[1]); // XNOR Gate implementation with e_0,0
   97      assign P[5] = ~(E[0] ^ H[2]);
   98      assign P[4] = ~(E[0] ^ H[3]);
   99      
  100      assign P[3] = V[0];
  101      assign P[2] = (E[8] ^ V[1]);  // [Rev 2.4] XOR Gate implementation with e_2,0 (E[8])
  102      assign P[1] = (E[8] ^ V[2]);
  103      assign P[0] = (E[8] ^ V[3]);
  104  
  105      // =========================================================================
  106      // [Rev 2.0/2.4] ACTIVE DISPARITY MANAGEMENT (SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.6.8)
  107      // =========================================================================
  108      wire [23:0] raw_codeword = {E[0], E[1], E[2], E[3], E[4], E[5], E[6], E[7],
  109                                  E[8], E[9], E[10], E[11], E[12], E[13], E[14], E[15], P};
  110  
  111      function [4:0] count_ones_24(input [23:0] w);
  112          integer idx;
  113          reg [4:0] sum;
  114          begin
  115              sum = 5'd0;
  116              for (idx = 0; idx < 24; idx = idx + 1) begin
  117                  sum = sum + w[idx];
  118              end
  119              count_ones_24 = sum;
  120          end
  121      endfunction
  122  
  123      wire [4:0]         cw_ones_cnt        = count_ones_24(raw_codeword);
  124      wire signed [6:0]  cw_disparity       = $signed({1'b0, cw_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
  125      reg  signed [11:0] running_disparity;
  126  
  127      wire disp_invert_active = en_d0 && (
  128          ((running_disparity > 12'sd0) && (cw_disparity > 7'sd0)) ||
  129          ((running_disparity < 12'sd0) && (cw_disparity < 7'sd0))
  130      );
  131  
  132      wire signed [11:0] next_running_disparity = disp_invert_active ?
  133          (running_disparity - {{5{cw_disparity[6]}}, cw_disparity}) :
  134          (running_disparity + {{5{cw_disparity[6]}}, cw_disparity});
  135  
  136      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  137          if (~rst_n) begin
  138              running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  139          end else if (en_d0) begin
  140              running_disparity <= next_running_disparity;
  141          end else begin
  142              // Reset running disparity to 0 at frame boundary (Preamble has 0 disparity)
  143              running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  144          end
  145      end
  146  
  147      wire [23:0] managed_codeword = (ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN && disp_invert_active) ? ~raw_codeword : raw_codeword;
  148  
  149      // Output Assembly (Figure 2-14: e_0,0 at bit 23 down to pv_3 at bit 0)
  150      assign flag     = en_d0;
  151      assign data_out = en_d0 ? managed_codeword : 24'd0;
  152  
  153  endmodule
