sources_1/new/encoder/rs_encoder_64.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : rs_encoder_64
    7  Description  : 8-Lane Parallel 64-bit Reed-Solomon RS(255,239) Encoder.
    8                 Instantiates 8 parallel byte-wide rs_encoder engines to 
    9                 achieve 8-symbol (64-bit) symbol interleaving depth per 
   10                 SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.6.3.
   11  
   12  Revision History:
   13    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 8-lane parallel RS(255,239) encoder wrapper.
   14    - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #2]
   15      Aligned default parameter MAX_CYCLE to 254 (0-indexed: 0..238 = 239 data
   16      cycles, 239..254 = 16 parity flush cycles; total = 255 cycles) to match
   17      core_tx.v instantiation and documentation.
   18  ===========================================================================
   19  */
   20  
   21  module rs_encoder_64 #(parameter MAX_CYCLE = 254) (
   22      input           clk,
   23      input           rst_n,
   24      input           en,
   25      input   [63:0]  data_in,
   26      output          flag,
   27      output  [63:0]  data_out
   28  );
   29  
   30      wire [7:0] f;
   31      assign flag = &f;
   32  
   33      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_7 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[63:56], f[7], data_out[63:56]);
   34      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_6 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[55:48], f[6], data_out[55:48]);
   35      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_5 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[47:40], f[5], data_out[47:40]);
   36      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_4 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[39:32], f[4], data_out[39:32]);
   37      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_3 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[31:24], f[3], data_out[31:24]);
   38      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_2 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[23:16], f[2], data_out[23:16]);
   39      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_1 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[15:8],  f[1], data_out[15:8]);
   40      rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_0 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[7:0],   f[0], data_out[7:0]);
   41  
   42  endmodule
sources_1/new/encoder/scrambler.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: 
    4  // Engineer: 
    5  // 
    6  // Create Date: 12/08/2025 06:25:33 PM
    7  // Design Name: 
    8  // Module Name: scrambler
    9  // Project Name: 
   10  // Target Devices: 
   11  // Tool Versions: 
   12  // Description: 
   13  // 
   14  // Dependencies: 
   15  // 
   16  // Revision:
   17  // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18  // Additional Comments:
   19  // Revision 2.00 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) - [ETRI Audit Item 4: SDA OISL Page 39-40,
   20  //   Table 2-17 & Figure 2-12]:
   21  //   1. Replaced 65-bit state (init = 64'h87654321abcd9536) with the standard 
   22  //      25-bit PRBS shift register X[24:0] initialized to SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007
   23  //      (X[0:1]=1, X[2]=1, X[24:3]=0 per Table 2-17) at the start of every frame header.
   24  //   2. Unrolled 64 bits per clock cycle with natural bit ordering S[63 - k] = s_k
   25  //      (k = 0..63), mapping Byte 0 MSB (b7 ^ s0) down to Byte 1 LSB (B0 ^ s15)
   26  //      across all 8 bytes per 64-bit word per Figure 2-12.
   27  //   3. Preserved exact port interface, 259-cycle frame window (max = 258), and 
   28  //      1-cycle pipeline latency.
   29  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   30  
   31  
   32  module scrambler(
   33      input               clk,
   34      input               rst_n,
   35      input               en,
   36      input   [63:0]      data_in,
   37      output              flag,
   38      output  [63:0]      data_out
   39  );
   40  
   41  parameter   max         = 258;
   42  reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   43  
   44  parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   45  parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   46  parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   47  
   48  reg     [2:0]   state;
   49  reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   50  
   51  // Legacy baseline parameter retained for reference:
   52  parameter   init        = 64'h87654321abcd9536;
   53  // [Rev 2.00 - 2026-10-27 04:09 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-17 25-bit seed:
   54  parameter   [24:0] SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007;
   55  
   56  reg     [63:0]  data_in_d0;
   57  reg     [63:0]  scr_out;
   58  wire    [63:0]  S;
   59  
   60  // [Rev 2.00] 25-bit PRBS State Register X[24:0] (Table 2-17)
   61  reg     [24:0]  Q   = SEED_INIT;
   62  wire    [24:0]  D;
   63  
   64  // Combinational 64-step unrolled 25-bit PRBS generator (Polynomial: 1 + D^3 + D^25)
   65  // Produces {next_state_25[24:0], S_64[63:0]} where S_64[63-k] = s_k per Figure 2-12.
   66  function [88:0] step_prbs25_64(input [24:0] q_in);
   67      reg [24:0] sr;
   68      reg [63:0] s_vec;
   69      reg        fb;
   70      integer    k;
   71      begin
   72          sr = q_in;
   73          for (k = 0; k < 64; k = k + 1) begin
   74              s_vec[63 - k] = sr[0];          // s_k natural output mapped MSB-first (b7 ^ s0)
   75              fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];  // Taps at stage 0 and stage 3 (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   76              sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]}; // Advance 25-bit shift register
   77          end
   78          step_prbs25_64 = {sr, s_vec};
   79      end
   80  endfunction
   81  
   82  wire [88:0] prbs25_step_out = step_prbs25_64(Q);
   83  assign D = prbs25_step_out[88:64];
   84  assign S = prbs25_step_out[63:0];
   85  
   86  
   87  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   88  begin
   89      if (~rst_n)
   90          state   <= IDLE;
   91      else
   92          state   <= next_state;
   93  end
   94  
   95  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   96  begin
   97      if (~rst_n)
   98          count   <= 16'd0;
   99      else if (state == ACTIVE)
  100          count   <= count + 1'b1;
  101      else
  102          count   <= 16'd0;
  103  end
  104  
  105  always @(*)
  106  begin
  107      case(state)
  108          IDLE:           begin
  109                              if (en)
  110                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  111                              else
  112                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
  113                          end
  114          ACTIVE:         begin
  115                              if (count < max)
  116                                  next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  117                              else
  118                                  next_state  <= END;
  119                          end
  120          END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  121          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  122      endcase
  123  end
  124  
  125  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  126  begin
  127      if (~rst_n)
  128          data_in_d0      <= 64'b0;
  129      else
  130          data_in_d0      <= data_in;
  131  end
  132  
  133  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  134  begin
  135      if (~rst_n)
  136          Q   <= SEED_INIT;
  137      else if (state == ACTIVE)
  138          Q   <= D;
  139      else
  140          Q   <= SEED_INIT;
  141  end
  142  
  143  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  144  begin
  145      if (~rst_n)
  146          scr_out     <= 64'd0;
  147      else if (state == ACTIVE)
  148          scr_out     <= data_in_d0 ^ S;
  149      else
  150          scr_out     <= 64'd0;
  151  end
  152  
  153  /* 
  154     [Legacy 65-bit B[0]..B[64] expansion retained in revision history; 
  155      replaced by 25-bit step_prbs25_64 function above per SDA OISL Table 2-17]
  156  */
  157  
  158  assign  flag        = (count != 0);
  159  assign  data_out    = (flag) ? scr_out : 64'b0;
  160  
  161  endmodule
sources_1/new/encoder/x_gth_logic.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 1 (CDC 1) Subsystem.
    7                 Bridges the high-speed 312.5 MHz GTH TX domain from the 
    8                 SDA Framer to the 200 MHz Baseband Logic domain.
    9  
   10                 Key Features & Revisions:
   11                 1. Asymmetric Bus Width: Converts 32-bit payload (312.5 MHz) 
   12                    to 64-bit payload (200 MHz) using Xilinx Independent Clock 
   13                    FIFO primitives to maintain high-throughput math pipeline.
   14                 2. Smart Trigger: Replaced fragile pulse synchronization with 
   15                    reliable FIFO 'empty' flag monitoring. This ensures 
   16                    Zero-Gap continuous streams are processed seamlessly.
   17                 3. Backpressure Mechanism: Outputs a 'cdc_ready' signal 
   18                    derived from FIFO 'full' flags. This throttles the upstream 
   19                    Framer, preventing throughput collisions and memory overflows.
   20                 4. Multi-Frame Continuous Read & 10G Pacing Alignment:
   21                    Aligned 'max_head' (25) and 'max_load' (404) with FIFO read 
   22                    latency so 'rd_head' pops strictly 16 bytes and 'rd_load' pops 
   23                    strictly 239 words per frame.
   24                 5. [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST - Target B2 Audit Fix]:
   25                    Aligned 'header_dv' and 'payload_dv' with C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2.
   26                 6. [Rev 2.1 - 2026-10-28 13:56 KST - Internal Audit Fix #6]:
   27                    Added a modulo-25 fractional cycle accumulator (frame_mod25_cnt)
   28                    that alternates between 499 cycles (2495.0 ns, 18 times out of 25)
   29                    and 498 cycles (2490.0 ns, 7 times out of 25), achieving an exact
   30                    long-term average frame period of:
   31                      (18 * 2495.0 ns + 7 * 2490.0 ns) / 25 = 2493.600 ns
   32                    matching the 3117-Byte @ 10 Gbps optical frame rate with zero drift.
   33  ===========================================================================
   34  */
   35  
   36  module x_gth_logic(
   37      // -------------------------------------------------------
   38      // System Clocks and Reset
   39      // -------------------------------------------------------
   40      input               clk_gth,      // Fast clock from GTH (e.g., 312.5 MHz)
   41      input               clk_logic,    // Slow clock for Baseband (e.g., 200 MHz)
   42      input               rst_n,        // Active-low asynchronous reset
   43      
   44      // -------------------------------------------------------
   45      // Inputs from SDA Framer (Write Domain - 312.5 MHz)
   46      // -------------------------------------------------------
   47      input               en_head,      // Header write enable
   48      input               en_load,      // Payload write enable
   49      input   [7:0]       header_in,    // 8-bit Header data
   50      input   [31:0]      payload_in,   // 32-bit Payload data
   51      
   52      // -------------------------------------------------------
   53      // Output to SDA Framer (Write Domain - 312.5 MHz)
   54      // -------------------------------------------------------
   55      output              cdc_ready,    // Backpressure to throttle Framer
   56  
   57      // -------------------------------------------------------
   58      // Outputs to FEC Encoder (Read Domain - 200 MHz)
   59      // -------------------------------------------------------
   60      output              header_dv,    // Header data valid flag
   61      output  [7:0]       header,       // 8-bit Header data
   62      output              payload_dv,   // Payload data valid flag
   63      output  [63:0]      payload       // Widened 64-bit Payload data
   64  );
   65  
   66      // =======================================================
   67      // TIMING CONSTANTS (Aligned with FEC RS Latency & C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
   68      // =======================================================
   69      parameter   st_head     = 8;
   70      parameter   max_head    = 25;     // count 9..24 (rd_head = 16 pops), count 11..26 (header_dv = 16 cycles)
   71      parameter   st_load     = 164;    // 164 cycles synchronization delay for RS Header
   72      parameter   max_load    = 404;    // count 165..403 (rd_load = 239 pops), count 167..405 (payload_dv = 239 cycles)
   73      parameter   max_frame   = 496;    // Base terminal count (499 cycles = 2495.0 ns; modulated to 495 = 2490.0 ns 7/25 frames)
   74  
   75      reg     [15:0]  count           = 16'd0;
   76      reg     [4:0]   frame_mod25_cnt = 5'd0; // [Rev 2.1] 0..24 fractional pacing counter (498.72 cycles avg = 2493.600 ns)
   77      wire    [15:0]  active_max_frame = (frame_mod25_cnt < 5'd18) ? max_frame : (max_frame - 16'd1);
   78  
   79      parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   80      parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   81      parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   82  
   83      reg     [2:0]   state;
   84      reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   85  
   86      wire    rd_head;
   87      wire    [7:0]   header_out;
   88      wire    rd_load;
   89      wire    [63:0]  payload_out;
   90  
   91      // Internal FIFO Flags
   92      wire    head_empty;
   93      wire    load_empty;
   94      wire    head_full;
   95      wire    load_full;
   96      wire    head_wr_rst_busy;
   97      wire    head_rd_rst_busy;
   98      wire    load_wr_rst_busy;
   99      wire    load_rd_rst_busy;
  100  
  101      // =======================================================
  102      // 1. BACKPRESSURE LOGIC (Write Domain)
  103      // =======================================================
  104      assign cdc_ready = ~(head_full | load_full | head_wr_rst_busy | load_wr_rst_busy);
  105  
  106      // =======================================================
  107      // 2. FINITE STATE MACHINE (Read Domain - clk_logic)
  108      // =======================================================
  109      always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  110          if (~rst_n)
  111              state <= IDLE;
  112          else
  113              state <= next_state;
  114      end
  115  
  116      // Cycle Counter & Modulo-25 Fractional Pacer (Exact 2493.600 ns Average)
  117      always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  118          if (~rst_n) begin
  119              count           <= 16'd0;
  120              frame_mod25_cnt <= 5'd0;
  121          end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  122              count <= count + 1'b1;
  123          end else begin
  124              count <= 16'd0;
  125              if (state == END) begin
  126                  if (frame_mod25_cnt == 5'd24)
  127                      frame_mod25_cnt <= 5'd0;
  128                  else
  129                      frame_mod25_cnt <= frame_mod25_cnt + 5'd1;
  130              end
  131          end
  132      end
  133  
  134      // State Transitions
  135      always @(*) begin
  136          case(state)
  137              IDLE: begin
  138                  if (~head_empty && ~load_empty && ~head_rd_rst_busy && ~load_rd_rst_busy)
  139                      next_state <= ACTIVE;
  140                  else
  141                      next_state <= IDLE;
  142              end
  143              
  144              ACTIVE: begin
  145                  if (count < active_max_frame)
  146                      next_state <= ACTIVE;
  147                  else
  148                      next_state <= END;
  149              end
  150              
  151              END: begin
  152                  next_state <= IDLE;
  153              end
  154              
  155              default: next_state <= IDLE;
  156          endcase
  157      end
  158  
  159      // =======================================================
  160      // 3. FIFO READ GATING & OUTPUT ASSIGNMENTS
  161      // =======================================================
  162      assign  rd_head     = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head && count < max_head);
  163      assign  header_dv   = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head + 2 && count < max_head + 2);
  164      assign  header      = (header_dv) ? header_out : 8'b0;
  165  
  166      assign  rd_load     = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load && count < max_load);
  167      assign  payload_dv  = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load + 2 && count < max_load + 2);
  168      assign  payload     = (payload_dv) ? payload_out : 64'b0;
  169  
  170      // =======================================================
  171      // 4. IP CORE INSTANTIATIONS (Xilinx FIFO Generator)
  172      // =======================================================
  173      cross_gth_logic_head cross_head_inst (
  174          .srst           (~rst_n),
  175          .wr_clk         (clk_gth),
  176          .wr_en          (en_head),
  177          .din            (header_in),
  178          .rd_clk         (clk_logic),
  179          .rd_en          (rd_head),
  180          .dout           (header_out),
  181          .full           (head_full),
  182          .empty          (head_empty),
  183          .wr_rst_busy    (head_wr_rst_busy),
  184          .rd_rst_busy    (head_rd_rst_busy)
  185      );
  186  
  187      cross_gth_logic_load cross_load_inst (
  188          .srst           (~rst_n),
  189          .wr_clk         (clk_gth),
  190          .wr_en          (en_load),
  191          .din            (payload_in),
  192          .rd_clk         (clk_logic),
  193          .rd_en          (rd_load),
  194          .dout           (payload_out),
  195          .full           (load_full),
  196          .empty          (load_empty),
  197          .wr_rst_busy    (load_wr_rst_busy),
  198          .rd_rst_busy    (load_rd_rst_busy)
  199      );
  200  
  201  endmodule
sources_1/new/encoder/x_logic_gth.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : x_logic_gth
    7  Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 2 (CDC 2) & Modulo-4 Byte-Packing Shifter.
    8                 - Bridges the 200.0 MHz 128-bit MUX Gearbox domain to the 
    9                   312.5 MHz 32-bit GTH TX domain via cross_logic_gth FIFO.
   10                 - Strips the 3 trailing zero-padding bytes on the 195th word 
   11                   (cdc_keep == 16'h1FFF -> 13 valid bytes) and seamlessly packs 
   12                   consecutive 3117-Byte frames back-to-back across 32-bit word 
   13                   boundaries (4 frames = 12,468 Bytes = 3117 clocks @ 312.5 MHz, 
   14                   exact 2.493600 us per frame).
   15  
   16  Revision History:
   17    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-to-32 bit CDC 2 with modulo-4 byte barrel shifter.
   18    - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Gray-Code CDC & FIFO Full Protection]
   19      1. Converted cross-domain frame counter (wr_frame_cnt) to Gray Code 
   20         (wr_frame_gray) before the 2-stage synchronizer (marked with 
   21         ASYNC_REG = "TRUE") and decoded Gray-to-Binary in the clk_gth domain 
   22         to eliminate multi-bit binary CDC sampling glitches.
   23      2. Gated FIFO write enable (fifo_wr_en) with !fifo_full & !wr_rst_busy 
   24         and exposed 'cdc2_ready' for lossless upstream flow control.
   25  ===========================================================================
   26  */
   27  
   28  module x_logic_gth (
   29      input  wire         clk_gth,     // 312.5 MHz Read Domain
   30      input  wire         clk_logic,   // 200.0 MHz Write Domain
   31      input  wire         rst_n,
   32      input  wire         en,
   33      input  wire [127:0] data_in,
   34      input  wire         data_in_dv,
   35      input  wire [15:0]  cdc_keep,
   36      output reg          flag,
   37      output reg  [31:0]  data_out
   38  );
   39  
   40      wire        fifo_full;
   41      wire        fifo_empty;
   42      wire        wr_rst_busy;
   43      wire        rd_rst_busy;
   44      wire [31:0] fifo_dout;
   45      wire        cdc2_ready = ~fifo_full & ~wr_rst_busy;
   46  
   47      // =======================================================
   48      // 1. WRITE DOMAIN (200 MHz): FRAME TRACKER & GRAY-CODE CDC
   49      // =======================================================
   50      reg [7:0]  wr_word_idx;
   51      reg [31:0] wr_frame_cnt;
   52      wire       fifo_wr_en = en && data_in_dv && (~fifo_full) && (~wr_rst_busy);
   53  
   54      // Binary-to-Gray conversion in clk_logic domain
   55      wire [31:0] wr_frame_gray_next = wr_frame_cnt ^ (wr_frame_cnt >> 1);
   56      reg  [31:0] wr_frame_gray;
   57  
   58      always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
   59          if (!rst_n) begin
   60              wr_word_idx   <= 8'd0;
   61              wr_frame_cnt  <= 32'd0;
   62              wr_frame_gray <= 32'd0;
   63          end else begin
   64              wr_frame_gray <= wr_frame_gray_next;
   65              if (fifo_wr_en) begin
   66                  if ((cdc_keep == 16'h1FFF) || (wr_word_idx == 8'd194)) begin
   67                      wr_word_idx  <= 8'd0;
   68                      wr_frame_cnt <= wr_frame_cnt + 32'd1;
   69                  end else begin
   70                      wr_word_idx  <= wr_word_idx + 8'd1;
   71                  end
   72              end else if (!data_in_dv) begin
   73                  wr_word_idx <= 8'd0;
   74              end
   75          end
   76      end
   77  
   78      // 2-Stage Gray-Code Synchronizer into clk_gth (312.5 MHz) Domain
   79      (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [31:0] wr_frame_gray_sync1;
   80      (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [31:0] wr_frame_gray_sync2;
   81  
   82      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   83          if (!rst_n) begin
   84              wr_frame_gray_sync1 <= 32'd0;
   85              wr_frame_gray_sync2 <= 32'd0;
   86          end else begin
   87              wr_frame_gray_sync1 <= wr_frame_gray;
   88              wr_frame_gray_sync2 <= wr_frame_gray_sync1;
   89          end
   90      end
   91  
   92      // Gray-to-Binary conversion in clk_gth domain
   93      function [31:0] gray2bin32(input [31:0] g);
   94          integer k;
   95          reg [31:0] b;
   96          begin
   97              b[31] = g[31];
   98              for (k = 30; k >= 0; k = k - 1) begin
   99                  b[k] = b[k + 1] ^ g[k];
  100              end
  101              gray2bin32 = b;
  102          end
  103      endfunction
  104  
  105      wire [31:0] wr_frame_cnt_gth = gray2bin32(wr_frame_gray_sync2);
  106  
  107      // =======================================================
  108      // 2. ASYNCHRONOUS FIFO (128-bit @ 200M -> 32-bit @ 312.5M)
  109      // =======================================================
  110      reg  [11:0] pop_word_idx;
  111      wire         need_word;
  112      wire        fifo_rd_en = (~fifo_empty) && (~rd_rst_busy) && need_word;
  113  
  114      cross_logic_gth u_async_fifo (
  115          .srst        (~rst_n),
  116          .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  117          .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  118          .din         (data_in),
  119          .wr_en       (fifo_wr_en),
  120          .rd_en       (fifo_rd_en),
  121          .dout        (fifo_dout),
  122          .full        (fifo_full),
  123          .empty       (fifo_empty),
  124          .wr_rst_busy (wr_rst_busy),
  125          .rd_rst_busy (rd_rst_busy)
  126      );
  127  
  128      // =======================================================
  129      // 3. READ DOMAIN (312.5 MHz): 3117-BYTE BARREL SHIFTER
  130      // =======================================================
  131      reg  [1:0]  pipe_valid;
  132      reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_0;
  133      reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_1;
  134      wire [2:0]  popped_valid_bytes = (pop_word_idx == 12'd779) ? 3'd1 : 3'd4;
  135  
  136      reg  [95:0] shift_reg;
  137      reg  [4:0]  avail_bytes;
  138      reg         stream_active;
  139      reg  [31:0] rd_frame_cnt;
  140      reg  [11:0] rd_frame_bytes;
  141  
  142      wire        has_4_bytes    = (avail_bytes >= 5'd4);
  143      wire        is_final_flush = stream_active && (rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1 >= wr_frame_cnt_gth) &&
  144                                   fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) &&
  145                                   (avail_bytes > 5'd0) && (avail_bytes < 5'd4);
  146      wire [4:0]  bytes_consumed = has_4_bytes ? 5'd4 : (is_final_flush ? avail_bytes : 5'd0);
  147      wire [4:0]  next_avail_pre = avail_bytes - bytes_consumed;
  148  
  149      assign need_word = stream_active && (avail_bytes <= 5'd8);
  150  
  151      wire [95:0] shifted_reg    = shift_reg << (bytes_consumed * 8);
  152      wire [95:0] incoming_alg   = ({fifo_dout, 64'd0} &
  153                                    ((pipe_bytes_1 == 3'd1) ? 96'hFF00_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000 :
  154                                                              96'hFFFF_FFFF_0000_0000_0000_0000))
  155                                   >> (next_avail_pre * 8);
  156  
  157      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  158          if (!rst_n) begin
  159              pop_word_idx   <= 12'd0;
  160              pipe_valid     <= 2'b00;
  161              pipe_bytes_0   <= 3'd0;
  162              pipe_bytes_1   <= 3'd0;
  163              shift_reg      <= 96'd0;
  164              avail_bytes    <= 5'd0;
  165              stream_active  <= 1'b0;
  166              rd_frame_cnt   <= 32'd0;
  167              rd_frame_bytes <= 12'd0;
  168              flag           <= 1'b0;
  169              data_out       <= 32'd0;
  170          end else begin
  171              // 2-Cycle FIFO Read Pipeline (C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
  172              pipe_valid[0] <= fifo_rd_en;
  173              pipe_valid[1] <= pipe_valid[0];
  174              pipe_bytes_0  <= fifo_rd_en ? popped_valid_bytes : 3'd0;
  175              pipe_bytes_1  <= pipe_bytes_0;
  176  
  177              if (fifo_rd_en) begin
  178                  if (pop_word_idx == 12'd779)
  179                      pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  180                  else
  181                      pop_word_idx <= pop_word_idx + 12'd1;
  182              end else if (!stream_active && fifo_empty) begin
  183                  pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  184              end
  185  
  186              // Start streaming once at least 1 complete frame is buffered in FIFO
  187              if (!stream_active) begin
  188                  if (wr_frame_cnt_gth > rd_frame_cnt) begin
  189                      stream_active <= 1'b1;
  190                  end
  191                  flag     <= 1'b0;
  192                  data_out <= 32'd0;
  193              end else begin
  194                  if (has_4_bytes || is_final_flush) begin
  195                      flag     <= 1'b1;
  196                      data_out <= shift_reg[95:64];
  197                      if (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed} >= 12'd3117) begin
  198                          rd_frame_bytes <= (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed}) - 12'd3117;
  199                          rd_frame_cnt   <= rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1;
  200                      end else begin
  201                          rd_frame_bytes <= rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed};
  202                      end
  203                  end else begin
  204                      flag     <= 1'b0;
  205                      data_out <= 32'd0;
  206                      if (fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) && (avail_bytes == 5'd0)) begin
  207                          stream_active <= 1'b0;
  208                      end
  209                  end
  210              end
  211  
  212              // Update Barrel Shifter
  213              if (pipe_valid[1]) begin
  214                  shift_reg   <= shifted_reg | incoming_alg;
  215                  avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre + {2'd0, pipe_bytes_1};
  216              end else begin
  217                  shift_reg   <= shifted_reg;
  218                  avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre;
  219              end
  220          end
  221      end
  222  
  223      // =======================================================
  224      // 4. SUB-CYCLE 0.8 NS BYTE & FRAME TRACKERS (For Waveform)
  225      // =======================================================
  226      reg [7:0]  byte_out;
  227      reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  228      reg [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;
  229      reg [31:0] frame_out_id;
  230  
  231  `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  232      integer b_sub;
  233      reg [31:0] cur_w;
  234      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  235          if (!rst_n) begin
  236              byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  237              out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  238              frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  239              frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  240          end else begin
  241              #0.001;
  242              if (flag) begin
  243                  cur_w = data_out;
  244                  if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  245                      frame_out_id   = 32'd1;
  246                      out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  247                      frame_byte_cnt = 12'd0;
  248                  end else begin
  249                      out_clk_cnt    = out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  250                  end
  251  
  252                  for (b_sub = 0; b_sub < 4; b_sub = b_sub + 1) begin
  253                      if (b_sub > 0) #(0.8);
  254                      byte_out = cur_w[31 - (b_sub * 8) -: 8];
  255                      if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  256                          frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  257                          frame_out_id   = frame_out_id + 32'd1;
  258                          out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  259                      end else begin
  260                          frame_byte_cnt = frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  261                      end
  262                  end
  263              end else begin
  264                  byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  265                  out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  266                  frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  267                  frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  268              end
  269          end
  270      end
  271  `else
  272      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  273          if (!rst_n) begin
  274              byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  275              out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  276              frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  277              frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  278          end else if (flag) begin
  279              byte_out       <= data_out[31:24];
  280              out_clk_cnt    <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  281              frame_byte_cnt <= (frame_byte_cnt >= 12'd3114) ? 12'd3117 : (frame_byte_cnt + 12'd4);
  282              if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) frame_out_id <= 32'd1;
  283          end else begin
  284              byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  285              out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  286              frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  287              frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  288          end
  289      end
  290  `endif
  291  
  292  endmodule

sources_1/new/error_inject.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: 
    4  // Engineer: 
    5  // 
    6  // Create Date: 11/19/2025 06:26:34 PM
    7  // Design Name: 
    8  // Module Name: error_inject
    9  // Project Name: 
   10  // Target Devices: 
   11  // Tool Versions: 
   12  // Description: 
   13  // 
   14  // Dependencies: 
   15  // 
   16  // Revision:
   17  // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18  // Additional Comments:
   19  // Revision 0.02 - Continuous 312.5 MHz 3117-Byte Stream & Dual-Mode VOA Support:
   20  //   - Operates on the continuous 312.5 MHz (3.2 ns period, 0.8 ns/byte) stream 
   21  //     exiting CDC 2 so every 3117-Byte frame has an exact duration of 2.4936 us.
   22  //   - SIM_MODE = 1: XORs 48 payload words per frame using 'error.mem' while 
   23  //     protecting the first 15 words (60B = 9B Preamble + 48B Header LPC + 3B).
   24  //   - SIM_MODE = 0: Clean bypass for physical testing with Manual VOA /t49G/51.
   25  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   26  
   27  module error_inject #(
   28      parameter   SIM_MODE    = 1,
   29      parameter   safe_words  = 15,
   30      parameter   max_error   = 47,
   31      parameter   max_pad     = 1035 - max_error
   32  )(
   33      input               clk,        // 312.5 MHz Continuous Clock
   34      input               rst_n,
   35      input               en,         // Continuous valid flag from CDC 2
   36      input   [31:0]      data_in,    // Continuous 32-bit stream from CDC 2
   37      output              flag,       // Continuous valid flag to gth64b66b_tx
   38      output  [31:0]      data_out    // 32-bit stream to gth64b66b_tx
   39  );
   40  
   41  reg     [31:0]      error   [0:max_error];
   42  reg     [15:0]      con_error   = 16'd0;
   43  reg     [15:0]      con_pad     = 16'd0;
   44  
   45  initial
   46      $readmemh("error.mem", error);
   47  
   48  parameter   IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   49  parameter   ERROR       = 4'b0010;
   50  parameter   PAD         = 4'b0100;
   51  parameter   END         = 4'b1000;
   52  
   53  reg     [3:0]   state;
   54  reg     [3:0]   next_state;
   55  
   56  reg     [31:0]      data_d0;
   57  reg     [31:0]      error_out;
   58  
   59  reg                 en_d0;
   60  reg                 en_d1;
   61  reg     [11:0]      frame_byte_acc;
   62  reg     [15:0]      frame_word_idx;
   63  wire                frame_wrap_now = en_d0 && (frame_byte_acc + 12'd4 >= 12'd3117);
   64  
   65  wire    [31:0]      active_err_mask = ((SIM_MODE == 1) && (state == ERROR)) ? error[con_error] : 32'd0;
   66  reg     [31:0]      applied_mask;
   67  
   68  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   69  begin
   70      if (~rst_n)
   71          state   <= IDLE;
   72      else
   73          state   <= next_state;
   74  end
   75  
   76  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   77  begin
   78      if (~rst_n) begin
   79          frame_byte_acc <= 12'd0;
   80          frame_word_idx <= 16'd0;
   81      end else if (en_d0) begin
   82          if (frame_byte_acc + 12'd4 >= 12'd3117) begin
   83              frame_byte_acc <= (frame_byte_acc + 12'd4) - 12'd3117;
   84              frame_word_idx <= 16'd0;
   85          end else begin
   86              frame_byte_acc <= frame_byte_acc + 12'd4;
   87              frame_word_idx <= frame_word_idx + 16'd1;
   88          end
   89      end else begin
   90          frame_byte_acc <= 12'd0;
   91          frame_word_idx <= 16'd0;
   92      end
   93  end
   94  
   95  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   96  begin
   97      if (~rst_n)
   98          con_error   <= 16'd0;
   99      else if (state == ERROR)
  100          con_error   <= con_error + 1'b1;
  101      else
  102          con_error   <= 16'd0;
  103  end
  104  
  105  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  106  begin
  107      if (~rst_n)
  108          con_pad   <= 16'd0;
  109      else if (state == PAD && !frame_wrap_now)
  110          con_pad   <= con_pad + 1'b1;
  111      else
  112          con_pad   <= 16'd0;
  113  end
  114  
  115  always @(*)
  116  begin
  117      case(state)
  118          IDLE:           begin
  119                              if (en_d0 && (frame_word_idx == safe_words - 1))
  120                                  next_state  <= ERROR;
  121                              else
  122                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
  123                          end
  124          ERROR:          begin
  125                              if (!en_d0)
  126                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
  127                              else if (con_error < max_error)
  128                                  next_state  <= ERROR;
  129                              else
  130                                  next_state  <= PAD;
  131                          end
  132          PAD:            begin
  133                              if (!en_d0)
  134                                  next_state  <= END;
  135                              else if (frame_wrap_now)
  136                                  next_state  <= IDLE;
  137                              else
  138                                  next_state  <= PAD;
  139                          end
  140          END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  141          default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  142      endcase
  143  end
  144  
  145  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  146  begin
  147      if (~rst_n) begin
  148          data_d0 <= 32'b0;
  149          en_d0   <= 1'b0;
  150          en_d1   <= 1'b0;
  151      end else begin
  152          data_d0 <= data_in;
  153          en_d0   <= en;
  154          en_d1   <= en_d0;
  155      end
  156  end
  157  
  158  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  159  begin
  160      if (~rst_n) begin
  161          error_out    <= 32'b0;
  162          applied_mask <= 32'b0;
  163      end else if (en_d0) begin
  164          error_out    <= active_err_mask ^ data_d0;
  165          applied_mask <= active_err_mask;
  166      end else begin
  167          error_out    <= 32'b0;
  168          applied_mask <= 32'b0;
  169      end
  170  end
  171  
  172  assign  flag        = en_d1;
  173  assign  data_out    = (flag) ? error_out : 32'b0;
  174  
  175  // synthesis translate_off
  176  reg  [7:0]  byte_out;
  177  reg  [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;
  178  reg  [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  179  reg  [31:0] frame_out_id;
  180  reg  [31:0] cur_word;
  181  reg  [15:0] corrupted_word_cnt;
  182  
  183  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  184      if (~rst_n)
  185          corrupted_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
  186      else if (en_d1) begin
  187          if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd1 && out_clk_cnt == 16'd1)
  188              corrupted_word_cnt <= (applied_mask != 32'd0) ? 16'd1 : 16'd0;
  189          else if (applied_mask != 32'd0)
  190              corrupted_word_cnt <= corrupted_word_cnt + 16'd1;
  191      end else begin
  192          corrupted_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
  193      end
  194  end
  195  
  196  task step_single_byte(input [7:0] b_val, input is_clk_rising);
  197  begin
  198      byte_out <= b_val;
  199      if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  200          frame_out_id   <= 32'd1;
  201          frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd1;
  202          out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd1;
  203      end else if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  204          frame_out_id   <= frame_out_id + 1'b1;
  205          frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd1;
  206          out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd1;
  207      end else begin
  208          frame_byte_cnt <= frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  209          if (is_clk_rising)
  210              out_clk_cnt <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  211      end
  212  end
  213  endtask
  214  
  215  always @(negedge rst_n) begin
  216      if (~rst_n) begin
  217          byte_out       <= 8'd0;
  218          frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  219          out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  220          frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  221          cur_word       <= 32'd0;
  222      end
  223  end
  224  
  225  always @(posedge clk) begin
  226      if (rst_n) begin
  227          if (en_d0) begin
  228              cur_word = active_err_mask ^ data_d0;
  229              step_single_byte(cur_word[31:24], 1'b1);
  230              #0.8 step_single_byte(cur_word[23:16], 1'b0);
  231              #0.8 step_single_byte(cur_word[15:8],  1'b0);
  232              #0.8 step_single_byte(cur_word[7:0],   1'b0);
  233          end else begin
  234              byte_out       <= 8'd0;
  235              frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  236              out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  237              frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  238          end
  239      end
  240  end
  241  // synthesis translate_on
  242  
  243  endmodule
sources_1/new/error_inject_hotswap.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  
    3  module error_inject_hotswap #(
    4      parameter MAX_ERROR = 47
    5  )(
    6      input  wire        clk,
    7      input  wire        rst_n,
    8      input  wire        en,
    9      input  wire [31:0] data_in,
   10      output wire [31:0] data_out,
   11      output wire        flag
   12  );
   13  
   14      reg [31:0] error_mem [0:MAX_ERROR];
   15      reg [15:0] err_counter;
   16  
   17      initial begin
   18          $readmemh("error.mem", error_mem);
   19      end
   20  
   21      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   22          if (!rst_n) begin
   23              err_counter <= 16'd0;
   24          end else begin
   25              if (en) begin
   26                  if (err_counter < MAX_ERROR)
   27                      err_counter <= err_counter + 1'b1;
   28              end else begin
   29                  err_counter <= 16'd0;
   30              end
   31          end
   32      end
   33  
   34      wire inject_active = (en && (err_counter <= MAX_ERROR));
   35      assign data_out = (en) ? (inject_active ? (data_in ^ error_mem[err_counter]) : data_in) : 32'd0;
   36      assign flag     = inject_active;
   37  
   38  endmodule
sources_1/new/eth_axis_packet_gen.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : Dynamic AXI4-Stream Ethernet Packet Generator.
    7                 Features:
    8                 - Dynamically adjustable frame size via input port.
    9                 - Generates standard Ethernet Headers (MAC, IPv4, UDP).
   10                 - Appends custom payload and simulated FCS (0xDEADBEEF).
   11  ===========================================================================
   12  */
   13  
   14  module eth_axis_packet_gen #(
   15      // --- Header Configuration ---
   16      parameter [47:0] DEST_MAC = 48'hAA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF, 
   17      parameter [47:0] SRC_MAC  = 48'h11_22_33_44_55_66, 
   18      parameter [31:0] SRC_IP   = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd10, 8'd1}, 
   19      parameter [31:0] DEST_IP  = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd10, 8'd2}, 
   20      
   21      // --- Custom Marker Payload ---
   22      parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_1 = 32'h4B_6F_6F_6B, // ASCII "Kook"
   23      parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_2 = 32'h6D_69_6E_20, // ASCII "min "
   24      parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_3 = 32'h46_53_4F_20  // ASCII "FSO "
   25  )(
   26      input  wire        clk,
   27      input  wire        rst_n,
   28      input  wire        trigger,           // Trigger 1 cycle HIGH to fire
   29      input  wire [15:0] frame_size_bytes,  // Target size (e.g., 2000 for Jumbo)
   30      
   31      // --- AXI4-Stream Output ---
   32      output reg [31:0]  m_axis_tdata,
   33      output reg [3:0]   m_axis_tkeep,
   34      output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   35      output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   36      input  wire        m_axis_tready
   37  );
   38  
   39      localparam S_IDLE = 2'd0, S_DATA = 2'd1, S_DONE = 2'd2;
   40  
   41      reg [1:0]  state;
   42      reg [15:0] word_count; 
   43      reg [15:0] total_words;
   44  
   45      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   46          if (~rst_n) begin
   47              state         <= S_IDLE;
   48              m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   49              m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'd0;
   50              m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   51              m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   52              word_count    <= 16'd0;
   53              total_words   <= 16'd0;
   54          end else begin
   55              case (state)
   56                  S_IDLE: begin
   57                      m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   58                      m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   59                      word_count    <= 16'd0;
   60                      if (trigger) begin
   61                          // Convert bytes to 32-bit words (divide by 4)
   62                          total_words <= frame_size_bytes >> 2; 
   63                          state       <= S_DATA;
   64                      end
   65                  end
   66  
   67                  S_DATA: begin
   68                      // Backpressure control: only advance if receiver is ready
   69                      if (m_axis_tready || !m_axis_tvalid) begin
   70                          m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   71                          m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'hF; // All 4 bytes valid
   72  
   73                          // Packet Assembly Multiplexer
   74                          case (word_count)
   75                              // Ethernet MAC Header
   76                              16'd0: m_axis_tdata <= DEST_MAC[47:16]; 
   77                              16'd1: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_MAC[15:0], SRC_MAC[47:32]};
   78                              16'd2: m_axis_tdata <= SRC_MAC[31:0];
   79                              16'd3: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType (IPv4) + IP Header
   80                              
   81                              // IP & UDP Headers
   82                              16'd4: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h002E_0000; 
   83                              16'd5: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h4000_4011; // Protocol UDP
   84                              16'd6: m_axis_tdata <= {16'h0000, SRC_IP[31:16]}; 
   85                              16'd7: m_axis_tdata <= {SRC_IP[15:0], DEST_IP[31:16]}; 
   86                              16'd8: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_IP[15:0], 16'h1234}; 
   87                              
   88                              // Payload Data
   89                              16'd9:  m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_1; 
   90                              16'd10: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_2; 
   91                              16'd11: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_3; 
   92                              
   93                              // End of Frame & Padding
   94                              (total_words - 1): m_axis_tdata <= 32'hDEADBEEF; // Simulated FCS
   95                              default: m_axis_tdata <= {16'hAAAA, word_count}; // Dummy Jumbo Data
   96                          endcase
   97  
   98                          // Frame termination logic
   99                          if (word_count == (total_words - 1)) begin
  100                              m_axis_tlast <= 1'b1;
  101                              state        <= S_DONE;
  102                          end else begin
  103                              m_axis_tlast <= 1'b0;
  104                              word_count   <= word_count + 1'b1;
  105                          end
  106                      end
  107                  end
  108  
  109                  S_DONE: begin
  110                      // Wait for last word to be accepted
  111                      if (m_axis_tready && m_axis_tvalid) begin
  112                          m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  113                          m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  114                          state         <= S_IDLE;
  115                      end
  116                  end
  117              endcase
  118          end
  119      end
  120  endmodule
sources_1/new/eth_mac_packing_tx.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : eth_mac_packing_tx
    7  Description  : Dynamic Ethernet MAC Transmit Stream Packer.
    8                 Forwards variable-length Ethernet frames (including the 8-Byte
    9                 Preamble, e.g., 502 cycles = 2008 Bytes for a 2000-Byte Jumbo 
   10                 packet, or 18 cycles = 72 Bytes for a 64-Byte Mini packet) 
   11                 from mux_eth_32 to xgmii_tx_formatter while tracking active 
   12                 word and byte counts per packet.
   13                 
   14                 Revision Notes:
   15                 - Removed the hardcoded 483-cycle (1930-Byte) truncation limit 
   16                   so full 2008-Byte Jumbo frames pass through without loss.
   17  ===========================================================================
   18  */
   19  
   20  module eth_mac_packing_tx #(
   21      parameter MAX_SAFE_WORDS = 16'd4096 // Up to 16 KB Super-Jumbo safety ceiling
   22  )(
   23      input  wire        clk,
   24      input  wire        rst_n,
   25      input  wire [31:0] mux_data,
   26      input  wire        mux_valid,
   27      output wire [31:0] pack_data,
   28      output wire        pack_valid,
   29      output reg  [15:0] tx_word_cnt,
   30      output reg  [15:0] tx_byte_cnt
   31  );
   32  
   33      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   34          if (!rst_n) begin
   35              tx_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
   36              tx_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
   37          end else begin
   38              if (mux_valid) begin
   39                  if (tx_word_cnt < MAX_SAFE_WORDS) begin
   40                      tx_word_cnt <= tx_word_cnt + 16'd1;
   41                      tx_byte_cnt <= tx_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
   42                  end
   43              end else begin
   44                  tx_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
   45                  tx_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
   46              end
   47          end
   48      end
   49  
   50      assign pack_valid = mux_valid && (tx_word_cnt < MAX_SAFE_WORDS);
   51      assign pack_data  = pack_valid ? mux_data : 32'd0;
   52  
   53  endmodule
sources_1/new/eth_mac_segmenter.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  
    3  module eth_mac_segmenter(
    4      input  wire        clk,
    5      input  wire        rst_n,
    6      input  wire [31:0] mac_data,
    7      input  wire        mac_valid,
    8      output reg  [31:0] payload_data,
    9      output reg         payload_en
   10  );
   11      // 1908 Byte = 477 siklus (32-bit)
   12      localparam MAX_CYCLES = 16'd477;
   13  
   14      localparam IDLE = 2'd0;
   15      localparam SEND = 2'd1;
   16      localparam PAD  = 2'd2;
   17  
   18      reg [1:0]  state;
   19      reg [15:0] cycle_count;
   20  
   21      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   22          if (!rst_n) begin
   23              state        <= IDLE;
   24              cycle_count  <= 16'd0;
   25              payload_data <= 32'd0;
   26              payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   27          end else begin
   28              case (state)
   29                  IDLE: begin
   30                      cycle_count <= 16'd0;
   31                      if (mac_valid) begin
   32                          state        <= SEND;
   33                          payload_data <= mac_data;
   34                          payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   35                          cycle_count  <= 16'd1;
   36                      end else begin
   37                          payload_data <= 32'd0;
   38                          payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   39                      end
   40                  end
   41  
   42                  SEND: begin
   43                      if (cycle_count == MAX_CYCLES) begin
   44                          if (!mac_valid) begin
   45                              state        <= IDLE;
   46                              payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   47                              cycle_count  <= 16'd0;
   48                          end else begin
   49                              payload_data <= mac_data;
   50                              payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   51                              cycle_count  <= 16'd1;
   52                          end
   53                      end 
   54                      else if (!mac_valid) begin
   55                          state        <= PAD;
   56                          payload_data <= 32'd0;
   57                          payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   58                          cycle_count  <= cycle_count + 1'b1;
   59                      end 
   60                      else begin
   61                          payload_data <= mac_data;
   62                          payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   63                          cycle_count  <= cycle_count + 1'b1;
   64                      end
   65                  end
   66  
   67                  PAD: begin
   68                      // LOGIKA ANTI-STUCK: Gunakan >= dan force reset
   69                      if (cycle_count >= MAX_CYCLES) begin
   70                          state        <= IDLE;
   71                          payload_data <= 32'd0;
   72                          payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   73                          cycle_count  <= 16'd0;
   74                      end else begin
   75                          payload_data <= 32'd0;
   76                          payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   77                          cycle_count  <= cycle_count + 1'b1;
   78                      end
   79                  end
   80              endcase
   81          end
   82      end
   83  endmodule
sources_1/new/eth_preamble_gen.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : eth_preamble_gen
    7  Description  : IEEE 802.3 Ethernet Preamble and Start Frame Delimiter (SFD)
    8                 Constant Generator. Outputs the standard 8-Byte (64-bit) 
    9                 synchronization pattern (7 Bytes of 0x55 followed by 1 Byte 
   10                 of 0xD5) for prepending to reassembled Ethernet packets.
   11  ===========================================================================
   12  */
   13  
   14  module eth_preamble_gen (
   15      output wire [63:0] preamble_sfd
   16  );
   17  
   18      // 7-Byte Ethernet Preamble (55_55_55_55_55_55_55) + 1-Byte SFD (D5)
   19      // Word 1 [63:32] : 32'h5555_5555 (Transmitted on Preamble Cycle 1)
   20      // Word 2 [31:0]  : 32'h5555_55D5 (Transmitted on Preamble Cycle 2)
   21      assign preamble_sfd = 64'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   22  
   23  endmodule
sources_1/new/eth_preamble_remover.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : eth_preamble_remover
    7  Description  : 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble & SFD (0x55555555_555555D5) Stripper.
    8                 Strips the first 2 words (8 Bytes) of each incoming framed 
    9                 XGMII packet and forwards the clean MAC frame to 
   10                 packaging_and_segmentation.v.
   11  
   12  Revision History:
   13    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 2-word Ethernet Preamble & SFD stripper.
   14    - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 16:42 KST) : [Audit Fix R12 - Valid Byte Count Propagation]
   15      Added 's_axis_tkeep_bytes' and 'm_axis_tkeep_bytes' [2:0] ports to forward the 
   16      exact valid byte count (1..4) of each word to packaging_and_segmentation.v.
   17  ===========================================================================
   18  */
   19  
   20  module eth_preamble_remover (
   21      input  wire        clk,
   22      input  wire        rst_n,
   23  
   24      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   25      input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   26      input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   27      output wire        s_axis_tready,
   28      input  wire [2:0]  s_axis_tkeep_bytes,
   29  
   30      output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   31      output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   32      output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   33      input  wire        m_axis_tready,
   34      output reg  [2:0]  m_axis_tkeep_bytes
   35  );
   36  
   37      assign s_axis_tready = m_axis_tready;
   38  
   39      reg [1:0] word_cnt;
   40      wire [2:0] safe_in_bytes = ((^s_axis_tkeep_bytes === 1'bx) || (s_axis_tkeep_bytes == 3'd0)) ?
   41                                 3'd4 : s_axis_tkeep_bytes;
   42  
   43      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   44          if (!rst_n) begin
   45              word_cnt           <= 2'd0;
   46              m_axis_tdata       <= 32'd0;
   47              m_axis_tvalid      <= 1'b0;
   48              m_axis_tlast       <= 1'b0;
   49              m_axis_tkeep_bytes <= 3'd4;
   50          end else begin
   51              if (s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready) begin
   52                  if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   53                      word_cnt <= 2'd0;
   54                  end else if (word_cnt < 2'd2) begin
   55                      word_cnt <= word_cnt + 2'd1;
   56                  end
   57  
   58                  // Strip Word 0 (0x55555555) and Word 1 (0xD5555555)
   59                  if (word_cnt == 2'd2) begin
   60                      m_axis_tdata       <= s_axis_tdata;
   61                      m_axis_tvalid      <= 1'b1;
   62                      m_axis_tlast       <= s_axis_tlast;
   63                      m_axis_tkeep_bytes <= safe_in_bytes;
   64                  end else begin
   65                      m_axis_tdata       <= 32'd0;
   66                      m_axis_tvalid      <= 1'b0;
   67                      m_axis_tlast       <= 1'b0;
   68                      m_axis_tkeep_bytes <= 3'd4;
   69                  end
   70              end else if (m_axis_tready) begin
   71                  m_axis_tvalid      <= 1'b0;
   72                  m_axis_tlast       <= 1'b0;
   73                  m_axis_tkeep_bytes <= 3'd4;
   74              end
   75          end
   76      end
   77  
   78  endmodule
sources_1/new/eth_rx_front_end_top.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : eth_rx_front_end_top
    7  Description  : Top-Level 10G Ethernet Receive Front-End (Ingress from PC 1).
    8                 Integrates the 10G Ethernet PCS/PMA RX IP Core, 32-bit XGMII 
    9                 Parser, Ethernet Preamble & SFD Remover, and Fixed 1900-Byte 
   10                 FSO Payload Packaging & Segmentation unit.
   11  
   12                 Revision Notes:
   13                 1. Preserved all original architecture descriptions.
   14                 2. Wrapped eth_10g_pcs_pma_rx_0 inside a generate block 
   15                    controlled by RUN_MODE (1 = Simulation / XGMII Direct Input, 
   16                    0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode).
   17                 3. Matched exact port connections on u_rx_parser 
   18                    (xgmii_rx_parser) and physical_mac_rx_inst 
   19                    (eth_10g_pcs_pma_rx_0 with DRP loopback and 
   20                    configuration_vector) so both SIM_MODE=1 and SIM_MODE=0 
   21                    synthesize cleanly without [Synth 8-11365].
   22                 4. [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST]: Exported 'seg_valid_bytes'
   23                    output port to propagate exact ingress packet/segment 
   24                    byte length metadata to sda_encoder.
   25                 5. [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 16:42 KST - Audit Fix R12]: Connected 
   26                    3-bit valid byte count ('parsed_tkeep_bytes' and 
   27                    'clean_mac_tkeep_bytes') from u_rx_parser -> u_preamble_remover 
   28                    -> u_segmenter for byte-accurate non-multiple-of-4 packets.
   29                 6. [Rev 2.8 - 2026-10-30 11:30 KST - Audit Fix A18]: Standardized 
   30                    'seg_valid_bytes' output port width to 14 bits ([13:0]) to 
   31                    match packaging_and_segmentation.v and downstream modules 
   32                    with zero width-mismatch warnings.
   33  ===========================================================================
   34  */
   35  
   36  module eth_rx_front_end_top #(
   37      parameter RUN_MODE = 1 // 1 = Simulation / XGMII Direct Mode, 0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode
   38  )(
   39      input  wire        clk,             // 312.5 MHz Clock
   40      input  wire        rst_n,           // Active-low reset
   41  
   42      // Direct XGMII Input (Used when RUN_MODE == 1)
   43      input  wire [31:0] xgmii_rxd,
   44      input  wire [3:0]  xgmii_rxc,
   45  
   46      // Segmented 1900-Byte FSO Payload Stream & 14-Bit Length Metadata Output to sda_encoder
   47      output wire [31:0] fso_data_out,
   48      output wire        fso_valid,
   49      output wire        fso_last,
   50      input  wire        fso_ready,
   51      output wire [13:0] seg_valid_bytes,
   52  
   53      // Physical SFP+ & Clocking Ports for 10G PCS/PMA RX IP Core
   54      input  wire        refclk_p,
   55      input  wire        refclk_n,
   56      input  wire        reset,
   57      input  wire        dclk,
   58      input  wire        rxp,
   59      input  wire        rxn
   60  );
   61  
   62      wire [31:0] active_xgmii_rxd;
   63      wire [3:0]  active_xgmii_rxc;
   64  
   65      generate
   66          if (RUN_MODE == 0) begin : gen_hw_eth_phy_rx
   67              wire [31:0] phy_xgmii_rxd;
   68              wire [3:0]  phy_xgmii_rxc;
   69              wire        txp_unused, txn_unused;
   70              wire        drp_gnt_w;
   71              wire        drp_den_w;
   72              wire        drp_dwe_w;
   73              wire [15:0] drp_daddr_w;
   74              wire [15:0] drp_di_w;
   75              wire        drp_drdy_w;
   76              wire [15:0] drp_drpdo_w;
   77  
   78              eth_10g_pcs_pma_rx_0 physical_mac_rx_inst (
   79                  .dclk                   (dclk),
   80                  .rxrecclk_out           (),
   81                  .refclk_p               (refclk_p),
   82                  .refclk_n               (refclk_n),
   83                  .sim_speedup_control    (1'b0),
   84                  .coreclk_out            (),
   85                  .qplloutclk_out         (),
   86                  .qplloutrefclk_out      (),
   87                  .qplllock_out           (),
   88                  .txusrclk_out           (),
   89                  .txusrclk2_out          (),
   90                  .areset_datapathclk_out (),
   91                  .gttxreset_out          (),
   92                  .gtrxreset_out          (),
   93                  .txuserrdy_out          (),
   94                  .reset_counter_done_out (),
   95                  .reset                  (reset),
   96                  .xgmii_txd              (32'h0707_0707),
   97                  .xgmii_txc              (4'b1111),
   98                  .xgmii_rxd              (phy_xgmii_rxd),
   99                  .xgmii_rxc              (phy_xgmii_rxc),
  100                  .txp                    (txp_unused),
  101                  .txn                    (txn_unused),
  102                  .rxp                    (rxp),
  103                  .rxn                    (rxn),
  104                  .configuration_vector   (536'd0),
  105                  .status_vector          (),
  106                  .core_status            (),
  107                  .resetdone_out          (),
  108                  .signal_detect          (1'b1),
  109                  .tx_fault               (1'b0),
  110                  .drp_req                (drp_gnt_w),
  111                  .drp_gnt                (drp_gnt_w),
  112                  .drp_den_o              (drp_den_w),
  113                  .drp_dwe_o              (drp_dwe_w),
  114                  .drp_daddr_o            (drp_daddr_w),
  115                  .drp_di_o               (drp_di_w),
  116                  .drp_drdy_o             (drp_drdy_w),
  117                  .drp_drpdo_o            (drp_drpdo_w),
  118                  .drp_den_i              (drp_den_w),
  119                  .drp_dwe_i              (drp_dwe_w),
  120                  .drp_daddr_i            (drp_daddr_w),
  121                  .drp_di_i               (drp_di_w),
  122                  .drp_drdy_i             (drp_drdy_w),
  123                  .drp_drpdo_i            (drp_drpdo_w),
  124                  .pma_pmd_type           (3'b101),
  125                  .tx_disable             ()
  126              );
  127  
  128              assign active_xgmii_rxd = phy_xgmii_rxd;
  129              assign active_xgmii_rxc = phy_xgmii_rxc;
  130          end else begin : gen_sim_eth_phy_rx_bypass
  131              assign active_xgmii_rxd = xgmii_rxd;
  132              assign active_xgmii_rxc = xgmii_rxc;
  133          end
  134      endgenerate
  135  
  136      // Stage 1: 32-bit XGMII Receive Frame Delimiter Parser (/S/ 0xFB & /T/ 0xFD)
  137      wire [31:0] parsed_tdata;
  138      wire        parsed_tvalid;
  139      wire        parsed_tlast;
  140      wire        parsed_tready;
  141      wire [2:0]  parsed_tkeep_bytes;
  142  
  143      xgmii_rx_parser u_rx_parser (
  144          .clk                (clk),
  145          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  146          .xgmii_rxd          (active_xgmii_rxd),
  147          .xgmii_rxc          (active_xgmii_rxc),
  148          .m_axis_tdata       (parsed_tdata),
  149          .m_axis_tvalid      (parsed_tvalid),
  150          .m_axis_tlast       (parsed_tlast),
  151          .m_axis_tkeep_bytes (parsed_tkeep_bytes)
  152      );
  153  
  154      // Stage 2: 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble & SFD (0x55..0xD5) Remover
  155      wire [31:0] clean_mac_tdata;
  156      wire        clean_mac_tvalid;
  157      wire        clean_mac_tlast;
  158      wire        clean_mac_tready;
  159      wire [2:0]  clean_mac_tkeep_bytes;
  160  
  161      eth_preamble_remover u_preamble_remover (
  162          .clk                (clk),
  163          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  164          .s_axis_tdata       (parsed_tdata),
  165          .s_axis_tvalid      (parsed_tvalid),
  166          .s_axis_tlast       (parsed_tlast),
  167          .s_axis_tready      (parsed_tready),
  168          .s_axis_tkeep_bytes (parsed_tkeep_bytes),
  169          .m_axis_tdata       (clean_mac_tdata),
  170          .m_axis_tvalid      (clean_mac_tvalid),
  171          .m_axis_tlast       (clean_mac_tlast),
  172          .m_axis_tready      (clean_mac_tready),
  173          .m_axis_tkeep_bytes (clean_mac_tkeep_bytes)
  174      );
  175  
  176      // Stage 3: Fixed 1900-Byte (475-Word) FSO Payload Segmentation & Padding
  177      packaging_and_segmentation u_segmenter (
  178          .clk                (clk),
  179          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  180          .s_axis_tdata       (clean_mac_tdata),
  181          .s_axis_tvalid      (clean_mac_tvalid),
  182          .s_axis_tlast       (clean_mac_tlast),
  183          .s_axis_tready      (clean_mac_tready),
  184          .s_axis_tkeep_bytes (clean_mac_tkeep_bytes),
  185          .m_axis_tdata       (fso_data_out),
  186          .m_axis_tvalid      (fso_valid),
  187          .m_axis_tlast       (fso_last),
  188          .m_axis_tready      (fso_ready),
  189          .seg_valid_bytes    (seg_valid_bytes)
  190      );
  191  
  192  endmodule
sources_1/new/eth_tx_back_end_top.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : eth_tx_back_end_top
    7  Description  : Top-Level 10G Ethernet Transmit Back-End (Egress to PC 2).
    8                 Integrates the Ethernet MAC TX Packing Buffer, 32-bit XGMII 
    9                 TX Formatter (/S/ 0xFB & /T/ 0xFD), 10G Ethernet PCS/PMA TX 
   10                 IP Core, and ChipScope ILA 3 (u_ila_2) telemetry counters.
   11  
   12                 Revision Notes:
   13                 1. Preserved all original architecture descriptions.
   14                 2. Wrapped eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0 inside a generate block 
   15                    controlled by RUN_MODE (1 = Simulation / XGMII Direct Output, 
   16                    0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode).
   17                 3. Placed ILA 3 (u_ila_2) telemetry registers inside this 
   18                    sub-module so SDAOISL10Gto10G_top remains 100% structural.
   19                 4. Connected DRP loopback and configuration_vector on 
   20                    physical_mac_tx_inst so the 10G PCS/PMA core completes 
   21                    hardware reset properly.
   22                 5. [Rev 2026-10-22 07:09 KST]: Updated timescale precision to 
   23                    1ns/1ps for project-wide simulation consistency.
   24                 6. [Rev 2.4 - 2026-10-29 13:07 KST - Deep Audit Section 6 Fix]:
   25                    Updated 'xgmii_is_active' detection from '(xgmii_txd != 32'h0707_0707)'
   26                    to '(xgmii_txc_wire != 4'b1111)' so legal Ethernet payload words 
   27                    matching 0x07070707 (with TXC == 4'b0000) are counted accurately.
   28                 7. [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 15:19 KST - Audit Fix R01 & R14]:
   29                    Restored exact child port connections on u_packing and u_formatter.
   30                 8. [Rev 2.6 - 2026-10-30 00:55 KST - Audit Fix N09]:
   31                    Moved 'dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt' increment outside the 'if (xgmii_is_active)'
   32                    block and triggered it on the XGMII Terminate delimiter (/T/ = 0xFD,
   33                    where xgmii_txc_wire == 4'b1111 and xgmii_txd_wire[7:0] == 8'hFD, or any
   34                    control lane containing 8'hFD), ensuring backend_counter.sv counts every
   35                    transmitted Ethernet packet accurately.
   36                 9. [Rev 2.9 - 2026-10-30 18:25 KST - Audit Fix B21 - Explicit Telemetry Counter Separation]:
   37                    Separated egress telemetry into three unambiguous metrics:
   38                      (a) 'dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt'       : Completed Ethernet packets (incremented on /T/).
   39                      (b) 'dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt' : Pure Layer-2 Ethernet MAC frame bytes (DA..FCS,
   40                          excluding /S/, 8-Byte Preamble/SFD, and /T/ control lanes; counts 2,000B).
   41                      (c) 'dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt'      : Active 32-bit XGMII bus-slot burst bytes
   42                          (includes 8B Preamble/SFD + MAC payload + 4B /T/ word = 2,012B).
   43  ===========================================================================
   44  */
   45  
   46  module eth_tx_back_end_top #(
   47      parameter RUN_MODE = 1 // 1 = Simulation Mode, 0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode
   48  )(
   49      input  wire        clk,       // 312.5 MHz Clock
   50      input  wire        rst_n,     // Active-low reset
   51      
   52      // Input 1922 Byte / 2008 Byte Reassembled Ethernet Frame from ethernet_frame_reassembly
   53      input  wire [31:0] data_in,
   54      input  wire        en,
   55      
   56      // Output menuju Simulasi Testbench (XGMII Probing Output)
   57      output wire [31:0] xgmii_txd,
   58      output wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc,
   59  
   60      // Port SFP+ & Clocking Fisik untuk IP Core
   61      input  wire        refclk_p,
   62      input  wire        refclk_n,
   63      input  wire        reset,
   64      input  wire        dclk,
   65      output wire        txp,
   66      output wire        txn
   67  );
   68  
   69      wire [31:0] pack_data;
   70      wire        pack_valid;
   71      wire [15:0] tx_word_cnt;
   72      wire [15:0] tx_byte_cnt;
   73  
   74      wire [31:0] xgmii_txd_wire;
   75      wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc_wire;
   76  
   77      // 1. Dynamic MAC Stream Packer (Packing and Segmentation)
   78      eth_mac_packing_tx u_packing (
   79          .clk         (clk),
   80          .rst_n       (rst_n),
   81          .mux_data    (data_in),
   82          .mux_valid   (en),
   83          .pack_data   (pack_data),
   84          .pack_valid  (pack_valid),
   85          .tx_word_cnt (tx_word_cnt),
   86          .tx_byte_cnt (tx_byte_cnt)
   87      );
   88  
   89      // 2. IEEE 802.3ae 32-bit XGMII Transmit Formatter
   90      xgmii_tx_formatter u_formatter (
   91          .clk       (clk),
   92          .rst_n     (rst_n),
   93          .mac_data  (pack_data),
   94          .mac_valid (pack_valid),
   95          .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd_wire),
   96          .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc_wire)
   97      );
   98  
   99      // CABANG 1: Teruskan ke pin output untuk Testbench Simulasi
  100      assign xgmii_txd = xgmii_txd_wire;
  101      assign xgmii_txc = xgmii_txc_wire;
  102  
  103      // =========================================================================
  104      // CABANG 2: IP Core 10G Ethernet PCS/PMA (Pemancar Optik SFP+ ke PC 2)
  105      //           Synthesized in Hardware Mode (RUN_MODE == 0)
  106      // =========================================================================
  107      generate
  108          if (RUN_MODE == 0) begin : gen_hw_eth_phy_tx
  109              wire        drp_gnt_w;
  110              wire        drp_den_w;
  111              wire        drp_dwe_w;
  112              wire [15:0] drp_daddr_w;
  113              wire [15:0] drp_di_w;
  114              wire        drp_drdy_w;
  115              wire [15:0] drp_drpdo_w;
  116  
  117              eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0 physical_mac_tx_inst (
  118                  .dclk                   (dclk),
  119                  .rxrecclk_out           (),
  120                  .refclk_p               (refclk_p),
  121                  .refclk_n               (refclk_n),
  122                  .sim_speedup_control    (1'b0),
  123                  .coreclk_out            (),
  124                  .qplloutclk_out         (),
  125                  .qplloutrefclk_out      (),
  126                  .qplllock_out           (),
  127                  .txusrclk_out           (),
  128                  .txusrclk2_out          (),
  129                  .areset_datapathclk_out (),
  130                  .gttxreset_out          (),
  131                  .gtrxreset_out          (),
  132                  .txuserrdy_out          (),
  133                  .reset_counter_done_out (),
  134                  .reset                  (reset),
  135                  .xgmii_txd              (xgmii_txd_wire),
  136                  .xgmii_txc              (xgmii_txc_wire),
  137                  .xgmii_rxd              (),
  138                  .xgmii_rxc              (),
  139                  .txp                    (txp),
  140                  .txn                    (txn),
  141                  .rxp                    (1'b0),
  142                  .rxn                    (1'b1),
  143                  .configuration_vector   (536'd0),
  144                  .status_vector          (),
  145                  .core_status            (),
  146                  .resetdone_out          (),
  147                  .signal_detect          (1'b1),
  148                  .tx_fault               (1'b0),
  149                  .drp_req                (drp_gnt_w),
  150                  .drp_gnt                (drp_gnt_w),
  151                  .drp_den_o              (drp_den_w),
  152                  .drp_dwe_o              (drp_dwe_w),
  153                  .drp_daddr_o            (drp_daddr_w),
  154                  .drp_di_o               (drp_di_w),
  155                  .drp_drdy_o             (drp_drdy_w),
  156                  .drp_drpdo_o            (drp_drpdo_w),
  157                  .drp_den_i              (drp_den_w),
  158                  .drp_dwe_i              (drp_dwe_w),
  159                  .drp_daddr_i            (drp_daddr_w),
  160                  .drp_di_i               (drp_di_w),
  161                  .drp_drdy_i             (drp_drdy_w),
  162                  .drp_drpdo_i            (drp_drpdo_w),
  163                  .pma_pmd_type           (3'b101),
  164                  .tx_disable             ()
  165              );
  166          end else begin : gen_sim_eth_phy_tx_bypass
  167              assign txp = 1'b0;
  168              assign txn = 1'b1;
  169          end
  170      endgenerate
  171  
  172      // =========================================================================
  173      // 3. INTERNAL ILA 3 (u_ila_2) RX & PC 2 EGRESS TELEMETRY COUNTERS
  174      //    Housed inside eth_tx_back_end_top so Top Schematic stays clean!
  175      // =========================================================================
  176      (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [31:0] dbg_pc2_xgmii_txd;
  177      (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [3:0]  dbg_pc2_xgmii_txc;
  178      (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt;      // Active XGMII bus-slot bytes (4..2012)
  179      (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt;       // Completed Ethernet packet count
  180      reg [15:0] dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt; // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B21] Pure Layer-2 MAC bytes (DA..FCS = 2000B)
  181      reg [15:0] last_eth_data_byte_cnt;   // Latched Layer-2 MAC byte count of most recent completed packet
  182      reg [1:0]  preamble_word_skip;       // Skips first 2 words (8B Preamble/SFD) for pure MAC byte count
  183  
  184      wire       xgmii_is_active  = (xgmii_txc_wire != 4'b1111);
  185      wire [2:0] valid_data_lanes = (!xgmii_txc_wire[3]) + (!xgmii_txc_wire[2]) +
  186                                    (!xgmii_txc_wire[1]) + (!xgmii_txc_wire[0]);
  187  
  188      // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N09] Detect XGMII Terminate (/T/ = 0xFD) on any control lane
  189      wire xgmii_has_term = (xgmii_txc_wire[0] && (xgmii_txd_wire[7:0]   == 8'hFD)) ||
  190                            (xgmii_txc_wire[1] && (xgmii_txd_wire[15:8]  == 8'hFD)) ||
  191                            (xgmii_txc_wire[2] && (xgmii_txd_wire[23:16] == 8'hFD)) ||
  192                            (xgmii_txc_wire[3] && (xgmii_txd_wire[31:24] == 8'hFD));
  193  
  194      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  195          if (!rst_n) begin
  196              dbg_pc2_xgmii_txd        <= 32'h0707_0707;
  197              dbg_pc2_xgmii_txc        <= 4'b1111;
  198              dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  199              dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt       <= 16'd0;
  200              dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  201              last_eth_data_byte_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  202              preamble_word_skip       <= 2'd0;
  203          end else begin
  204              dbg_pc2_xgmii_txd <= xgmii_txd_wire;
  205              dbg_pc2_xgmii_txc <= xgmii_txc_wire;
  206  
  207              if (xgmii_has_term) begin
  208                  dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt       <= dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt + 16'd1;
