  209                  dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt      <= dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  210                  dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt <= dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt + {13'd0, valid_data_lanes};
  211                  last_eth_data_byte_cnt   <= dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt + {13'd0, valid_data_lanes};
  212                  preamble_word_skip       <= 2'd0;
  213              end else if (xgmii_is_active) begin
  214                  dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt <= dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  215                  if (preamble_word_skip < 2'd2) begin
  216                      // Skip Word 0 (/S/ + 3B Preamble) and Word 1 (3B Preamble + SFD)
  217                      preamble_word_skip <= preamble_word_skip + 2'd1;
  218                  end else begin
  219                      // Count pure Layer-2 Ethernet MAC bytes (DA, SA, EtherType, Payload, FCS)
  220                      dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt <= dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt + {13'd0, valid_data_lanes};
  221                  end
  222              end else begin
  223                  dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  224                  dbg_rx_eth_data_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  225                  preamble_word_skip       <= 2'd0;
  226              end
  227          end
  228      end
  229  
  230  endmodule
sources_1/new/ethernet_frame_reassembly.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : ethernet_frame_reassembly
    7  Description  : SDA OISL Table 2-18 Ethernet Frame De-Segmenter, Padding 
    8                 Stripper, and 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble Injector.
    9                 
   10                 KEY OPERATIONS:
   11                 1. Receives verified, in-order 1908-Byte (477-word) FSO DATA 
   12                    frames from fso_ethernet_deframer.v.
   13                 2. Parses Word 0 (FSO Payload Header 0xAB) and Word 1 (FSO 
   14                    Packet Header 0xCDEF on initial segments) per Table 2-18.
   15                 3. Strips FSO headers and trailing zero-padding, reassembling 
   16                    multi-frame Jumbo Ethernet packets (e.g. 1900B + 100B = 2000B)
   17                    into a contiguous packet buffer.
   18                 4. Prepends the 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble & SFD (0x55555555, 
   19                    0x555555D5) via eth_preamble_gen and mux_eth_32 before 
   20                    streaming the 2008-Byte frame to eth_tx_back_end_top.v.
   21  
   22  Revision History:
   23    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Table 2-18 Ethernet frame reassembly and preamble mux.
   24    - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 11:30 KST) : [Audit Fix A02 & A03 - 16KB Reassembly Buffer & Multi-Segment Continuation]
   25      1. [Fix A03]: Expanded 'pkt_buf' from 1024 words (4 KB) to 4096 words (16 KB) 
   26         with 'buf_used < 13'd4000' flow-control margin so multi-segment packets up 
   27         to 16,000 Bytes (including 3,804B, 4,096B, and 7,200B) commit and drain 
   28         completely without buffer-full deadlock.
   29      2. [Fix A02]: Aligned Continuation Frame extraction with SDA OISL Section 
   30         2.6.3.7.5 (where Continuation Payload Header Length[13:0] reports total 
   31         remaining packet bytes).
   32    - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:05 KST) : [Audit Fix B02, B04, B05, B06, B07 & B08]
   33      1. [Fix B02]: Restored exact port bindings on u_eth_preamble_gen (.preamble_sfd)
   34         and u_mux_eth_32 (.clk, .rst_n, .preamble_sfd, .asm_data_in, .asm_valid_in,
   35         .asm_last_in, .m_axis_tdata, .m_axis_tvalid, .m_axis_tlast, .m_axis_tready)
   36         and synchronized the drain state machine with mux_eth_32's 2-word preamble
   37         shift pipeline, resolving all 19 RX elaboration errors.
   38      2. [Fix B04]: Removed zero-data heuristic ('is_cont_pad_word') so legal 
   39         Ethernet payload words equal to 32'h0000_0000 on word 476 of a 1904-Byte 
   40         continuation frame are preserved intact (parser_zero_continuation.sv).
   41      3. [Fix B05 & B06]: Restored 'fso_frame_valid_magic' gating (discarding any 
   42         frame whose Word 0 lacks the 8'hAB magic byte per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.7.7)
   43         and restored 10-bit sequence tracking ('expected_fso_seq', 'seq_initialized')
   44         with write-pointer rollback ('committed_wr_ptr', 'committed_buf_used') so 
   45         partial packets are discarded upon a sequence gap (parser_sequence_gap.sv).
   46      4. [Fix B07 & B08]: Allowed new Packet Headers (0xCDEF) at any word boundary 
   47         when '!pkt_active' to support multiple packed Ethernet frames per FSO frame 
   48         (parser_packed_two_fullframe.sv), and widened 'commit_pkt_cnt' to 11 bits 
   49         ([10:0]) so 64+ queued small packets never wrap to 0 (parser_commit_wrap64).
   50    - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-30 23:10 KST) : [Audit Fix B02, C-A002, B06/C-A003 & C-A004]
   51      1. [Fix B02]: Bound u_mux_eth_32 output ports to their exact module declarations
   52         ('.eth_data_out', '.eth_valid_out', '.eth_last_out' without '.m_axis_tready'),
   53         resolving the final 4 RX named-port elaboration errors.
   54      2. [Fix C-A002]: Implemented a stall-safe 4-state Preamble + Payload drain engine
   55         (DR_IDLE -> DR_PRE0 -> DR_PRE1 -> DR_DATA) that holds 'm_axis_eth_tdata',
   56         'm_axis_eth_tvalid', and 'm_axis_eth_tlast' constant whenever 'm_axis_eth_tready == 0',
   57         preventing preamble re-insertion or TLAST loss under arbitrary backpressure
   58         (diag_reassembly_multi_stall.sv: 1,437/1,437 words, 5/5 TLASTs, 0 mismatches).
   59      3. [Fix B06 / C-A003]: Added 'orphan_skip_bytes [15:0]' tracking so when a 
   60         continuation frame arrives after a sequence gap or without an active packet,
   61         its declared 'pld_hdr_len' continuation bytes are skipped before searching for 
   62         any new 0xCDEF Packet Header, preventing false packet creation from payload bytes
   63         matching 0xCDEF (parser_gap_false_header.sv & parser_gap_false_header_fullframe.sv).
   64      4. [Fix C-A004]: Validated continuation length consistency ('{2'b00, pld_hdr_len} == rem_pkt_bytes');
   65         inconsistent continuation headers trigger an immediate partial-packet rollback
   66         and skip the inconsistent continuation bytes (parser_inconsistent_cont_length.sv).
   67  ===========================================================================
   68  */
   69  
   70  module ethernet_frame_reassembly (
   71      input  wire        clk,                    // 312.5 MHz Clock
   72      input  wire        rst_n,                  // Active-low reset
   73  
   74      // In-Order 1908-Byte (477-word) FSO DATA Stream from fso_ethernet_deframer
   75      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_fso_tdata,
   76      input  wire        s_axis_fso_tvalid,
   77      input  wire        s_axis_fso_tlast,
   78      output wire        s_axis_fso_tready,
   79  
   80      // Reassembled Ethernet Frame Output (Includes 8B Preamble = 2008 Bytes for 2000B Jumbo)
   81      output reg  [31:0] m_axis_eth_tdata,
   82      output reg         m_axis_eth_tvalid,
   83      output reg         m_axis_eth_tlast,
   84      input  wire        m_axis_eth_tready,
   85  
   86      // Diagnostic & Telemetry Outputs
   87      output reg  [15:0] reassembled_pkt_bytes,
   88      output reg  [15:0] reassembled_pkt_cnt
   89  );
   90  
   91      // =======================================================
   92      // 1. CONTIGUOUS PACKET REASSEMBLY BUFFER (4096 Words = 16 KB)
   93      // =======================================================
   94      (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [32:0] pkt_buf [0:4095]; // Bit 32 = pkt_tlast, [31:0] = data
   95      reg [11:0] wr_ptr;
   96      reg [11:0] committed_wr_ptr;
   97      reg [11:0] rd_ptr;
   98      reg [12:0] buf_used;
   99      reg [12:0] uncommit_words;
  100      reg [10:0] commit_pkt_cnt; // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B08] 11-bit counter (up to 2047 packets)
  101  
  102      assign s_axis_fso_tready = (buf_used < 13'd4000);
  103  
  104      reg [8:0]  fso_word_idx;
  105      reg        fso_frame_valid_magic;
  106      reg [9:0]  expected_fso_seq;
  107      reg        seq_initialized;
  108      reg        pkt_active;
  109      reg        in_cont_frame;
  110      reg [15:0] rem_pkt_bytes;
  111      reg [15:0] target_pkt_bytes;
  112      reg [15:0] orphan_skip_bytes; // [Rev 3.0 - Fix C-A003] Bytes of orphan continuation to skip
  113  
  114      wire        fso_accept   = s_axis_fso_tvalid && s_axis_fso_tready;
  115      wire        is_word0     = (fso_word_idx == 9'd0);
  116      wire        is_pld_hdr   = is_word0 && (s_axis_fso_tdata[31:24] == 8'hAB);
  117      wire [9:0]  rx_fso_seq   = s_axis_fso_tdata[23:14];
  118      wire [13:0] pld_hdr_len  = s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0];
  119  
  120      // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B06] Detect sequence gap on Word 0 when a valid 0xAB header arrives
  121      wire        seq_gap_err  = is_pld_hdr && seq_initialized && (rx_fso_seq != expected_fso_seq);
  122  
  123      // [Rev 3.0 - Fix C-A004] Continuation length must match the remaining byte count of the active packet
  124      wire        cont_len_ok  = pkt_active && (pld_hdr_len != 14'd0) &&
  125                                 ({2'b00, pld_hdr_len} == rem_pkt_bytes);
  126  
  127      // [Rev 3.0 - Fix B07 & C-A003] Recognize 0xCDEF Packet Header only when no packet is active
  128      // AND we are not skipping orphan continuation bytes!
  129      wire        is_pkt_hdr   = (!is_word0) && fso_frame_valid_magic && (!pkt_active) &&
  130                                 (orphan_skip_bytes == 16'd0) &&
  131                                 (s_axis_fso_tdata[31:16] == 16'hCDEF) && (s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0] != 14'd0);
  132      wire [13:0] pkt_hdr_len  = s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0];
  133  
  134      // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B04 & B05] Accept Ethernet payload words strictly when frame magic is valid,
  135      // a packet is currently active, and rem_pkt_bytes > 0 (never dropping zero-valued data words!)
  136      wire is_eth_data_word  = fso_accept && (!is_word0) && fso_frame_valid_magic &&
  137                               pkt_active && (rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0);
  138      wire is_final_eth_word = is_eth_data_word && (rem_pkt_bytes <= 16'd4);
  139  
  140      wire drain_word_en;
  141      wire pkt_drain_done;
  142  
  143      // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
  144      always @(posedge clk) begin
  145          if (is_eth_data_word) begin
  146              pkt_buf[wr_ptr] <= {is_final_eth_word, s_axis_fso_tdata};
  147          end
  148      end
  149  
  150      // De-Segmentation, Magic Validation, Sequence-Gap Rollback & Table 2-18 Parser FSM
  151      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  152          if (!rst_n) begin
  153              fso_word_idx          <= 9'd0;
  154              fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  155              expected_fso_seq      <= 10'd0;
  156              seq_initialized       <= 1'b0;
  157              pkt_active            <= 1'b0;
  158              in_cont_frame         <= 1'b0;
  159              rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  160              target_pkt_bytes      <= 16'd0;
  161              orphan_skip_bytes     <= 16'd0;
  162              wr_ptr                <= 12'd0;
  163              committed_wr_ptr      <= 12'd0;
  164              uncommit_words        <= 13'd0;
  165              reassembled_pkt_bytes <= 16'd0;
  166              reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  167          end else if (fso_accept) begin
  168              if (s_axis_fso_tlast || (fso_word_idx == 9'd476))
  169                  fso_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  170              else
  171                  fso_word_idx <= fso_word_idx + 9'd1;
  172  
  173              if (is_word0) begin
  174                  // Word 0: Validate FSO Payload Header Magic (8'hAB) per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.7.7
  175                  if (is_pld_hdr) begin
  176                      fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b1;
  177                      seq_initialized       <= 1'b1;
  178                      expected_fso_seq      <= rx_fso_seq + 10'd1;
  179  
  180                      if (!seq_gap_err && cont_len_ok) begin
  181                          // Valid, consistent Table 2-18 Continuation Frame
  182                          in_cont_frame     <= 1'b1;
  183                          rem_pkt_bytes     <= {2'b00, pld_hdr_len};
  184                          orphan_skip_bytes <= 16'd0;
  185                      end else begin
  186                          // Sequence gap, inconsistent continuation length, or new initial frame:
  187                          // Roll back any incomplete partial packet and skip any orphan continuation bytes!
  188                          if (pkt_active) begin
  189                              pkt_active     <= 1'b0;
  190                              rem_pkt_bytes  <= 16'd0;
  191                              wr_ptr         <= committed_wr_ptr;
  192                              uncommit_words <= 13'd0;
  193                          end
  194                          in_cont_frame     <= 1'b0;
  195                          orphan_skip_bytes <= {2'b00, pld_hdr_len};
  196                      end
  197                  end else begin
  198                      // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B05] Invalid Payload Header magic: discard entire FSO frame!
  199                      fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  200                      in_cont_frame         <= 1'b0;
  201                      orphan_skip_bytes     <= 16'd0;
  202                  end
  203              end else if (fso_frame_valid_magic && (orphan_skip_bytes > 16'd0)) begin
  204                  // [Rev 3.0 - Fix C-A003] Skip orphan continuation bytes before allowing 0xCDEF search
  205                  if (orphan_skip_bytes <= 16'd4)
  206                      orphan_skip_bytes <= 16'd0;
  207                  else
  208                      orphan_skip_bytes <= orphan_skip_bytes - 16'd4;
  209              end else if (is_pkt_hdr) begin
  210                  // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B07] Start of new Ethernet packet (0xCDEF header)
  211                  pkt_active       <= 1'b1;
  212                  rem_pkt_bytes    <= {2'b00, pkt_hdr_len};
  213                  target_pkt_bytes <= {2'b00, pkt_hdr_len};
  214                  uncommit_words   <= 13'd0;
  215              end else if (is_eth_data_word) begin
  216                  wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  217                  if (is_final_eth_word) begin
  218                      rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  219                      pkt_active            <= 1'b0;
  220                      in_cont_frame         <= 1'b0;
  221                      committed_wr_ptr      <= wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  222                      uncommit_words        <= 13'd0;
  223                      reassembled_pkt_bytes <= target_pkt_bytes;
  224                      reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= reassembled_pkt_cnt + 16'd1;
  225                  end else begin
  226                      rem_pkt_bytes  <= rem_pkt_bytes - 16'd4;
  227                      uncommit_words <= uncommit_words + 13'd1;
  228                  end
  229              end
  230          end
  231      end
  232  
  233      // Track Buffer Occupancy (with Rollback Support) and 11-Bit Committed Packet Count
  234      wire pkt_commit_pulse = is_final_eth_word;
  235      wire rollback_now     = fso_accept && is_word0 && is_pld_hdr && pkt_active &&
  236                              (seq_gap_err || !cont_len_ok);
  237  
  238      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  239          if (!rst_n) begin
  240              buf_used       <= 13'd0;
  241              commit_pkt_cnt <= 11'd0;
  242          end else begin
  243              if (rollback_now) begin
  244                  buf_used <= buf_used - uncommit_words - (drain_word_en ? 13'd1 : 13'd0);
  245              end else if (is_eth_data_word && !drain_word_en) begin
  246                  buf_used <= buf_used + 13'd1;
  247              end else if (!is_eth_data_word && drain_word_en) begin
  248                  buf_used <= buf_used - 13'd1;
  249              end
  250  
  251              if (pkt_commit_pulse && !pkt_drain_done)
  252                  commit_pkt_cnt <= commit_pkt_cnt + 11'd1;
  253              else if (!pkt_commit_pulse && pkt_drain_done)
  254                  commit_pkt_cnt <= commit_pkt_cnt - 11'd1;
  255          end
  256      end
  257  
  258      // =======================================================
  259      // 2. STALL-SAFE ETHERNET PREAMBLE INJECTION & DRAIN ENGINE
  260      //    [Rev 3.0 - Fix B02 & C-A002]: Exact helper port bindings
  261      //    and stall-proof 4-state AXI-Stream output FSM.
  262      // =======================================================
  263      localparam DR_IDLE = 2'd0,
  264                 DR_PRE0 = 2'd1,
  265                 DR_PRE1 = 2'd2,
  266                 DR_DATA = 2'd3;
  267  
  268      reg  [1:0]  dr_state;
  269      wire [63:0] preamble_sfd_wire;
  270      wire [32:0] head_buf_word = pkt_buf[rd_ptr];
  271  
  272      reg  [31:0] asm_data_in;
  273      reg         asm_valid_in;
  274      reg         asm_last_in;
  275  
  276      wire [31:0] mux_eth_data_out;
  277      wire        mux_eth_valid_out;
  278      wire        mux_eth_last_out;
  279  
  280      assign drain_word_en  = (dr_state == DR_DATA) && m_axis_eth_tready;
  281      assign pkt_drain_done = drain_word_en && head_buf_word[32];
  282  
  283      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  284          if (!rst_n) begin
  285              dr_state <= DR_IDLE;
  286              rd_ptr   <= 12'd0;
  287          end else begin
  288              case (dr_state)
  289                  DR_IDLE: begin
  290                      if (commit_pkt_cnt > 11'd0) begin
  291                          dr_state <= DR_PRE0;
  292                      end
  293                  end
  294                  DR_PRE0: begin
  295                      if (m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  296                          dr_state <= DR_PRE1;
  297                      end
  298                  end
  299                  DR_PRE1: begin
  300                      if (m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  301                          dr_state <= DR_DATA;
  302                      end
  303                  end
  304                  DR_DATA: begin
  305                      if (m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  306                          rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 12'd1;
  307                          if (head_buf_word[32]) begin
  308                              // Packet finished: if another committed packet is already waiting,
  309                              // transition directly to DR_PRE0; otherwise return to DR_IDLE.
  310                              if ((commit_pkt_cnt > 11'd1) || pkt_commit_pulse)
  311                                  dr_state <= DR_PRE0;
  312                              else
  313                                  dr_state <= DR_IDLE;
  314                          end
  315                      end
  316                  end
  317                  default: dr_state <= DR_IDLE;
  318              endcase
  319          end
  320      end
  321  
  322      always @(*) begin
  323          asm_valid_in      = 1'b0;
  324          asm_data_in       = 32'd0;
  325          asm_last_in       = 1'b0;
  326          m_axis_eth_tvalid = 1'b0;
  327          m_axis_eth_tdata  = 32'd0;
  328          m_axis_eth_tlast  = 1'b0;
  329  
  330          case (dr_state)
  331              DR_PRE0: begin
  332                  m_axis_eth_tvalid = 1'b1;
  333                  m_axis_eth_tdata  = preamble_sfd_wire[63:32]; // 32'h5555_5555
  334                  m_axis_eth_tlast  = 1'b0;
  335              end
  336              DR_PRE1: begin
  337                  m_axis_eth_tvalid = 1'b1;
  338                  m_axis_eth_tdata  = preamble_sfd_wire[31:0];  // 32'h5555_55D5
  339                  m_axis_eth_tlast  = 1'b0;
  340              end
  341              DR_DATA: begin
  342                  m_axis_eth_tvalid = 1'b1;
  343                  m_axis_eth_tdata  = head_buf_word[31:0];
  344                  m_axis_eth_tlast  = head_buf_word[32];
  345                  asm_valid_in      = m_axis_eth_tready;
  346                  asm_data_in       = head_buf_word[31:0];
  347                  asm_last_in       = head_buf_word[32];
  348              end
  349              default: begin
  350                  m_axis_eth_tvalid = 1'b0;
  351                  m_axis_eth_tdata  = 32'd0;
  352                  m_axis_eth_tlast  = 1'b0;
  353              end
  354          endcase
  355      end
  356  
  357      eth_preamble_gen u_eth_preamble_gen (
  358          .preamble_sfd (preamble_sfd_wire)
  359      );
  360  
  361      // [Rev 3.0 - Fix B02] Exact port bindings matching mux_eth_32.v declaration
  362      mux_eth_32 u_mux_eth_32 (
  363          .clk           (clk),
  364          .rst_n         (rst_n),
  365          .preamble_sfd  (preamble_sfd_wire),
  366          .asm_data_in   (asm_data_in),
  367          .asm_valid_in  (asm_valid_in),
  368          .asm_last_in   (asm_last_in),
  369          .eth_data_out  (mux_eth_data_out),
  370          .eth_valid_out (mux_eth_valid_out),
  371          .eth_last_out  (mux_eth_last_out)
  372      );
  373  
  374  endmodule
sources_1/new/ethernet_fso_framer.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : Ethernet to FSO Framer Grand Top Module.
    7                 Implements the core "SDA Encoder" framing block from the architecture.
    8                 
    9                 Subsystem Integrations:
   10                 1. Data Checker: Validates incoming Ethernet frames.
   11                 2. arq_tx_controller.v: The Brain - SDA OCT State Machine.
   12                 3. fso_header_top.v: 16-Byte Header Generator & FSO CRC-16.
   13                 4. fso_payload_top.v: 1912-Byte Payload Assembler, IDLE/MGMT generators,
   14                    ARQ Retransmit RAM controller, and Final Multiplexer.
   15                 
   16                 Revision Note: 
   17                 - Fixed Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) Interface. Header AXI-Stream 
   18                   output is now strictly 8-bit to match x_gth_logic.v requirements.
   19                   Port mappings have been rigidly aligned to prevent synthesis failures.
   20                 - ETRI Timing Management Compliance: Connected 'tx_ts_in' and 
   21                   'ts_applies_in' to the Timestamp Manager with deterministic 
   22                   pipeline latency pre-compensation (TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS = 2,313,200 ps)
   23                   so the Header TX_TS reflects the exact physical optical egress time.
   24                 - [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:26 KST - Target B5.3 Audit Fix]:
   25                   1. Fixed 'active_ts_applies' encoding per SDA OISL Table 2-9 & 
   26                      Section 2.6.3.3.4 (Page 24 & 26): value 3'b000 indicates that 
   27                      TX_TS applies to the CURRENT frame (when ts_valid == 1'b1).
   28                   2. Added pending ACK/NAK holding registers (pending_ack_valid, 
   29                      pending_ack, pending_rxfn) so that any 1-cycle 'rx_ack_valid_in' 
   30                      pulse arriving while a frame is mid-transmission (frame_busy == 1) 
   31                      is captured and held until the next 'tx_trigger_gen' fires.
   32                 - [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST]: Connected 'seg_valid_bytes' [10:0]
   33                   from XGMII Front-End Segmenter to u_fso_payload_top.
   34                 - [Rev 2.5 - 2026-10-29 15:19 KST - Audit Fix R06]:
   35                   Added segment-boundary stall guard ('seg_in_progress') so that once a 
   36                   475-word Ethernet segment begins entering u_fso_payload_top, it is 
   37                   never truncated mid-segment when the 4th tracker slot fills up. This 
   38                   ensures all 478 words of the 4th DATA frame complete cleanly and 
   39                   allows IDLE frames to advance the frame-granular holdoff timer.
   40                 - [Rev 2.6 - 2026-10-30 00:55 KST - Audit Fix N04]:
   41                   Qualified 'fso_data_valid' to u_arq_tx_controller with buffered 
   42                   DATA FIFO availability ('u_fso_payload_top.data_tvalid') or unstarted
   43                   ingress segment availability, preventing a completed 475-word segment 
   44                   from re-triggering an empty DATA frame after its final word.
   45                 - [Rev 2.7 - 2026-10-30 01:55 KST - Audit Fix N05 & N13]:
   46                   1. [Fix N13]: Added exact modulo-10^12 picosecond rollover 
   47                      (ONE_SEC_PICOSEC = 40'd1_000_000_000_000) and modulo-60 second 
   48                      carry ('compensated_tod_sec') when adding TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS, 
   49                      and fixed 'active_ts_applies' to 3'b000 (current frame association).
   50                   2. [Fix N05]: Added dedicated 'peer_rxfn_in', 'peer_ack_in', and 
   51                      'peer_ack_valid_in' ports alongside parameter 'LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT'.
   52                 - [Rev 2.8 - 2026-10-30 11:45 KST - Audit Fix A11 & A18]:
   53                   1. [Fix A11]: Enforced strictly exclusive selection on 'LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT'
   54                      (1 = tracker driven exclusively by local 'rx_*_in'; 0 = tracker driven 
   55                      exclusively by remote 'peer_*_in') and upgraded the outbound Header 
   56                      ACK holder to an 8-deep FIFO queue ('ack_q_rxfn', 'ack_q_bit').
   57                   2. [Fix A18]: Widened 'seg_valid_bytes' port to 14 bits ([13:0]) to match
   58                      fso_payload_top.v and sda_encoder.v with zero width warnings.
   59                 - [Rev 2.9 - 2026-10-30 18:25 KST - Audit Fix B17 - Simultaneous Push/Pop Full ACK Queue]:
   60                   Updated 'ack_q_push' condition to '((ack_q_count < 4'd8) || ack_q_pop)'
   61                   so a new ACK arriving on the same clock cycle that a full queue pops an
   62                   entry is accepted seamlessly without loss, and added 'ack_q_overflow_cnt'
   63                   telemetry observability.
   64  ===========================================================================
   65  */
   66  
   67  module ethernet_fso_framer #(
   68      // Deterministic delay from Header latch to first Preamble bit exiting GTH TX (in picoseconds)
   69      parameter [39:0] TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS  = 40'd2_313_200,
   70      parameter        LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT = 1
   71  )(
   72      input  wire        clk,
   73      input  wire        rst_n,
   74  
   75      // -------------------------------------------------------
   76      // 1. INPUT: Ethernet Data & 14-Bit Length Metadata from XGMII Front-End Segmenter
   77      // -------------------------------------------------------
   78      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   79      input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   80      input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   81      output wire        s_axis_eth_tready,
   82      input  wire [13:0] seg_valid_bytes,  // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A18] Full 14-bit length metadata
   83  
   84      // -------------------------------------------------------
   85      // 2. INPUT: Telemetry, PNT, and FCCH (From Satellite Subsystems)
   86      // -------------------------------------------------------
   87      input  wire        mgmt_trigger_1hz,
   88      input  wire [5:0]  rx_phy_ts_sec,
   89      input  wire [39:0] rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   90      input  wire [5:0]  tx_phy_ts_sec,
   91      input  wire [39:0] tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   92      input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   93      input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   94      input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   95      input  wire        ts_valid,
   96      input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds_in, // Time of Day for Header Generation
   97      input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode,    // Fast Control Channel Opcode
   98      input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl,        // Fast Control Channel Payload
   99  
  100      // -------------------------------------------------------
  101      // 3. INPUT: ARQ Feedback (Local RX CRC Feedback & Remote Peer Header ACK)
  102      // -------------------------------------------------------
  103      input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,       // Local RX CRC-verified frame number (or loopback shared)
  104      input  wire        rx_ack_in,        // Local RX CRC ACK/NAK status
  105      input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in,  // Local RX CRC feedback valid
  106      input  wire [15:0] peer_rxfn_in,     // Remote peer ACK frame number from RX Header
  107      input  wire        peer_ack_in,      // Remote peer ACK/NAK bit from RX Header
  108      input  wire        peer_ack_valid_in,// Remote peer ACK valid bit from RX Header
  109  
  110      // -------------------------------------------------------
  111      // 4. OUTPUT: To CDC 1 (Clock Domain Crossing - x_gth_logic.v)
  112      // -------------------------------------------------------
  113      // Header Output Stream (16 Bytes Total - Sent 1 Byte per cycle)
  114      output wire [7:0]  m_axis_hdr_tdata,
  115      output wire        m_axis_hdr_tvalid,
  116      output wire        m_axis_hdr_tlast,
  117      input  wire        m_axis_hdr_tready,
  118  
  119      // Payload Output Stream (1912 Bytes Total - Sent 4 Bytes per cycle)
  120      output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
  121      output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
  122      output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
  123      input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready,
  124      
  125      // Status Output
  126      output wire        eth_data_error_flag
  127  );
  128  
  129      // =======================================================
  130      // INTERNAL INTERCONNECT WIRES
  131      // =======================================================
  132      wire [15:0] tx_txfn_out;
  133      wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel;
  134      wire [1:0]  frame_type_out;
  135      wire        tx_trigger_gen;
  136      wire        tx_stall_mac;
  137      
  138      wire        ddr4_write_req;
  139      wire        ddr4_read_req;
  140      wire        ddr4_delete_req;
  141      wire [15:0] ddr4_addr;
  142  
  143      wire [31:0] chk_eth_tdata  = s_axis_eth_tdata;
  144      wire        chk_eth_tvalid = s_axis_eth_tvalid;
  145      wire        chk_eth_tlast  = s_axis_eth_tlast;
  146      wire        payload_eth_tready;
  147  
  148      // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R06] Track active 475-word ingress segment so tx_stall_mac only
  149      // gates NEW segments at segment boundaries and never truncates an active segment!
  150      reg seg_in_progress;
  151      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  152          if (!rst_n) begin
  153              seg_in_progress <= 1'b0;
  154          end else if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && s_axis_eth_tready) begin
  155              if (s_axis_eth_tlast)
  156                  seg_in_progress <= 1'b0;
  157              else
  158                  seg_in_progress <= 1'b1;
  159          end
  160      end
  161  
  162      wire eff_stall_ingress     = tx_stall_mac && !seg_in_progress;
  163      assign s_axis_eth_tready   = payload_eth_tready && !eff_stall_ingress;
  164      assign eth_data_error_flag = 1'b0;
  165      assign m_axis_hdr_tlast    = 1'b0;
  166  
  167      wire hdr_sys_busy;
  168      reg  payload_streaming;
  169      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  170          if (!rst_n) payload_streaming <= 1'b0;
  171          else if (tx_trigger_gen) payload_streaming <= 1'b1;
  172          else if (m_axis_fso_tvalid && m_axis_fso_tready && m_axis_fso_tlast) payload_streaming <= 1'b0;
  173      end
  174  
  175      wire frame_busy = hdr_sys_busy || payload_streaming;
  176  
  177      // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N04] Signal new DATA availability to scheduler only when either:
  178      // (a) fifo_data in u_fso_payload_top already holds buffered DATA words (data_tvalid), OR
  179      // (b) a new ingress segment is waiting at s_axis_eth_tvalid before streaming starts.
  180      wire fifo_data_has_frame = u_fso_payload_top.data_tvalid;
  181      wire new_data_seg_ready  = (chk_eth_tvalid && !seg_in_progress) || fifo_data_has_frame;
  182  
  183      // =======================================================
  184      // [Rev 2.8 & Rev 2.9 - Fix A11 & B17] 8-DEEP OUTBOUND HEADER ACK QUEUE
  185      // =======================================================
  186      reg [15:0] ack_q_rxfn [0:7];
  187      reg        ack_q_bit  [0:7];
  188      reg [2:0]  ack_q_wr_ptr;
  189      reg [2:0]  ack_q_rd_ptr;
  190      reg [3:0]  ack_q_count;
  191      reg [15:0] ack_q_overflow_cnt;
  192      integer    q_idx;
  193  
  194      wire ack_q_pop  = tx_trigger_gen && (ack_q_count > 4'd0);
  195      // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B17] Accept new ACK when space is available OR when a full queue pops simultaneously
  196      wire ack_q_push = rx_ack_valid_in && ((ack_q_count < 4'd8) || ack_q_pop) &&
  197                        !(tx_trigger_gen && (ack_q_count == 4'd0));
  198  
  199      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  200          if (!rst_n) begin
  201              ack_q_wr_ptr       <= 3'd0;
  202              ack_q_rd_ptr       <= 3'd0;
  203              ack_q_count        <= 4'd0;
  204              ack_q_overflow_cnt <= 16'd0;
  205              for (q_idx = 0; q_idx < 8; q_idx = q_idx + 1) begin
  206                  ack_q_rxfn[q_idx] <= 16'd0;
  207                  ack_q_bit[q_idx]  <= 1'b0;
  208              end
  209          end else begin
  210              if (ack_q_push) begin
  211                  ack_q_rxfn[ack_q_wr_ptr] <= rx_rxfn_in;
  212                  ack_q_bit[ack_q_wr_ptr]  <= rx_ack_in;
  213                  ack_q_wr_ptr             <= ack_q_wr_ptr + 3'd1;
  214              end else if (rx_ack_valid_in && (ack_q_count == 4'd8) && !ack_q_pop) begin
  215                  ack_q_overflow_cnt       <= ack_q_overflow_cnt + 16'd1;
  216              end
  217              if (ack_q_pop) begin
  218                  ack_q_rd_ptr <= ack_q_rd_ptr + 3'd1;
  219              end
  220              if (ack_q_push && !ack_q_pop)
  221                  ack_q_count <= ack_q_count + 4'd1;
  222              else if (!ack_q_push && ack_q_pop)
  223                  ack_q_count <= ack_q_count - 4'd1;
  224          end
  225      end
  226  
  227      wire [15:0] hdr_rxfn_mux      = (ack_q_count > 4'd0) ? ack_q_rxfn[ack_q_rd_ptr] : rx_rxfn_in;
  228      wire        hdr_ack_mux       = (ack_q_count > 4'd0) ? ack_q_bit[ack_q_rd_ptr]  : rx_ack_in;
  229      wire        hdr_ack_valid_mux = (ack_q_count > 4'd0) || rx_ack_valid_in;
  230  
  231      // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A11] Strictly exclusive parameter selection:
  232      // LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT == 1 -> always local rx_*_in; 0 -> always remote peer_*_in
  233      wire [15:0] safe_peer_rxfn   = (^peer_rxfn_in === 1'bx) ? 16'd0 : peer_rxfn_in;
  234      wire        safe_peer_ack    = (peer_ack_in === 1'b1);
  235      wire        safe_peer_valid  = (peer_ack_valid_in === 1'b1);
  236  
  237      wire [15:0] tracker_rxfn_in  = LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT ? rx_rxfn_in      : safe_peer_rxfn;
  238      wire        tracker_ack_in   = LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT ? rx_ack_in       : safe_peer_ack;
  239      wire        tracker_valid_in = LOOPBACK_ARQ_DIRECT ? rx_ack_valid_in : safe_peer_valid;
  240  
  241      // =======================================================
  242      // [Rev 2.7 - Fix N13] EGRESS TIMESTAMP PREDICTION WITH 10^12 PS ROLLOVER & MOD-60 CARRY
  243      // =======================================================
  244      localparam [39:0] ONE_SEC_PICOSEC = 40'd1_000_000_000_000;
  245  
  246      wire [40:0] raw_egress_tx_ts       = {1'b0, tx_phy_ts_picosec} + {1'b0, TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS};
  247      wire        tx_ts_sec_carry        = (raw_egress_tx_ts >= {1'b0, ONE_SEC_PICOSEC});
  248      wire [39:0] predicted_egress_tx_ts = tx_ts_sec_carry ?
  249                                           (raw_egress_tx_ts[39:0] - ONE_SEC_PICOSEC) :
  250                                           raw_egress_tx_ts[39:0];
  251      wire [5:0]  compensated_tod_sec    = tx_ts_sec_carry ?
  252                                           ((tod_seconds_in >= 6'd59) ? 6'd0 : (tod_seconds_in + 6'd1)) :
  253                                           tod_seconds_in;
  254      // SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.3.4: 3'b000 indicates TX_TS applies to the current frame
  255      wire [2:0]  active_ts_applies      = 3'b000;
  256  
  257      // =======================================================
  258      // B. ARQ TX CONTROLLER (The Orchestrator Brain)
  259      // =======================================================
  260      arq_tx_controller u_arq_tx_controller (
  261          .clk               (clk),
  262          .rst_n             (rst_n),
  263          .fso_data_valid    (new_data_seg_ready),
  264          .mgmt_tick_1hz     (mgmt_trigger_1hz),
  265          .header_gen_busy   (frame_busy),
  266          
  267          .rx_rxfn_in        (tracker_rxfn_in),
  268          .rx_ack_in         (tracker_ack_in),
  269          .rx_ack_valid_in   (tracker_valid_in),
  270          
  271          .tx_txfn_out       (tx_txfn_out),
  272          .tx_frame_type     (frame_type_out),
  273          .tx_trigger_gen    (tx_trigger_gen),
  274          .payload_mux_sel   (payload_mux_sel),
  275          .tx_stall_mac      (tx_stall_mac),
  276          
  277          .ddr4_write_req    (ddr4_write_req),
  278          .ddr4_read_req     (ddr4_read_req),
  279          .ddr4_delete_req   (ddr4_delete_req),
  280          .ddr4_addr         (ddr4_addr)
  281      );
  282  
  283      // =======================================================
  284      // C. HEADER TOP SUBSYSTEM (16-Byte Formatter)
  285      // =======================================================
  286      fso_header_top u_fso_header_top (
  287          .clk                 (clk),
  288          .rst_n               (rst_n),
  289          .trigger_header_gen  (tx_trigger_gen),
  290          
  291          // Sequence & Status Inputs (From ARQ & Frame Scheduler)
  292          .txfn_in             (tx_txfn_out),
  293          .rxfn_in             (hdr_rxfn_mux),            
  294          .ack_in              (hdr_ack_mux),             
  295          .ack_valid_in        (hdr_ack_valid_mux),       
  296          .frame_type_in       (frame_type_out),
  297          
  298          // PNT, Timestamp Manager & Control/Status Manager (FCCH)
  299          .tx_ts_in            (predicted_egress_tx_ts),
  300          .tod_seconds_in      (compensated_tod_sec),
  301          .ts_applies_in       (active_ts_applies),
  302          .fcch_opcode_in      (fcch_opcode),
  303          .fcch_pl_in          (fcch_pl),
  304          
  305          // Standardized 8-bit Output Stream
  306          .final_header_byte   (m_axis_hdr_tdata),
  307          .final_header_valid  (m_axis_hdr_tvalid),
  308          .system_busy         (hdr_sys_busy)
  309      );
  310  
  311      // =======================================================
  312      // D. PAYLOAD TOP SUBSYSTEM (1912-Byte Formatter)
  313      // =======================================================
  314      fso_payload_top u_fso_payload_top (
  315          .clk               (clk),
  316          .rst_n             (rst_n),
  317          
  318          .s_axis_eth_tdata  (chk_eth_tdata),
  319          .s_axis_eth_tvalid (chk_eth_tvalid && !eff_stall_ingress),
  320          .s_axis_eth_tlast  (chk_eth_tlast),
  321          .s_axis_eth_tready (payload_eth_tready),
  322          .seg_valid_bytes   (seg_valid_bytes),
  323          
  324          .payload_mux_sel   (payload_mux_sel),
  325          .txfn_in           (tx_txfn_out),
  326          .ddr4_write_req    (ddr4_write_req),
  327          .ddr4_read_req     (ddr4_read_req),
  328          .ddr4_delete_req   (ddr4_delete_req),
  329          .ddr4_addr         (ddr4_addr),
  330          
  331          .mgmt_trigger_1hz  (mgmt_trigger_1hz),
  332          .rx_phy_ts_sec     (rx_phy_ts_sec),
  333          .rx_phy_ts_picosec (rx_phy_ts_picosec),
  334          .tx_phy_ts_sec     (tx_phy_ts_sec),
  335          .tx_phy_ts_picosec (tx_phy_ts_picosec),
  336          .range_meters      (range_meters),
  337          .range_ts_sec      (range_ts_sec),
  338          .range_ts_picosec  (range_ts_picosec),
  339          .ts_valid          (ts_valid),
  340          
  341          .m_axis_fso_tdata  (m_axis_fso_tdata),
  342          .m_axis_fso_tvalid (m_axis_fso_tvalid),
  343          .m_axis_fso_tlast  (m_axis_fso_tlast),
  344          .m_axis_fso_tready (m_axis_fso_tready)
  345      );
  346  
  347  endmodule
sources_1/new/frame_demultiplexer.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : frame_demultiplexer
    7  Description  : Data Plane Frame Router (1908-Byte / 477-Word Payload).
    8                 Routes verified payloads based on rx_frame_type[1:0]:
    9                 - 2'b00 (IDLE): Routed to idle_discard.v
   10                 - 2'b10 (MGMT): Routed to mgmt_extraction.v
   11                 - 2'b01 (DATA): Routed to arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper.v
   12  ===========================================================================
   13  */
   14  
   15  module frame_demultiplexer (
   16      input  wire        clk,
   17      input  wire        rst_n,
   18  
   19      // Verified 1908-Byte Payload from deframer_payload
   20      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_pld_tdata,
   21      input  wire        s_axis_pld_tvalid,
   22      input  wire        s_axis_pld_tlast,
   23  
   24      // Header Context & Control Inputs
   25      input  wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   26      input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   27      input  wire        non_data_seq_adv,
   28      input  wire [15:0] non_data_txfn,
   29  
   30      // In-Order 1908-Byte DATA Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
   31      output wire [31:0] m_axis_data_tdata,
   32      output wire        m_axis_data_tvalid,
   33      output wire        m_axis_data_tlast,
   34      input  wire        m_axis_data_tready,
   35  
   36      // Extracted MGMT Telemetry Outputs
   37      output wire [5:0]  mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec,
   38      output wire [39:0] mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   39      output wire [5:0]  mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec,
   40      output wire [39:0] mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   41      output wire [63:0] mgmt_range_meters,
   42      output wire [31:0] mgmt_range_ts_sec,
   43      output wire [39:0] mgmt_range_ts_picosec,
   44      output wire        mgmt_ts_valid,
   45      output wire        mgmt_telemetry_valid,
   46  
   47      // Diagnostic Counters
   48      output wire [15:0] expected_txfn,
   49      output wire [15:0] idle_frame_cnt,
   50      output wire [15:0] mgmt_frame_cnt
   51  );
   52  
   53      wire is_idle = (rx_frame_type == 2'b00);
   54      wire is_data = (rx_frame_type == 2'b01);
   55      wire is_mgmt = (rx_frame_type == 2'b10);
   56  
   57      // 1. IDLE Frame Termination (2'b00)
   58      idle_discard u_idle_discard (
   59          .clk               (clk),
   60          .rst_n             (rst_n),
   61          .s_axis_idle_tdata (is_idle ? s_axis_pld_tdata : 32'd0),
   62          .s_axis_idle_tvalid(s_axis_pld_tvalid && is_idle),
   63          .s_axis_idle_tlast (s_axis_pld_tlast  && is_idle),
   64          .idle_frame_cnt    (idle_frame_cnt),
   65          .idle_byte_cnt     ()
   66      );
   67  
   68      // 2. MGMT Frame Telemetry Extraction (2'b10)
   69      mgmt_extraction u_mgmt_extraction (
   70          .clk                     (clk),
   71          .rst_n                   (rst_n),
   72          .s_axis_mgmt_tdata       (is_mgmt ? s_axis_pld_tdata : 32'd0),
   73          .s_axis_mgmt_tvalid      (s_axis_pld_tvalid && is_mgmt),
   74          .s_axis_mgmt_tlast       (s_axis_pld_tlast  && is_mgmt),
   75          .mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec      (mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec),
   76          .mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec  (mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec),
   77          .mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec      (mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec),
   78          .mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec  (mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec),
   79          .mgmt_range_meters       (mgmt_range_meters),
   80          .mgmt_range_ts_sec       (mgmt_range_ts_sec),
   81          .mgmt_range_ts_picosec   (mgmt_range_ts_picosec),
   82          .mgmt_ts_valid           (mgmt_ts_valid),
   83          .mgmt_telemetry_valid    (mgmt_telemetry_valid),
   84          .mgmt_frame_cnt          (mgmt_frame_cnt)
   85      );
   86  
   87      // 3. Selective Repeat ARQ Reorder Buffer for DATA Frames (2'b01)
   88      arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper u_arq_rx_reorder (
   89          .clk               (clk),
   90          .rst_n             (rst_n),
   91          .s_axis_data_tdata (is_data ? s_axis_pld_tdata : 32'd0),
   92          .s_axis_data_tvalid(s_axis_pld_tvalid && is_data),
   93          .s_axis_data_tlast (s_axis_pld_tlast  && is_data),
   94          .rx_txfn_in        (rx_txfn),
   95          .non_data_seq_adv  (non_data_seq_adv),
   96          .non_data_txfn     (non_data_txfn),
   97          .m_axis_ord_tdata  (m_axis_data_tdata),
   98          .m_axis_ord_tvalid (m_axis_data_tvalid),
   99          .m_axis_ord_tlast  (m_axis_data_tlast),
  100          .m_axis_ord_tready (m_axis_data_tready),
  101          .expected_txfn     (expected_txfn)
  102      );
  103  
  104  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_axis_fifo.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : FSO AXI-Stream Synchronous FIFO.
    7                 Configurable depth. Designed to be instantiated as:
    8                 - fifo_data  (Buffers normal Payload traffic)
    9                 - fifo_idle  (Buffers PRBS Idle traffic)
   10                 - fifo_mgmt  (Buffers Telemetry/PNT traffic)
   11  Revision Notes:
   12                 - Separated the 'mem' array write operation into a dedicated 
   13                   'always @(posedge clk)' block without asynchronous reset so 
   14                   Vivado infers Distributed LUTRAM cleanly.
   15  ===========================================================================
   16  */
   17  
   18  module fso_axis_fifo #(
   19      parameter DATA_WIDTH = 32,
   20      parameter FIFO_DEPTH = 1024,
   21      parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 10,
   22      parameter DEPTH      = FIFO_DEPTH,
   23      parameter PTR_WIDTH  = ADDR_WIDTH
   24  )(
   25      input  wire                  clk,
   26      input  wire                  rst_n,
   27  
   28      // AXI-Stream Slave (Write Side)
   29      input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] s_axis_tdata,
   30      input  wire                  s_axis_tvalid,
   31      input  wire                  s_axis_tlast,
   32      output wire                  s_axis_tready,
   33  
   34      // AXI-Stream Master (Read Side)
   35      output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata,
   36      output wire                  m_axis_tvalid,
   37      output wire                  m_axis_tlast,
   38      input  wire                  m_axis_tready
   39  );
   40  
   41      (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [DATA_WIDTH:0] mem [0:FIFO_DEPTH-1];
   42  
   43      reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_ptr;
   44      reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_ptr;
   45      reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   count;
   46  
   47      wire full  = (count == FIFO_DEPTH);
   48      wire empty = (count == 0);
   49  
   50      assign s_axis_tready = !full;
   51      assign m_axis_tvalid = !empty;
   52  
   53      wire [DATA_WIDTH:0] head_word = mem[rd_ptr];
   54      assign m_axis_tdata = m_axis_tvalid ? head_word[DATA_WIDTH-1:0] : {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   55      assign m_axis_tlast = m_axis_tvalid ? head_word[DATA_WIDTH]     : 1'b0;
   56  
   57      wire wr_en = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   58      wire rd_en = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready;
   59  
   60      // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
   61      always @(posedge clk) begin
   62          if (wr_en) begin
   63              mem[wr_ptr] <= {s_axis_tlast, s_axis_tdata};
   64          end
   65      end
   66  
   67      // Pointer and Occupancy Control Logic
   68      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   69          if (!rst_n) begin
   70              wr_ptr <= {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   71              rd_ptr <= {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   72              count  <= {(ADDR_WIDTH+1){1'b0}};
   73          end else begin
   74              if (wr_en) begin
   75                  wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1'b1;
   76              end
   77              if (rd_en) begin
   78                  rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1'b1;
   79              end
   80              case ({wr_en, rd_en})
   81                  2'b10:   count <= count + 1'b1;
   82                  2'b01:   count <= count - 1'b1;
   83                  default: count <= count;
   84              endcase
   85          end
   86      end
   87  
   88  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_crc_16.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini (Original Core Math) 
    6                 Williamsyah Baginda Miraj (Refactoring)
    7  Description  : FSO Frame Header CRC-16 Generator.
    8                 Uses polynomial: g(x) = x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1
    9                 Compliant with SDA OISL Table 2-15.
   10                 Processes 14 Bytes of Header data sequentially (8-bit/clock).
   11  ===========================================================================
   12  */
   13  
   14  module fso_crc_16 #(parameter max = 15) (
   15      input  wire       clk,
   16      input  wire       rst_n,
   17      input  wire       en,
   18      input  wire [7:0] data_in,
   19      output wire       flag,
   20      output wire [7:0] data_out
   21  );
   22  
   23      reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   24  
   25      localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   26      localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   27      localparam END    = 3'b100;
   28  
   29      reg [2:0] state, next_state;
   30      reg [7:0] temp, crc_out;
   31  
   32      wire [15:0] D;
   33      reg  [15:0] Q = 16'b0;
   34      reg  [15:0] R = 16'b0;
   35  
   36      // FSM State Register
   37      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   38          if (~rst_n) state <= IDLE;
   39          else        state <= next_state;
   40      end
   41  
   42      // Byte Counter
   43      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   44          if (~rst_n) count <= 8'd0;
   45          else if (state == ACTIVE) count <= count + 1'b1;
   46          else count <= 8'd0;
   47      end
   48  
   49      // Next State Logic
   50      always @(*) begin
   51          case(state)
   52              IDLE:    next_state = en ? ACTIVE : IDLE;
   53              ACTIVE:  next_state = (count < max) ? ACTIVE : END;
   54              END:     next_state = IDLE;
   55              default: next_state = IDLE;
   56          endcase
   57      end
   58  
   59      // Input Register
   60      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   61          if (~rst_n) temp <= 8'd0;
   62          else        temp <= data_in;
   63      end
   64  
   65      // Shift Register Processing
   66      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   67          if(~rst_n) begin
   68              Q <= 16'b0;
   69              R <= 16'b0;
   70          end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
   71              if (count < max) begin
   72                  Q <= D;
   73                  if (count == max - 2) R <= D; // Latch final CRC
   74              end else begin
   75                  Q <= 16'b0;
   76                  R <= 16'b0;
   77              end
   78          end
   79      end
   80  
   81      // Output Formatting (The Hardware MUX) -- following figure 2-9 sda oisl
   82      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   83          if(~rst_n) crc_out <= 8'b0;
   84          else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
   85              if (count < max - 1)      crc_out <= temp;      // Pass-through data
   86              else if (count == max - 1) crc_out <= R[15:8];  // Append CRC High Byte
   87              else if (count == max)     crc_out <= R[7:0];   // Append CRC Low Byte
   88          end
   89      end
   90  
   91      // CORE MATH: CCITT-16 XOR Logic (by Irzal Zaini)
   92      assign D[0]  = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4];
   93      assign D[1]  = Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5];
   94      assign D[2]  = Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6];
   95      assign D[3]  = Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
   96      assign D[4]  = Q[12] ^ temp[4];
   97      assign D[5]  = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[5];
   98      assign D[6]  = Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5] ^ temp[6];
   99      assign D[7]  = Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[7];
  100      assign D[8]  = Q[0] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
  101      assign D[9]  = Q[1] ^ Q[12] ^ temp[4];
  102      assign D[10] = Q[2] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[5];
  103      assign D[11] = Q[3] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[6];
  104      assign D[12] = Q[4] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[7];
  105      assign D[13] = Q[5] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5];
  106      assign D[14] = Q[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6];
  107      assign D[15] = Q[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
  108  
  109      assign flag     = (count != 0);
  110      assign data_out = (flag) ? crc_out : 8'b0;
  111  
  112  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_crc_16_checker.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : fso_crc_16_checker
    7  Description  : 16-bit Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC-16) Verifier for the 
    8                 16-Byte SDA OISL Frame Header.
    9                 Computes the CRC-16 polynomial x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1 over 
   10                 the first 14 Header bytes (d0..d13) and compares the result 
   11                 against bytes d14..d15.
   12  
   13  Revision History:
   14    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-Byte Header CRC-16 verifier.
   15    - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #3 - Strict CRC-16 Verification]
   16      Added parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0 (disabled by default) so operational 
   17      synthesis and compliance verification strictly require (rx_crc_word == Q) 
   18      without accepting the legacy simulation marker (16'hC160 + TXFN).
   19  ===========================================================================
   20  */
   21  
   22  module fso_crc_16_checker #(
   23      parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0
   24  )(
   25      input  wire       clk,
   26      input  wire       rst_n,
   27      input  wire       en,             // 16 cycles active from CDC 4 (header_dv)
   28      input  wire [7:0] data_in,        // 8-bit Header stream (d0..d15)
   29      output reg        hdr_check_done, // 1-cycle pulse after 16th byte
   30      output reg        hdr_crc_ok,     // 1 = CRC-16 PASS, 0 = CRC-16 FAIL
   31      output reg [15:0] calculated_crc,
   32      output reg [15:0] received_crc
   33  );
   34  
   35      reg [4:0]  byte_cnt;
   36      reg [15:0] Q;
   37      reg [7:0]  txfn_lsb;
   38      reg [7:0]  txfn_msb;
   39      reg [7:0]  crc_msb_rx;
   40  
   41      // Parallel LFSR feedback equations for x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1
   42      wire [15:0] D;
   43      assign D[0]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12];
   44      assign D[1]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   45      assign D[2]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   46      assign D[3]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   47      assign D[4]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[12];
   48      assign D[5]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13];
   49      assign D[6]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14];
   50      assign D[7]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15];
   51      assign D[8]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[0]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   52      assign D[9]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[1]  ^ Q[12];
   53      assign D[10] = data_in[5] ^ Q[2]  ^ Q[13];
   54      assign D[11] = data_in[6] ^ Q[3]  ^ Q[14];
   55      assign D[12] = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[4]  ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15];
   56      assign D[13] = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[5]  ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   57      assign D[14] = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[6]  ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   58      assign D[15] = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[7]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   59  
   60      wire [15:0] rx_crc_word    = {crc_msb_rx, data_in};
   61      wire [15:0] sim_marker_crc = 16'hC160 + {txfn_msb, txfn_lsb};
   62  
   63      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   64          if (!rst_n) begin
   65              byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   66              Q              <= 16'd0;
   67              txfn_lsb       <= 8'd0;
   68              txfn_msb       <= 8'd0;
   69              crc_msb_rx     <= 8'd0;
   70              hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   71              hdr_crc_ok     <= 1'b0;
   72              calculated_crc <= 16'd0;
   73              received_crc   <= 16'd0;
   74          end else begin
   75              hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   76  
   77              if (en) begin
   78                  if (byte_cnt == 5'd0)  txfn_lsb <= data_in;
   79                  if (byte_cnt == 5'd1)  txfn_msb <= data_in;
   80  
   81                  if (byte_cnt < 5'd14) begin
   82                      // Bytes 0..13: Accumulate CRC-16 over 14-Byte Header
   83                      Q        <= D;
   84                      byte_cnt <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   85                  end else if (byte_cnt == 5'd14) begin
   86                      // Byte 14: Capture received CRC-16 MSB
   87                      crc_msb_rx <= data_in;
   88                      byte_cnt   <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   89                  end else begin
   90                      // Byte 15 (16th Byte): Capture CRC-16 LSB and verify
   91                      calculated_crc <= Q;
   92                      received_crc   <= rx_crc_word;
   93                      hdr_check_done <= 1'b1;
   94                      hdr_crc_ok     <= (rx_crc_word == Q) ||
   95                                        (SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT && (rx_crc_word == sim_marker_crc));
   96                      byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   97                      Q              <= 16'd0;
   98                  end
   99              end else begin
  100                  byte_cnt <= 5'd0;
  101                  Q        <= 16'd0;
  102              end
  103          end
  104      end
  105  
  106  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_crc_32.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj, Irzal Zaini, & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : SDA OISL FSO CRC-32 Generator (AXI4-Stream Compliant).
    7                 Utilizes parallel 32-bit XOR tree for zero-latency computation.
    8                 Dynamic FSM intercepts the `tlast` signal from the 1908-Byte 
    9                 payload, suppresses it, appends the 4-Byte calculated CRC, 
   10                 and re-asserts the true `tlast` at the 1912th Byte.
   11  ===========================================================================
   12  */
   13  
   14  module fso_crc_32 (
   15      input  wire        clk,
   16      input  wire        rst_n,
   17  
   18      // Input from fso_payload.v (1908 Bytes / 477 Words)
   19      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   20      input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   21      input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   22      output wire        s_axis_tready,
   23  
   24      // Output to fifo_data (1912 Bytes / 478 Words)
   25      output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   26      output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   27      output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   28      input  wire        m_axis_tready
   29  );
   30  
   31      localparam S_DATA = 1'b0, S_CRC = 1'b1;
   32      reg state;
   33  
   34      reg  [31:0] crc_reg;
   35      wire [31:0] next_crc;
   36  
   37      // =======================================================
   38      // AXI4-Stream Handshake Logic
   39      // =======================================================
   40      // We can accept new data if we are in S_DATA and the output 
   41      // register is either empty (!m_axis_tvalid) or being read this cycle.
   42      assign s_axis_tready = (state == S_DATA) && (!m_axis_tvalid || m_axis_tready);
   43      
   44      wire fire_in  = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   45      wire fire_out = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready;
   46  
   47      // =======================================================
   48      // Dynamic FSM & Data Pipeline
   49      // =======================================================
   50      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   51          if (!rst_n) begin
   52              state         <= S_DATA;
   53              crc_reg       <= 32'd0;
   54              m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   55              m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   56              m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   57          end else begin
   58              // Clear valid flag if downstream accepted the data
   59              if (fire_out) begin
   60                  m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   61              end
   62  
   63              case (state)
   64                  S_DATA: begin
   65                      if (fire_in) begin
   66                          m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   67                          m_axis_tdata  <= s_axis_tdata; // Passthrough payload
   68                          m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;         // Suppress incoming tlast
   69                          crc_reg       <= next_crc;     // Update running CRC
   70  
   71                          // Intercept the end of the payload
   72                          if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   73                              state <= S_CRC;
   74                          end
   75                      end
   76                  end
   77  
   78                  S_CRC: begin
   79                      // Wait until output is free to append the CRC
   80                      if (!m_axis_tvalid || fire_out) begin
   81                          m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   82                          m_axis_tdata  <= crc_reg;      // Inject 4-Byte CRC
   83                          m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b1;         // Assert true end of frame
   84                          crc_reg       <= 32'd0;        // Reset CRC for next frame
   85                          state         <= S_DATA;       // Loop back
   86                      end
   87                  end
   88              endcase
   89          end
   90      end
   91  
   92      // =======================================================
   93      // Combinational Parallel 32-bit CRC XOR Tree
   94      // Adapted from Irzal Zaini's original architecture
   95      // =======================================================
   96      assign next_crc[0] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
   97      assign next_crc[1] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[28];
   98      assign next_crc[2] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
   99      assign next_crc[3] = crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  100      assign next_crc[4] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  101      assign next_crc[5] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29];
  102      assign next_crc[6] = crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[30];
  103      assign next_crc[7] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29];
  104      assign next_crc[8] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  105      assign next_crc[9] = crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[29];
  106      assign next_crc[10] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  107      assign next_crc[11] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  108      assign next_crc[12] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  109      assign next_crc[13] = crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  110      assign next_crc[14] = crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[29];
  111      assign next_crc[15] = crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[30];
  112      assign next_crc[16] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[30];
  113      assign next_crc[17] = crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  114      assign next_crc[18] = crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  115      assign next_crc[19] = crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[29];
  116      assign next_crc[20] = crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[30];
  117      assign next_crc[21] = crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  118      assign next_crc[22] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  119      assign next_crc[23] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  120      assign next_crc[24] = crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[16] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[16] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[30];
  121      assign next_crc[25] = crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[17] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[17] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  122      assign next_crc[26] = crc_reg[0] ^ crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[18] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[0] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[18] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  123      assign next_crc[27] = crc_reg[1] ^ crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[19] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[1] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[19] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[29];
  124      assign next_crc[28] = crc_reg[2] ^ crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[12] ^ crc_reg[20] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[2] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[12] ^ s_axis_tdata[20] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[30];
  125      assign next_crc[29] = crc_reg[3] ^ crc_reg[6] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[13] ^ crc_reg[21] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[3] ^ s_axis_tdata[6] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[13] ^ s_axis_tdata[21] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  126      assign next_crc[30] = crc_reg[4] ^ crc_reg[7] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[10] ^ crc_reg[14] ^ crc_reg[22] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[26] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[4] ^ s_axis_tdata[7] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[10] ^ s_axis_tdata[14] ^ s_axis_tdata[22] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[26] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[30];
