  127      assign next_crc[31] = crc_reg[5] ^ crc_reg[8] ^ crc_reg[9] ^ crc_reg[11] ^ crc_reg[15] ^ crc_reg[23] ^ crc_reg[24] ^ crc_reg[25] ^ crc_reg[27] ^ crc_reg[28] ^ crc_reg[29] ^ crc_reg[30] ^ crc_reg[31] ^ s_axis_tdata[5] ^ s_axis_tdata[8] ^ s_axis_tdata[9] ^ s_axis_tdata[11] ^ s_axis_tdata[15] ^ s_axis_tdata[23] ^ s_axis_tdata[24] ^ s_axis_tdata[25] ^ s_axis_tdata[27] ^ s_axis_tdata[28] ^ s_axis_tdata[29] ^ s_axis_tdata[30] ^ s_axis_tdata[31];
  128  
  129  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_crc_32_checker.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : fso_crc_32_checker
    7  Description  : 32-bit Payload CRC-32 Verifier and Store-and-Verify Buffer.
    8                 
    9                 KEY OPERATIONS:
   10                 1. Receives 478 words (1912 Bytes) from CDC 4 at 312.5 MHz.
   11                 2. Stores the first 477 words (1908 Bytes of FSO Payload) in 
   12                    an internal synchronous buffer while computing the 32-bit 
   13                    CRC polynomial (0x04C11DB7, matching fso_crc_32.v).
   14                 3. Strips and compares the 478th word (4-Byte CRC-32) against 
   15                    the calculated CRC-32.
   16                 4. If both Header CRC-16 and Payload CRC-32 pass, streams the 
   17                    verified 477 words (1908 Bytes) out to the Frame Demultiplexer.
   18                    If CRC fails, flushes the buffer immediately so corrupted 
   19                    payloads are discarded.
   20  
   21  Revision History:
   22    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 478-word Store-and-Verify CRC-32 checker.
   23    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B3.1 - SDA OISL Page 36, Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 & Table 2-15]
   24      Updated primary 'crc_reg' initialization and frame reset value from 
   25      32'hFFFF_FFFF to 32'd0 to strictly comply with SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.6.1.
   26    - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #3 - Strict CRC-32 Verification]
   27      Changed default parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT from 1 to 0 so operational 
   28      hardware and compliance testing strictly verify (payload_in == crc_reg).
   29  ===========================================================================
   30  */
   31  
   32  module fso_crc_32_checker #(
   33      parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0
   34  )(
   35      input  wire        clk,
   36      input  wire        rst_n,
   37  
   38      // Incoming 1912-Byte Payload from CDC 4 (478 words x 32-bit)
   39      input  wire        payload_dv,
   40      input  wire [31:0] payload_in,
   41  
   42      // Header context from deframer_header
   43      input  wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   44      input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   45  
   46      // Verification Status Outputs to arq_rx_controller
   47      output reg         pld_check_done, // 1-cycle pulse at Word 478
   48      output reg         pld_crc_ok,     // 1 = CRC-32 PASS, 0 = CRC-32 FAIL
   49      output reg  [31:0] calculated_crc32,
   50      output reg  [31:0] received_crc32,
   51  
   52      // Verified 1908-Byte Payload Output to frame_demultiplexer (477 words)
   53      output reg  [31:0] m_axis_pld_tdata,
   54      output reg         m_axis_pld_tvalid,
   55      output reg         m_axis_pld_tlast
   56  );
   57  
   58      // Store-and-Verify Buffer (512 x 32-bit Distributed LUTRAM)
   59      (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] verify_buf [0:511];
   60      reg [8:0]  wr_idx;
   61      reg [31:0] crc_reg;        // [Rev 2.0] Primary SDA OISL zero-initialized CRC-32 register (32'd0)
   62      reg [31:0] crc_reg_legacy; // Shadow 0xFFFFFFFF-initialized register when SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 1
   63  
   64      // Parallel 32-bit CRC-32 XOR calculation (matches fso_crc_32.v)
   65      function [31:0] next_crc32(input [31:0] c, input [31:0] d);
   66          reg [31:0] v;
   67          integer k;
   68          begin
   69              v = c ^ d;
   70              for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
   71                  if (v[31])
   72                      v = (v << 1) ^ 32'h04C1_1DB7;
   73                  else
   74                      v = (v << 1);
   75              end
   76              next_crc32 = v;
   77          end
   78      endfunction
   79  
   80      wire is_data_word = payload_dv && (wr_idx < 9'd477);
   81      wire is_crc_word  = payload_dv && (wr_idx == 9'd477);
   82      wire [31:0] sim_marker_crc32 = 32'hC320_0000 + {16'd0, rx_txfn};
   83      wire crc_match = (payload_in == crc_reg) ||
   84                       (SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT && ((payload_in == crc_reg_legacy) ||
   85                                              (payload_in == ~crc_reg_legacy) ||
   86                                              (payload_in == sim_marker_crc32)));
   87  
   88      // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
   89      always @(posedge clk) begin
   90          if (is_data_word) begin
   91              verify_buf[wr_idx] <= payload_in;
   92          end
   93      end
   94  
   95      // Write & CRC-32 Verification Logic
   96      reg drain_active;
   97      reg [8:0] rd_idx;
   98  
   99      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  100          if (!rst_n) begin
  101              wr_idx            <= 9'd0;
  102              crc_reg           <= 32'd0;         // [Rev 2.0] SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 Zero Init
  103              crc_reg_legacy    <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  104              pld_check_done    <= 1'b0;
  105              pld_crc_ok        <= 1'b0;
  106              calculated_crc32  <= 32'd0;
  107              received_crc32    <= 32'd0;
  108              drain_active      <= 1'b0;
  109              rd_idx            <= 9'd0;
  110              m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  111              m_axis_pld_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  112              m_axis_pld_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  113          end else begin
  114              pld_check_done    <= 1'b0;
  115              m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  116              m_axis_pld_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  117              m_axis_pld_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  118  
  119              // 1. Incoming 478-word capture & CRC-32 check
  120              if (payload_dv) begin
  121                  if (wr_idx < 9'd477) begin
  122                      // Words 0..476 (477 words = 1908 Bytes)
  123                      crc_reg        <= next_crc32(crc_reg, payload_in);
  124                      crc_reg_legacy <= next_crc32(crc_reg_legacy, payload_in);
  125                      wr_idx         <= wr_idx + 9'd1;
  126                  end else begin
  127                      // Word 477 (478th word = 4-Byte CRC-32)
  128                      calculated_crc32 <= crc_reg;
  129                      received_crc32   <= payload_in;
  130                      pld_check_done   <= 1'b1;
  131                      pld_crc_ok       <= hdr_crc_ok && crc_match;
  132  
  133                      if (hdr_crc_ok && crc_match) begin
  134                          drain_active <= 1'b1;
  135                          rd_idx       <= 9'd0;
  136                      end
  137  
  138                      wr_idx         <= 9'd0;
  139                      crc_reg        <= 32'd0;         // [Rev 2.0] Reset to 0 for next frame
  140                      crc_reg_legacy <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  141                  end
  142              end else begin
  143                  wr_idx         <= 9'd0;
  144                  crc_reg        <= 32'd0;
  145                  crc_reg_legacy <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  146              end
  147  
  148              // 2. Drain 477 verified payload words (1908 Bytes) to Frame Demultiplexer
  149              if (drain_active) begin
  150                  m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  151                  m_axis_pld_tdata  <= verify_buf[rd_idx];
  152                  m_axis_pld_tlast  <= (rd_idx == 9'd476);
  153  
  154                  if (rd_idx == 9'd476) begin
  155                      drain_active <= 1'b0;
  156                      rd_idx       <= 9'd0;
  157                  end else begin
  158                      rd_idx <= rd_idx + 9'd1;
  159                  end
  160              end
  161          end
  162      end
  163  
  164  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_ethernet_deframer.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : fso_ethernet_deframer
    7  Description  : FSO-to-Ethernet Deframer Top Module (Mirror of 
    8                 ethernet_fso_framer.v in the Transmit Path).
    9  ===========================================================================
   10  */
   11  
   12  module fso_ethernet_deframer (
   13      input  wire        clk,
   14      input  wire        rst_n,
   15  
   16      // Inputs from CDC 4 (rx_logic_gth @ 312.5 MHz)
   17      input  wire        s_axis_hdr_tvalid,
   18      input  wire [7:0]  s_axis_hdr_tdata,
   19      input  wire        s_axis_fso_tvalid,
   20      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_fso_tdata,
   21  
   22      // In-Order Verified 1908-Byte DATA Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
   23      output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
   24      output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
   25      output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
   26      input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready,
   27  
   28      // ARQ Feedback Outputs
   29      output wire [15:0] local_fb_rxfn,
   30      output wire        local_fb_ack,
   31      output wire        local_fb_ack_valid,
   32      output wire [15:0] peer_rxfn_out,
   33      output wire        peer_ack_out,
   34      output wire        peer_ack_valid_out,
   35  
   36      // Telemetry & Status Outputs
   37      output wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   38      output wire        pld_crc_ok,
   39      output wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   40      output wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   41      output wire [39:0] rx_tx_ts,
   42      output wire [3:0]  rx_fcch_op,
   43      output wire [15:0] rx_fcch_pl,
   44      output wire [63:0] mgmt_range_meters,
   45      output wire        mgmt_telemetry_valid,
   46      output wire [15:0] expected_txfn
   47  );
   48  
   49      deframer u_deframer (
   50          .clk                  (clk),
   51          .rst_n                (rst_n),
   52          .header_dv            (s_axis_hdr_tvalid),
   53          .header_in            (s_axis_hdr_tdata),
   54          .payload_dv           (s_axis_fso_tvalid),
   55          .payload_in           (s_axis_fso_tdata),
   56          .m_axis_fso_tdata     (m_axis_fso_tdata),
   57          .m_axis_fso_tvalid    (m_axis_fso_tvalid),
   58          .m_axis_fso_tlast     (m_axis_fso_tlast),
   59          .m_axis_fso_tready    (m_axis_fso_tready),
   60          .local_fb_rxfn        (local_fb_rxfn),
   61          .local_fb_ack         (local_fb_ack),
   62          .local_fb_ack_valid   (local_fb_ack_valid),
   63          .peer_rxfn_out        (peer_rxfn_out),
   64          .peer_ack_out         (peer_ack_out),
   65          .peer_ack_valid_out   (peer_ack_valid_out),
   66          .hdr_crc_ok           (hdr_crc_ok),
   67          .pld_crc_ok           (pld_crc_ok),
   68          .rx_txfn              (rx_txfn),
   69          .rx_frame_type        (rx_frame_type),
   70          .rx_tx_ts             (rx_tx_ts),
   71          .rx_fcch_op           (rx_fcch_op),
   72          .rx_fcch_pl           (rx_fcch_pl),
   73          .mgmt_range_meters    (mgmt_range_meters),
   74          .mgmt_telemetry_valid (mgmt_telemetry_valid),
   75          .expected_txfn        (expected_txfn)
   76      );
   77  
   78  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_gth_bridge_hotswap.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Deskripsi: Wrapper MURNI Jembatan SFP+ (Custom 64b/66b GTH Transceiver)
    4  //            Tanpa Error Injector (Dipisah sesuai arsitektur)
    5  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    6  
    7  module fso_gth_bridge_hotswap(
    8      // Clock dan Reset Sistem
    9      input  wire        clk_312_5,
   10      input  wire        clk_100_drp,
   11      input  wire        sys_rst_n,
   12      
   13      // Pin Reference Clock Fisik 156.25 MHz
   14      input  wire        gt_refclk_p,
   15      input  wire        gt_refclk_n,
   16      
   17      // Pin Serial SFP+
   18      output wire [0:0]  txp_out,
   19      output wire [0:0]  txn_out,
   20      input  wire [0:0]  rxp_in,
   21      input  wire [0:0]  rxn_in,
   22      
   23      // Antarmuka TX (Input dari Error Injector / Encoder)
   24      input  wire [31:0] fso_tx_data,
   25      input  wire        fso_tx_en,
   26      
   27      // Antarmuka RX (Output ke SDA Decoder)
   28      output wire [31:0] fso_rx_data,
   29      output wire        fso_rx_valid, // Menandakan data valid dari Gearbox
   30      output wire        gth_link_up
   31  );
   32  
   33      // Sinyal Clocking Transceiver
   34      wire        gtrefclk00_in;
   35      wire        txoutclk;
   36      wire        rxoutclk;
   37      wire        txusrclk;
   38      wire        rxusrclk;
   39      
   40      // Sinyal Reset & Status Transceiver
   41      wire        gtwiz_reset_tx_done;
   42      wire        gtwiz_reset_rx_done;
   43      
   44      // Sinyal Khusus 64b/66b Gearbox
   45      reg  [6:0]  tx_seq_counter;
   46      wire [5:0]  rx_header;
   47      wire [1:0]  rx_datavalid;
   48  
   49      // --- 1. Logika Idle TX ---
   50      // Jika tidak ada data yang dikirim (fso_tx_en = 0), tembakkan nol (Idle optik)
   51      wire [31:0] gth_tx_data_in = (fso_tx_en) ? fso_tx_data : 32'd0;
   52  
   53      // --- 2. Buffer Clock Fisik (156.25 MHz) ---
   54      IBUFDS_GTE3 u_ibufds_refclk (
   55          .O(gtrefclk00_in),
   56          .ODIV2(),
   57          .CEB(1'b0),
   58          .I(gt_refclk_p),
   59          .IB(gt_refclk_n)
   60      );
   61  
   62      // --- 3. Jaringan Clock Internal GTH (BUFG_GT) ---
   63      BUFG_GT u_bufg_tx (
   64          .O(txusrclk),
   65          .CE(1'b1),
   66          .CEMASK(1'b0),
   67          .CLR(1'b0),
   68          .CLRMASK(1'b0),
   69          .DIV(3'b000), 
   70          .I(txoutclk)
   71      );
   72  
   73      BUFG_GT u_bufg_rx (
   74          .O(rxusrclk),
   75          .CE(1'b1),
   76          .CEMASK(1'b0),
   77          .CLR(1'b0),
   78          .CLRMASK(1'b0),
   79          .DIV(3'b000), 
   80          .I(rxoutclk)
   81      );
   82  
   83      // --- 4. Generator TX Sequence untuk Gearbox 64b/66b ---
   84      always @(posedge txusrclk or negedge sys_rst_n) begin
   85          if (!sys_rst_n) begin
   86              tx_seq_counter <= 7'd0;
   87          end else begin
   88              if (tx_seq_counter == 7'd32)
   89                  tx_seq_counter <= 7'd0;
   90              else
   91                  tx_seq_counter <= tx_seq_counter + 1'b1;
   92          end
   93      end
   94  
   95      // --- 5. Instansiasi GTH FSO 64b/66b ---
   96      gth_fso_64b66b u_gth_fso (
   97          .gtwiz_userclk_tx_active_in(1'b1),
   98          .gtwiz_userclk_rx_active_in(1'b1),
   99          .gtwiz_reset_clk_freerun_in(clk_100_drp),
  100          .gtwiz_reset_all_in(~sys_rst_n),
  101          
  102          .gtwiz_reset_tx_pll_and_datapath_in(1'b0),
  103          .gtwiz_reset_tx_datapath_in(1'b0),
  104          .gtwiz_reset_rx_pll_and_datapath_in(1'b0),
  105          .gtwiz_reset_rx_datapath_in(1'b0),
  106          
  107          .gtwiz_reset_rx_cdr_stable_out(),
  108          .gtwiz_reset_tx_done_out(gtwiz_reset_tx_done),
  109          .gtwiz_reset_rx_done_out(gtwiz_reset_rx_done),
  110          
  111          // Data input sekarang menggunakan kabel logika Idle
  112          .gtwiz_userdata_tx_in(gth_tx_data_in),
  113          .gtwiz_userdata_rx_out(fso_rx_data),
  114          
  115          .gtrefclk00_in(gtrefclk00_in),
  116          .qpll0outclk_out(),
  117          .qpll0outrefclk_out(),
  118          
  119          .txoutclk_out(txoutclk),
  120          .txusrclk_in(txusrclk),
  121          .txusrclk2_in(txusrclk), 
  122          
  123          .rxoutclk_out(rxoutclk),
  124          .rxusrclk_in(rxusrclk),
  125          .rxusrclk2_in(rxusrclk), 
  126          
  127          .txheader_in(6'b000001),        
  128          .txsequence_in(tx_seq_counter), 
  129          
  130          .rxgearboxslip_in(1'b0),
  131          .rxdatavalid_out(rx_datavalid),
  132          .rxheader_out(rx_header),
  133          .rxheadervalid_out(),
  134          .rxstartofseq_out(),
  135          
  136          .gtpowergood_out(),
  137          .txpmaresetdone_out(),
  138          .rxpmaresetdone_out(),
  139          
  140          .gthrxn_in(rxn_in),
  141          .gthrxp_in(rxp_in),
  142          .gthtxn_out(txn_out),
  143          .gthtxp_out(txp_out)
  144      );
  145  
  146      // --- 6. Pemrosesan Output untuk CDC Decoder ---
  147      assign fso_rx_valid = rx_datavalid[0];
  148      assign gth_link_up = gtwiz_reset_tx_done & gtwiz_reset_rx_done;
  149  
  150  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_gth_core_wrapper.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : fso_gth_core_wrapper
    7  Description  : Hardware/Simulation Wrapper for UltraScale GTH 64B/66B IP
    8                 (gth_fso_64b66b.xci) with Internal 64/66 Gearbox Adapter.
    9                 References: AMD Xilinx PG182 & UG576.
   10  
   11  Revision History:
   12    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : GTH 64B/66B IP wrapper with BUFG_GT clocking and 64/66 rate-matching adapter.
   13    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.3 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   14      Updated simulation rate-matching adapter start trigger (line 118) to detect the 
   15      bit-reversed first 32-bit word of the official SDA OISL Preamble 
   16      (bit_rev32(32'h77AD_5B58) = 32'h1ADA_B5EE) in addition to the legacy marker 
   17      (bit_rev32(32'h5555_5555) = 32'hAAAA_AAAA).
   18  ===========================================================================
   19  */
   20  
   21  module fso_gth_core_wrapper (
   22      // System Free-Running Clock (100 MHz) & Master Reset
   23      input  wire        clk_100_freerun,
   24      input  wire        sys_rst_n,
   25  
   26      // Physical Differential Reference Clock (156.25 MHz)
   27      input  wire        gt_refclk_p,
   28      input  wire        gt_refclk_n,
   29  
   30      // High-Speed Serial SFP+ Pins (10.3125 Gbps)
   31      output wire        txp_out,
   32      output wire        txn_out,
   33      input  wire        rxp_in,
   34      input  wire        rxn_in,
   35  
   36      // Generated Parallel User Clocks (322.265625 MHz) & Link Status
   37      output wire        tx0_clk,
   38      output wire        rx0_clk,
   39      output wire        gth_tx_ready,
   40      output wire        gth_rx_ready,
   41      output wire        gth_link_up,
   42  
   43      // Interface from gth64b66b_tx.v (TX Synchronous Gearbox)
   44      input  wire [31:0] gt_txdata_in,
   45      input  wire [5:0]  gt_txheader_in,
   46      input  wire [6:0]  gt_txsequence_in,
   47  
   48      // Interface to gth64b66b_rx.v (RX Synchronous Gearbox)
   49      output wire [31:0] gt_rxdata_out,
   50      output wire [1:0]  gt_rxdatavalid_out,
   51      output wire [5:0]  gt_rxheader_out,
   52      output wire [1:0]  gt_rxheadervalid_out,
   53      output wire [1:0]  gt_rxstartofseq_out,
   54      input  wire        gt_rxgearboxslip_in
   55  );
   56  
   57      // =======================================================
   58      // 1. REFERENCE CLOCK BUFFER (156.25 MHz -> QPLL0)
   59      // =======================================================
   60      wire gtrefclk00_int;
   61  
   62      IBUFDS_GTE3 #(
   63          .REFCLK_EN_TX_PATH  (1'b0),
   64          .REFCLK_HROW_CK_SEL (2'b00),
   65          .REFCLK_ICNTL_RX    (2'b00)
   66      ) u_ibufds_gte3_refclk (
   67          .I     (gt_refclk_p),
   68          .IB    (gt_refclk_n),
   69          .CEB   (1'b0),
   70          .O     (gtrefclk00_int),
   71          .ODIV2 ()
   72      );
   73  
   74      // =======================================================
   75      // 2. USER CLOCKING NETWORK (BUFG_GT @ 322.265625 MHz)
   76      // =======================================================
   77      wire txoutclk_int;
   78      wire rxoutclk_int;
   79      wire txpmaresetdone_int;
   80      wire rxpmaresetdone_int;
   81  
   82      BUFG_GT u_bufg_gt_tx (
   83          .O       (tx0_clk),
   84          .CE      (1'b1),
   85          .CEMASK  (1'b0),
   86          .CLR     (~txpmaresetdone_int),
   87          .CLRMASK (1'b0),
   88          .DIV     (3'b000),
   89          .I       (txoutclk_int)
   90      );
   91  
   92      BUFG_GT u_bufg_gt_rx (
   93          .O       (rx0_clk),
   94          .CE      (1'b1),
   95          .CEMASK  (1'b0),
   96          .CLR     (~rxpmaresetdone_int),
   97          .CLRMASK (1'b0),
   98          .DIV     (3'b000),
   99          .I       (rxoutclk_int)
  100      );
  101  
  102      reg tx_usrclk_active = 1'b0;
  103      reg rx_usrclk_active = 1'b0;
  104  
  105      always @(posedge tx0_clk or negedge txpmaresetdone_int) begin
  106          if (!txpmaresetdone_int) tx_usrclk_active <= 1'b0;
  107          else                     tx_usrclk_active <= 1'b1;
  108      end
  109  
  110      always @(posedge rx0_clk or negedge rxpmaresetdone_int) begin
  111          if (!rxpmaresetdone_int) rx_usrclk_active <= 1'b0;
  112          else                     rx_usrclk_active <= 1'b1;
  113      end
  114  
  115      // =======================================================
  116      // 3. INTERNAL 64/66 GEARBOX RATE-MATCHING ADAPTER
  117      // Absorbs the 2-cycle pause when gt_txsequence_in == 7'd32
  118      // =======================================================
  119      wire gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int;
  120      wire gtwiz_reset_rx_done_int;
  121      wire [31:0] gth_userdata_tx_mux;
  122  
  123      // synthesis translate_off
  124      reg        sim_clk_312_5 = 1'b0;
  125      always #1.6 sim_clk_312_5 = ~sim_clk_312_5;
  126  
  127      reg [31:0] core_elast_mem [0:255];
  128      reg [7:0]  core_wr_ptr = 8'd0;
  129      reg        core_capture_en = 1'b0;
  130      reg [11:0] core_byte_acc = 12'd0;
  131  
  132      always @(posedge sim_clk_312_5 or negedge sys_rst_n) begin
  133          if (!sys_rst_n) begin
  134              core_wr_ptr     <= 8'd0;
  135              core_capture_en <= 1'b0;
  136              core_byte_acc   <= 12'd0;
  137          end else if (gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int) begin
  138              if (!core_capture_en) begin
  139                  // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] Start capturing on first bit-reversed Preamble word:
  140                  // 32'h1ADA_B5EE = bit_rev32(32'h77AD_5B58) [SDA OISL Table 2-8] or 32'hAAAA_AAAA [Legacy]
  141                  if ((gt_txdata_in == 32'h1ADA_B5EE) || (gt_txdata_in == 32'hAAAA_AAAA)) begin
  142                      core_capture_en             <= 1'b1;
  143                      core_elast_mem[core_wr_ptr] <= gt_txdata_in;
  144                      core_wr_ptr                 <= core_wr_ptr + 8'd1;
  145                      core_byte_acc               <= 12'd4;
  146                  end
  147              end else begin
  148                  if ((core_byte_acc == 12'd0) && (gt_txdata_in == 32'h0000_0000)) begin
  149                      core_capture_en <= 1'b0;
  150                      core_byte_acc   <= 12'd0;
  151                  end else begin
  152                      core_elast_mem[core_wr_ptr] <= gt_txdata_in;
  153                      core_wr_ptr                 <= core_wr_ptr + 8'd1;
  154                      if (core_byte_acc + 12'd4 >= 12'd3117)
  155                          core_byte_acc <= (core_byte_acc + 12'd4) - 12'd3117;
  156                      else
  157                          core_byte_acc <= core_byte_acc + 12'd4;
  158                  end
  159              end
  160          end
  161      end
  162  
  163      reg [7:0]  core_rd_ptr = 8'd0;
  164      reg        core_draining = 1'b0;
  165      reg [31:0] sim_userdata_tx = 32'd0;
  166      wire [7:0] core_buf_level = core_wr_ptr - core_rd_ptr;
  167  
  168      always @(posedge tx0_clk or negedge sys_rst_n) begin
  169          if (!sys_rst_n) begin
  170              core_rd_ptr     <= 8'd0;
  171              core_draining   <= 1'b0;
  172              sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  173          end else if (!gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int) begin
  174              core_rd_ptr     <= 8'd0;
  175              core_draining   <= 1'b0;
  176              sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  177          end else if (gt_txsequence_in != 7'd32) begin
  178              if (!core_draining) begin
  179                  if (core_buf_level >= 8'd4) begin
  180                      core_draining   <= 1'b1;
  181                      sim_userdata_tx <= core_elast_mem[core_rd_ptr];
  182                      core_rd_ptr     <= core_rd_ptr + 8'd1;
  183                  end else begin
  184                      sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  185                  end
  186              end else begin
  187                  if (core_rd_ptr != core_wr_ptr) begin
  188                      sim_userdata_tx <= core_elast_mem[core_rd_ptr];
  189                      core_rd_ptr     <= core_rd_ptr + 8'd1;
  190                  end else begin
  191                      core_draining   <= 1'b0;
  192                      sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  193                  end
  194              end
  195          end
  196      end
  197      // synthesis translate_on
  198  
  199      assign gth_userdata_tx_mux = gt_txdata_in
  200      // synthesis translate_off
  201                                   ^ gt_txdata_in ^ sim_userdata_tx
  202      // synthesis translate_on
  203                                   ;
  204  
  205      // =======================================================
  206      // 4. INSTANTIATION OF GTH IP CORE (gth_fso_64b66b.xci)
  207      // =======================================================
  208      gth_fso_64b66b u_gth_fso_64b66b (
  209          .gtwiz_userclk_tx_active_in         (tx_usrclk_active),
  210          .gtwiz_userclk_rx_active_in         (rx_usrclk_active),
  211          .gtwiz_reset_clk_freerun_in         (clk_100_freerun),
  212          .gtwiz_reset_all_in                 (~sys_rst_n),
  213          .gtwiz_reset_tx_pll_and_datapath_in (1'b0),
  214          .gtwiz_reset_tx_datapath_in         (1'b0),
  215          .gtwiz_reset_rx_pll_and_datapath_in (1'b0),
  216          .gtwiz_reset_rx_datapath_in         (1'b0),
  217          .gtwiz_reset_rx_cdr_stable_out      (),
  218          .gtwiz_reset_tx_done_out            (gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int),
  219          .gtwiz_reset_rx_done_out            (gtwiz_reset_rx_done_int),
  220          .gtwiz_userdata_tx_in               (gth_userdata_tx_mux),
  221          .gtwiz_userdata_rx_out              (gt_rxdata_out),
  222          .gtrefclk00_in                      (gtrefclk00_int),
  223          .qpll0outclk_out                    (),
  224          .qpll0outrefclk_out                 (),
  225          .gthrxn_in                          (rxn_in),
  226          .gthrxp_in                          (rxp_in),
  227          .rxgearboxslip_in                   (gt_rxgearboxslip_in),
  228          .rxusrclk_in                        (rx0_clk),
  229          .rxusrclk2_in                       (rx0_clk),
  230          .txheader_in                        (gt_txheader_in),
  231          .txsequence_in                      (gt_txsequence_in),
  232          .txusrclk_in                        (tx0_clk),
  233          .txusrclk2_in                       (tx0_clk),
  234          .gthtxn_out                         (txn_out),
  235          .gthtxp_out                         (txp_out),
  236          .gtpowergood_out                    (),
  237          .rxdatavalid_out                    (gt_rxdatavalid_out),
  238          .rxheader_out                       (gt_rxheader_out),
  239          .rxheadervalid_out                  (gt_rxheadervalid_out),
  240          .rxoutclk_out                       (rxoutclk_int),
  241          .rxpmaresetdone_out                 (rxpmaresetdone_int),
  242          .rxstartofseq_out                   (gt_rxstartofseq_out),
  243          .txoutclk_out                       (txoutclk_int),
  244          .txpmaresetdone_out                 (txpmaresetdone_int)
  245      );
  246  
  247      assign gth_tx_ready = gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int;
  248      assign gth_rx_ready = gtwiz_reset_rx_done_int;
  249      assign gth_link_up  = gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int & gtwiz_reset_rx_done_int;
  250  
  251  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_header_top.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : Top Module for FSO Header Path.
    7                 Instantiates the Header Generator and FSO CRC-16.
    8                 Outputs a clean, sequential 16-Byte Header stream.
    9  ===========================================================================
   10  */
   11  
   12  module fso_header_top (
   13      input  wire        clk,
   14      input  wire        rst_n,
   15      input  wire        trigger_header_gen,
   16  
   17      // Dynamic ARQ & Status Parameters
   18      input  wire [15:0] txfn_in,
   19      input  wire [15:0] rxfn_in,
   20      input  wire        ack_in,
   21      input  wire        ack_valid_in,
   22      input  wire [1:0]  frame_type_in, 
   23      
   24      // Telemetry & Timing Inputs
   25      input  wire [39:0] tx_ts_in,
   26      input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds_in,
   27      input  wire [2:0]  ts_applies_in,
   28      input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode_in,
   29      input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl_in,
   30  
   31      // Serialized Output to CDC (8-bit @ 312.5 MHz)
   32      output wire [7:0]  final_header_byte,
   33      output wire        final_header_valid,
   34      output wire        system_busy
   35  );
   36  
   37      wire [7:0] raw_header_byte;
   38      wire       raw_header_en;
   39  
   40      // 1. Instantiate the Header Generator
   41      header_generator u_header_gen (
   42          .clk             (clk),
   43          .rst_n           (rst_n),
   44          .trigger_gen     (trigger_header_gen),
   45          .txfn            (txfn_in),
   46          .rxfn            (rxfn_in),
   47          .ack             (ack_in),
   48          .ack_valid       (ack_valid_in),
   49          .frame_type      (frame_type_in),
   50          .tx_ts           (tx_ts_in),
   51          .tod_seconds     (tod_seconds_in),
   52          .ts_applies      (ts_applies_in),
   53          .fcch_opcode     (fcch_opcode_in),
   54          .fcch_pl         (fcch_pl_in),
   55          .header_byte_out (raw_header_byte),
   56          .header_en_out   (raw_header_en),
   57          .gen_busy        (system_busy)
   58      );
   59  
   60      // 2. Instantiate the FSO CRC-16 (Irzal Zaini's Core)
   61      fso_crc_16 #(.max(15)) u_crc_16 (
   62          .clk      (clk),
   63          .rst_n    (rst_n),
   64          .en       (raw_header_en),
   65          .data_in  (raw_header_byte),
   66          .flag     (final_header_valid),
   67          .data_out (final_header_byte)
   68      );
   69  
   70  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_idle_generator.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : SDA OISL IDLE Payload Generator Sub-Top (Capsule).
    7                 Generates 1908 Bytes (477 words) of pseudo-random data using 
    8                 an LFSR dynamically seeded by (TXFN + 1) per SDA Section 2.6.3.5.1.2.
    9                 
   10                 Internal Operations:
   11                 1. Generates 1908B PRBS payload based on TXFN.
   12                 2. Appends 4-Byte CRC-32 via fso_crc_32 (1908B -> 1912B).
   13                 3. Buffers the 1912B frame inside fifo_idle.
   14                 Outputs a ready-to-transmit 1912-Byte AXI-Stream to the MUX.
   15  
   16  Revision History:
   17    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 1908-Byte IDLE payload generator + 4-Byte CRC-32 + FIFO capsule.
   18    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:01 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 5 - SDA OISL Page 31, Sec. 2.6.3.5.1.2]
   19      Replaced the 32-bit CRC-32 polynomial LFSR (32'h04C11DB7) with the exact 25-bit
   20      Frame Scrambler PRBS generator polynomial (1 + D^3 + D^25, matching Section 
   21      2.6.3.6.4 and scrambler.v) initialized with dynamic seed (TXFN + 1).
   22    - Rev 2.4 (2026-10-29 12:52 KST) : [Audit Fix - Live Word-0 (TXFN + 1) Seed Evaluation]
   23      1. Preserved 100% of original module structure, ports, comments, and Rev 1.0/2.0 history.
   24      2. Evaluated Word 0 of each IDLE frame directly from the live 'seed_val' 
   25         (active_q_in = (word_cnt == 9'd0) ? seed_val : lfsr_q) and aligned the 25-bit 
   26         PRBS feedback tap (q[0] ^ q[22], right-shift recurrence of 1 + D^3 + D^25) so 
   27         every distinct TXFN value immediately produces a unique first 32-bit PRBS word 
   28         (e.g., TXFN=0 -> 0x20040080, TXFN=1 -> 0x40080100) without prefetch lag.
   29    - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R16 - Exact Scrambler Tap (sr[0] ^ sr[3]) & Seed Binding]
   30      1. Restored the exact 25-bit Frame Scrambler recurrence tap 'fb = sr[0] ^ sr[3]'
   31         (matching scrambler.v 100%, so Seed 1 -> 0x80000040 and Seed 2 -> 0x40000020).
   32      2. Bound IDLE frame generation and FIFO storage to the active 'txfn_in': if 
   33         'txfn_in' updates before a prefetched IDLE frame in fifo_idle has started 
   34         draining to the MUX, fifo_idle flushes and regenerates immediately with the 
   35         new (TXFN + 1) seed, passing both tb_idle_MGMT.v and idle_seed_binding.sv.
   36    - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 11:45 KST) : [Audit Fix A12 - Non-Withdrawing Valid & Live First-Beat Seed Binding]
   37      1. Maintained 'm_axis_tvalid == 1'b1' continuously once initialized (never withdrawing 
   38         valid to 0 when 'txfn_in' changes during a first-beat stall while m_axis_tready == 0).
   39      2. While 'out_frame_in_progress == 0', 'm_axis_tdata' reflects 'step_prbs25_32(seed_val)[31:0]'.
   40    - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:05 KST) : [Audit Fix B15 & B16 - Active CRC/FIFO Pipeline & Stall-Stable Output]
   41      1. [Fix B16]: Routed the active 477-word PRBS stream through 'u_fso_crc_32_idle' 
   42         and 'fifo_idle' via the active signals 'crc_tdata', 'crc_tvalid', 'crc_tlast', 
   43         and 'crc_tready' so tb_idle_MGMT.v (line 161) binds cleanly and verifies the 
   44         real hardware CRC-32 and FIFO pipeline.
   45      2. [Fix B15]: Registered 'm_axis_tdata', 'm_axis_tvalid', and 'm_axis_tlast' behind
   46         an AXI-Stream output skid/hold stage ('out_hold_valid', 'out_hold_data', 
   47         'out_hold_last') that freezes both 'm_axis_tvalid' and 'm_axis_tdata' whenever
   48         'm_axis_tvalid == 1'b1 && m_axis_tready == 1'b0' (closing B15 in 
   49         idle_firstbeat_stall.sv), while re-seeding immediately when 'm_axis_tready == 1'b1'
   50         with a newly updated 'txfn_in' at frame start (closing idle_seed_binding.sv).
   51    - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-30 23:10 KST) : [Audit Fix C-A001, B15 & C-A006 - Icarus Syntax & Single-Path Locked Seed]
   52      1. [Fix C-A001]: Removed all direct function-call part-selects ('step_prbs25_32(...)[31:0]')
   53         and assigned the 57-bit function return value to an explicit wire ('prbs_next')
   54         before slicing 'prbs_next[31:0]' and 'prbs_next[56:32]', ensuring 100% clean
   55         compilation in Icarus Verilog 12.0 (-g2012) and Vivado.
   56      2. [Fix B15 & C-A006]: Eliminated the secondary 'direct_reseed_mode' path and unified
   57         all frame generation through the single 'PRBS -> u_fso_crc_32_idle -> fifo_idle'
   58         pipeline with one-frame-in-flight locking ('frame_in_flight'). Once Word 0 is 
   59         generated and offered with 'm_axis_tvalid == 1', its data and seed remain 100%
   60         unchanged across stalls AND on the acceptance edge ('m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready'),
   61         and the next frame latches the updated 'txfn_in' cleanly after 'm_axis_tlast' is accepted.
   62  ===========================================================================
   63  */
   64  
   65  module fso_idle_generator (
   66      input  wire        clk,
   67      input  wire        rst_n,
   68  
   69      // Current Transmit Frame Number from ARQ TX Controller
   70      input  wire [15:0] txfn_in,
   71  
   72      // AXI-Stream Output to fso_payload_mux.v (1912 Bytes = 478 Words)
   73      output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   74      output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   75      output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   76      input  wire        m_axis_tready
   77  );
   78  
   79      // =======================================================
   80      // 1. PRBS GENERATOR ENGINE (1908 Bytes = 477 Words)
   81      // Uses the 25-bit Frame Scrambler PRBS (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   82      // seeded dynamically with (TXFN + 1) per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.5.1.2.
   83      // =======================================================
   84      localparam MAX_WORDS = 9'd477; // 477 words * 4 bytes = 1908 Bytes
   85      
   86      localparam S_INIT = 1'b0,
   87                 S_GEN  = 1'b1;
   88  
   89      reg        state, next_state;
   90      reg [8:0]  word_cnt;
   91      reg [24:0] lfsr_q;
   92      reg [24:0] locked_seed_q;
   93      reg        frame_in_flight;
   94  
   95      reg  [31:0] prbs_tdata;
   96      reg         prbs_tvalid;
   97      reg         prbs_tlast;
   98      wire        crc_tready;
   99  
  100      // Active wires between u_fso_crc_32_idle and fifo_idle (Monitored by tb_idle_MGMT.v)
  101      wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  102      wire        crc_tvalid;
  103      wire        crc_tlast;
  104      wire        fifo_tready;
  105  
  106      // Dynamic 25-bit seed calculation: (TXFN + 1) per SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.5.1.2
  107      wire [24:0] raw_seed = {9'd0, txfn_in} + 25'd1;
  108      wire [24:0] seed_val = (raw_seed == 25'd0) ? 25'h0000007 : raw_seed;
  109  
  110      // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R16] Exact 32-step unrolled Frame Scrambler PRBS (1 + D^3 + D^25)
  111      // Identical recurrence (fb = sr[0] ^ sr[3]) and shift orientation to scrambler.v
  112      function [56:0] step_prbs25_32(input [24:0] q_in);
  113          reg [24:0] sr;
  114          reg [31:0] w_out;
  115          reg        fb;
  116          integer    k;
  117          begin
  118              sr = (q_in == 25'd0) ? 25'h0000007 : q_in;
  119              for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
  120                  w_out[31 - k] = sr[0];
  121                  fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];
  122                  sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]};
  123              end
  124              step_prbs25_32 = {sr, w_out};
  125          end
  126      endfunction
  127  
  128      // [Rev 3.0 - Fix C-A001] Assign 57-bit function result to explicit wire before slicing
  129      wire [24:0] active_q_in   = (word_cnt == 9'd0) ? locked_seed_q : lfsr_q;
  130      wire [56:0] prbs_next     = step_prbs25_32(active_q_in);
  131      wire [31:0] prbs_word_out = prbs_next[31:0];
  132      wire [24:0] prbs_state_nx = prbs_next[56:32];
  133  
  134      wire frame_done_accepted  = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready && m_axis_tlast;
  135  
  136      // [Rev 3.0 - Fix B15 & C-A006] Single-Path Producer FSM with Locked Per-Frame Seed
  137      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  138          if (!rst_n) begin
  139              state           <= S_INIT;
  140              word_cnt        <= 9'd0;
  141              lfsr_q          <= 25'h0000001;
  142              locked_seed_q   <= 25'h0000001;
  143              frame_in_flight <= 1'b0;
  144          end else begin
  145              state <= next_state;
  146  
  147              if (frame_done_accepted) begin
  148                  frame_in_flight <= 1'b0;
  149              end
  150  
  151              if (state == S_INIT) begin
  152                  word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  153                  if (crc_tready && !frame_in_flight) begin
  154                      // Lock the live (TXFN + 1) seed before Word 0 is generated and offered
  155                      locked_seed_q   <= seed_val;
  156                      lfsr_q          <= seed_val;
  157                      frame_in_flight <= 1'b1;
  158                  end
  159              end else if (state == S_GEN && prbs_tvalid && crc_tready) begin
  160                  word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  161                  lfsr_q   <= prbs_state_nx;
  162              end
  163          end
  164      end
  165  
  166      always @(*) begin
  167          next_state  = state;
  168          prbs_tvalid = 1'b0;
  169          prbs_tlast  = 1'b0;
  170          prbs_tdata  = 32'd0;
  171  
  172          case (state)
  173              S_INIT: begin
  174                  if (crc_tready && !frame_in_flight)
  175                      next_state = S_GEN;
  176              end
  177              S_GEN: begin
  178                  prbs_tvalid = 1'b1;
  179                  prbs_tdata  = prbs_word_out;
  180                  if (word_cnt == (MAX_WORDS - 1)) begin
  181                      prbs_tlast = 1'b1;
  182                      if (crc_tready) next_state = S_INIT;
  183                  end
  184              end
  185          endcase
  186      end
  187  
  188      // =======================================================
  189      // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  190      // =======================================================
  191      fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32_idle (
  192          .clk             (clk),
  193          .rst_n           (rst_n),
  194          .s_axis_tdata    (prbs_tdata),
  195          .s_axis_tvalid   (prbs_tvalid),
  196          .s_axis_tlast    (prbs_tlast),
  197          .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  198          .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  199          .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  200          .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  201          .m_axis_tready   (fifo_tready)
  202      );
  203  
  204      // =======================================================
  205      // 3. FIFO IDLE BUFFER (Ready for MUX - Holds Offered Data Until Handshake)
  206      // =======================================================
  207      fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(1024), .ADDR_WIDTH(10)) fifo_idle (
  208          .clk             (clk),
  209          .rst_n           (rst_n),
  210          .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  211          .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  212          .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  213          .s_axis_tready   (fifo_tready),
  214          .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_tdata),
  215          .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_tvalid),
  216          .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_tlast),
  217          .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_tready)
  218      );
  219  
  220  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_payload.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : SDA OISL FSO Payload Encapsulation Engine.
    7                 Appends FSO Payload Header (0xAB) and FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF)
    8                 to the incoming 1900-Byte segmented Ethernet payload.
    9                 Output geometrically guaranteed to be exactly 1908 Bytes 
   10                 (477 clock cycles) as dictated by SDA OISL Figure 2-17.
   11                 
   12                 Acts as the primary encapsulation container for Ethernet data.
   13                 Internal Operations:
   14                 1. Injects FSO Payload & Packet Headers (1900B -> 1908B).
   15                 2. Computes and appends CRC-32 (1908B -> 1912B) via fso_crc_32.
   16                 3. Sniffs and stores the 1912B frame into ARQ_DDR4_WRAPPER.
   17                 4. Buffers the 1912B frame into fifo_data.
   18                 Outputs both the normal data stream and the ARQ retx stream.
   19  
   20  Revision History:
   21    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : FSO Payload (0xAB) & Packet (0xCDEF) Header injector + CRC-32 + FIFO.
   22    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:34 KST) : [Target B6.2 - SDA OISL Page 43-45, Table 2-18]
   23      Populated the 14-bit 'Length' fields in Table 2-18 and added strict Table 2-18 
   24      continuation formatting (no duplicate 0xCDEF header).
   25    - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #5 - Dynamic Ingress Length & Zero-Data Safety]
   26      1. Added 'seg_valid_bytes' metadata input from packaging_and_segmentation.v.
   27      2. Completely removed 's_axis_eth_tdata != 32'd0' from the continuation decision.
   28    - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 00:55 KST) : [Audit Fix N07 - 14-Bit Super-Jumbo Length & Multi-Segment Continuation]
   29      Reconstructed 14-bit packet length and added multi-segment continuation tracking.
   30    - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 11:30 KST) : [Audit Fix A01, A02 & A18]:
   31      1. [Fix A18 & A01]: Widened 'seg_valid_bytes' input port to 14 bits ([13:0]).
   32      2. [Fix A02]: Populated the Continuation Frame Payload Header (0xAB) Length[13:0]
   33         field with the full remaining packet byte count ('cont_rem_bytes') per SDA OISL 
   34         Section 2.6.3.7.5.
   35    - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:05 KST) : [Audit Fix B03 - Full 1904-Byte Continuation Frame Alignment]
   36      1. When 'in_continuation && (cont_rem_bytes > 14'd1900)', accepts all 476 data 
   37         words (1,904 Bytes) from packaging_and_segmentation.v directly in S_DATA 
   38         (asserting 'inj_tlast = s_axis_eth_tlast' on the 476th data word without 
   39         entering S_CONT_PAD) and decrements 'cont_rem_bytes' by 1,904 Bytes. This 
   40         eliminates mid-packet 4-byte zero padding in >=3,804B multi-segment packets 
   41         (achieving 0 normative byte mismatches in tx_payload_trace.sv).
   42      2. When 'in_continuation && (cont_rem_bytes <= 14'd1900)' (such as the 100B 
   43         second segment of a 2,000B packet), appends the 476th zero-pad word via 
   44         S_CONT_PAD after the 475th segmenter word, preserving 100% compatibility with
   45         all 2,000B testbenches.
   46  ===========================================================================
   47  */
   48  
   49  module fso_payload #(
   50      parameter [13:0] DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES = 14'd2000, // Fallback only if seg_valid_bytes is unconnected (0)
   51      parameter        CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN    = 1         // 1 = Strict Table 2-18 Continuation (No duplicate 0xCDEF)
   52  )(
   53      input  wire        clk,
   54      input  wire        rst_n,
   55  
   56      // -------------------------------------------------------
   57      // Interface from XGMII Front-End (packaging_and_segmentation.v)
   58      // Expected: 1900B (Initial) / 1904B (Full Continuation) + 14-Bit Length Metadata
   59      // -------------------------------------------------------
   60      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   61      input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   62      input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   63      output reg         s_axis_eth_tready,
   64      input  wire [13:0] seg_valid_bytes,   // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A18] Full 14-bit packet/segment byte count
   65  
   66      // -------------------------------------------------------
   67      // ARQ Control Interfaces (from arq_tx_controller.v)
   68      // -------------------------------------------------------
   69      input  wire        ddr4_write_req,
   70      input  wire        ddr4_read_req,
   71      input  wire        ddr4_delete_req,
   72      input  wire [15:0] ddr4_addr,
   73  
   74      // -------------------------------------------------------
   75      // AXI-Stream Outputs to fso_payload_mux.v
   76      // Output: 1912 Bytes (Both Data and Retransmit paths)
   77      // -------------------------------------------------------
   78      output wire [31:0] m_axis_data_tdata,
   79      output wire        m_axis_data_tvalid,
   80      output wire        m_axis_data_tlast,
   81      input  wire        m_axis_data_tready,
   82  
   83      output wire [31:0] m_axis_retx_tdata,
   84      output wire        m_axis_retx_tvalid,
   85      output wire        m_axis_retx_tlast,
   86      input  wire        m_axis_retx_tready
   87  );
   88  
   89      // =======================================================
   90      // 1. INJECTOR FSM: Append FSO Headers (1900B/1904B -> 1908B)
   91      // =======================================================
   92      localparam S_IDLE     = 3'd0,
   93                 S_HDR1     = 3'd1,
   94                 S_HDR2     = 3'd2,
   95                 S_DATA     = 3'd3,
   96                 S_CONT_PAD = 3'd4;
   97      
   98      reg [2:0]  state, next_state;
   99      reg [9:0]  seq_num;
  100      reg        in_continuation;
  101      reg [13:0] cont_rem_bytes;
  102      reg [13:0] latched_pkt_bytes;
  103  
  104      // Resolve active ingress packet length (handles both 14-bit direct and unconnected fallback)
  105      wire        meta_low_valid  = (^seg_valid_bytes[10:0] !== 1'bx);
  106      wire        meta_high_valid = (^seg_valid_bytes[13:11] !== 1'bx);
  107      wire [13:0] live_pkt_bytes  = meta_low_valid ?
  108                                    {meta_high_valid ? seg_valid_bytes[13:11] : 3'd0, seg_valid_bytes[10:0]} :
  109                                    DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  110  
  111      // Internal wires connecting Injector -> CRC
  112      reg  [31:0] inj_tdata;
  113      reg         inj_tvalid;
  114      reg         inj_tlast;
  115      wire        inj_tready;
  116  
  117      // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A02] Per SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.7.5, Continuation Payload Header (0xAB)
  118      // carries the total remaining byte length of the continued packet ('cont_rem_bytes').
  119      wire [13:0] pld_hdr_len_field = in_continuation ? cont_rem_bytes : 14'd0;
  120      wire [13:0] pkt_hdr_len_field = latched_pkt_bytes;
  121  
  122      // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B03] When cont_rem_bytes > 1900, the segmenter provides 476 full data words
  123      // (1904 Bytes), so S_CONT_PAD is NOT needed (1 Header word + 476 Data words = 477 words).
  124      // S_CONT_PAD is only used when cont_rem_bytes <= 1900 (where the segmenter provides 475 words).
  125      wire cont_needs_pad_word = CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation && (cont_rem_bytes <= 14'd1900);
  126  
  127      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  128          if (!rst_n) begin
  129              state             <= S_IDLE;
  130              seq_num           <= 10'd0;
  131              in_continuation   <= 1'b0;
  132              cont_rem_bytes    <= 14'd0;
  133              latched_pkt_bytes <= DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  134          end else begin
  135              state <= next_state;
  136  
  137              if ((state == S_IDLE || state == S_HDR1) && s_axis_eth_tvalid && !in_continuation) begin
  138                  latched_pkt_bytes <= (live_pkt_bytes != 14'd0) ? live_pkt_bytes : DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  139              end
  140  
  141              if (state == S_DATA && s_axis_eth_tvalid && s_axis_eth_tready) begin
  142                  if (s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  143                      // [Rev 2.9 - Fix B03] Exact 1900B initial & 1904B continuation subtraction
  144                      if (!in_continuation) begin
  145                          if (latched_pkt_bytes > 14'd1900) begin
  146                              in_continuation <= 1'b1;
  147                              cont_rem_bytes  <= latched_pkt_bytes - 14'd1900;
  148                          end else begin
  149                              in_continuation <= 1'b0;
  150                              cont_rem_bytes  <= 14'd0;
  151                          end
  152                      end else begin
  153                          if (cont_rem_bytes > 14'd1904) begin
  154                              in_continuation <= 1'b1;
  155                              cont_rem_bytes  <= cont_rem_bytes - 14'd1904;
  156                          end else begin
  157                              in_continuation <= 1'b0;
  158                              cont_rem_bytes  <= 14'd0;
  159                          end
  160                      end
  161  
  162                      if (!cont_needs_pad_word) begin
  163                          seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  164                      end
  165                  end
  166              end else if (state == S_CONT_PAD && inj_tready) begin
  167                  seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  168              end
  169          end
  170      end
  171  
  172      always @(*) begin
  173          next_state        = state;
  174          s_axis_eth_tready = 1'b0;
  175          inj_tvalid        = 1'b0;
  176          inj_tlast         = 1'b0;
  177          inj_tdata         = 32'd0;
  178  
  179          case (state)
  180              S_IDLE: begin
  181                  if (s_axis_eth_tvalid) next_state = S_HDR1;
  182              end
  183              S_HDR1: begin
  184                  inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  185                  // Table 2-18 FSO Payload Header: {0xAB, seq_num[9:0], Length[13:0]}
  186                  inj_tdata  = {8'hAB, seq_num, pld_hdr_len_field};
  187                  if (inj_tready) begin
  188                      if (CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation)
  189                          next_state = S_DATA; // Table 2-18 Continuation: skip duplicate 0xCDEF header
  190                      else
  191                          next_state = S_HDR2;
  192                  end
  193              end
  194              S_HDR2: begin
  195                  inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  196                  // Table 2-18 FSO Packet Header: {0xCDEF, 2'b00, Length[13:0]}
  197                  inj_tdata  = {16'hCDEF, 2'b00, pkt_hdr_len_field};
  198                  if (inj_tready) next_state = S_DATA;
  199              end
  200              S_DATA: begin
  201                  inj_tvalid        = s_axis_eth_tvalid;
  202                  inj_tdata         = s_axis_eth_tdata;
  203                  s_axis_eth_tready = inj_tready;
  204  
  205                  if (cont_needs_pad_word) begin
  206                      // Suppress tlast on the 475th word so S_CONT_PAD appends the 476th trailing pad word
  207                      inj_tlast = 1'b0;
  208                      if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  209                          next_state = S_CONT_PAD;
  210                      end
  211                  end else begin
  212                      inj_tlast = s_axis_eth_tlast;
  213                      if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  214                          next_state = S_IDLE;
  215                      end
  216                  end
  217              end
  218              S_CONT_PAD: begin
  219                  // Appends the 476th word (trailing zero-pad word for <=1900B continuation tail)
  220                  inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  221                  inj_tdata  = 32'd0;
  222                  inj_tlast  = 1'b1;
  223                  if (inj_tready) begin
  224                      next_state = S_IDLE;
  225                  end
  226              end
  227              default: next_state = S_IDLE;
  228          endcase
  229      end
  230  
  231      // =======================================================
  232      // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  233      // =======================================================
  234      wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  235      wire        crc_tvalid;
  236      wire        crc_tlast;
  237      wire        crc_tready;
  238  
  239      fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32 (
  240          .clk             (clk),
  241          .rst_n           (rst_n),
  242          .s_axis_tdata    (inj_tdata),
  243          .s_axis_tvalid   (inj_tvalid),
  244          .s_axis_tlast    (inj_tlast),
  245          .s_axis_tready   (inj_tready),
  246          .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  247          .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  248          .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  249          .m_axis_tready   (crc_tready)
  250      );
  251  
  252      // =======================================================
  253      // 3. FIFO DATA BUFFER (Primary Output Path)
  254      // =======================================================
  255      fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(1024), .ADDR_WIDTH(10)) fifo_data (
  256          .clk             (clk),
  257          .rst_n           (rst_n),
  258          .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  259          .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  260          .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  261          .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  262          .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_data_tdata),
  263          .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_data_tvalid),
  264          .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_data_tlast),
  265          .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_data_tready)
  266      );
  267  
  268      // =======================================================
  269      // 4. ARQ DDR4 WRAPPER (Retransmit Path)
  270      // Sniffs the output of CRC-32 silently.
  271      // =======================================================
  272      arq_ddr4_wrapper u_arq_ddr4_wrapper (
  273          .clk             (clk),
  274          .rst_n           (rst_n),
  275          .ddr4_write_req  (ddr4_write_req),
  276          .ddr4_read_req   (ddr4_read_req),
  277          .ddr4_delete_req (ddr4_delete_req),
  278          .ddr4_addr       (ddr4_addr),
  279          
  280          // Sniffing CRC Data
  281          .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  282          .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  283          .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  284          .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  285          
  286          // Retransmit Output to MUX
  287          .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_retx_tdata),
  288          .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_retx_tvalid),
  289          .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_retx_tlast),
  290          .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_retx_tready)
  291      );
  292  
  293  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_payload_mux.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Description  : FSO Payload Combinational Multiplexer.
    7                 Acts as the Arbi traffic router before CDC and FEC.
    8                 Selects between 4 AXI-Stream inputs based on payload_mux_sel:
    9                 00 = IDLE FIFO
   10                 01 = DATA FIFO
   11                 10 = MGMT FIFO
   12                 11 = ARQ DDR4 Retransmit RAM
   13                 Zero-latency combinational routing.
   14  ===========================================================================
   15  */
   16  
   17  module fso_payload_mux (
   18      // Control Signal from ARQ TX Controller
   19      input  wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,
   20  
   21      // Input 0: IDLE FIFO (00)
   22      input  wire [31:0] s_idle_tdata,
   23      input  wire        s_idle_tvalid,
   24      input  wire        s_idle_tlast,
   25      output wire        s_idle_tready,
   26  
   27      // Input 1: DATA FIFO (01)
   28      input  wire [31:0] s_data_tdata,
   29      input  wire        s_data_tvalid,
   30      input  wire        s_data_tlast,
   31      output wire        s_data_tready,
   32  
   33      // Input 2: MGMT FIFO (10)
   34      input  wire [31:0] s_mgmt_tdata,
   35      input  wire        s_mgmt_tvalid,
   36      input  wire        s_mgmt_tlast,
   37      output wire        s_mgmt_tready,
   38  
   39      // Input 3: ARQ Retransmit RAM (11)
   40      input  wire [31:0] s_retx_tdata,
   41      input  wire        s_retx_tvalid,
   42      input  wire        s_retx_tlast,
   43      output wire        s_retx_tready,
   44  
   45      // Output: To x_gth_logic.v (CDC)
   46      output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   47      output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   48      output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   49      input  wire        m_axis_tready
   50  );
   51  
   52      // =======================================================
   53      // Combinational Routing for Downstream Data (tdata, tvalid, tlast)
   54      // =======================================================
   55      assign m_axis_tdata  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tdata  :
   56                             (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tdata  :
   57                             (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tdata  :
   58                                                          s_retx_tdata;
   59  
   60      assign m_axis_tvalid = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tvalid :
   61                             (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tvalid :
   62                             (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tvalid :
   63                                                          s_retx_tvalid;
   64  
   65      assign m_axis_tlast  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tlast  :
   66                             (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tlast  :
   67                             (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tlast  :
   68                                                          s_retx_tlast;
   69  
   70      // =======================================================
   71      // Combinational Routing for Upstream Flow Control (tready)
   72      // Only the selected path receives the true tready from CDC.
   73      // Unselected paths are stalled (tready = 0).
   74      // =======================================================
   75      assign s_idle_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   76      assign s_data_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   77      assign s_mgmt_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   78      assign s_retx_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b11) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   79  
   80  endmodule
sources_1/new/fso_payload_top.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : fso_payload_top
    7  Description  : Grand Top-Level FSO Payload Subsystem (1912-Byte Assembler).
    8                 Integrates the 3 autonomous FSO Payload Capsules and the 
    9                 4-to-1 Frame Multiplexer:
   10                 1. fso_payload              : Ethernet DATA Capsule (Path 01) 
   11                                               & ARQ Retransmit RAM (Path 11).
   12                 2. fso_idle_generator       : Dynamic (TXFN+1) 25-bit PRBS 
   13                                               IDLE Capsule (Path 00).
   14                 3. mgmt_telemetry_generator : 1Hz Satellite Ranging/Timestamp 
   15                                               MGMT Capsule (Path 10).
   16                 4. fso_payload_mux          : Lock-On-Frame 4-to-1 AXI-Stream 
   17                                               Multiplexer to CDC 1.
   18  
   19  Revision History:
   20    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-path FSO payload capsule integration.
   21    - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : Added 'seg_valid_bytes' input port and 
   22      connected it to u_fso_payload.
   23    - Rev 2.8 (2026-10-30 11:30 KST) : [Audit Fix A18 - Consistent 14-Bit Length Port]
   24      Standardized 'seg_valid_bytes' port width to 14 bits ([13:0]) to match 
   25      fso_payload.v and ethernet_fso_framer.v without width-mismatch warnings.
   26    - Rev 2.9 (2026-10-30 18:05 KST) : [Audit Fix B01 - Exact fso_payload_mux Port Binding]
   27      Restored the exact port names on u_fso_payload_mux (.payload_mux_sel, .s_idle_*,
   28      .s_data_*, .s_mgmt_*, .s_retx_*, and .m_axis_*) to match the combinational
   29      fso_payload_mux.v module definition in the project, resolving all 22 TX 
   30      named-port elaboration errors.
   31  ===========================================================================
   32  */
   33  
   34  module fso_payload_top (
   35      input  wire        clk,
   36      input  wire        rst_n,
   37  
   38      // -------------------------------------------------------
   39      // 1. Ethernet Segment Stream Input (From Front-End Segmenter)
   40      // -------------------------------------------------------
   41      input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   42      input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   43      input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   44      output wire        s_axis_eth_tready,
   45      input  wire [13:0] seg_valid_bytes,   // [Rev 2.8 - Fix A18] Full 14-bit packet/segment byte count
   46  
   47      // -------------------------------------------------------
   48      // 2. ARQ TX Controller & Scheduler Commands
   49      // -------------------------------------------------------
   50      input  wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,   // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT, 11=RETX
   51      input  wire [15:0] txfn_in,           // Current TXFN for IDLE PRBS seeding
   52      input  wire        ddr4_write_req,
   53      input  wire        ddr4_read_req,
   54      input  wire        ddr4_delete_req,
   55      input  wire [15:0] ddr4_addr,
   56  
   57      // -------------------------------------------------------
   58      // 3. 1Hz MGMT Telemetry & Ranging Inputs
   59      // -------------------------------------------------------
   60      input  wire        mgmt_trigger_1hz,
   61      input  wire [5:0]  rx_phy_ts_sec,
   62      input  wire [39:0] rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   63      input  wire [5:0]  tx_phy_ts_sec,
   64      input  wire [39:0] tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   65      input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   66      input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   67      input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   68      input  wire        ts_valid,
   69  
   70      // -------------------------------------------------------
   71      // 4. Multiplexed 1912-Byte FSO Payload Stream Output (To CDC 1)
   72      // -------------------------------------------------------
   73      output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
   74      output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
   75      output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
   76      input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready
   77  );
   78  
   79      // Internal AXI-Stream Buses from the 4 Payload Sources
   80      wire [31:0] idle_tdata;
   81      wire        idle_tvalid;
   82      wire        idle_tlast;
   83      wire        idle_tready;
   84  
   85      wire [31:0] data_tdata;
   86      wire        data_tvalid;
   87      wire        data_tlast;
   88      wire        data_tready;
   89  
   90      wire [31:0] mgmt_tdata;
   91      wire        mgmt_tvalid;
   92      wire        mgmt_tlast;
   93      wire        mgmt_tready;
   94  
   95      wire [31:0] retx_tdata;
   96      wire        retx_tvalid;
   97      wire        retx_tlast;
   98      wire        retx_tready;
   99  
  100      // 1. DATA & RETRANSMIT CAPSULE (Path 01 & Path 11)
  101      fso_payload u_fso_payload (
  102          .clk                (clk),
  103          .rst_n              (rst_n),
  104          .s_axis_eth_tdata   (s_axis_eth_tdata),
  105          .s_axis_eth_tvalid  (s_axis_eth_tvalid),
  106          .s_axis_eth_tlast   (s_axis_eth_tlast),
  107          .s_axis_eth_tready  (s_axis_eth_tready),
  108          .seg_valid_bytes    (seg_valid_bytes),
  109          .ddr4_write_req     (ddr4_write_req),
  110          .ddr4_read_req      (ddr4_read_req),
  111          .ddr4_delete_req    (ddr4_delete_req),
  112          .ddr4_addr          (ddr4_addr),
  113          .m_axis_data_tdata  (data_tdata),
  114          .m_axis_data_tvalid (data_tvalid),
  115          .m_axis_data_tlast  (data_tlast),
  116          .m_axis_data_tready (data_tready),
  117          .m_axis_retx_tdata  (retx_tdata),
  118          .m_axis_retx_tvalid (retx_tvalid),
  119          .m_axis_retx_tlast  (retx_tlast),
  120          .m_axis_retx_tready (retx_tready)
  121      );
  122  
  123      // 2. IDLE PRBS CAPSULE (Path 00 - Seeded by TXFN + 1)
  124      fso_idle_generator u_fso_idle_generator (
  125          .clk           (clk),
  126          .rst_n         (rst_n),
  127          .txfn_in       (txfn_in),
  128          .m_axis_tdata  (idle_tdata),
  129          .m_axis_tvalid (idle_tvalid),
  130          .m_axis_tlast  (idle_tlast),
  131          .m_axis_tready (idle_tready)
  132      );
  133  
  134      // 3. 1HZ MANAGEMENT TELEMETRY CAPSULE (Path 10)
  135      mgmt_telemetry_generator u_mgmt_telemetry_generator (
  136          .clk               (clk),
  137          .rst_n             (rst_n),
  138          .mgmt_trigger_1hz  (mgmt_trigger_1hz),
  139          .rx_phy_ts_sec     (rx_phy_ts_sec),
  140          .rx_phy_ts_picosec (rx_phy_ts_picosec),
  141          .tx_phy_ts_sec     (tx_phy_ts_sec),
  142          .tx_phy_ts_picosec (tx_phy_ts_picosec),
  143          .range_meters      (range_meters),
  144          .range_ts_sec      (range_ts_sec),
  145          .range_ts_picosec  (range_ts_picosec),
  146          .ts_valid          (ts_valid),
  147          .m_axis_tdata      (mgmt_tdata),
  148          .m_axis_tvalid     (mgmt_tvalid),
  149          .m_axis_tlast      (mgmt_tlast),
  150          .m_axis_tready     (mgmt_tready)
  151      );
  152  
  153      // 4. 4-TO-1 PAYLOAD MULTIPLEXER [Rev 2.9 - Fix B01: Exact fso_payload_mux Port Map]
  154      fso_payload_mux u_fso_payload_mux (
  155          .payload_mux_sel (payload_mux_sel),
  156          .s_idle_tdata    (idle_tdata),
  157          .s_idle_tvalid   (idle_tvalid),
  158          .s_idle_tlast    (idle_tlast),
  159          .s_idle_tready   (idle_tready),
  160          .s_data_tdata    (data_tdata),
  161          .s_data_tvalid   (data_tvalid),
  162          .s_data_tlast    (data_tlast),
  163          .s_data_tready   (data_tready),
  164          .s_mgmt_tdata    (mgmt_tdata),
  165          .s_mgmt_tvalid   (mgmt_tvalid),
  166          .s_mgmt_tlast    (mgmt_tlast),
  167          .s_mgmt_tready   (mgmt_tready),
  168          .s_retx_tdata    (retx_tdata),
  169          .s_retx_tvalid   (retx_tvalid),
  170          .s_retx_tlast    (retx_tlast),
  171          .s_retx_tready   (retx_tready),
  172          .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_fso_tdata),
  173          .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_fso_tvalid),
  174          .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_fso_tlast),
  175          .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_fso_tready)
  176      );
  177  
  178  endmodule
sources_1/new/gth64b66b_rx.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : gth64b66b_rx
    7  Function     : 64B/66B External Gearbox Receiver, Block Sync Slip Controller,
    8                 and De-Jitter Elastic Buffer.
    9                 - Executes IEEE 802.3ae 64B/66B block lock state machine by 
   10                   asserting gt_rxgearboxslip_out until 64 consecutive valid 
   11                   2'b01 sync headers are verified (rx_block_locked = 1).
   12                 - Performs bit-reversal (bit_rev32) to restore MSB-first byte 
   13                   ordering, removes 2-cycle Gearbox pauses via rx_elast_mem, 
   14                   and outputs a 100% contiguous 312.5 MHz stream to CDC 3.
   15  
   16  Revision History:
   17    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic 64B/66B receiver gearbox slip FSM.
   18    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-20) : Added 66/64 de-jitter buffer and internal ILA 2 
   19      (GTH Stage) debug registers to keep SDAOISL10Gto10G_top schematic clean.
   20    - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-21 05:18 KST) : Enforced strict hdr_is_valid_sync = 
   21      (gt_rxheader_in[1:0] == 2'b01) to eliminate false-locking on 2'b10.
   22    - Rev 3.1 (2026-10-21 12:21 KST) :
   23      1. Updated rx_elast_mem write controller with committed non-zero pointer 
   24         tracking so the entire byte-packed 4-frame burst (3117 words = 12,468 
   25         Bytes across IDLE, DAT1, DAT2, MGMT) is captured continuously without 
   26         swallowing Frame 4's preamble or inserting inter-frame gaps.
   27      2. Matched byte_out [7:0], out_clk_cnt [15:0], frame_byte_cnt [11:0], and 
   28         frame_out_id [31:0] to the exact 0.8 ns byte-level granularity of 
   29         u_error_inject so all 4 frames (1, 2, 3, 4) count 1..3117 bytes cleanly.
   30    - Rev 3.2 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.2 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   31      Updated start_new_burst and in_burst_sync trigger condition (is_preamble_word0)
   32      to detect the first 32-bit word of the official SDA OISL 72-bit Preamble 
   33      (32'h77AD_5B58 from 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) while retaining legacy marker 
   34      (32'h5555_5555) compatibility.
   35  ===========================================================================
   36  */
   37  
   38  module gth64b66b_rx (
   39      input  wire        clk_gth,              // GTH RXUSRCLK2 (rx0_clk = 322.265625 MHz)
   40      input  wire        clk_312_5,            // Downstream 312.5 MHz Clock
   41      input  wire        rst_n,                // Active-low reset
   42      input  wire        gth_rx_ready,         // High when GTH RX reset is done
   43  
   44      // Upstream Interface from GTH Transceiver Primitive
   45      input  wire [31:0] gt_rxdata_in,
   46      input  wire [1:0]  gt_rxdatavalid_in,
   47      input  wire [5:0]  gt_rxheader_in,
   48      input  wire [1:0]  gt_rxheadervalid_in,
   49      output reg         gt_rxgearboxslip_out,
   50  
   51      // Status Output
   52      output reg         rx_block_locked,
   53  
   54      // Downstream Interface to CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic)
   55      output reg  [31:0] down_data,
   56      output reg         down_dv
   57  );
   58  
   59      function [31:0] bit_rev32(input [31:0] d);
   60          integer i;
   61          begin
   62              for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
   63                  bit_rev32[i] = d[31 - i];
   64              end
   65          end
   66      endfunction
   67  
   68      // =======================================================
   69      // 1. STRICT IEEE 802.3ae 64B/66B BLOCK SYNC LOCK & SLIP FSM
   70      //    Strictly checks 2'b01 so pre-frame zeros never false-lock on 2'b10!
   71      // =======================================================
   72      wire hdr_is_valid_sync = (gt_rxheader_in[1:0] == 2'b01);
   73  
   74      reg [6:0] good_sync_cnt;
   75      reg [5:0] slip_wait_cnt;
   76  
   77      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   78          if (!rst_n) begin
   79              gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   80              rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
   81              good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
   82              slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   83          end else if (!gth_rx_ready) begin
   84              gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   85              rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
   86              good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
   87              slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   88          end else begin
   89              gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   90  
   91              if (slip_wait_cnt > 6'd0) begin
   92                  slip_wait_cnt <= slip_wait_cnt - 6'd1;
   93              end else if (gt_rxheadervalid_in[0]) begin
   94                  if (hdr_is_valid_sync) begin
   95                      if (good_sync_cnt < 7'd64) begin
   96                          good_sync_cnt <= good_sync_cnt + 7'd1;
   97                      end else begin
   98                          rx_block_locked <= 1'b1;
   99                      end
  100                  end else begin
  101                      rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
  102                      good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
  103                      gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b1;
  104                      slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd32;
  105                  end
  106              end
  107          end
  108      end
  109  
  110      // =======================================================
  111      // 2. 66/64 DE-JITTER ELASTIC BUFFER (Continuous Burst Capture)
  112      //    Uses commit_wr_ptr so trailing post-burst zeros are never drained
  113      // =======================================================
  114      (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] rx_elast_mem [0:4095];
  115      reg  [11:0] raw_wr_ptr;
  116      reg  [11:0] commit_wr_ptr;
  117      reg         in_burst_sync;
  118      reg  [3:0]  zero_idle_cnt;
  119  
  120      wire [31:0] descrambled_word = bit_rev32(gt_rxdata_in);
  121      // [Rev 3.2 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] Triggers on SDA OISL Table 2-8 Preamble Word 0 (32'h77AD_5B58) or legacy (32'h5555_5555)
  122      wire        is_preamble_word0 = (descrambled_word == 32'h77AD_5B58) ||
  123                                      (descrambled_word == 32'h5555_5555);
  124      wire        start_new_burst  = rx_block_locked && gt_rxdatavalid_in[0] &&
  125                                     !in_burst_sync && is_preamble_word0;
  126      wire        rx_mem_we        = rx_block_locked && gt_rxdatavalid_in[0] &&
  127                                     (in_burst_sync || start_new_burst);
  128  
  129      always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  130          if (rx_mem_we) begin
  131              rx_elast_mem[raw_wr_ptr] <= descrambled_word;
  132          end
  133      end
  134  
  135      always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  136          if (!rst_n) begin
  137              raw_wr_ptr    <= 12'd0;
  138              commit_wr_ptr <= 12'd0;
  139              in_burst_sync <= 1'b0;
  140              zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
  141          end else if (!rx_block_locked) begin
  142              raw_wr_ptr    <= 12'd0;
  143              commit_wr_ptr <= 12'd0;
  144              in_burst_sync <= 1'b0;
  145              zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
  146          end else if (gt_rxdatavalid_in[0]) begin
  147              if (!in_burst_sync) begin
  148                  zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
