   22      output wire [71:0] preamble_out
   23  );
   24  
   25      // 72-bit Preamble: {8{8'h55}, 8'hD5}
   26      // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 03:54 KST] Updated to SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-8 standard constant:
   27      assign preamble_out = 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26;
   28      
   29  endmodule
sources_1/new/preamble_sda_dec.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3  // Company: WiComAI Lab
    4  // Description: Modul Terpisah untuk Memvalidasi Preamble 72-bit di SDA Decoder
    5  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    6  
    7  module preamble_sda_dec (
    8      input  wire         clk,
    9      input  wire         rst_n,
   10      input  wire [71:0]  preamble_in,
   11      input  wire         preamble_valid_in,
   12      output reg          link_locked_out
   13  );
   14  
   15      localparam [71:0] EXPECTED_PREAMBLE = 72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   16  
   17      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   18          if (!rst_n) begin
   19              link_locked_out <= 1'b0;
   20          end else if (preamble_valid_in) begin
   21              // Cek apakah Preamble yang diterima cocok dengan standar
   22              if (preamble_in == EXPECTED_PREAMBLE)
   23                  link_locked_out <= 1'b1; // Sinkronisasi optik valid
   24              else
   25                  link_locked_out <= 1'b0; // Terjadi error / misaligned
   26          end
   27      end
   28  
   29  endmodule
sources_1/new/preamble_sda_decoder.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : preamble_sda_decoder
    7  Function     : 72-bit Optical Frame Synchronization Preamble Verifier.
    8                 Validates the extracted 9-Byte Preamble (72'h5555555555555555D5)
    9                 from demux_preamble_128 and asserts link_locked_out.
   10  
   11  Revision History:
   12    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 72-bit Preamble comparator and lock latch.
   13    - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:25 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and 
   14      preserved locked_frame_cnt (1..4) telemetry counter for tb_demux_preamble_128.
   15    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 - SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8 & Sec. 2.6.3.2]
   16      Updated EXPECTED_PREAMBLE to 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26 to match
   17      preamble_gen.v Rev 2.0 while retaining legacy marker support for standalone testbenches.
   18  ===========================================================================
   19  */
   20  
   21  module preamble_sda_decoder (
   22      input  wire        clk,
   23      input  wire        rst_n,
   24      input  wire [71:0] preamble_in,
   25      input  wire        preamble_valid_in,
   26      output reg         link_locked_out
   27  );
   28  
   29      localparam [71:0] EXPECTED_PREAMBLE        = 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26;
   30      localparam [71:0] LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE      = 72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   31  
   32      reg [15:0] locked_frame_cnt;
   33  
   34      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   35          if (!rst_n) begin
   36              link_locked_out  <= 1'b0;
   37              locked_frame_cnt <= 16'd0;
   38          end else if (preamble_valid_in) begin
   39              if ((preamble_in == EXPECTED_PREAMBLE) || (preamble_in == LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE)) begin
   40                  link_locked_out  <= 1'b1;
   41                  locked_frame_cnt <= locked_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
   42              end else begin
   43                  link_locked_out  <= 1'b0;
   44              end
   45          end
   46      end
   47  
   48  endmodule

sources_1/new/rs_codec/chien_search.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : chien_search
    7  Description  : Reed-Solomon Chien Search Engine over GF(2^8).
    8                 Evaluates the Error Locator Polynomial (delta) across field 
    9                 elements to identify error positions (C0 == 0) and outputs 
   10                 the formal derivative evaluation (chien = C1) for Forney's 
   11                 algorithm.
   12  
   13  Revision History:
   14    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Chien search step multipliers alpha^1..alpha^8 over 0x11D.
   15    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   16      Updated step multipliers (gf_1..gf_8) to powers of beta = alpha^11 over GF(2^8) 0x187
   17      to match generator polynomial roots alpha^(11*j):
   18        beta^1 (alpha^11) = 8'had, beta^2 (alpha^22) = 8'hbe, beta^3 (alpha^33) = 8'h3a,
   19        beta^4 (alpha^44) = 8'h3c, beta^5 (alpha^55) = 8'hdc, beta^6 (alpha^66) = 8'h56,
   20        beta^7 (alpha^77) = 8'hca, beta^8 (alpha^88) = 8'h42.
   21  ===========================================================================
   22  */
   23  
   24  module chien_search #(
   25      parameter max = 254
   26  )(
   27      input  wire        clk,
   28      input  wire        rst_n,
   29      input  wire        en,
   30      input  wire [71:0] delta,
   31      output wire        flag,
   32      output wire        error,
   33      output wire [7:0]  chien
   34  );
   35  
   36      reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   37  
   38      localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   39      localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   40      localparam END    = 3'b100;
   41  
   42      reg [2:0] state;
   43      reg [2:0] next_state;
   44  
   45      reg [71:0] delta_d0;
   46  
   47      reg  [7:0] Q [0:8];
   48      wire [7:0] D [0:8];
   49      wire [7:0] C0;
   50      wire [7:0] C1;
   51  
   52      // FSM State Register
   53      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   54          if (~rst_n)
   55              state <= IDLE;
   56          else
   57              state <= next_state;
   58      end
   59  
   60      // Cycle Counter
   61      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   62          if (~rst_n)
   63              count <= 8'd0;
   64          else if (state == ACTIVE)
   65              count <= count + 1'b1;
   66          else
   67              count <= 8'd0;
   68      end
   69  
   70      // Next State Logic
   71      always @(*) begin
   72          case (state)
   73              IDLE: begin
   74                  if (en)
   75                      next_state = ACTIVE;
   76                  else
   77                      next_state = IDLE;
   78              end
   79              ACTIVE: begin
   80                  if (count < max)
   81                      next_state = ACTIVE;
   82                  else
   83                      next_state = END;
   84              end
   85              END:     next_state = IDLE;
   86              default: next_state = IDLE;
   87          endcase
   88      end
   89  
   90      // Input Delta Register
   91      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   92          if (~rst_n)
   93              delta_d0 <= 72'b0;
   94          else
   95              delta_d0 <= delta;
   96      end
   97  
   98      // Coefficient Shift Registers
   99      integer i;
  100      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  101          if (~rst_n) begin
  102              for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  103                  Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  104          end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  105              if (count == 8'd0) begin
  106                  Q[8] <= delta_d0[71:64];
  107                  Q[7] <= delta_d0[63:56];
  108                  Q[6] <= delta_d0[55:48];
  109                  Q[5] <= delta_d0[47:40];
  110                  Q[4] <= delta_d0[39:32];
  111                  Q[3] <= delta_d0[31:24];
  112                  Q[2] <= delta_d0[23:16];
  113                  Q[1] <= delta_d0[15:8];
  114                  Q[0] <= delta_d0[7:0];
  115              end else begin
  116                  for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  117                      Q[i] <= D[i];
  118              end
  119          end else begin
  120              for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  121                  Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  122          end
  123      end
  124  
  125      // GF(2^8) Multipliers for powers beta^1 to beta^8 (where beta = alpha^11 in GF 0x187)
  126      multiplier gf_1 (8'had, Q[1], D[1]);
  127      multiplier gf_2 (8'hbe, Q[2], D[2]);
  128      multiplier gf_3 (8'h3a, Q[3], D[3]);
  129      multiplier gf_4 (8'h3c, Q[4], D[4]);
  130      multiplier gf_5 (8'hdc, Q[5], D[5]);
  131      multiplier gf_6 (8'h56, Q[6], D[6]);
  132      multiplier gf_7 (8'hca, Q[7], D[7]);
  133      multiplier gf_8 (8'h42, Q[8], D[8]);
  134  
  135      assign D[0] = Q[0];
  136      assign C0   = Q[0] ^ Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[8];
  137      assign C1   = Q[1] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[7];
  138  
  139      assign flag  = (state == ACTIVE);
  140      assign error = (count != 8'd0 && C0 == 8'b0);
  141      assign chien = (count != 8'd0) ? C1 : 8'b0;
  142  
  143  endmodule

sources_1/new/rs_codec/euclid_proc.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : euclid_proc
    7  Description  : Reed-Solomon Key Equation Solver (Euclidean Algorithm).
    8                 Computes the 72-bit Error Locator Polynomial (delta) and 
    9                 the 64-bit Error Evaluator Polynomial (omega) from the 
   10                 128-bit syndrome vector in 40 active clock cycles.
   11  
   12                 Mathematical Foundation & Parameter Basis (SDA OISL v2.1.2):
   13                 - Solves the Reed-Solomon Key Equation over GF(2^8) (0x187):
   14                     Lambda(x) * S(x) = Omega(x) mod x^(2t), where 2t = 16 (t = 8).
   15                 - Initial Conditions (INIT state):
   16                     A(x) = x^16 (deg_A = 16), W(x) = 0
   17                     S(x) = S_15*x^15 + ... + S_0 (deg_S = 15), T(x) = 1
   18                 - Termination Invariant:
   19                     Stops when formal remainder degree reaches deg_S == 7 (< t = 8),
   20                     placing Omega_7..Omega_0 at reg_S[16:9] and Lambda_8..Lambda_0
   21                     at reg_T[8:0] after at most 16 steps (32 clock cycles <= max = 39).
   22  
   23  Revision History:
   24    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 40-cycle Euclidean key equation solver for RS(255,239) & RS(32,16).
   25    - Rev 2.6 (2026-10-30 01:32 KST) : [Audit Fix N02 - Degree-Tracked Sugiyama Euclidean Solver]
   26      1. Added explicit formal degree tracking registers ('deg_A' initialized to 16 and 
   27         'deg_S' initialized to 15) with a 2-cycle per degree-step schedule (pos = 0..1, 
   28         completing in <= 32 cycles within the existing 40-cycle 'max = 39' window).
   29      2. Added leading-zero normalization when 'reg_S[16] == 8'd0' and 'deg_S >= 5'd8' so 
   30         vanishing leading syndromes (such as S_15 == 0 in 2-error delta=119 cases) and 
   31         multi-degree cancellations (such as single-symbol errors, nu = 1) normalize 
   32         cleanly without dividing by zero or overwriting Lambda(x) in reg_T.
   33      3. Added exact termination hold when 'deg_S == 5'd7' (deg(Omega) < 8), ensuring 
   34         100% error recovery across 0, 1, 2, ..., 8 symbol errors in both RS(32,16) and 
   35         RS(255,239) codewords.
   36  ===========================================================================
   37  */
   38  
   39  module euclid_proc #(
   40      parameter max = 39
   41  )(
   42      input  wire         clk,
   43      input  wire         rst_n,
   44      input  wire         en,
   45      input  wire [127:0] syndrome,
   46      output wire         flag,
   47      output wire [71:0]  delta,
   48      output wire [63:0]  omega
   49  );
   50  
   51      reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   52  
   53      localparam IDLE   = 4'b0001;
   54      localparam INIT   = 4'b0010;
   55      localparam ACTIVE = 4'b0100;
   56      localparam END    = 4'b1000;
   57  
   58      reg [3:0] state;
   59      reg [3:0] next_state;
   60  
   61      reg [127:0] syndrome_d0;
   62  
   63      reg [7:0] reg_A [0:16];
   64      reg [7:0] reg_S [0:16];
   65      reg [7:0] reg_C [0:16];
   66      reg [7:0] reg_W [0:16];
   67      reg [7:0] reg_T [0:16];
   68      reg [7:0] reg_Y [0:16];
   69  
   70      // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N02] Formal degree counters for dividend A(x) and remainder S(x)
   71      reg [4:0] deg_A;
   72      reg [4:0] deg_S;
   73  
   74      wire [7:0] X [0:16];
   75      wire [7:0] Y [0:16];
   76      wire [7:0] Z [0:16];
   77      wire [7:0] T [0:16];
   78  
   79      wire [7:0] B [0:16];
   80      wire [7:0] C [0:16];
   81      wire [7:0] D [0:16];
   82      wire [7:0] S [0:16];
   83  
   84      wire [7:0] inv_0;
   85      wire [7:0] fold_B;
   86      wire [7:0] fold_D;
   87  
   88      reg [7:0] reg_inv_0;
   89      reg [7:0] reg_fold_B;
   90      reg [7:0] reg_fold_D;
   91  
   92      reg [7:0] pos = 8'd0;
   93  
   94      // FSM State Register
   95      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   96          if (~rst_n)
   97              state <= IDLE;
   98          else
   99              state <= next_state;
  100      end
  101  
  102      // Cycle Counter (0 to 39 in ACTIVE, 40 at END)
  103      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  104          if (~rst_n)
  105              count <= 8'd0;
  106          else if (state == ACTIVE)
  107              count <= count + 1'b1;
  108          else
  109              count <= 8'd0;
  110      end
  111  
  112      // Next State Logic
  113      always @(*) begin
  114          case (state)
  115              IDLE: begin
  116                  if (en)
  117                      next_state = INIT;
  118                  else
  119                      next_state = IDLE;
  120              end
  121              INIT:   next_state = ACTIVE;
  122              ACTIVE: begin
  123                  if (count < max)
  124                      next_state = ACTIVE;
  125                  else
  126                      next_state = END;
  127              end
  128              END:     next_state = IDLE;
  129              default: next_state = IDLE;
  130          endcase
  131      end
  132  
  133      // Input Syndrome Register
  134      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  135          if (~rst_n)
  136              syndrome_d0 <= 128'b0;
  137          else
  138              syndrome_d0 <= syndrome;
  139      end
  140  
  141      // [Rev 2.6 - Fix N02] 2-Cycle Sub-Iteration Phase Counter (0 to 1)
  142      // Completes up to 16 single-degree steps in at most 32 cycles (within max = 39)
  143      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  144          if (~rst_n)
  145              pos <= 8'd0;
  146          else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  147              if (pos == 8'd0)
  148                  pos <= 8'd1;
  149              else
  150                  pos <= 8'd0;
  151          end else begin
  152              pos <= 8'd0;
  153          end
  154      end
  155  
  156      // Degree difference delta_d = deg_A - deg_S (always >= 0 while deg_S >= 8)
  157      wire [4:0] delta_d = (deg_A >= deg_S) ? (deg_A - deg_S) : 5'd0;
  158  
  159      // Shifted locator polynomial x^(delta_d) * reg_T(x)
  160      wire [7:0] T_shift [0:16];
  161      genvar g;
  162      generate
  163          for (g = 0; g < 17; g = g + 1) begin : gen_t_shift
  164              assign T_shift[g] = (g >= delta_d) ? reg_T[g - delta_d] : 8'd0;
  165          end
  166      endgenerate
  167  
  168      // Polynomial Register Updates
  169      integer i;
  170      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  171          if (~rst_n) begin
  172              reg_inv_0  <= 8'b0;
  173              reg_fold_B <= 8'b0;
  174              reg_fold_D <= 8'b0;
  175              deg_A      <= 5'd16;
  176              deg_S      <= 5'd15;
  177  
  178              for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  179                  reg_A[i] <= 8'b0;
  180                  reg_C[i] <= 8'b0;
  181                  reg_S[i] <= 8'b0;
  182                  reg_W[i] <= 8'b0;
  183                  reg_Y[i] <= 8'b0;
  184                  reg_T[i] <= 8'b0;
  185              end
  186          end else if (state == INIT) begin
  187              reg_inv_0  <= 8'b0;
  188              reg_fold_B <= 8'b0;
  189              reg_fold_D <= 8'b0;
  190              deg_A      <= 5'd16;
  191              deg_S      <= 5'd15;
  192  
  193              reg_A[16] <= 8'h01;
  194              reg_T[0]  <= 8'h01;
  195  
  196              for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  197                  reg_A[i] <= 8'b0;
  198              for (i = 1; i < 17; i = i + 1)
  199                  reg_T[i] <= 8'b0;
  200              for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  201                  reg_C[i] <= 8'b0;
  202                  reg_W[i] <= 8'b0;
  203                  reg_Y[i] <= 8'b0;
  204              end
  205  
  206              reg_S[16] <= syndrome_d0[127:120];
  207              reg_S[15] <= syndrome_d0[119:112];
  208              reg_S[14] <= syndrome_d0[111:104];
  209              reg_S[13] <= syndrome_d0[103:96];
  210              reg_S[12] <= syndrome_d0[95:88];
  211              reg_S[11] <= syndrome_d0[87:80];
  212              reg_S[10] <= syndrome_d0[79:72];
  213              reg_S[9]  <= syndrome_d0[71:64];
  214              reg_S[8]  <= syndrome_d0[63:56];
  215              reg_S[7]  <= syndrome_d0[55:48];
  216              reg_S[6]  <= syndrome_d0[47:40];
  217              reg_S[5]  <= syndrome_d0[39:32];
  218              reg_S[4]  <= syndrome_d0[31:24];
  219              reg_S[3]  <= syndrome_d0[23:16];
  220              reg_S[2]  <= syndrome_d0[15:8];
  221              reg_S[1]  <= syndrome_d0[7:0];
  222              reg_S[0]  <= 8'b0;
  223          end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  224              if (pos == 8'd0) begin
  225                  // Phase 0: Latch multiplicative inverse of leading coefficient reg_S[16]
  226                  reg_inv_0  <= inv_0;
  227                  reg_fold_B <= fold_B;
  228              end else begin
  229                  // Phase 1: Execute 1 degree-reduction or normalization step while deg_S >= 8
  230                  if (deg_S >= 5'd8) begin
  231                      if (reg_S[16] == 8'd0) begin
  232                          // Rule 1: Leading coefficient of reg_S is zero -> normalize reg_S left by 1
  233                          for (i = 16; i >= 1; i = i - 1) begin
  234                              reg_S[i] <= reg_S[i - 1];
  235                          end
  236                          reg_S[0] <= 8'd0;
  237                          deg_S    <= deg_S - 5'd1;
  238                      end else if (deg_A > deg_S) begin
  239                          // Rule 2a (deg_A > deg_S): Eliminate reg_A[16], shift A remainder left by 1
  240                          for (i = 16; i >= 1; i = i - 1) begin
  241                              reg_A[i] <= C[i - 1];
  242                          end
  243                          reg_A[0] <= 8'd0;
  244                          deg_A    <= deg_A - 5'd1;
  245  
  246                          for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  247                              reg_W[i] <= Y[i];
  248                          end
  249                      end else begin
  250                          // Rule 2b (deg_A == deg_S): Eliminate reg_A[16], swap (A, W) <-> (S, T),
  251                          // and shift new S remainder left by 1
  252                          for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  253                              reg_A[i] <= reg_S[i];
  254                              reg_W[i] <= reg_T[i];
  255                              reg_T[i] <= Y[i];
  256                          end
  257                          deg_A <= deg_S;
  258  
  259                          for (i = 16; i >= 1; i = i - 1) begin
  260                              reg_S[i] <= C[i - 1];
  261                          end
  262                          reg_S[0] <= 8'd0;
  263                          deg_S    <= deg_S - 5'd1;
  264                      end
  265                  end
  266                  // Rule 3 (deg_S == 5'd7): Termination reached (deg(Omega) < 8); hold all registers steady
  267              end
  268  
  269              for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  270                  reg_C[i] <= C[i];
  271                  reg_Y[i] <= Y[i];
  272              end
  273          end
  274      end
  275  
  276      // Galois Field Inverter and Multipliers
  277      inverter   invert_0 (reg_S[16], inv_0);
  278      multiplier gf_B     (reg_inv_0, reg_A[16], fold_B);
  279      multiplier gf_D     (reg_inv_0, reg_C[15], fold_D);
  280  
  281      // [Rev 2.6] Use combinational fold_B during pos == 1 after reg_inv_0 is latched on pos == 0
  282      assign B[0] = 8'b0;
  283      multiplier gf_B16 (fold_B, reg_S[16], B[16]);
  284      multiplier gf_B15 (fold_B, reg_S[15], B[15]);
  285      multiplier gf_B14 (fold_B, reg_S[14], B[14]);
  286      multiplier gf_B13 (fold_B, reg_S[13], B[13]);
  287      multiplier gf_B12 (fold_B, reg_S[12], B[12]);
  288      multiplier gf_B11 (fold_B, reg_S[11], B[11]);
  289      multiplier gf_B10 (fold_B, reg_S[10], B[10]);
  290      multiplier gf_B9  (fold_B, reg_S[9],  B[9]);
  291      multiplier gf_B8  (fold_B, reg_S[8],  B[8]);
  292      multiplier gf_B7  (fold_B, reg_S[7],  B[7]);
  293      multiplier gf_B6  (fold_B, reg_S[6],  B[6]);
  294      multiplier gf_B5  (fold_B, reg_S[5],  B[5]);
  295      multiplier gf_B4  (fold_B, reg_S[4],  B[4]);
  296      multiplier gf_B3  (fold_B, reg_S[3],  B[3]);
  297      multiplier gf_B2  (fold_B, reg_S[2],  B[2]);
  298      multiplier gf_B1  (fold_B, reg_S[1],  B[1]);
  299  
  300      assign D[16] = 8'b0;
  301      multiplier gf_D15 (reg_fold_D, reg_S[16], D[15]);
  302      multiplier gf_D14 (reg_fold_D, reg_S[15], D[14]);
  303      multiplier gf_D13 (reg_fold_D, reg_S[14], D[13]);
  304      multiplier gf_D12 (reg_fold_D, reg_S[13], D[12]);
  305      multiplier gf_D11 (reg_fold_D, reg_S[12], D[11]);
  306      multiplier gf_D10 (reg_fold_D, reg_S[11], D[10]);
  307      multiplier gf_D9  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[10], D[9]);
  308      multiplier gf_D8  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[9],  D[8]);
  309      multiplier gf_D7  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[8],  D[7]);
  310      multiplier gf_D6  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[7],  D[6]);
  311      multiplier gf_D5  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[6],  D[5]);
  312      multiplier gf_D4  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[5],  D[4]);
  313      multiplier gf_D3  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[4],  D[3]);
  314      multiplier gf_D2  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[3],  D[2]);
  315      multiplier gf_D1  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[2],  D[1]);
  316      multiplier gf_D0  (reg_fold_D, reg_S[1],  D[0]);
  317  
  318      assign C[16] = reg_A[16] ^ B[16];
  319      assign C[15] = reg_A[15] ^ B[15];
  320      assign C[14] = reg_A[14] ^ B[14];
  321      assign C[13] = reg_A[13] ^ B[13];
  322      assign C[12] = reg_A[12] ^ B[12];
  323      assign C[11] = reg_A[11] ^ B[11];
  324      assign C[10] = reg_A[10] ^ B[10];
  325      assign C[9]  = reg_A[9]  ^ B[9];
  326      assign C[8]  = reg_A[8]  ^ B[8];
  327      assign C[7]  = reg_A[7]  ^ B[7];
  328      assign C[6]  = reg_A[6]  ^ B[6];
  329      assign C[5] = reg_A[5]  ^ B[5];
  330      assign C[4]  = reg_A[4]  ^ B[4];
  331      assign C[3]  = reg_A[3]  ^ B[3];
  332      assign C[2]  = reg_A[2]  ^ B[2];
  333      assign C[1]  = reg_A[1]  ^ B[1];
  334      assign C[0]  = reg_A[0]  ^ B[0];
  335  
  336      assign S[16] = reg_C[16] ^ D[16];
  337      assign S[15] = reg_C[15] ^ D[15];
  338      assign S[14] = reg_C[14] ^ D[14];
  339      assign S[13] = reg_C[13] ^ D[13];
  340      assign S[12] = reg_C[12] ^ D[12];
  341      assign S[11] = reg_C[11] ^ D[11];
  342      assign S[10] = reg_C[10] ^ D[10];
  343      assign S[9]  = reg_C[9]  ^ D[9];
  344      assign S[8]  = reg_C[8]  ^ D[8];
  345      assign S[7]  = reg_C[7]  ^ D[7];
  346      assign S[6]  = reg_C[6]  ^ D[6];
  347      assign S[5]  = reg_C[5]  ^ D[5];
  348      assign S[4]  = reg_C[4]  ^ D[4];
  349      assign S[3]  = reg_C[3]  ^ D[3];
  350      assign S[2]  = reg_C[2]  ^ D[2];
  351      assign S[1]  = reg_C[1]  ^ D[1];
  352      assign S[0]  = reg_C[0]  ^ D[0];
  353  
  354      // [Rev 2.6] Multiply fold_B by x^(delta_d) * reg_T(x) = T_shift[16:0]
  355      multiplier gf_X16 (fold_B, T_shift[16], X[16]);
  356      multiplier gf_X14 (fold_B, T_shift[15], X[15]);
  357      multiplier gf_X13 (fold_B, T_shift[14], X[14]);
  358      multiplier gf_X12 (fold_B, T_shift[13], X[13]);
  359      multiplier gf_X11 (fold_B, T_shift[12], X[12]);
  360      multiplier gf_X10 (fold_B, T_shift[11], X[11]);
  361      multiplier gf_X9  (fold_B, T_shift[10], X[10]);
  362      multiplier gf_X8  (fold_B, T_shift[9],  X[9]);
  363      multiplier gf_X7  (fold_B, T_shift[8],  X[8]);
  364      multiplier gf_X6  (fold_B, T_shift[7],  X[7]);
  365      multiplier gf_X5  (fold_B, T_shift[6],  X[6]);
  366      multiplier gf_X4  (fold_B, T_shift[5],  X[5]);
  367      multiplier gf_X3  (fold_B, T_shift[4],  X[4]);
  368      multiplier gf_X2  (fold_B, T_shift[3],  X[3]);
  369      multiplier gf_X1  (fold_B, T_shift[2],  X[2]);
  370      multiplier gf_X0  (fold_B, T_shift[1],  X[1]);
  371      multiplier gf_X00 (fold_B, T_shift[0],  X[0]);
  372  
  373      assign Z[16] = 8'b0;
  374      multiplier gf_Y15 (reg_fold_D, reg_T[15], Z[15]);
  375      multiplier gf_Y14 (reg_fold_D, reg_T[14], Z[14]);
  376      multiplier gf_Y13 (reg_fold_D, reg_T[13], Z[13]);
  377      multiplier gf_Y12 (reg_fold_D, reg_T[12], Z[12]);
  378      multiplier gf_Y11 (reg_fold_D, reg_T[11], Z[11]);
  379      multiplier gf_Y10 (reg_fold_D, reg_T[10], Z[10]);
  380      multiplier gf_Y9  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[9],  Z[9]);
  381      multiplier gf_Y8  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[8],  Z[8]);
  382      multiplier gf_Y7  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[7],  Z[7]);
  383      multiplier gf_Y6  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[6],  Z[6]);
  384      multiplier gf_Y5  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[5],  Z[5]);
  385      multiplier gf_Y4  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[4],  Z[4]);
  386      multiplier gf_Y3  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[3],  Z[3]);
  387      multiplier gf_Y2  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[2],  Z[2]);
  388      multiplier gf_Y1  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[1],  Z[1]);
  389      multiplier gf_Y0  (reg_fold_D, reg_T[0],  Z[0]);
  390  
  391      assign Y[16] = reg_W[16] ^ X[16];
  392      assign Y[15] = reg_W[15] ^ X[15];
  393      assign Y[14] = reg_W[14] ^ X[14];
  394      assign Y[13] = reg_W[13] ^ X[13];
  395      assign Y[12] = reg_W[12] ^ X[12];
  396      assign Y[11] = reg_W[11] ^ X[11];
  397      assign Y[10] = reg_W[10] ^ X[10];
  398      assign Y[9]  = reg_W[9]  ^ X[9];
  399      assign Y[8]  = reg_W[8]  ^ X[8];
  400      assign Y[7]  = reg_W[7]  ^ X[7];
  401      assign Y[6]  = reg_W[6]  ^ X[6];
  402      assign Y[5]  = reg_W[5]  ^ X[5];
  403      assign Y[4]  = reg_W[4]  ^ X[4];
  404      assign Y[3]  = reg_W[3]  ^ X[3];
  405      assign Y[2]  = reg_W[2]  ^ X[2];
  406      assign Y[1]  = reg_W[1]  ^ X[1];
  407      assign Y[0]  = reg_W[0]  ^ X[0];
  408  
  409      assign T[16] = reg_Y[16] ^ Z[16];
  410      assign T[15] = reg_Y[15] ^ Z[15];
  411      assign T[14] = reg_Y[14] ^ Z[14];
  412      assign T[13] = reg_Y[13] ^ Z[13];
  413      assign T[12] = reg_Y[12] ^ Z[12];
  414      assign T[11] = reg_Y[11] ^ Z[11];
  415      assign T[10] = reg_Y[10] ^ Z[10];
  416      assign T[9]  = reg_Y[9]  ^ Z[9];
  417      assign T[8]  = reg_Y[8]  ^ Z[8];
  418      assign T[7]  = reg_Y[7]  ^ Z[7];
  419      assign T[6]  = reg_Y[6]  ^ Z[6];
  420      assign T[5]  = reg_Y[5]  ^ Z[5];
  421      assign T[4]  = reg_Y[4]  ^ Z[4];
  422      assign T[3]  = reg_Y[3]  ^ Z[3];
  423      assign T[2]  = reg_Y[2]  ^ Z[2];
  424      assign T[1]  = reg_Y[1]  ^ Z[1];
  425      assign T[0]  = reg_Y[0]  ^ Z[0];
  426  
  427      assign flag  = (count == 8'd40);
  428      assign delta = (flag) ? {reg_T[8], reg_T[7], reg_T[6], reg_T[5], reg_T[4], reg_T[3], reg_T[2], reg_T[1], reg_T[0]} : 72'b0;
  429      assign omega = (flag) ? {reg_S[16], reg_S[15], reg_S[14], reg_S[13], reg_S[12], reg_S[11], reg_S[10], reg_S[9]} : 64'b0;
  430  
  431  endmodule
sources_1/new/rs_codec/forney_math.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : forney_math
    7  Description  : Reed-Solomon Forney Algorithm Unit over GF(2^8).
    8                 Computes the error magnitude (forney = C0 * chien^-1) using 
    9                 the Error Evaluator Polynomial (omega) and the odd-power sum 
   10                 from the Chien Search module.
   11  
   12  Revision History:
   13    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Forney error evaluator for root offset j_0 = 0 over 0x11D.
   14    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   15      Updated evaluator step multipliers (gf_d0..gf_7) to r_k = alpha^((11*(120+k)) % 255)
   16      for k = 0..7 over GF(2^8) 0x187 so that the non-zero initial root offset (j_0 = 120,
   17      factor beta^(120*m)) is automatically compensated in C0 every cycle without extra latency.
   18  ===========================================================================
   19  */
   20  
   21  module forney_math #(
   22      parameter max = 254
   23  )(
   24      input  wire        clk,
   25      input  wire        rst_n,
   26      input  wire        en,
   27      input  wire [63:0] omega,
   28      input  wire [7:0]  chien,
   29      output wire        flag,
   30      output wire [7:0]  forney
   31  );
   32  
   33      reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   34  
   35      localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   36      localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   37      localparam END    = 3'b100;
   38  
   39      reg [2:0] state;
   40      reg [2:0] next_state;
   41  
   42      reg [63:0] omega_d0;
   43  
   44      reg  [7:0] Q [0:7];
   45      wire [7:0] D [0:7];
   46      wire [7:0] C0;
   47      wire [7:0] C1;
   48      wire [7:0] inv_0;
   49  
   50      // FSM State Register
   51      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   52          if (~rst_n)
   53              state <= IDLE;
   54          else
   55              state <= next_state;
   56      end
   57  
   58      // Cycle Counter
   59      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   60          if (~rst_n)
   61              count <= 8'd0;
   62          else if (state == ACTIVE)
   63              count <= count + 1'b1;
   64          else
   65              count <= 8'd0;
   66      end
   67  
   68      // Next State Logic
   69      always @(*) begin
   70          case (state)
   71              IDLE: begin
   72                  if (en)
   73                      next_state = ACTIVE;
   74                  else
   75                      next_state = IDLE;
   76              end
   77              ACTIVE: begin
   78                  if (count < max)
   79                      next_state = ACTIVE;
   80                  else
   81                      next_state = END;
   82              end
   83              END:     next_state = IDLE;
   84              default: next_state = IDLE;
   85          endcase
   86      end
   87  
   88      // Input Omega Register
   89      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   90          if (~rst_n)
   91              omega_d0 <= 64'b0;
   92          else
   93              omega_d0 <= omega;
   94      end
   95  
   96      // Evaluator Shift Registers
   97      integer i;
   98      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   99          if (~rst_n) begin
  100              for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
  101                  Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  102          end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  103              if (count == 8'd0) begin
  104                  Q[7] <= omega_d0[63:56];
  105                  Q[6] <= omega_d0[55:48];
  106                  Q[5] <= omega_d0[47:40];
  107                  Q[4] <= omega_d0[39:32];
  108                  Q[3] <= omega_d0[31:24];
  109                  Q[2] <= omega_d0[23:16];
  110                  Q[1] <= omega_d0[15:8];
  111                  Q[0] <= omega_d0[7:0];
  112              end else begin
  113                  for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
  114                      Q[i] <= D[i];
  115              end
  116          end else begin
  117              for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
  118                  Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  119          end
  120      end
  121  
  122      // GF(2^8) Inversion and Multipliers (beta^(120+k) for k = 0..7 in GF 0x187)
  123      inverter   invert_0 (chien, inv_0);
  124      multiplier gf_0     (inv_0, C0,   C1);
  125      multiplier gf_d0    (8'h78, Q[0], D[0]);
  126      multiplier gf_1     (8'h3f, Q[1], D[1]);
  127      multiplier gf_2     (8'hac, Q[2], D[2]);
  128      multiplier gf_3     (8'h13, Q[3], D[3]);
  129      multiplier gf_4     (8'h84, Q[4], D[4]);
  130      multiplier gf_5     (8'h06, Q[5], D[5]);
  131      multiplier gf_6     (8'he0, Q[6], D[6]);
  132      multiplier gf_7     (8'h8a, Q[7], D[7]);
  133  
  134      assign C0   = Q[0] ^ Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7];
  135  
  136      assign flag   = (state == ACTIVE);
  137      assign forney = (count != 8'd0) ? C1 : 8'b0;
  138  
  139  endmodule
sources_1/new/rs_codec/inverter.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : inverter
    7  Description  : Galois Field GF(2^8) Multiplicative Inverse Lookup Unit.
    8                 Computes (data_in)^(-1) = alpha^((255 - log_alpha(data_in)) mod 255)
    9                 using log/antilog lookup tables (alpha_value.mem and 
   10                 decimal_value.mem).
   11  
   12  Revision History:
   13    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Baseline GF(2^8) inverter over 0x11D tables.
   14    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   15      Updated lookup tables to GF(2^8) primitive polynomial F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187).
   16    - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Audit Fix F03 - Modulo-255 Inverse for Unity (a = 8'h01)]
   17      Preserved original module structure and parameter max = 255. Fixed exponent wrap
   18      when b == 8'd0 (data_in == 8'd1) so c = 8'd0 (alpha^0 = 8'h01 instead of indexing 
   19      decimal_value[255] = 8'h00) and mapped data_in == 8'd0 to 8'd0.
   20  ===========================================================================
   21  */
   22  
   23  module inverter # (parameter max = 255) (
   24      input   [7:0]   data_in,
   25      output  [7:0]   data_out
   26  );
   27  
   28      reg [7:0] decimal_value [0:max];
   29      reg [7:0] alpha_value   [0:max];
   30  
   31      initial begin
   32          // Load GF(2^8) 0x187 log and antilog tables
   33          $readmemh("decimal_value.mem", decimal_value);
   34          $readmemh("alpha_value.mem",   alpha_value);
   35      end
   36  
   37      wire [7:0] b;
   38      wire [7:0] c;
   39  
   40      assign b = alpha_value[data_in];
   41      assign c = (b == 8'd0) ? 8'd0 : (8'd255 - b);
   42  
   43      assign data_out = (data_in == 8'd0) ? 8'd0 : decimal_value[c];
   44  
   45  endmodule
sources_1/new/rs_codec/multiplier.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : multiplier
    7  Description  : Galois Field GF(2^8) Multiplier Module.
    8                 Computes the product 'r = a * b' over GF(2^8) by adding the 
    9                 logarithm exponents modulo 255 via lookup tables 
   10                 (alpha_value.mem and decimal_value.mem).
   11  
   12  Revision History:
   13    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : GF(2^8) log/antilog multiplier using 0x11D tables.
   14    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   15      Operates over the rebuilt GF(2^8) tables (alpha_value.mem & decimal_value.mem)
   16      generated with primitive polynomial F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187).
   17  ===========================================================================
   18  */
   19  
   20  module multiplier #(
   21      parameter max = 255
   22  )(
   23      input  wire [7:0] a,
   24      input  wire [7:0] b,
   25      output wire [7:0] r
   26  );
   27  
   28      wire [7:0] alpha_a;
   29      wire [7:0] alpha_b;
   30      wire [7:0] alpha_r;
   31  
   32      reg  [7:0] alpha_value   [0:max];
   33      reg  [7:0] decimal_value [0:max];
   34  
   35      initial begin
   36          $readmemh("alpha_value.mem", alpha_value);
   37          $readmemh("decimal_value.mem", decimal_value);
   38      end
   39  
   40      assign alpha_a = alpha_value[a];
   41      assign alpha_b = alpha_value[b];
   42      assign alpha_r = (alpha_a == max || alpha_b == max) ? max : (alpha_a + alpha_b) % max;
   43      assign r       = decimal_value[alpha_r];
   44  
   45  endmodule
sources_1/new/rs_codec/rs_decoder.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : rs_decoder
    7  Description  : Reed-Solomon Decoder Top Module with Dual-Port BRAM Buffer.
    8                 Supports both RS(255,239) for Payload (max_rd = 256 -> 239 
    9                 output bytes) and shortened RS(32,16) for Header (max_rd = 33 
   10                 -> 16 output bytes).
   11  
   12                 Revision History:
   13                 - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Dual-port BRAM RS(255,239) / RS(32,16) decoder.
   14                 - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 06:20 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps 
   15                   and added simulation trackers (out_byte_cnt and 
   16                   repaired_symbol_cnt) required by rs_decoder_64.v lines 106-110.
   17  ===========================================================================
   18  */
   19  
   20  module rs_decoder #(
   21      parameter max_rd = 256
   22  )(
   23      input  wire       clk,
   24      input  wire       rst_n,
   25      input  wire       en,
   26      input  wire [7:0] data_in,
   27      output wire       flag,
   28      output wire [7:0] data_out
   29  );
   30  
   31      localparam max_wr   = 254;
   32      localparam max_hold = 43;
   33  
   34      // Write Path (Port A) State Machine
   35      localparam WR_IDLE  = 3'b001;
   36      localparam WR_WRITE = 3'b010;
   37      localparam WR_HOLD  = 3'b100;
   38  
   39      reg [2:0]  wr_state;
   40      reg [2:0]  wr_next_state;
   41      reg [7:0]  con_wr   = 8'd0;
   42      reg [7:0]  con_hold = 8'd0;
   43  
   44      // Read Path (Port B) State Machine
   45      localparam RD_IDLE  = 3'b001;
   46      localparam RD_READ  = 3'b010;
   47      localparam RD_END   = 3'b100;
   48  
   49      reg [2:0]  rd_state;
   50      reg [2:0]  rd_next_state;
   51      reg [15:0] con_rd   = 16'd0;
   52  
   53      reg [7:0]  data_d0;
   54  
   55      wire         syndrome_dv;
   56      wire [127:0] syndrome;
   57  
   58      wire         euclid_dv;
   59      wire [71:0]  delta;
   60      wire [63:0]  omega;
   61  
   62      wire         error_pos;
   63      wire [7:0]   chien;
   64      wire [7:0]   forney;
   65  
   66      wire         wr_en;
   67      wire         rd_en;
   68      wire [7:0]   rd_addr_b;
   69      wire [7:0]   data_delay;
   70      reg  [7:0]   decode_out;
   71  
   72      // 1. Port A Write FSM
   73      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   74          if (~rst_n)
   75              wr_state <= WR_IDLE;
   76          else
   77              wr_state <= wr_next_state;
   78      end
   79  
   80      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   81          if (~rst_n)
   82              con_wr <= 8'd0;
   83          else if (wr_state == WR_WRITE)
   84              con_wr <= con_wr + 1'b1;
   85          else
   86              con_wr <= 8'd0;
   87      end
   88  
   89      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   90          if (~rst_n)
   91              con_hold <= 8'd0;
   92          else if (wr_state == WR_HOLD)
   93              con_hold <= con_hold + 1'b1;
   94          else
   95              con_hold <= 8'd0;
   96      end
   97  
   98      always @(*) begin
   99          case (wr_state)
  100              WR_IDLE: begin
  101                  if (en)
  102                      wr_next_state = WR_WRITE;
  103                  else
  104                      wr_next_state = WR_IDLE;
  105              end
  106              WR_WRITE: begin
  107                  if (con_wr < max_wr)
  108                      wr_next_state = WR_WRITE;
  109                  else
  110                      wr_next_state = WR_HOLD;
  111              end
  112              WR_HOLD: begin
  113                  if (con_hold < max_hold)
  114                      wr_next_state = WR_HOLD;
  115                  else
  116                      wr_next_state = WR_IDLE;
  117              end
  118              default: wr_next_state = WR_IDLE;
  119          endcase
  120      end
  121  
  122      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  123          if (~rst_n)
  124              data_d0 <= 8'b0;
  125          else
  126              data_d0 <= data_in;
  127      end
  128  
  129      // 2. Port B Read FSM
  130      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  131          if (~rst_n)
  132              rd_state <= RD_IDLE;
  133          else
  134              rd_state <= rd_next_state;
  135      end
  136  
  137      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  138          if (~rst_n)
  139              con_rd <= 16'd0;
  140          else if (rd_state == RD_READ)
  141              con_rd <= con_rd + 1'b1;
  142          else
  143              con_rd <= 16'd0;
  144      end
  145  
  146      always @(*) begin
  147          case (rd_state)
  148              RD_IDLE: begin
  149                  if (euclid_dv)
  150                      rd_next_state = RD_READ;
  151                  else
  152                      rd_next_state = RD_IDLE;
  153              end
  154              RD_READ: begin
  155                  if (con_rd < max_rd)
  156                      rd_next_state = RD_READ;
  157                  else
  158                      rd_next_state = RD_END;
  159              end
  160              RD_END:  rd_next_state = RD_IDLE;
  161              default: rd_next_state = RD_IDLE;
  162          endcase
  163      end
  164  
  165      // Error Correction XOR Logic
  166      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  167          if (~rst_n)
  168              decode_out <= 8'b0;
  169          else if (rd_state == RD_READ && con_rd < max_rd - 16) begin
  170              if (error_pos)
  171                  decode_out <= data_delay ^ forney;
  172              else
  173                  decode_out <= data_delay;
  174          end else
  175              decode_out <= 8'b0;
  176      end
  177  
  178      // 1-cycle address pre-fetch on Port B compensates for bram_rs 2-cycle read latency
  179      assign wr_en     = (wr_state == WR_WRITE && con_wr < max_rd - 1);
  180      assign rd_en     = euclid_dv || (rd_state == RD_READ);
  181      assign rd_addr_b = (rd_state == RD_READ) ? (con_rd[7:0] + 8'd1) : 8'd0;
  182  
  183      assign flag      = (rd_state == RD_READ) && (con_rd > 1 && con_rd < max_rd - 15);
  184      assign data_out  = (flag) ? decode_out : 8'b0;
  185  
  186      // 3. Dual-Port BRAM Data Delay Buffer
  187      bram_rs bram_rs_inst (
  188          .clka  (clk),
  189          .ena   (wr_en),
  190          .wea   (1'b1),
  191          .addra (con_wr[7:0]),
  192          .dina  (data_d0),
  193  
  194          .clkb  (clk),
  195          .enb   (rd_en),
  196          .addrb (rd_addr_b),
  197          .doutb (data_delay)
  198      );
  199  
  200      // 4. Reed-Solomon Sub-Modules
  201      syndrome_unit syndrome_unit_inst (
  202          .clk      (clk),
  203          .rst_n    (rst_n),
  204          .en       (en),
  205          .data_in  (data_in),
  206          .flag     (syndrome_dv),
  207          .syndrome (syndrome)
  208      );
  209  
  210      euclid_proc euclid_proc_inst (
  211          .clk      (clk),
  212          .rst_n    (rst_n),
  213          .en       (syndrome_dv),
  214          .syndrome (syndrome),
  215          .flag     (euclid_dv),
  216          .delta    (delta),
  217          .omega    (omega)
  218      );
  219  
  220      chien_search chien_search_inst (
  221          .clk   (clk),
  222          .rst_n (rst_n),
  223          .en    (euclid_dv),
  224          .delta (delta),
  225          .flag  (),
  226          .error (error_pos),
  227          .chien (chien)
  228      );
  229  
  230      forney_math forney_math_inst (
  231          .clk    (clk),
  232          .rst_n  (rst_n),
  233          .en     (euclid_dv),
  234          .omega  (omega),
  235          .chien  (chien),
  236          .flag   (),
  237          .forney (forney)
  238      );
  239  
  240      // =======================================================
  241      // 5. SIMULATION TRACKERS (Required by rs_decoder_64.v)
  242      // =======================================================
  243      // synthesis translate_off
  244      wire [8:0]  out_byte_cnt = flag ? (con_rd[8:0] - 9'd1) : 9'd0;
  245      reg  [11:0] repaired_symbol_cnt;
  246  
  247      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  248          if (~rst_n)
  249              repaired_symbol_cnt <= 12'd0;
  250          else if (rd_state == RD_READ && con_rd < max_rd - 16 && error_pos && (forney != 8'd0))
  251              repaired_symbol_cnt <= repaired_symbol_cnt + 12'd1;
  252      end
  253      // synthesis translate_on
  254  
  255  endmodule
sources_1/new/rs_codec/rs_encoder.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5  Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6  Module Name  : rs_encoder
    7  Description  : Reed-Solomon (RS) Systematic Encoder over GF(2^8).
    8                 Appends 16 Parity bytes to an incoming data stream using 
    9                 generator polynomial g(x) = (x + alpha^0)...(x + alpha^15).
   10  
   11                 Configuration:
   12                 - Payload RS(255,239): MAX_CYCLE = 254 (0-indexed: 0..254 = 255 cycles)
   13                   -> Active Data Phase = 239 cycles (count = 0..238)
   14                   -> Flush Parity Phase = 16 cycles (count = 239..254)
   15                   -> Total Output = 255 cycles.
   16                 - Header RS(32,16)   : MAX_CYCLE = 31 (0-indexed: 0..31 = 32 cycles)
   17                   -> Active Data Phase = 16 cycles (count = 0..15)
   18                   -> Flush Parity Phase = 16 cycles (count = 16..31)
   19                   -> Total Output = 32 cycles.
   20  
   21  Revision History:
   22    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Baseline RS(255,239) / RS(32,16) encoder with roots alpha^0..alpha^15.
   23    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   24      Recalculated and replaced all 16 generator polynomial multiplier coefficients (gf_0..gf_f)
   25      for g(x) = prod_{j=120}^{135} (x - alpha^(11*j)) over GF(2^8) primitive polynomial
   26      F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187) in conventional basis.
   27    - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #1 & #2]
   28      1. Changed FLUSH phase output assignment from 'C0' (Q[15] ^ data_d0) to pure 'Q[15]'
   29         so that the 16 emitted parity bytes are completely isolated from any residual 
   30         transitions on data_in / data_d0 after the active data window ends.
   31      2. Aligned default parameter MAX_CYCLE to 254 (matching 0-indexed count 0..254 = 
   32         255 total cycles used by core_tx.v).
   33  ===========================================================================
   34  */
   35  
   36  module rs_encoder # (parameter MAX_CYCLE = 254) (
   37      input           clk,
   38      input           rst_n,
   39      input           en,
   40      input   [7:0]   data_in,
   41      output          flag,
   42      output  [7:0]   data_out
   43  );
   44      
   45      reg     [7:0]   count   = 8'd0;
   46  
   47      localparam  IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   48      localparam  ACTIVE      = 4'b0010;
   49      localparam  FLUSH       = 4'b0100;
   50      localparam  END         = 4'b1000;
   51  
   52      reg     [3:0]   state;
   53      reg     [3:0]   next_state;
   54  
   55      reg     [7:0]   data_d0;
   56  
   57      reg     [7:0]   Q   [0:15];
   58      wire    [7:0]   D   [0:15];
   59      wire    [7:0]   R   [0:15];
   60  
   61      wire    [7:0]   C0;
   62      wire    [7:0]   C1;
   63  
   64      // =======================================================
   65      // FSM LOGIC
   66      // =======================================================
   67      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   68          if (~rst_n)
   69              state   <= IDLE;
   70          else
   71              state   <= next_state;
   72      end
   73  
   74      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   75          if (~rst_n)
   76              count   <= 8'd0;
   77          else if (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH)
   78              count   <= count + 1'b1;
   79          else
   80              count   <= 8'd0;
   81      end
   82  
   83      always @(*) begin
   84          case(state)
   85              IDLE:   begin
   86                          if (en) next_state <= ACTIVE;
   87                          else    next_state <= IDLE;
   88                      end
   89              ACTIVE: begin
   90                          // Read Data Phase
   91                          if (count < MAX_CYCLE - 16) next_state <= ACTIVE;
   92                          else                        next_state <= FLUSH;
   93                      end
   94              FLUSH:  begin
   95                          // Dump 16 Parity Bytes Phase
   96                          if (count < MAX_CYCLE) next_state <= FLUSH;
   97                          else                   next_state <= END;
   98                      end
   99              END:    next_state <= IDLE;
  100              default: next_state <= IDLE;
  101          endcase
  102      end
  103  
  104      // =======================================================
  105      // DATA PIPELINE & SHIFT REGISTERS
  106      // =======================================================
  107      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  108          if (~rst_n)
  109              data_d0 <= 8'b0;
  110          else
  111              data_d0 <= data_in;
  112      end
  113  
  114      reg [7:0] i;
  115      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  116          if (~rst_n) begin
  117              for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  118                  Q[i]  <= 8'b0;
  119          end 
  120          else if (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH) begin
  121              for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  122                  Q[i]  <= D[i];
  123          end 
  124          else begin
  125              for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  126                  Q[i]  <= 8'b0;
  127          end
  128      end
  129  
  130      // =======================================================
  131      // GALOIS FIELD MULTIPLIERS
  132      // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 03:54 KST] Updated to SDA OISL v2.1.2 Page 37
  133      // roots alpha^(11*j) for j = 120..135 over GF(2^8) 0x187:
  134      // =======================================================
  135      multiplier gf_0 (8'h01, C1, R[0]);
  136      multiplier gf_1 (8'ha5, C1, R[1]);
  137      multiplier gf_2 (8'h69, C1, R[2]);
  138      multiplier gf_3 (8'h1b, C1, R[3]);
  139      multiplier gf_4 (8'h9f, C1, R[4]);
  140      multiplier gf_5 (8'h68, C1, R[5]);
  141      multiplier gf_6 (8'h98, C1, R[6]);
  142      multiplier gf_7 (8'h65, C1, R[7]);
  143      multiplier gf_8 (8'h4a, C1, R[8]);
  144      multiplier gf_9 (8'h65, C1, R[9]);
  145      multiplier gf_a (8'h98, C1, R[10]);
  146      multiplier gf_b (8'h68, C1, R[11]);
  147      multiplier gf_c (8'h9f, C1, R[12]);
  148      multiplier gf_d (8'h1b, C1, R[13]);
  149      multiplier gf_e (8'h69, C1, R[14]);
  150      multiplier gf_f (8'ha5, C1, R[15]);
  151  
  152      assign  D[0]  = R[0];
  153      assign  D[1]  = R[1]  ^ Q[0];
  154      assign  D[2]  = R[2]  ^ Q[1];
  155      assign  D[3]  = R[3]  ^ Q[2];
  156      assign  D[4]  = R[4]  ^ Q[3];
  157      assign  D[5]  = R[5]  ^ Q[4];
  158      assign  D[6]  = R[6]  ^ Q[5];
  159      assign  D[7]  = R[7]  ^ Q[6];
  160      assign  D[8]  = R[8]  ^ Q[7];
  161      assign  D[9]  = R[9]  ^ Q[8];
  162      assign  D[10] = R[10] ^ Q[9];
  163      assign  D[11] = R[11] ^ Q[10];
  164      assign  D[12] = R[12] ^ Q[11];
  165      assign  D[13] = R[13] ^ Q[12];
  166      assign  D[14] = R[14] ^ Q[13];
  167      assign  D[15] = R[15] ^ Q[14];
  168  
  169      assign  C0       = Q[15] ^ data_d0;
  170      assign  C1       = (state == FLUSH) ? 8'b0 : C0;
  171  
  172      // Output Mapping ([Rev 2.1] Output pure Q[15] during FLUSH so parity is immune to data_d0)
  173      assign  flag     = (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH);
  174      assign  data_out = (state == FLUSH) ? Q[15] : data_d0;
  175  
  176  endmodule
sources_1/new/rs_codec/syndrome_unit.v
    1  `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2  /*
    3  ===========================================================================
    4  Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5  Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6  Module Name  : syndrome_unit
    7  Description  : Reed-Solomon Syndrome Computation Unit over GF(2^8).
    8                 Evaluates the incoming codeword at 16 consecutive roots 
    9                 (alpha^(11*j) for j = 120..135) over a 256-cycle evaluation window.
   10                 For shortened RS(32,16) headers, the 224 trailing zero cycles 
   11                 (and 1 trailing zero cycle for RS(255,239)) automatically 
   12                 shift the codeword roots to align with the Chien search 
   13                 starting position (alpha^-254).
   14  
   15  Revision History:
   16    - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Syndrome computation for roots alpha^0..alpha^15 over 0x11D.
   17    - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   18      Updated the 16 syndrome evaluation roots (gf_0..gf_f) to r_k = alpha^((11*(120+k)) % 255)
   19      for j = 120..135 over GF(2^8) 0x187:
   20        j=120 (alpha^45)=8'h78, j=121 (alpha^56)=8'h3f, j=122 (alpha^67)=8'hac, j=123 (alpha^78)=8'h13,
   21        j=124 (alpha^89)=8'h84, j=125 (alpha^100)=8'h06, j=126 (alpha^111)=8'he0, j=127 (alpha^122)=8'h8a,
   22        j=128 (alpha^133)=8'h9c, j=129 (alpha^144)=8'h88, j=130 (alpha^155)=8'h41, j=131 (alpha^166)=8'h73,
   23        j=132 (alpha^177)=8'h35, j=133 (alpha^188)=8'h0b, j=134 (alpha^199)=8'h0a, j=135 (alpha^210)=8'ha7.
   24    - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 12:39 KST) : [Audit Fix F10 - Enable Gating Against Invalid Tail Bytes]
   25      Gated data_in_d0 with 'en' so invalid non-zero bytes after 'en' deasserts are forced to 0.
   26    - Rev 2.5 (2026-10-29 15:19 KST) : [Audit Fix R17 - Restored 256-Cycle Pre-Shift & Syndrome Bus Order]
   27      Restored the original 256-cycle ACTIVE root shift (else if (state == ACTIVE) Q[i] <= D[i])
   28      and original syndrome bus ordering (syndrome[127:0] = {Q[15], Q[14], ..., Q[0]}) required 
   29      by euclid_proc, chien_search, and forney_math, while keeping 'data_in_d0 <= en ? data_in : 8'b0'
   30      so both F10 (tail poisoning immunity) and R17 (shortened/full RS pre-shift alignment) hold.
   31  ===========================================================================
   32  */
   33  
   34  module syndrome_unit #(
   35      parameter max = 255
   36  )(
   37      input  wire         clk,
   38      input  wire         rst_n,
   39      input  wire         en,
   40      input  wire [7:0]   data_in,
   41      output wire         flag,
   42      output wire [127:0] syndrome
   43  );
   44  
   45      reg [15:0] count = 16'd0;
   46  
   47      reg  [7:0] Q [0:15];
   48      wire [7:0] D [0:15];
   49      wire [7:0] C [0:15];
   50  
   51      localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   52      localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   53      localparam END    = 3'b100;
   54  
   55      reg [2:0] state;
   56      reg [2:0] next_state;
   57  
   58      reg [7:0] data_in_d0;
   59  
   60      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   61          if (~rst_n)
   62              state <= IDLE;
   63          else
   64              state <= next_state;
   65      end
   66  
   67      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   68          if (~rst_n)
   69              count <= 16'd0;
   70          else if (state == ACTIVE)
   71              count <= count + 1'b1;
   72          else
   73              count <= 16'd0;
   74      end
   75  
   76      always @(*) begin
   77          case (state)
   78              IDLE: begin
   79                  if (en)
   80                      next_state = ACTIVE;
   81                  else
   82                      next_state = IDLE;
   83              end
   84              ACTIVE: begin
   85                  if (count < max)
   86                      next_state = ACTIVE;
   87                  else
   88                      next_state = END;
   89              end
   90              END:     next_state = IDLE;
   91              default: next_state = IDLE;
   92          endcase
   93      end
   94  
   95      // [Rev 2.3/2.5 - Fix F10] Gate input with 'en' so invalid tail bytes (e.g. 0xA5) become 8'b0
   96      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   97          if (~rst_n)
   98              data_in_d0 <= 8'b0;
   99          else
  100              data_in_d0 <= en ? data_in : 8'b0;
  101      end
  102  
  103      integer i;
  104      always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  105          if (~rst_n) begin
  106              for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  107                  Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  108          end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  109              // [Rev 2.5 - Fix R17] Run full 256-cycle Horner shift (with data_in_d0 = 0 when en == 0)
  110              for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  111                  Q[i] <= D[i];
  112          end else begin
  113              for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  114                  Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  115          end
  116      end
  117  
  118      // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 03:54 KST] Evaluation roots alpha^(11*j) for j = 120..135 over GF(0x187)
  119      multiplier gf_0 (8'h78, Q[0],  C[0]);
  120      multiplier gf_1 (8'h3f, Q[1],  C[1]);
  121      multiplier gf_2 (8'hac, Q[2],  C[2]);
  122      multiplier gf_3 (8'h13, Q[3],  C[3]);
  123      multiplier gf_4 (8'h84, Q[4],  C[4]);
  124      multiplier gf_5 (8'h06, Q[5],  C[5]);
  125      multiplier gf_6 (8'he0, Q[6],  C[6]);
  126      multiplier gf_7 (8'h8a, Q[7],  C[7]);
  127      multiplier gf_8 (8'h9c, Q[8],  C[8]);
  128      multiplier gf_9 (8'h88, Q[9],  C[9]);
  129      multiplier gf_a (8'h41, Q[10], C[10]);
  130      multiplier gf_b (8'h73, Q[11], C[11]);
  131      multiplier gf_c (8'h35, Q[12], C[12]);
  132      multiplier gf_d (8'h0b, Q[13], C[13]);
  133      multiplier gf_e (8'h0a, Q[14], C[14]);
  134      multiplier gf_f (8'ha7, Q[15], C[15]);
  135  
  136      assign D[0]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[0];
  137      assign D[1]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[1];
  138      assign D[2]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[2];
  139      assign D[3]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[3];
  140      assign D[4]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[4];
  141      assign D[5]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[5];
  142      assign D[6]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[6];
  143      assign D[7]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[7];
  144      assign D[8]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[8];
  145      assign D[9]  = data_in_d0 ^ C[9];
  146      assign D[10] = data_in_d0 ^ C[10];
  147      assign D[11] = data_in_d0 ^ C[11];
  148      assign D[12] = data_in_d0 ^ C[12];
  149      assign D[13] = data_in_d0 ^ C[13];
  150      assign D[14] = data_in_d0 ^ C[14];
  151      assign D[15] = data_in_d0 ^ C[15];
  152  
  153      assign syndrome[127:120] = (state == END) ? Q[15] : 8'b0;
  154      assign syndrome[119:112] = (state == END) ? Q[14] : 8'b0;
  155      assign syndrome[111:104] = (state == END) ? Q[13] : 8'b0;
  156      assign syndrome[103:96]  = (state == END) ? Q[12] : 8'b0;
  157      assign syndrome[95:88]   = (state == END) ? Q[11] : 8'b0;
  158      assign syndrome[87:80]   = (state == END) ? Q[10] : 8'b0;
  159      assign syndrome[79:72]   = (state == END) ? Q[9]  : 8'b0;
  160      assign syndrome[71:64]   = (state == END) ? Q[8]  : 8'b0;
  161      assign syndrome[63:56]   = (state == END) ? Q[7]  : 8'b0;
  162      assign syndrome[55:48]   = (state == END) ? Q[6]  : 8'b0;
  163      assign syndrome[47:40]   = (state == END) ? Q[5]  : 8'b0;
  164      assign syndrome[39:32]   = (state == END) ? Q[4]  : 8'b0;
  165      assign syndrome[31:24]   = (state == END) ? Q[3]  : 8'b0;
  166      assign syndrome[23:16]   = (state == END) ? Q[2]  : 8'b0;
  167      assign syndrome[15:8]    = (state == END) ? Q[1]  : 8'b0;
  168      assign syndrome[7:0]     = (state == END) ? Q[0]  : 8'b0;
  169  
  170      assign flag = (state == END);
  171  
  172  endmodule
